kids.d_en: Safety and disconnect switches provide manual control of electrical circuits to connect and disconnect power from industrial machinery, electrical systems, and motors for maintenance or in an emergency.

kids.d_tr: Güneş panelleri ve aksesuarları güneş ışığını elektriğe dönüştürür.
kids.d_en: Solar panels and accessories convert sunlight to electricity.

kids.d_tr: Güneş panelleri ve setleri güneş ışığını elektriğe dönüştürür.
kids.d_en: Solar panels and kits convert sunlight to electricity. They supplement or replace the need for outside utilities, serving as a cost-effective and environmentally-friendly source of energy for homes and businesses.

kids.d_tr: Şarj kontrol cihazları akımı düzenleyerek aküyü aşırı ısınma ve aşırı şarjdan korur, tam dolum için doğru gerilimi verir.
kids.d_en: Charge controllers protect batteries from overheating or overcharging by regulating the current, or delivering the appropriate voltage to a battery to fully charge it. They also regulate the electricity delivered to the load.

kids.tr: Güneş Enerjisi Test ve Ölçüm Cihazları

kids.d_tr: Güneş paneli kabloları panelleri güç işleme ve dağıtım sistemlerine bağlar ve üretilen enerjiyi aktarır.
kids.d_en: PV (Photovoltaic) solar wires connect solar panels to their power processing and distribution systems and transfer the generated power between them.

kids.d_tr: Geçici güç dağıtım ürünleri, kalıcı elektrik bağlantısının bulunmadığı yerlerde enerji sağlar.
kids.d_en: Temporary power distribution products provide electricity in locations where permanent electrical connections are inaccessible or unavailable.

kids.d_tr: Seyyar dağıtım kutuları ve arabaları elektrik yüklerini bağlayan merkez görevi görür; çok sayıda çıkışla enerjiyi dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Temporary power distribution boxes and carts serve as hubs to connect electrical loads and have multiple outlets to distribute power. Also called power spider boxes, they provide temporary power for locations without permanent electricity sources. Common applications include construction, outdoor events, emergency services, and remote work locations.

kids.tr: Güç Merkezleri ve Taşınabilir Güç İstasyonları
kids.d_tr: Güç merkezleri ve taşınabilir güç istasyonları, transformatör ile dağıtım panosunu birleştirerek jeneratör veya geçici hattan gelen enerjiyi düzenler.
kids.d_en: Power centers and portable power stations act as a combination transformer and distribution panel to regulate and distribute power from a generator, temporary power pole, or other 480V AC power source. They are suitable for indoor or outdoor use and provide ground fault circuit interrupters (GFCIs) to help protect against electrical shock. They are commonly used to supply power for temporary needs, such as outdoor events, construction sites, disaster recovery, and off-grid operations.

kids.tr: Geçici Güç Dağıtım Kabloları ve Aksesuarları
kids.d_tr: Bu aksesuarlar büyük etkinlik ve şantiye gibi yerlerde geçici enerji sağlanmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: These accessories help provide temporary power where needed, such as large events or construction.

kids.tr: Endüstriyel Kumanda, Otomasyon ve Makine Emniyeti
kids.en: Industrial Controls, Automation and Machine Safety
kids.d_tr: Endüstriyel kumanda, otomasyon ve makine emniyeti ürünleri makineleri ve otomatik süreçleri izler ve denetler.
kids.d_en: Industrial controls, automation, and machine safety products monitor and regulate machinery and automated processes.

kids.tr: Kumanda Kutuları, Askı Kumandalar ve Anahtarlar
kids.en: Control Stations, Control Pendants & Tumbler Switches
kids.d_tr: Kumanda kutuları, askı kumandalar ve anahtarlar; makine ve sistemlerin devrelerini açıp kapatır veya işlevleri arasında geçiş yapar.
kids.d_en: Control stations, control pendants, and tumbler switches turn circuits on and off to industrial machinery, equipment, and systems to power them or switch between functionalities.

kids.d_tr: Kumanda butonları ve sinyal lambaları endüstriyel ekipmanı kontrol eder ve durumunu gösterir.
kids.d_en: Operator switches and pilot lights connect with industrial equipment, machinery, and systems to control or indicate their status.

kids.d_tr: Limit anahtarları fiziksel temasa tepki vererek nesnenin varlığını, yokluğunu veya belirlenen konuma ulaştığını algılar.
kids.d_en: Limit switches react to physical contact to detect whether objects are present, absent, or at their preset destination.

kids.d_tr: Mikro anahtarlar, hızlı ve güvenilir tepki gereken düşük gerilimli sistemlerde temasla devreyi anında açıp kapatan küçük elektromekanik elemanlardır.
kids.d_en: Snap-action switches are small electromagnetic devices that react to physical contact to quickly open or close circuits in low-voltage systems and devices that need fast and reliable responses. Also known as miniature snap-action switches, they require minimal compression to activate their contacts and have small constructions that allow them to operate in tight or confined spaces. Micro snap-action switches actuate quickly for applications like safety devices, control panels, appliances, and HVAC equipment.

kids.d_tr: Seviye kontrol sensörleri ve anahtarları tank ve kaplardaki sıvı seviyesini izler; belirlenen eşikte devreyi açıp kapatır.
kids.d_en: Liquid-level control sensors and switches monitor fluid levels inside tanks, containers, and vessels and turn circuits on and off when levels reach a preset threshold.

kids.d_tr: Basınç, vakum ve titreşim anahtarları endüstriyel sistemlerdeki koşulları izleyerek hasarı ve duruşu önler.
kids.d_en: Pressure, vacuum, and vibration switches monitor conditions in industrial systems and equipment to prevent damage and downtime.

kids.d_tr: Yakınlık, hareket ve görüntü sensörleri hedef nesnenin varlığını algılar veya şekil dizilerini okur.
kids.d_en: Proximity, motion, and vision sensors observe the presence of a target object or read a series of shapes.

kids.d_tr: Makine emniyeti sensörleri ve kilit anahtarları, kaza ve hasarı önlemek için makinelerin enerjisini keser.
kids.d_en: Machine safety sensors and interlock switches shut off power to industrial machinery and systems to help prevent accidents and damage.

kids.d_tr: Endüstriyel otomasyon cihazları, tesislerde enerji tasarrufu ve maliyet düşüşü sağlayan ekipmanı kontrol eder.
kids.d_en: Industrial automation devices control equipment used to help facilities save energy and reduce costs.

kids.d_tr: Röleler, enerjilendiğinde alt devrelere giden gücü düzenleyen elektrikle çalışan anahtarlardır.
kids.d_en: Relays are electrically-operated switches that regulate power to downstream circuits when energized to control low-current equipment, devices, machinery, and electrical systems.

kids.d_tr: Robotik ekipmanlar; ayırma, montaj ve konveyörde toplayıp yerleştirme gibi tekrarlayan işleri otomatikleştiren bağımsız veya entegre ünitelerdir.
kids.d_en: Robotics equipment includes standalone devices and other units that integrate into existing systems to automate repetitive jobs such as sorting, assembling, and picking and placing items on conveyors.

kids.d_tr: Işıklı kuleler, bir ekipmanın veya sistemin durumunu bildiren dikey ışık dizileridir.
kids.d_en: Tower lights are vertically stacked light arrays that communicate the status of a piece of equipment or system.

kids.d_tr: Motor kumanda ürünleri elektrik motorlarını çalıştırır, durdurur, hızını düzenler ve dönüş yönünü değiştirir.
kids.d_en: Motor controls start, stop, regulate the speed, and change the rotation of electric motors.

kids.d_tr: Kontaktörler ve termik röleler birlikte motor yol verici gruplarını oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Contactors and overload relays combine to create motor starter assemblies.

kids.tr: Motor Yol Vericiler ve Kombine Starterler
kids.d_tr: Motor yol vericiler ve kombine starterler motorların kontrolünü sağlar ve onları hasara karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Motor starters and combination starters provide control of motors and help protect them against damage.

kids.d_tr: Motor izleme ve yönetim sistemleri gerçek zamanlı performans takibi ve tanılama sunar; anormal yük ve koşulları erkenden algılar.
kids.d_en: Motor monitoring and management systems provide comprehensive control of electrical motors for real-time performance monitoring and diagnostics, detecting abnormal loads and other conditions that might lead to motor system damage and breakdown. These customizable systems connect with communication protocols and are used in motor management systems that control critical applications like wastewater management, oil and gas processing, food and beverage production, and pumps.

kids.d_tr: Paket ve motor şalterleri motorları durduran, çalıştıran veya yönünü değiştiren elle kumandalı elemanlardır.
kids.d_en: Drum and motor starter switches are manually operated controls that stop, start, or reverse the direction of motors.

kids.d_tr: Motor EMC filtreleri parazit kaynağının yakınına takılarak duruş anındaki gerilim sıçramalarının yol açtığı kısa devreleri önler.
kids.d_en: Motor EMC suppressors install near the source of interference to help eliminate short circuits caused by voltage peaks and surges during motor shutdowns. These suppressors prevent parts and components from retaining high electrical frequencies, which helps extend the overall life of coil windings and contacts. They are typically mounted inside the motor terminal box, beneath the motor contactor, or configured to fasten to a DIN rail. By reducing the risk of shorts, these motor suppressors enable equipment to run smoothly and minimize costs and downtime.

kids.en: Contactor & Motor Starter Replacement Parts & Accessories
kids.d_tr: Kontaktör ve starter yedek parçaları, grupların bakımını, modifikasyonunu veya kurulumunu sağlar.
kids.d_en: Contactor and motor starter replacement parts and accessories maintain, modify, or build contactors and motor starter assemblies.

kids.d_tr: Transformatörler, kesintisiz güç kaynakları ve güç kaynakları; enerjiyi cihaza uyarlayarak veya kesintide çalışır tutarak hassas ekipmanı korur.
kids.d_en: Transformers, UPS, and power supplies keep sensitive electronic equipment safe by adapting power to suit their needs or keeping equipment online during outages.

kids.d_tr: Transformatörler ve faz çeviriciler besleme gerilimini uyarlayarak ekipmanı hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Transformers and phase converters adapt power supplies, protecting equipment from damage.

kids.d_tr: Kesintisiz güç kaynakları ve aküleri; kesinti sırasında bilgisayar ve sunucu gibi hassas cihazları veri kaybı ile hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Uninterruptible Power Supply and UPS batteries provide backup power to sensitive electronic equipment like computers and servers to protect against damage or data loss during an outage.

kids.d_tr: Güç kaynakları alternatif akımı daha temiz doğru akıma çevirir ve gerilimi düşürerek ekipmanı korur.
kids.d_en: Power supplies adapt alternating AC power to cleaner DC power and step the voltage down to protect electrical equipment.

kids.d_tr: Güç şartlandırıcılar gelen alternatif akımı stabilize ederek bilgisayar, televizyon ve ses sistemi gibi hassas cihazları korur.
kids.d_en: Power conditioners stabilize incoming AC power to protect sensitive electrical equipment like computers, TVs, and sound systems. Also known as line conditioners, they provide surge protection, prevent voltage fluctuations, and remove electrical interference.

kids.d_tr: Mikro veri merkezi sistemleri bilişim varlıkları için yerinde veri depolama ve koruma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Micro data center systems provide in-house data storage and protection for IT assets. These standalone units analyze, process, and back up data in real-time to reduce security threats. They use data redundancy protocols for added protection and have integrated cooling systems that keep data safe in harsh environments. Their modular design makes them easy to install and expand, and they are commonly used for data storage solutions in the finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and energy industries.

d_tr: Elektronik ürünler ve bataryalar ofis, endüstriyel tesis ve diğer çalışma alanlarında iletişimi mümkün kılar.
d_en: Electronics and batteries facilitate communication in offices, industrial facilities, and other work areas.

kids.d_tr: Piller, aküler ve şarj cihazları elektrikli cihaz ve ekipmana enerji ve taşınabilirlik sağlar.
kids.d_en: Batteries and battery chargers provide power and portability to electrical devices and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Pil saklama kutuları yedek pilleri bir arada tutar; kaybolmalarını ve kutuplarının kısa devre yapmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Battery storage cases and organizers hold spare batteries to prevent them from getting lost within a toolbox or office drawer and to shield their terminals from contact with materials that can cause short circuits or leaks. These organizers also separate batteries by size for tracking inventory and saving time when replacing batteries. Sometimes called battery holders, battery organizers are often used by maintenance workers and military personnel to provide a travel case for keeping batteries at hand to make in-the-field replacements.

kids.d_tr: Tek kullanımlık piller, şarjı bittiğinde değiştirilen tek seferlik güç kaynaklarıdır.
kids.d_en: Disposable batteries are single-use power sources that are replaced after they run out of charge.

kids.d_tr: Pompa aküleri, ana pompa devre dışı kaldığında yedek pompayı çalıştıracak enerjiyi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Sump pump batteries supply power to operate a backup sump pump when the primary sump pump fails. They are standby or storage batteries that work with the secondary pump during power outages or mechanical failures to prevent flooding or water damage. These batteries are designed to work with specific sump pump models.

kids.d_tr: Taşınabilir şarj üniteleri, kendi şarj cihazından uzaktayken mobil cihazları doldurmak için istasyon veya harici batarya sunar.
kids.d_en: Portable device chargers provide a charging station or external battery for recharging mobile devices when users are away from their factory-supplied chargers.

kids.d_tr: Şarjlı piller ve şarj cihazları tek kullanımlık pillere yeniden kullanılabilir bir alternatif sunar.
kids.d_en: Rechargeable batteries and chargers provide a reusable alternative to disposable batteries. These batteries (also called secondary cells) can be replenished for multiple uses by a compatible charger to eliminate the need for constant replacement. They're ideal for powering high-drain equipment such as keyless entry systems, digital audio devices, digital cameras, GPS, and video game controllers. They are sized according to the same ANSI/IEC standards as disposable batteries, so they can be used as direct replacements.

kids.tr: Kuru Tip ve Lityum Aküler ile Şarj Cihazları
kids.en: Sealed Lead Acid & Lithium Batteries & Chargers
kids.d_tr: Kuru tip ve lityum aküler ile şarj cihazları büyük cihazlara enerji verir ve endüstriyel sistemlere yedek güç sağlar.
kids.d_en: Sealed lead acid and lithium batteries and chargers power large devices and supply backup or reserve power for industrial systems.

kids.d_tr: Elektronik haberleşme ekipmanları ses ve görüntü cihazlarını ağa bağlayan ve içeriği monitör ile hoparlörde oynatan ürünleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Electronic communication equipment includes devices and accessories for connecting audio-video equipment to network services and playing visual content on external devices like monitors and televisions, or audio on speakers.

kids.d_tr: Görüntü ekipmanları arasında televizyon, monitör, kamera ve oynatıcılar bulunur; uyumlu sistemlerle görsel içeriği kaydeder ve oynatır.
kids.d_en: Video equipment includes televisions, monitors, cameras, camcorders, and DVD players that record and play visual content with compatible systems.

kids.d_tr: Ses ekipmanları uzak noktalar arasında iletişim kurmak üzere ses sinyallerini iletir, alır ve yeniden üretir.
kids.d_en: Audio equipment transmits, receives, and reproduces audio signals to communicate between locations over a distance.

kids.d_tr: Ses ve görüntü aksesuarları kabloları cihazlara bağlar ve ekipman için saklama alanı sunar.
kids.d_en: Audio-video accessories connect cables to devices and provide space to store equipment.

kids.en: Antenna and Satellite Dish Mounts & Accessories
kids.d_tr: Anten ve çanak montaj elemanları anten, uydu çanağı veya gözetim ekipmanını sabitler ve konumlandırır.
kids.d_en: Antenna and satellite dish mounts secure and position antennas, satellite dishes, or surveillance equipment. These mounts are often used to install equipment on roofs or other elevated areas.

kids.d_tr: Veri giriş cihazları; tesise girişi denetlemek veya ekipmana kod girmek için endüstriyel alanlarda kullanılan klavye ve tuş takımlarını kapsar.
kids.d_en: Data entry devices include keyboards and keypads used in industrial areas for security to allow people entrance to facilities or to enter codes to control equipment and devices.

kids.d_tr: Haberleşme ekipmanları ticari ve konaklama ortamlarında kullanılan görüntü sistemleri, monitörler, telefonlar ve aksesuarları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Communication equipment includes AV equipment, TV monitors, phones, and accessories for use in commercial and hospitality environments.

kids.d_tr: Mesaj panosu aksesuarları; tabela harfleri, koruyucu kapaklar ve plastik harf ile rakam tepsilerini kapsar.
kids.d_en: When you need sign letters and other sign accessories, such as protective sign covers and trays for plastic letters, numbers and symbols, shop Grainger. Stock up on everything you need to create and manage messages on your display letterboard. Come to Grainger for magnets, storage solutions, sign letters, plastic letters and other sign accessories.

d_tr: Bağlantı elemanları, birden fazla malzeme veya nesneyi mekanik olarak birleştiren hırdavat ürünleridir.
d_en: Fasteners are pieces of hardware that mechanically join multiple materials or objects together.

kids.d_tr: Cıvatalar ve vidalar dıştan dişli erkek bağlantı elemanlarıdır; dişi bağlantı elemanı veya delikle güvenli bir bağ kurar.
kids.d_en: Bolts and screws are externally threaded male fasteners used with female-threaded fasteners or holes to provide secure, reliable fastening.

kids.d_tr: Altı köşe başlı cıvatalar anahtarla sıkılır; yüksek çekme dayanımı gerektiren güvenli bağlantılar sağlar.
kids.d_en: Hex head bolts have hexagonal heads that are tightened with a wrench to provide secure and reliable fastening that requires high-tensile strength.

kids.d_tr: İmbus başlı cıvatalar altıgen yuvasıyla alyan anahtarla sıkılır ve bağlantı yüzeyiyle aynı hizada oturur.
kids.d_en: Socket head cap screws feature a hexagonal recess for tightening and loosening with an Allen wrench or hex key, providing a flush fit with the fastening surface.

kids.d_tr: Matkap uçlu ve kılavuzlu vidalar malzemeleri birbirine sabitlemeyi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drilling and tapping screws allow users to fasten materials together.

kids.d_tr: Makine vidaları küçük çaplı bağlantı elemanlarıdır; yüksek adetli imalata uygun olup neredeyse her yüzeyde kullanılabilir.
kids.d_en: Machine screws are small-diameter fasteners that fit most high-volume machining applications and can be used on almost any type of surface.

kids.d_tr: Halkalı cıvataların gövdesi yapıya sabitlenir, üstündeki halka ise halat, kanca ve diğer donanımın bağlanmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Eye bolts have a shank for anchoring to structures or equipment and a ring (or loop) at the top for attaching rope, hooks, or other hardware. They're used as anchor eye bolts for routing or tying down wire and cable. Machinery or lifting eye bolts are rated for vertical or angular lifting up to their specified capacity.

kids.d_tr: U cıvatalar ağır nesneleri tavan, duvar ve direklerden taşır.
kids.d_en: U-bolts support heavy objects from ceilings, walls, and poles. They are stronger than routing clamps and hangers. U-bolts are fastened with nuts for a secure connection and pair with mounting plates for added support. Cushioned and vibration-damping U-bolts help reduce vibration to protect pipes.

kids.d_tr: Yuvarlak başlı cıvatalar; kilit başlı, basamaklı, asansör ve pulluk cıvatalarını kapsar.
kids.d_en: Round bolts include carriage and step bolts, elevator bolts, plow bolts, and freight car bolts.

kids.d_tr: Omuzlu cıvatalar kasnak, bağlantı kolu ve diğer hareketli parçaların dönmesine imkan verir.
kids.d_en: Shoulder screws allow the rotation of pulleys, linkages, and other moving parts in engines and mechanical applications. Also called shoulder bolts, they feature a plain, non-threaded section under their heads to allow for free rotation, while their ends feature threaded sections to secure them in place.

kids.d_tr: Setuskur vidalar genellikle başsızdır; bir parçadaki dişli deliğe takılarak onu başka bir parçaya karşı yerinde tutar.
kids.d_en: Set screws typically have no heads and are fastened into a threaded hole on a component to hold it in place against another component. Also called grub screws, they are commonly used to hold sleeves, collars, knobs, and gears in place on rotating shafts. They come in a variety of materials and tip shapes, which dictate their holding power.

kids.d_tr: Askı cıvataları ve dübel vidaları, iki farklı bağlantı yüzeyinin birleştirilmesi gereken ahşap-ahşap veya ahşap-hırdavat bağlantılarında kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hanger bolts and dowel screws join wood-to-wood or wood-to-hardware where two different fastening surfaces need to be connected. They are used in furniture, handrails, legs, brackets, displays, and light construction applications that require hidden or double‑ended fastening.

kids.d_tr: Bu bağlantı pimleri elektrik panosu, kalın belge veya birkaç metal katman içinden geçerek bağlantı kurar.
kids.d_en: These binding posts feed through electrical panels, thick documents, or several metal layers to create connections. Also called Chicago screws, these two-component fastener systems consist of an internally threaded post barrel and a binding screw.

kids.d_tr: Kelebek vidaların büyük başları kanat veya tırtıllıdır; tek elle kolayca kavranıp döndürülür.
kids.d_en: Thumb screws have large heads with wings, ridges, or protruding tips that make them easy to grip and turn with one hand. They are often used on access panels and other frequently used parts.

kids.d_tr: Düşmez pano vidaları tutucularla eşleşerek söküldüğünde sık kullanılan erişim panellerinde takılı kalır.
kids.d_en: Captive panel screws pair with retainers to stay fixed onto frequently used access panels of machinery or electronics when removed. These attached screws secure doors and covers to check ports or controls and are also used on assembly lines where dropped or loose fasteners could cause damage.

kids.d_tr: Kare başlı cıvataların geniş düz yüzeyleri vardır ve anahtarla kolayca sıkılır.
kids.d_en: Square-head bolts have large, flat sides and tighten easily with a wrench. They are typically used in tight or dark environments where visibility is limited and a machinist or fabricator must tighten the bolt blind: it is simple to fit a tool over their square shape even when no visual markers are available. These bolts come both partially and fully threaded. In some cases, a partially threaded bolt may have threads that extend all the way to the top of the head, provided it meets the minimum thread length requirement. This can make the screw look fully threaded.

kids.d_tr: Cıvata ve vida kapakları başları korur ve görünümünü iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Bolt and screw caps enhance and protect bolt and screw heads. These plastic or metal covers push or snap on and are decorative as well as protective. To find the correct cap width, measure the head from one flat to the other.

kids.d_tr: Somunlar dişi dişleriyle erkek bağlantı elemanına takılır ve montaj yüzeyine doğru sıkılır.
kids.d_en: Nuts screw onto male-threaded fasteners using matching female threads and tighten towards a mounting surface.

kids.d_tr: Altı köşe somunlar kilitleme gerektirmeyen uygulamalarda erkek bağlantı elemanına takılır.
kids.d_en: Hex nuts screw onto male-threaded fasteners in non-locking applications. They feature six flat sides that allow for installation with wrenches or other tools. They come in different finishes and grades for various applications.

kids.d_tr: Emniyetli somunlar erkek elemanı veya montaj yüzeyini kavrayarak istenmeyen dönmeye direnir.
kids.d_en: Lock nuts resist unwanted rotation by engaging the male fastener or the mounting surface. They come in a variety of locking methods depending on the application and rotation resistance required.

kids.d_tr: Başlıklı somunlar açıkta kalan erkek elemanlara takılarak dişleri korur ve temiz bir görünüm sağlar.
kids.d_en: Cap nuts screw onto exposed male fasteners to protect their threads and provide a finished look. Also called capped, dome, or acorn nuts, they come in a variety of shapes and profiles that allow users to match certain aesthetics or fit inside of tight assemblies.

kids.d_tr: Manşon somunlar iki erkek dişli elemanı birbirine bağlayan bir ek görevi görür.
kids.d_en: Coupling nuts act as a junction to connect two male-threaded fasteners. Their increased length and thread engagement reduce thread stripping under heavy loads.

kids.d_tr: Flanşlı somunlar sıkma kuvvetini normal somunlara göre daha geniş bir alana yayar.
kids.d_en: Flange nuts spread their fastening force over a wider area than traditional nuts. This reduces the potential for damage to the mounting surface and allows for a more secure connection on uneven mounting surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Kare somunlar kare biçimli açıklık, kanal ve yuvalara oturur.
kids.d_en: Square nuts fit into square-shaped openings, channels, or slots. They are primarily used in blind fastening situations where their flat sides can engage the mounting surface and prevent undesired rotation.

kids.d_tr: Kelebek somunların iki kanadı sayesinde elle daha yüksek tork uygulanır; sık sıkılıp gevşetilen bağlantılarda kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Wing nuts feature two integrated wings to allow fastening by hand with greater torque than thumb nuts, and are commonly used when a fastener is repeatedly tightened and loosened.

kids.d_tr: Tırtıllı somunlar bağlantıyı alet kullanmadan sabitleme imkanı verir.
kids.d_en: Thumb nuts provide a tool-free method of securing a fastener in place. They fasten by hand and are used in applications where repeated tightening and loosening is needed.

kids.d_tr: Kollu somunlar alet gerektirmeden yüksek kuvvet uygulanmasını sağlar; sık sıkma ve gevşetme için tasarlanmıştır.
kids.d_en: Handle nuts provide a tool-free, high-leverage fastener that is designed for repeated tightening and loosening.

kids.d_tr: Halkalı somunlar erkek dişli elemana takılır ve bağlantı noktası olarak metal bir halka sunar.
kids.d_en: Eye nuts screw onto male-threaded fasteners and provide a metal loop as a mounting point. They are round, oval, or teardrop in shape and can be made with several different materials and finishes.

kids.d_tr: Kaynak somunları kaynak flanşı ile dişi dişli somunu birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Weld nuts combine a welding flange with a female threaded nut. This provides a threaded mounting point that can be welded into place.

kids.d_tr: Perçin somunların gövdesinde çepeçevre bir kanal bulunur.
kids.d_en: Clinch nuts have an annual recess in the shank. When they are pressed into unthreaded holes in sheet metal, the material folds into the recess to hold the nut securely in place. Clinch nuts also have serrations that bite into the sheet metal to help prevent torque-out of the fastener.

kids.d_tr: Kafes ve yaylı somunlar, diş açmanın mümkün olmadığı panellerde bağlantı noktası sağlar.
kids.d_en: Cage nuts and spring nuts provide mounting points on panels where tapping threads would be impossible. They clip onto the panel surface and engage the male-threaded fastener directly or with an integrated nut. They come in several shapes which dictate how and where they are used.

kids.d_tr: Ahşap için T somunlar ahşap yüzeye gömülerek metal, dişi dişli bir bağlantı noktası oluşturur.
kids.d_en: T-nuts for wood embed into wood surfaces to provide metallic, female-threaded mounting points. Their integrated prongs embed into the wood surface as they are tightened into place and anchor against rotation.

kids.d_tr: Baskılı somunlar ve tutucular parçaları erkek dişli elemana hızla sabitler.
kids.d_en: Push nuts and retainers provide a fast method of securing components to a male-threaded fastener. They are pushed onto fasteners rather than being screwed or tightened into place.

kids.d_tr: Sızdırmaz somunlar bağlantı elemanı ile yüzey arasında hava geçirmez bir yalıtım kurarak sıvı ve hava kaçağını önler.
kids.d_en: Sealing nuts eliminate fluid and air leakage by creating an airtight seal between fasteners and surfaces. They reduce vibration and decrease noise, making them ideal for loud machinery with moving parts.

kids.d_tr: Pullar bağlantı elemanının baskısını yüzeye eşit dağıtır; zamanla gevşemeyi azaltır ve elemanın düzgün bir yüzeye oturmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Washers distribute the pressure of a fastener head evenly over a surface to reduce loosening over time and ensure the fastener is pressed against a smooth surface.

kids.d_tr: Düz pullar cıvata veya vida sıkıldığında baskıyı eşit biçimde dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Flat washers evenly distribute pressure when a bolt or screw is tightened. Its thin, plate-shape increases surface area to prevent the loosening and pullout of a fastener. They also relieve surface friction and can be used as spacers when additional clearance between objects is necessary. Flat washers come in different shapes and sizes to fit matching bolts for various applications.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı pullar cıvatayı iş parçasının dişli deliğine kilitleyerek gerginlik oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Lock washers create tension by locking the bolt or screw into the workpiece’s threaded hole. These washers are frequently used in high-vibration environments to prevent the fastener assembly from loosening.

kids.d_tr: İzolasyon pulları çok dayanıklı ve korozyona dirençlidir; vidaları yüzeyden, nemden, kirden ve elektrikten yalıtır.
kids.d_en: Insulator washers are highly-durable and corrosion-resistant to insulate screws and other fasteners from mounting surfaces, moisture, dirt, and electricity. Also known as shoulder washers, they dampen vibration and seal leaks. They are used in electrical, HVAC, automotive, and construction applications.

kids.d_tr: Havşa pullar çanak biçimlidir; havşa başlı vidaların yüzeyle aynı hizada oturmasını ve düzgün bir görünüm sağlar.
kids.d_en: Countersunk washers are bowl-shaped to allow flat or oval countersunk head screws to lie flush with the work surface and to create a more professional finish. Their recessed shape also prevents the screws from damaging soft material. Countersunk washers are often used when installing or repairing wood trim to create a smooth, finished appearance over and around the fastener assembly.

kids.d_tr: Küresel pullar hizasız yüzeyleri telafi edecek şekilde tasarlanmıştır; fikstür uygulamalarına uygundur.
kids.d_en: Spherical washers are designed to compensate for misaligned surfaces, making them suitable for fixture applications. They help prevent bolts from bending and twisting and have two components: a male washer with a narrower inside diameter and a female washer that it connects with. The male washer has a convex shape that fits into the concave shape of the female washer, and both share the same radius.

kids.d_tr: Yapısal pullar kalın ve ağır hizmet tipidir; yüksek dayanımlı bağlantı elemanlarıyla mekanik ve yapısal kullanım içindir.
kids.d_en: Structural washers are thick and heavy-duty for mechanical and structural use with high-strength fasteners. They are typically found in steel-to-steel connections for bridges, buildings, and other infrastructure.

kids.d_tr: Ogee pulların dış çapı eşleştiği cıvatanın çapının dört katıdır; zorlu ortamlarda ek takviye sağlar.
kids.d_en: Ogee washers have an outside diameter that is four times larger than the diameter of the paired bolt to provide additional reinforcement in harsh environments. They also have an elevated inside diameter to provide added height and thickness.

kids.d_tr: Tutucu pullar sıkı bir geçme oluşturarak dönmeyi ve gevşemeyi engeller.
kids.d_en: Retaining washers create a tight fit that prevents turning and loosening. Also called push nuts, they grip the outside of bolts, screws, and shaft components, creating a tight fit and insulating and cushioning the fastener.

kids.d_tr: Dişli çubuklar ve saplamalar, parçaları yerine monte eden, destekleyen ve güçlendiren silindirik bağlantı elemanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Threaded rods and studs are cylindrical fasteners that mount, brace, and reinforce components into place.

kids.d_tr: Tam dişli çubuk ve saplamalarda diş uçtan uca devam eder; somun ve dişi elemanlarla tam kavrama sağlar.
kids.d_en: Fully-threaded rods and studs have threads from one end to the other for full engagement of nuts or other female-threaded components. Also known as all-thread rods (ATR) or thread full-length rods (TFL), they provide high grip strength and evenly distributed tension when mounting and securing components. Note: studs are under 12”.

kids.d_tr: Çift uçtan dişli saplamaların iki ucu da dişlidir; beton, metal veya ahşapta sıkı geçme için ölçüye kesilebilir.
kids.d_en: Double-end threaded rods and studs are threaded on both ends and may be cut to specific lengths for tight fits into concrete, metal, or wood substrates. The rod fits into an unthreaded hole with both threaded ends exposed to attach fasteners. They are commonly used in construction applications, assembly housings, metal fabrication, and machinery repair. Double-end rods can also be bent to make specialized fasteners such as anchor bolts and U-bolts.

kids.d_tr: Tek uçtan dişli saplamaların bir ucu dişli, diğer ucu düzdür.
kids.d_en: Single-end threaded rods and studs have threads on one end and an unthreaded end on the other. The threaded end allows for secure attachment to fasteners like nuts, while the unthreaded end can be inserted into pre-drilled holes or secured by welding. These rods and studs are commonly used in construction, manufacturing, and other industries to create adjustable connections, secure components, or attach accessories.

kids.d_tr: Montajlı saplamalar iş parçasının yüzeyine bağlanarak kalıcı ve sabit bir erkek diş oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Mounted studs bond to the surface of a workpiece to provide a permanent, stationary male thread. Also known as mountable threaded studs, they are typically used in repair applications where access to one side of the mounting surface is limited or without a through-hole, such as in machinery, equipment, and motors.

kids.d_tr: Perçin saplamalar montaj sırasında malzemeye gömülen çentik ve tırtıllarıyla güçlü ve güvenli bir tutuş sağlar.
kids.d_en: Clinch studs are designed with notches, cuts, or serrations that bite into and displace material during installation to ensure a strong and secure hold. They are installed in pre-drilled, unthreaded holes using a specialized tool that presses the nut firmly into place.

kids.d_tr: Dübeller ve ankrajlar, bir nesnenin veya ekipmanın yüzeye bağlanması için güvenli bir montaj noktası oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Anchors create a secure mounting point to attach an item or equipment to a mounting surface.

kids.d_tr: Beton, briket ve tuğla dübelleri duvar yüzeylerine takılır ve nesneleri sabitlemek için dişli bir bağlantı noktası sunar.
kids.d_en: Anchors for concrete, block, and brick install into masonry surfaces and provide a threaded connection point to secure items into place.

kids.d_tr: Kimyasal ankrajlar, montaj yüzeyine yapıştırıcı yardımıyla tutunur.
kids.d_en: Adhesive anchors, also called adhesive anchoring systems or chemical anchors, attach to the mounting surface using adhesives. During installation, pilot hole size and alignment are not as critical as the adhesive can flow to fill irregular holes. They cannot be used before fully curing and are sensitive to dust and debris in the pilot hole.

kids.d_tr: Çubuk askıları tavan ve düz yüzeylere takılır; dişli çubuk ve elemanlar için dişi bir ankraj noktası sunar.
kids.d_en: Rod hangers install into ceilings and other flat surfaces and provide a female-threaded anchoring point for male-threaded rods and fasteners. They feature a screw-like male-threaded section that embeds into the mounting surface and an exposed female-threaded nut that provides the mounting location. They are commonly used to suspend lighting, HVAC, and other building infrastructure from the ceiling.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı dübeller dişi deliklere vidalanarak yay ve gergili yükler için sağlam bir ankraj noktası oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Spring anchors screw into female-threaded holes and fasteners to provide a solid anchoring point for springs and other tensioned loads. They are made with steel or stainless steel for strength, durability, and corrosion resistance. Swiveling spring anchors feature an integrated swivel that allows for adjustment of the attached spring.

kids.d_tr: Dişli yuvalar sıyrılmış dişleri onarır veya montaj yüzeyinde kalıcı yeni diş açar.
kids.d_en: Threaded inserts repair stripped threads or create new permanent threads in a mounting surface.

kids.d_tr: Kendinden kilitlemeli yuvalar montaj yüzeyine takılır ve erkek dişli elemanlar için dişi bir delik sunar.
kids.d_en: Self-locking inserts install into a mounting surface and provide a female-threaded hole for installing male-threaded fasteners. They feature external threading with a pre-applied thread-locking compound that engages with the mounting surface and resists loosening from vibrations.

kids.d_tr: Kamalı kilitlemeli yuvalar dişli deliklere sabitlenir ve bağlantı elemanlarının kavrayacağı yeni dişi diş oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Key-locking inserts fasten into threaded holes and provide new female threads for fasteners to engage with. The insert screws into the mounting surface then the integrated keys are driven into place with an installation tool and a hammer. This wedges the keys into place and prevents the insert from rotating and backing out unintentionally. They are commonly used to repair damaged or weak threads and provide thread reinforcement.

kids.d_tr: Perçin somunlar ince veya zayıf malzemelere takılarak dişi dişli bir bağlantı noktası sağlar.
kids.d_en: Rivet nuts, also known as blind nuts, install into thin or weak materials and provide a female-threaded mounting point. They are installed with specialized tools that can be used when only one side of the mounting surface is accessible. They reinforce existing female-threaded mounting holes or create new ones where needed.

kids.d_tr: Isıyla yerleşen yuvalar plastik ve ısıyla şekil değiştiren malzemelere ısı yardımıyla gömülerek yerine sabitlenir.
kids.d_en: Heat-set threaded inserts, also known as ultrasonic inserts, install into plastics and other thermally deformable materials using heat to secure themselves in place. They can be installed using an ultrasonic insert tool, soldering iron, or a similar heat-generating tool. As they are installed, the heat melts the mounting surface around the insert and then cools and solidifies, locking the insert in place.

kids.d_tr: Yuvalı somunlar hem yuva hem de dişi dişli somun olarak çalışabilen bağlantı elemanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Socket nuts, also known as Allen nuts, are female-threaded fasteners that can function as either an insert or female-threaded nut. They feature internal threads for engaging male fasteners and a hexagonal recess for tightening with a hex or Allen key. They are press-fit into a mounting surface when used as an insert and can be molded in place.

kids.d_tr: Perçinler iki veya daha fazla malzemenin içinden geçip önden ve arkadan sıkıştırarak kalıcı bağlantı kurar.
kids.d_en: Rivets create permanent connections between two or more materials by inserting through them and clamping the materials together from the front and back.

kids.d_tr: Kör perçinler malzemedeki deliklere takılarak parçaları birbirine sabitler.
kids.d_en: Blind rivets install into holes in materials to secure them together. They are used to join materials with no access to the back or blind side.

kids.d_tr: Dolu perçinler montaj yüzeyindeki deliklerden geçirilerek malzemeleri birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Solid rivets install through holes in the mounting surface to secure materials together. Their heads clamp the materials from one side while their shanks are deformed and flattened to grip from the opposite side.

kids.d_tr: Boru perçinler kanal işlerinde veya mekanik ürün ve elektronik montajında kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Tubular rivets are used to fasten duct work or assemble mechanical products and electronics. Tubular rivets have a hollow shaft to reduce the amount of force required to apply them. Rivets with a hollow tip are called semi tubular. Both types can be affixed loosely to function as a pivot point. Tubular rivets are applied with a rivet gun or an automated rivet machine.

kids.d_tr: Geçmeli perçinler yalnızca tek taraftan erişilebilen ahşap, metal ve plastik panelleri sabitler.
kids.d_en: Push-in rivets fasten wood, metal, and plastic panels that are only accessible from one side. They are commonly made of plastic or nylon for use on panels and circuit boards.

kids.d_tr: Çakmalı perçinler montaj yüzeyindeki deliklerden geçirilir ve güçlü bir tutuş sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drive pin rivets, also known as drive rivets, install through holes in the mounting surface and provide strong holding power. They easily install using only a hammer and can hold their full shear strength for structural or load-bearing applications.

kids.d_tr: Perçin pulları montaj yüzeyi ile perçin başı arasında durarak sıkma kuvvetini daha geniş bir alana yayar.
kids.d_en: Rivet washers sit between the mounting surface and the head of a rivet to spread its fastening force over a larger area. They are used when working with weak materials or when the installation hole is oversized.

kids.d_tr: Kilitli perçin cıvataları ve bilezikleri birlikte, iki malzeme arasında titreşime dayanıklı kalıcı bir bağ oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Lock bolts and lock bolt collars combine to create a permanent, vibration-resistant joint between two materials. The collar slips over the bolt's shank and is press-fit around the shank threads, locking it into place.

kids.d_tr: Çiviler ve kazıklar yüzeye çakılarak bir nesneyi diğerine bağlayan tutuş gücü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Nails and spikes are fasteners that are driven into a surface and provide holding power to attach one item to another.

kids.d_tr: Çiviler dişsiz, dökme bağlantı elemanlarıdır; iki nesneyi sürtünmeyle bir arada tutar.
kids.d_en: Nails are loose-pack, non-threaded fasteners that secure two items together using friction. They are commonly used for construction and assembly applications where screws would be unsuitable.

kids.d_tr: Şeritli çiviler plastik ve esnek malzemelerle şerit ya da rulo halinde bağlanır; çivi tabancasından kolayca beslenir.
kids.d_en: Collated nails are connected in strips or rolls using plastic and other flexible materials that can easily feed through a powered nail gun. They are commonly used for high-volume applications such as production environments and construction sites where many fasteners must be installed rapidly.

kids.d_tr: Kazık çiviler, dış etkenlere maruz kalan yükleri sabitleyen büyük ve dayanıklı çivilerdir.
kids.d_en: Spikes are large, durable nails that secure loads that are exposed to the elements. They are commonly used in landscaping and to secure railroad ties in place.

kids.d_tr: Zımba telleri, iki kısa bacak ile tepe adı verilen uzun bir orta bölümden oluşan U biçimli bağlantı elemanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Staple products are U-shaped fasteners featuring two short legs and a long middle section called the crown. They are usually formed from a single metal wire but can be made using other materials or assembled from multiple components. They install using a stapler or a powered staple gun.

kids.d_tr: Ara parçalar, bileşenlerin kendilerini bağlayan çubuk üzerinde kaymasını engelleyerek aralarındaki mesafeyi korur.
kids.d_en: Spacers, also known as unthreaded sleeves or separators, keep components in an assembly spaced apart by preventing them from sliding along the rod or fastener that connects them.

kids.d_tr: Standart ara parçalar, montajdaki bileşenler arasında belirli bir mesafeyi korumak için tasarlanmış dişsiz manşonlardır.
kids.d_en: Standard spacers are unthreaded sleeves or separators designed to maintain a specific distance between components in an assembly. They prevent the components from sliding along the rod or fastener that connects them. These spacers fit around male fasteners so components remain properly spaced apart.

kids.d_tr: Tutucu ara parçalar, erkek dişli elemanın gövdesini kavrayan tutma kanatlarıyla onu dik konumda hizalı tutar.
kids.d_en: Retaining spacers are unthreaded fasteners with retaining ribs that grip onto the shank of a male-threaded fastener and keep it aligned vertically through the spacer. This gripping action centers the fastener and also holds the spacer in place on the male-threaded fastener to ensure proper placement and help expedite assembly processes.

kids.d_tr: Baskı sınırlayıcılar bağlantı elemanı ile yüzey arasında bariyer oluşturur; plastik montajlarda aşırı sıkmayı ve hasarı önler.
kids.d_en: Compression limiters serve as a barrier between fasteners and mounting surfaces to help prevent over-compression and potential damage to plastic assemblies, such as plastic panels. These unthreaded components ensure a reliable and consistent compression force, which is essential for maintaining the structural stability of the assembly.

kids.d_tr: Distans parçaları, iki bileşeni belirli bir mesafede birbirine bağlayan dişli elemanlardır.
kids.d_en: Standoffs are threaded fasteners that connect two components at a set distance from each other.

kids.d_tr: Erkek-dişi distanslar nesneler arasında boşluk oluşturur ve güvenli bir bağlantı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Male x female standoffs are threaded components that create space between objects and provide a secure connection. These standoffs have a male x female type mounting configuration, with an internally threaded female connector on one end and an externally threaded male connector on the other. They allow for the connection of a female component on one end and a male connector on the other with a single standoff. They are available in various sizes and materials to suit the needs of specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Dişi-dişi distanslar nesneler arasında boşluk oluşturur ve güvenli bir bağlantı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Female x female standoffs are threaded components that create space between objects and provide a secure connection. These standoffs have a female x female type mounting configuration, with internally threaded connectors on both ends. These connectors mate with screws or male standoffs with externally threaded connections, enabling the connection of two different components with a single standoff. They are available in various sizes and materials to suit the needs of specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Perçin distanslar sac içine preslenerek veya sıkıştırılarak kalıcı bir bağ oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Clinch standoffs install into sheets by being pressed or squeezed around the material, creating a permanent bond. When pressed into round holes, they create permanent installations in metal sheets. They are often used to secure stainless steel sheets and are commonly used to mount, space, or stack panels, boards, or other components.

kids.d_tr: Pano montaj distansları cam, plastik veya başka bir malzemeden paneli duvardan belirli bir mesafede monte etmeyi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Panel-mount standoffs provide a way to install a panel of glass, plastic, or other material above a wall or other mounting surface. They feature slots or pair with caps and set screws to hold the panel in place.

kids.d_tr: Diş adaptörlerinin iki ucu da dişlidir; farklı diş ölçüsündeki iki bileşeni belirli bir mesafede bağlar.
kids.d_en: Thread adapters have threads on both ends and connect two components with different thread sizes at a specified distance apart.

kids.d_tr: Erkek-dişi diş adaptörleri diş ölçüsünü dönüştürmek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Male x female thread adapters are used to convert thread sizes. They have a mounting configuration where one end has an internally threaded female connector, and the other end has an externally threaded male connector, allowing for the connection of components with opposite thread types. These thread adapters are available in a variety of sizes and materials to meet the requirements of specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Erkek-erkek diş adaptörleri diş ölçüsünü dönüştürmek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Male x male thread adapters are used to convert thread sizes. They have a mounting configuration where each end has an externally threaded male connector, enabling the connection of components with opposite female thread types. These thread adapters are available in a variety of sizes and materials to meet the requirements of specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Dişi-dişi diş adaptörleri diş ölçüsünü dönüştürmek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Female x female thread adapters are used to convert thread sizes. They have a mounting configuration where each end has an internally threaded female connector, enabling the connection of components with opposite male thread types. These thread adapters are available in a variety of sizes and materials to meet the requirements of specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Pimler montajdaki deliklerden geçirilerek bileşenleri yerinde tutar ve aralarında sökülebilir bağlantı noktaları oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Pins insert through holes in assemblies to secure components in place and create removable connection points between them.

kids.d_tr: Silindirik pimler deliklere takılarak bileşenlerin sabitlenmesine veya hizalanmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Dowel pins insert into holes to help secure or align components together. They are made using metal, wood, or plastic and are used in various applications.

kids.d_tr: Çatal pimler çatal ucundaki deliklere takılır ve gupilya benzeri bir pimle sabitlenir; hızlı montaj ve söküm sağlar.
kids.d_en: Clevis pins install into holes on the end of a clevis and are secured in place using a cotter pin or other similar pin. They allow for rapid assembly and disassembly and are able to secure much higher tension loads than bolts, rivets, or screws.

kids.d_tr: Gupilyalar çatal pim, mil ve diğer bileşenlerdeki deliklere takılarak parçaları yerinde kilitler.
kids.d_en: Cotter pins, also called split pins, insert into holes in clevis pins, shafts, and other components to lock components in place. They feature a split-end design that inserts through the mounting surface, expands on the back side, and is folded back to prevent the pin from pulling out. This provides a solid yet removable connection between the components being assembled.

kids.d_tr: Endüstriyel emniyet pimleri çatal ve römork bağlantıları ile yüklü döner mafsallarda bağlantının kopmamasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Industrial safety pins install into clevis hitches, trailer hitches, and other loaded rotating joints that must remain connected to prevent injury or damage.

kids.d_tr: Kanallı pimlerin boyunca uzanan birkaç düz kanalı bulunur.
kids.d_en: Grooved pins feature several straight grooves that run along their length. These grooves are formed so that when the pin is installed, it deforms slightly to fill the grooves and lock itself in place. This creates a solid, non-permanent connection between the pin and the mounting surface.

kids.d_tr: Çeki pimleri halka başlı üç noktalı pimlerdir; ucuna takılan gupilya ile yerine kilitlenir.
kids.d_en: Hitch pins, also called trailer pins, are three-point pins that feature a ring-shaped head and a cotter pin inserted into their tips to lock them in place. They are commonly used to attach equipment and trailers to tractors, ATVs, and other outdoor equipment.

kids.d_tr: Emniyet halkalı pimlerde, takıldıktan sonra pimin üzerine geçip mil ucunu saran kendinden kilitlemeli bir halka bulunur.
kids.d_en: Lynch pins, sometimes called quick pins, feature a self-locking ring that snaps over the pin after it is installed and locks around the end of the mounting shaft.

kids.d_tr: Konik pimler düz veya konik deliklere girer ve sürtünmeyle yerine kamalanır.
kids.d_en: Taper pins insert into straight or tapered holes and wedge themselves into place using friction. They gradually decrease in size from the nominal diameter, moving from their head to their tips. The size of the smaller tip is directly related to the length of the pin, making it proportional in size. Some pins feature internal or external threading towards the larger end for attaching other fasteners or components.

kids.d_tr: Çıt çıt düğmeler, boru içine yerleşen yaylı V biçimli klipslerdir; delikler hizalandığında teleskopik boruyu kilitler.
kids.d_en: Snap buttons, also called press studs or snap fasteners, are spring-loaded v-shaped clips that sit inside a tube or pipe to lock telescopic tubing into place when their holes align.

kids.d_tr: Hızlı ayırmalı pimler ve yuvaları birlikte çalışarak bileşenleri geçici olarak bir arada tutar.
kids.d_en: Quick-release pins and receptacles work together to hold components together temporarily.

kids.d_tr: Segmanlar montaja takılarak dönen veya hareket eden bileşenlerin hareketini sınırlar.
kids.d_en: Retaining rings install into an assembly to restrict the movement of rotating or moving components.

kids.d_tr: Dış segmanlar millere açılmış kanallara oturur; bileşenleri tutar ve mili montaj içinde sabit kılar.
kids.d_en: External retaining rings, also called snap rings or circlips, fit into grooves cut into shafts to help retain components and keep the shaft inside the assembly. They are removable and reusable for easy maintenance and repair on high-wear components. Some rings feature wings or fingers on their inner surface to provide additional grip on the shaft.

kids.d_tr: İç segmanlar gövde veya delik iç yüzeyindeki kanallara takılarak bileşenleri montajda tutar.
kids.d_en: Internal retaining rings install into grooves on the inner wall of a housing or bore to help retain components with the assembly.

kids.d_tr: Kamalar ve kama çubukları, çıkış mili ile kasnak, dişli veya zincir dişlisinin göbeği arasına giren küçük metal çubuklardır.
kids.d_en: Keys and key stock are small metal bars or wedges that fit between an output shaft and the hub of a pulley, gear, sprocket, or other rotating component.

kids.d_tr: Şimler ve şim levhaları, boşluk ayarı, terazileme, hizalama ve yalıtım için ek yerlerine veya yüzeyler arasına yerleştirilir.
kids.d_en: Shims and shim stock fit into joints or between surfaces for spacing, leveling, alignment, and insulation applications.

kids.d_tr: Yuvarlak mil ara parçaları, motorlu mil üzerindeki bileşenleri hizalayan kalın pullardır; iç yüzeylerinde kama yuvası bulunur.
kids.d_en: Round arbor spacers, also called keyed spacers, are thick washers that help align components on a motorized shaft. They have a square or rectangular keyway cut into their inner surface so they can fit over the shaft and key during installation. They are commonly used to align and space out saws and milling machines.

kids.d_tr: Yarıklı şimler U biçimli dikdörtgen şimlerdir; cıvata veya çubuğun çevresine geçerek bileşenleri yüzeyden ayırır.
kids.d_en: Slotted shims, also called horseshoe shims, are rectangular, U-shaped shims that slide around a bolt or rod to space components from mounting surfaces and each other. They are commonly used on the mounting bolts of machines or structures that are already installed and need alignment or leveling.

kids.d_tr: Şim levhaları, özel ölçüde şim kesilebilen ince malzeme rulo ve tabakalarından oluşur.
kids.d_en: Shim stock consists of rolls or sheets of thin material from which custom shims can be cut or stamped. They are manufactured to an exact thickness and are commonly used for custom installations and repairs.

kids.d_tr: Kama şimleri konik veya kademelidir; titreşim sönümü gerekip gerekmediğine göre esnek ya da rijit malzemeden üretilir.
kids.d_en: Wedge shims are tapered or stepped shims made with flexible or rigid materials, depending on whether vibration damping is needed. They install after the shimmed item is in position. Some shims feature interlocking ridges that let them stack together and remain in place.

kids.d_tr: Emniyet teli, titreşim ve hareket nedeniyle bağlantı elemanlarının gevşeyip düşmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Safety lockwire, or safety wire, prevents fasteners from loosening and falling out due to equipment vibration or movement. Safety lockwire is threaded through a fastener, twisted and tightened, and then wound around another part to anchor it in place. It is commonly used to secure fasteners when it is critical to keep them in place, such as in industrial equipment, aircraft, moving vehicles, or marine vessels.

d_tr: Filo ve araç bakımı ürünleri; filoyu hizmette tutmak için ekipman, alet, yağ, temizlik sıvısı ve yedek parçaları kapsar.
d_en: Fleet and vehicle maintenance products include equipment, tools, lubricants, cleaning fluids, and replacement parts to keep fleets in service and vehicles on the road.

kids.d_tr: Servis ekipmanları filo araçlarının bakım ve onarımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Garage equipment supports and facilitates maintenance and repairs on fleet vehicles.

kids.d_tr: Araç kaldırma ve destekleme ekipmanları arasında krikolar, sehpalar, vinçler, sapanlar, yükleme rampaları ve takoz blokları bulunur.
kids.d_en: Equipment to lift and support vehicles includes vehicle lifting jacks, support stands, lifting cranes and slings, loading and repair ramps, and outrigger pads and cribbing blocks.

kids.d_tr: Servis yatakları metal bir kasa, teknisyenin uzandığı bir yüzey ve aracın altına kaymayı sağlayan tekerleklerden oluşur.
kids.d_en: Creepers consist of a metal frame, a creeper seat on which the mechanic sits, and a set of casters to move the creeper under vehicles.

kids.d_tr: Servis taşıma arabaları ekipmanı atölye içinde hareket ettirir; bakım sırasında ağır kaldırmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Garage dollies move equipment around the shop floor to limit lifting and moving heavy equipment during fleet maintenance and repair.

kids.d_tr: Lastik ve jant ekipmanları lastik, jant grubu ve bileşenlerin bakımı ile saklanmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Tire and wheel equipment helps maintain and store tires, wheel assemblies, and components.

kids.d_tr: Yağ filtresi presleri eski filtreleri orijinal hacminin yaklaşık %20'sine indirir ve içindeki yağın %95'e kadarını dışarı çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Oil filter crushers and industrial oil filter crushers reduce old oil filters to about 20% of their original size and force up to 95% of the old oil and sludge out. These crushers help garages and repair shops meet EPA standards for reducing oil-borne wastes. These crushers smash filters up to 16". They have interlocking doors to prevent spills during operation.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt bidonları, tankları ve arabaları; yakıt ve diğer yanıcı sıvıların geçici olarak aktarılması ve taşınması için özel kaplardır.
kids.d_en: Fuel cans, tanks, and caddies are dedicated storage containers for temporarily transferring, transporting, and dispensing fuels and other flammable liquids.

kids.d_tr: Araç örtüleri, depolama ve taşıma sırasında aracın tamamını veya parçalarını toz, kir ve hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Vehicle covers protect entire vehicles or parts from dust, dirt, and damage during storage or transport.

kids.d_tr: Lastik ve fren bakım ürünleri lastik, jant grubu, fren ve bileşenlerinin onarım ve değişimine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Tire and brake maintenance products help repair and replace tires, wheel assemblies, brakes, and components.

kids.d_tr: Lastik şişirme ve hava boşaltma ekipmanları doğru basınç seviyesine ulaşmak için lastiği doldurur veya havasını alır.
kids.d_en: Tire inflators and deflators equipment fill or release air from tires to achieve the correct pressure levels.

kids.d_tr: Lastik ve jant performans ürünleri lastik ile jant grubunun çalışmasını iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Tire and wheel performance products improve the operation of tire and wheel assemblies.

kids.d_tr: Römork ve ekipman lastikleri; römork, traktör ve çim biçme makinelerindeki eski veya yıpranmış lastiklerin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: Trailer and equipment tires replace old or worn tires on trailers, sporting vehicles, tractors, and lawnmowers.

kids.d_tr: Fren servis ürünleri fren sistemlerinin onarım ve bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Brake service products support the repair and maintenance of braking systems.

kids.d_tr: Araç bakım aletleri onarım ile muayeneyi hızlandırır, arızayı tespit eder ve filo bakımını kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle tools ease fleet maintenance by speeding up repairs and inspections and diagnosing issues.

kids.d_tr: Arıza tespit cihazları araç sistemlerini test eder ve onarım gereken noktaları gösterir.
kids.d_en: Diagnostic tools test vehicle systems and highlight areas needing repair.

kids.d_tr: Araç elektrik aparatları akü ve elektrik devrelerini onarır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle electrical tools repair batteries and electrical circuits.

kids.d_tr: Motor bakım aparatları filo araçlarının sorunsuz çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle engine tools help keep fleet vehicles running smoothly.

kids.d_tr: Genel servis aletleri araç bakım ve onarım işlerine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: General fleet shop tools assist with vehicle maintenance and repair tasks.

kids.d_tr: Klima gazı makineleri ve aksesuarları araç klima sistemlerinin bakım ile onarımını destekler ve performansını artırır.
kids.d_en: AC refrigerant machines and accessories support the maintenance and repair of vehicle air conditioning systems and enhance their performance.

kids.d_tr: Yağlama aparatları sıvıların aktarılmasına ve bertarafına yardımcı olur; atölye zemininde yağ dökülmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Vehicle lubricant tools help transfer and dispose of fluids and prevent oily messes on shop floors.

kids.d_tr: Direksiyon ve süspansiyon bakımı, aracın yolda doğru şekilde kontrol edilmesini sağlamak için yapılır.
kids.d_en: Steering and suspension maintenance is done to ensure a vehicle has proper control on the road.

kids.d_tr: Şanzıman ve debriyaj aparatlarının elde bulunması düzenli bakımı hızlandırır ve araçların sorunsuz çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Having the necessary transmission and clutch tools on hand to perform regular engine maintenance speeds repairs and helps keep vehicles running smoothly.

kids.d_tr: Bu aparatlar lastik ve jant gruplarını onarır, bakımını yapar ve değiştirir.
kids.d_en: These tools repair, maintain, and replace tires and wheel assemblies.

kids.d_tr: Antifriz ve soğutma sıvıları araçları aşırı sıcaklıklara karşı korur ve radyatörde korozyonu engeller.
kids.d_en: Antifreeze and coolants protect vehicles from extreme temperatures and prohibit corrosion in radiators.

kids.d_tr: Antifriz ve soğutma sıvıları araçları aşırı sıcaklıklardan korur, motor hasarını ve radyatörde korozyon birikimini önler.
kids.d_en: Antifreeze and coolants protect vehicles from extreme temperatures, prevent engine damage, and prohibit corrosion buildup in radiators. Antifreeze is a primary component of coolant mixtures, it stops liquids from freezing inside a vehicle's cooling system in very cold temperatures. Coolants comprise antifreeze, additives, and water. They are added to radiators to regulate fluids from extreme heat and cold thus preventing engine damage.

kids.d_tr: Fren hidrolikleri fren sisteminin metal bileşenlerini korur ve fren performansını güvence altına alır.
kids.d_en: Brake fluids protect the metal components of a vehicle's braking system and ensure braking performance. They contain additives that prevent moisture-related corrosion and resist malfunction in extreme temperatures.

kids.d_tr: AdBlue, seçici katalitik indirgemeli dizel motorların zehirli azot oksit emisyonunu düşürerek emisyon standartlarına uymasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Diesel exhaust fluids (DEF) help selective catalytic reduction (SCR) diesel engines meet the EPA’s near-zero emissions standards by lowering toxic nitrogen oxide exhaust levels as a vehicle is operated. Use of this fluid is mandatory in these diesel engines operating on U.S. roads and on farmlands.

kids.d_tr: Motor yağları hareketli parçaları yağlayarak sürtünmeyi azaltır, korozyonu önler ve motorun performansı ile ömrünü artırır.
kids.d_en: Engine and motor oils improve performance and extend the life of engines and motors by lubricating the many moving parts to reduce friction and prevent corrosion. Friction on engine parts causes increased wear and heat build-up which can lead to more maintenance. Vehicle and equipment owner's manuals should be checked to verify proper oil usage.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt ve motor yağı katkıları temizler, verimi artırır ve hareketli parçaları aşınmaya karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Fuel and engine oil additives help clean, improve efficiency, and protect moving parts against wear.

kids.d_tr: Stabilizatörler ve koruyucu yağlar, uzun süre bekleyen araç ve ekipmanlarda yakıtın bozulmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Stabilizers and fogging oils help keep fuel from degrading in vehicles or equipment that are stored or not used frequently.

kids.d_tr: Direksiyon hidrolikleri hidrolik direksiyon sistemini hasar ve korozyona karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Power steering fluids protect power steering systems from damage and corrosion. They help reduce steering noise and lubricate metal parts to prevent friction. These fluids are used as either a stop-gap before leak repair or as a regular power steering fluid additive to optimize steering system performance.

kids.d_tr: İlk hareket spreyleri aşırı sıcaklıklarda motorun daha kolay çalışmasını sağlamak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Starting fluids are added to engines to improve vehicle starting in extreme temperatures. They are used in both gasoline and diesel engines to aid in the starting of combustion engines. Starting fluids extend the life of the starter gear.

kids.d_tr: Şanzıman yağları araç ve iş makinesi şanzımanlarının çalışma ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Transmission fluids extend the working life of vehicle and heavy equipment transmissions. They prevent wear, reduce heat, and promote smooth shifting.

kids.tr: İki ve Dört Zamanlı Motor Yakıtları
kids.d_tr: İki ve dört zamanlı motor yakıtları, katkı ve yağlayıcılarla zenginleştirilmiştir; tüketimi ve emisyonu azaltır.
kids.d_en: 2-cycle and 4-cycle fuels are engineered fuels with added lubricants and additives that help equipment use less gasoline and reduce emissions.

kids.d_tr: Sistem temizleme sıvıları araç sistemlerine nüfuz ederek hatları tıkayan yağ ve kirlilikleri temizler.
kids.d_en: Flushes penetrate vehicle systems to remove oils and contaminants blocking lines. These flushes also help improve fuel usage, wash away road salt and soot, and clean engine parts without removing or tearing down the engine. They can also improve emissions control by removing old engine sludge.

kids.d_tr: Gres ve yağlayıcılar aracın tüm ana bağlantı noktalarında sürtünmeyi azaltır ve parça ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Grease and lubricants are used at all major vehicle connection points to reduce friction and extend the life of parts.

kids.tr: Kaçak Tespit Boyaları, Klima Yağları ve Katkılar
kids.en: Vehicle UV Leak Detection Dyes, AC Oils & Coolant Additives
kids.d_tr: Kaçak tespit boyaları, klima yağları ve soğutma katkıları; yağ, yakıt, klima ve direksiyon sistemlerindeki sızıntıyı bulmaya yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Vehicle UV leak detection dyes, oils, and coolant additives help detect or deter fluid leaks in oil, fuel, air conditioning systems, automatic transmission, and power steering systems.

kids.d_tr: Araç ve ekipman filtreleri havayı ve sıvıyı temizleyerek performansı artırır, bileşenleri kirlilikten korur.
kids.d_en: Vehicle and equipment filters cleanse air and fluid to improve performance and protect components from contaminants.

kids.d_tr: Motor hava filtreleri havadaki kirliliklerin yanma odasına girmesini engeller.
kids.d_en: Vehicle engine air filters prevent airborne contaminants from entering the engine's combustion chamber. They work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Polen filtreleri aracın ısıtma ve klima sistemindeki toz, polen ve kirliliği tutarak yolcu bölümüne geçmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Cabin air filters remove dust, pollen, and smog from a vehicle's heating and air conditioning system to prevent pollutants from entering the driver and passenger area. They work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Karter havalandırma filtreleri dizel motorlardaki blow-by emisyonlarının atmosfere karışmasını azaltır.
kids.d_en: Crankcase ventilation (CCV) filters reduce diesel engine emissions (blow-by) from venting into the atmosphere. They also decrease oil consumption by capturing oil vapor and routing it back into the oil reservoir. These filters work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma suyu filtreleri aşınma parçacıkları ve korozif birikintileri tutarak motor soğutma sisteminin performansını artırır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle coolant filters remove contaminants such as wear particles and corrosive deposits from coolant fluids to improve the performance of engine cooling systems. Coolant flows through the canister's internal element to filter out contaminants before circulating back into the cooling system. They work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: AdBlue filtreleri, seçici katalitik indirgeme sistemlerinin performansını artırmak için sıvıdaki kirlilikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: DEF filters remove contaminants from diesel exhaust fluid to improve the performance of Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems. SCR systems reduce harmful diesel emissions into the environment and are used to meet Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt filtreleri yakıttaki kirlilikleri tutarak motorun verimli çalışmasını sağlar ve bakım ihtiyacını azaltır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle fuel filters remove contaminants from fuel to help engines run efficiently and reduce maintenance. Foreign particles such as rust, sediment, and water impact combustion, reduce fuel's lubricity, and can clog the tight, pressurized components of a fuel injection system. Fuel filters should be replaced following the recommended maintenance schedule of the compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Araç ve ekipman hidrolik filtreleri, yüksek basınçlı sistemlerdeki hassas parçaların performansı için akışkanı temizler.
kids.d_en: Vehicle and equipment hydraulic filters cleanse fluid to improve the performance of precise moving components in high pressure hydraulic systems. They remove sediment, wear particles, dirt, and water from heavy moving and lifting equipment on construction, agricultural, and mining vehicles.

kids.d_tr: Yağ filtreleri yağdaki tortu, kir ve suyu tutarak motorun hareketli parçalarının aşınmasını önler ve etkin yağlamayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Oil filters remove sediment, dirt, water, and other contaminants from oil to prevent wear on the engine's moving parts and ensure effective lubrication. They work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Direksiyon hidrolik filtreleri, direksiyon ile ön tekerlekler arasındaki hidrolik bağlantıyı yağlayan sıvıdaki kirlilikleri temizler.
kids.d_en: Power steering filters cleanse sediment, dirt, water, and other contaminants from the power steering fluid that lubricates and drives the hydraulic connection between the steering wheel and the front wheels of a vehicle. These filters work with a compatible vehicle make.

kids.d_tr: Şanzıman filtreleri tortu, kir ve suyu tutarak hareketli parçaların aşınmasını önler ve etkin yağlamayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Transmission filters remove sediment, dirt, water, and other contaminants to prevent wear on moving parts and ensure effective lubrication in a transmission system. These filters work with a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Filtre bakım setleri, uyumlu araç veya ekipmanda filtre değişimi için gereken bileşenleri bir arada sunar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle filter service kits include multiple components for performing a filter change on a compatible vehicle make or type of equipment.

kids.d_tr: Filtre parça ve aksesuarları; otomobil, kamyon, traktör ve ekipmanda hava ile sıvı filtrasyonunun bakım ve onarımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Vehicle filter parts and accessories support the maintenance and repair of air and fluid filtering in automobiles, trucks, tractors, and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Motor, radyatör ve egzoz bakım ürünleri filo araçlarının çalışır durumda kalmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle engine, radiator, and exhaust maintenance products help keep fleet vehicles running.

kids.d_tr: Motor bakım ürünleri motor grubundaki yıpranmış parçaları onarır ve değiştirir.
kids.d_en: Vehicle engine maintenance products repair and replace worn parts in the engine assembly.

kids.d_tr: Egzoz bakım ürünleri emisyon sistemlerinin bakımını ve onarımını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle exhaust maintenance products maintain and repair emission systems.

kids.d_tr: Klima ve radyatör bakımı, bu sistemlerin etkin çalışması için özel aparatlar gerektirir.
kids.d_en: Vehicle A/C and radiator maintenance requires specialized tools to keep these systems running effectively.

kids.d_tr: Şanzıman bakım ürünleri otomotiv şanzıman sistemlerinin onarımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Vehicle transmission maintenance products support the repair of automotive transmission systems.

kids.d_tr: Elektrik sistemi bakımı filo araçlarının akü ve devrelerinin ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Electrical system maintenance helps prolong the life of fleet vehicles' batteries and circuits.

kids.d_tr: Akü şarj ve güç ekipmanları araç akülerini bağlamaya, şarj etmeye, bakımını yapmaya ve takviye vermeye yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Battery power and charging equipment helps connect, recharge, maintain, and jump-start vehicle batteries.

kids.d_tr: Bujiler ateşleme sisteminden gelen elektrik akımını yanma odasına ileterek aracın çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Spark plugs deliver electrical current from a vehicle's ignition system to the combustion chamber to start the vehicle.

kids.d_tr: Araç tesisat sistemleri elektrik akımını bir otomotiv bileşeninden diğerine taşır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle wiring systems transfer electrical current from one automotive component to another.

kids.d_tr: Araç aydınlatması güvenliği artırır ve aracın içinde ile dışında bilgi aktarır.
kids.d_en: Vehicle lighting improves safety and conveys information inside and outside of the vehicle.

They come in various colors and can be used in hygienic color-coding systems to prevent cross-contamination or indicate implements that handle hazardous materials and waste products.

kids.d_en: Box air filters are rigid filters with more capacity for capturing contaminants than panel filters.

kids.d_tr: Torba filtreler, iç hava kalitesini artırmak ve kirliliğin ekipmanda birikmesini önlemek için kullanılan yüksek performanslı filtrelerdir.
kids.d_en: Bag air filters are high-performance air filters installed in HVAC systems to capture contaminants in the air stream, which increases indoor air quality and helps prevent contaminants from accumulating on equipment or surfaces, thereby protecting them from damage.

kids.d_tr: Filtre keçeleri ve ruloları, uyumlu filtre çerçevesine yerleştirilerek havalandırma sistemlerinde kirlilik tutan bir filtre oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Air filter pads and rolls are lengths of filter media that install into a compatible air filter holding frame to create an air filter for removing contaminants from the air stream in ventilation systems.

kids.d_tr: Fan muhafaza filtreleri fan koruma ızgaralarının çevresine sarılarak havayı süzer ve büyük partiküllerin fana zarar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Fan shroud air filters, also known as circular fan filters, wrap around the protective guards on fans to filter the air and trap large airborne particles, preventing them from damaging the fan.

kids.en: Air Filter Gasketing, Holding Clips & Pullers
kids.d_tr: Filtre contaları, klipsleri ve çekicileri filtre ile çerçeve arasından hava kaçmasını önler ve filtrenin yerinde durmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air filter gasketing, holding clips, and pullers help prevent air from leaking between the filter and its frame or housing, help users keep air filters in place in HVAC systems, and help users retrieve and install air filters from hard-to-reach areas.

kids.d_tr: Hava şartlandırma ürünleri iç ortam hava kalitesini denetler.
kids.d_en: Air treatment products control indoor air quality.

kids.d_tr: Hava temizleyiciler havadaki kirlilikleri azaltır veya etkisizleştirir; iç ortam hava kalitesini artırır ve kokuları nötralize eder.
kids.d_en: Air purifiers and cleaners reduce or deactivate airborne contaminants to help improve indoor air quality and neutralize odors in homes and offices.

kids.tr: Hava Yıkayıcılar ve Negatif Basınç Makineleri
kids.d_tr: Hava yıkayıcılar ve negatif basınç makineleri havayı temizler ve kirliliğin iç mekanda yayılmasını durdurur.
kids.d_en: Air scrubbers and negative air machines clean the air and help stop the spread of airborne contaminants indoors.

kids.d_tr: Nem alma cihazları havadaki nemi çekerek iç mekanları kurutur ve küf ile koku oluşumunu önler.
kids.d_en: Dehumidifiers remove moisture from the air to dry indoor spaces and help prevent the growth of mold, mildew, and odors.

kids.d_tr: Nemlendiriciler iç ortam havasına nem katarak solunumu kolaylaştırır, statik elektriği azaltır ve ahşap yüzeylerin kurumasını önler.
kids.d_en: Humidifiers add moisture to indoor air to ease breathing, make the space feel warmer, minimize static shocks, and help prevent wood surfaces and furniture from drying out.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma fanları kontrollü hava akışı üreterek iç ve dış mekanlarda ısı, nem ve hava sirkülasyonunu yönetir.
kids.d_en: Cooling fans generate controlled airflow to manage heat, moisture, and air circulation around people, equipment, and surfaces in a wide range of indoor and outdoor environments.

kids.d_tr: Endüstriyel soğutma fanları üretim ve ticari alanlarda havayı hareket ettirerek ısıyı kontrol eder; tavan, zemin ve ayaklı modelleri bulunur.
kids.d_en: Industrial cooling fans move air to control heat in production, commercial, and industrial spaces, with ceiling and HVLS fans covering large areas, floor and pedestal fans handling spot cooling, dock fans serving loading zones, and misting coolers, fan heads, and accessories supporting specialized setups.

kids.d_tr: Ofis ve masa fanları düşük tozlu ortamlarda havayı sirküle eder; kişisel, tavan, zemin ve duvar tipi modelleri vardır.
kids.d_en: Office and desk fans circulate air in offices and other low-dust environments, with personal and desk models for individual cooling and ceiling, floor, pedestal, wall-mount, and window fans used to move air across rooms or open areas.

kids.d_tr: Ekipman soğutma ve aksiyel fanlar, pasif havalandırmanın yetersiz kaldığı makine kabinlerine soğuk hava basar veya sıcak havayı dışarı atar.
