kids.d_en: Equipment-cooling and axial fans, also called enclosure or cabinet-cooling fans, move cool air in or hot air out of machinery enclosures when passive ventilation isn’t sufficient, helping regulate temperatures, reduce component wear, and support reliable operation in demanding industrial environments.

kids.d_tr: Taşınabilir hava üfleyiciler yüksek debili fanlardır; su baskını sonrası iç mekanlarda kurumayı hızlandırarak küf riskini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Portable air movers, also known as carpet blowers or dryers, are high-velocity fans that move large volumes of air to accelerate drying in interior spaces after water-related incidents, helping reduce the risk of mold and related damage.

kids.d_tr: Havalandırma ekipmanları temiz hava alıp bayat havayı atarak iç ortam hava kalitesini korur.
kids.d_en: Ventilation equipment maintains indoor air quality through the intake of fresh air and exhausting of stale air.

kids.d_tr: Havalandırma fanları temiz hava çekip iç mekanda sirküle ederek ve bayat havayı atarak hava kalitesi ile sıcaklığı düzenler.
kids.d_en: Ventilation fans help maintain indoor air quality and regulate air temperatures by pulling in fresh air, circulating it through the indoor space, and exhausting stale air.

kids.d_tr: Blowerlar ve hava üfleyiciler hedefe yönlendirilmiş bir hava akımının gerektiği uygulamalarda kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Blowers and air movers are used in applications where a targeted airstream is required.

kids.tr: Baca Fanları ve Yanma Havası Sistemleri
kids.d_tr: Baca fanları ve yanma havası sistemleri, yanma sisteminden hava geçirerek emiş ve egzoz debisini artırır.
kids.d_en: Draft inducers and combustion air systems move air through a combustion system to increase the intake and exhaust airflow.

kids.d_tr: Isı geri kazanım cihazları iç mekan havasını yeniler ve şartlandırır.
kids.d_en: Energy-recovery ventilators (ERVs) and heat-recovery ventilators (HRVs) refresh and condition the air in indoor spaces. They help reduce utility costs by using the air that is being vented out of the space to condition the fresh air that is being brought into the space. Also known as balanced ventilation, this process replenishes oxygen and reduces airborne contaminants in indoor air to help occupants breathe more comfortably.

kids.d_tr: Hava perdeleri, mekanlar arası ısı geçişini azaltan ve kirlilik ile haşerenin geçişini engelleyen hava bariyerleri oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Air curtains create air barriers that reduce heat transfer between spaces and help block the passage of airborne contaminants or pests.

kids.d_tr: Kanal ve menfezler, hava akışını binanın iklimlendirme sistemi ile emiş ve egzoz menfezleri boyunca yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Duct and venting products help direct airflow through a building's HVAC system and the intake and exhaust vents.

kids.d_tr: Damperler ve panjurlar içlerinden geçen hava akışını düzenleyerek emiş ile egzozu dengeler.
kids.d_en: Dampers and louvers regulate airflow passing through them to balance HVAC intake and exhaust airflow.

kids.d_tr: Klimalar ve evaporatif soğutucular; endüstriyel, ticari, konut ve dış mekanlarda konforu koruyan iklim kontrolü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air conditioners and evaporative coolers provide climate control to keep spaces comfortable in industrial, commercial, residential, and outdoor settings.

kids.d_tr: Klimalar basınçlı soğutucu akışkan ve faz değişimi teknolojisiyle mekana ısı taşıyıp mekandan ısı alarak sıcaklığı düzenler.
kids.d_en: Air conditioners moderate the temperature of a space by transferring heat into and out of the space using pressurized refrigerants and phase change technology.

kids.d_tr: Evaporatif soğutucular su kullanarak hava sıcaklığını düşürür; insanları ve ekipmanı serinletir.
kids.d_en: Evaporative coolers use water to reduce air temperatures and cool people and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Merkezi ısıtma ve soğutma ekipmanları, kanal yoluyla tek üniteden birden çok odaya dağıtım yapan sistemlerin bakım ve onarımında kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Central heating and cooling equipment is used to maintain, repair, and replace components of HVAC systems that use ductwork to distribute heat and air conditioning from a single furnace or cooling unit to multiple rooms.

kids.d_tr: Merkezi gazlı sıcak hava cihazları doğalgaz hattına bağlanarak çok konutlu binalar için ısı üretir.
kids.d_en: Whole-house gas furnaces connect to natural gas lines to produce heat for multifamily homes. They burn natural gas to heat their heat exchanger, which transfers heat to airflow passing over the exchanger and gets blown out through the homes' ductwork. These furnaces are used in new installations and to replace existing furnaces of similar BtuH output.

kids.d_tr: Klima santralleri merkezi iklimlendirme sistemlerine entegre olur ve iç ortam havasını şartlandırır.
kids.d_en: Air handlers integrate into central HVAC systems and help to condition the interior air. They connect to exterior HVAC components and transfer heat to and from the outside air. Some units can be retrofitted with an optional electric heater kit to provide both heating and cooling.

kids.d_tr: Klima evaporatör serpantinleri, şartlandırılan hacme ısı taşıyarak veya ısı çekerek sistemden geçen havayı şartlandırır.
kids.d_en: Evaporator coils for air conditioners condition the air passing through an HVAC system by transferring heat into or out of the conditioned space.

kids.d_tr: Yedek kompresörler ve kondenser üniteleri, soğutucu akışkanı sıkıştırıp genleştirerek ısıyı taşıyan ana bileşenlerdir.
kids.d_en: Replacement refrigeration compressors and condensing units are the main components of an HVAC system that compress and expand the refrigerant to transfer heat into and out of the system.

kids.d_tr: Isıtıcılar ısı üreterek mekanı, havayı veya malzemeyi ısıtır ve kontrollü sıcaklığın korunmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Heaters are devices that generate and transfer heat to warm spaces, air, or materials, helping maintain comfortable or controlled temperatures.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli ısıtıcılar konut, ticari ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda elektrikle ısı üreterek havayı ve malzemeyi ısıtır.
kids.d_en: Electric heaters generate heat using electricity to warm air, materials, or processes in residential, commercial, and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli proses ısıtıcıları rezistanslı elemanlarla endüstriyel ekipman ve proseslere kontrollü ısı verir.
kids.d_en: Electric process heaters use resistive heating elements to deliver controlled heat for industrial equipment, materials, and processing applications.

kids.d_tr: Gazlı, motorinli ve gazyağlı ısıtıcılar yakıt yakarak ısı üretir ve çevredeki mekanı ısıtır.
kids.d_en: Gas, oil, and kerosene heaters burn fuels to generate heat and warm the surrounding space.

kids.d_tr: Sulu sistem kazanları ve ısıtıcıları soğuk havalarda sıcak su veya buharla birincil ısı kaynağını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Hydronic boilers and heaters use hot water or steam to provide the primary source of heat in cold weather.

kids.d_tr: Isı değiştiriciler; ısı borusu, kanatçık ve plaka kullanarak kaynak akışkan ile çalışma akışkanı arasında ısı aktarır.
kids.d_en: Heat exchangers transfer heat between a source fluid (liquid or gas) and a working fluid using heat pipes, fins, and heat plates.

kids.d_tr: Gövde borulu ısı değiştiriciler, dış gövde içindeki boru demetiyle akışkanlar arasında ısı aktarır.
kids.d_en: Shell and tube heat exchangers transfer heat between fluids using a series of heat tubes surrounded by an outer shell. This design makes them less likely to clog and can handle high temperatures and pressures with limited pressure drop. They are commonly used to heat or cool water and oil or condense steam into water.

kids.d_tr: Isı değiştirici yedek parçaları yıpranmış veya hasarlı bileşenleri değiştirir.
kids.d_en: Heat exchanger replacement parts change out worn or damaged heat exchanger components. They are commonly used to repair or maintain existing heat exchangers, extending their lifespan and eliminating the need to purchase new equipment.

kids.d_tr: İklimlendirme kontrolleri ve termostatlar sistemi düzenler ve verimli çalışmayla kullanıcı konforunu sağlar.
kids.d_en: HVAC controls and thermostats regulate the HVAC system and help ensure occupant comfort through efficient operation.

kids.d_tr: Termostatlar iklimlendirme sistemine bağlanır ve mekanda belirli bir sıcaklık ya da aralığı korumak için sistemi denetler.
kids.d_en: Thermostats connect to the HVAC system and control its functions to maintain a specific temperature or temperature range in a space or process system.

kids.d_tr: İklimlendirme sensörleri ve anahtarları ortam değişimlerine tepki verip kontrol sistemine sinyal göndererek otomasyona yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: HVAC sensors and switches help automate the control of an HVAC system by responding to environmental changes and sending signals to the HVAC control system.

kids.d_tr: Sulu sistem vanaları, sulu ısıtma sistemlerinde su ve buhar akışını denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydronic HVAC valves control the flow of water and steam through the hydronic heating systems.

kids.d_tr: Kondenstoplar ve purjörler sulu ısıtma sistemlerinden hava ile suyu tahliye ederek verimi artırır ve güvenli çalışmayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Steam system traps and vents, also known as steam system flow controls, remove air and water from hydronic heating systems to improve their efficiency and help prevent unsafe conditions.

kids.d_tr: İklimlendirme kontrol bileşenleri sistemin belirli parçalarını düzenler.
kids.d_en: HVAC equipment controls regulate specific components of the HVAC system.

kids.d_tr: Damper ve vana aktüatörleri, bağlı vana ya da damperi açıp kapatmak için gereken kuvveti sağlar.
kids.d_en: Actuators for dampers and valves connect to infrastructure components and provide the force needed to open or close the connected valve or damper.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik kontroller, iklimlendirme bileşenlerini çalıştırmak için basınçlı hava sinyallerini düzenler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic controls regulate compressed air signals to operate various HVAC system components.

kids.tr: Soğutucu Akışkanlar, Isı Transfer Sıvıları ve Yağlar
kids.d_tr: Soğutucu akışkanlar, ısı transfer sıvıları ve yağlar; klima ve sulu ısıtma sistemlerinin başlıca çalışma akışkanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Refrigerants, heat-transfer fluids, and lubricants are the main working fluids of air conditioning and hydronic heating systems.

kids.d_tr: Soğutucu gazlar, iklimlendirme sistemlerinde mekanı ısıtmak ya da soğutmak için ısı taşıyan çalışma akışkanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Refrigerants are the working fluids that transfer heat in HVAC systems to heat or cool spaces. They are compressed and expanded in specific parts of the HVAC system to either absorb heat from or release it to the surrounding air. Different blends of refrigerants offer different performance characteristics and meet various regulatory requirements. While newer refrigerants can replace older ones, they are not chemically compatible and should not be mixed or combined and used to operate an HVAC system.

kids.d_tr: Isı transfer sıvıları ısıtma ve soğutma sistemlerinde ısıyı kaynaktan alıp dağıtarak mekan sıcaklığını denetler.
kids.d_en: Heat-transfer fluids are used in heating and cooling systems to move heat from a source and dissipate it to control the temperature in a space.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma kompresör yağları; buzdolabı, klima ve ısı pompası gibi faz değişimli ısı transfer sistemlerinde kullanılan özel yağlardır.
kids.d_en: Refrigeration oils are specialty lubricants used in refrigerators, air conditioners, heat pumps, and other similar phase-change heat transfer systems. They protect the compressor and other system components from wear and are chemically compatible with the refrigerant in the system.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma yağı pompaları iklimlendirme sistemine bağlanarak belirli miktarda yağı sisteme aktarır.
kids.d_en: Pumps for refrigerant oils connect to HVAC systems and transfer specific amounts of refrigerant oil into the system. They are used when charging a brand-new system or adding missing lubricant to an existing system.

kids.d_tr: Soğutucu tüp ısıtıcıları tüpü ideal sıcaklıkta tutarak sistemi doldurmak için gereken doğru basıncı korur.
kids.d_en: Heaters for refrigerant cylinders keep them at the optimal temperature to ensure they maintain the correct pressure to charge an HVAC system.

kids.tr: Arıza Tespit, Gaz Geri Kazanım ve Vakumlama
kids.d_tr: Arıza tespit, gaz geri kazanım ve vakumlama ekipmanları soğutucu akışkanlı sistemleri kurar, bakımını yapar ve onarır.
kids.d_en: HVAC diagnostics, recovery, and evacuation equipment install, maintain, and repair refrigerant-based HVAC systems.

kids.d_tr: Gaz vakumlama ve geri kazanım ürünleri sistemi dolum için hazırlar ve bakım için gazı sistemden alır.
kids.d_en: Refrigerant evacuation and recovery products help prepare refrigerant systems for charging and remove refrigerant from the system for maintenance or conversion.

kids.tr: Manifold Saat Setleri, Manometreler ve Hortumlar
kids.en: HVAC Manifold Gauge Sets, Gauges & Hoses
kids.d_tr: Manifold saat setleri, manometreler ve hortumlar sistemi tüp, pompa ve aksesuarlara bağlayarak işletme ve bakımı kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: HVAC manifold gauge sets, gauges, and hoses connect HVAC systems to cylinders, pumps, and other accessories to help users operate and maintain the system.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma servis vanaları ve aparatları, teknisyenlerin sistemdeki erişim noktalarını kurmasına ve onarmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Refrigeration access valves, tools, and accessories help HVAC technicians install, modify, and repair access points on the HVAC system.

kids.d_tr: Kaçak tespit cihazları iklimlendirme ve soğutma sistemlerindeki kaçakların bulunmasına ve yerinin belirlenmesine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: HVACR (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning, Refrigeration) leak detection equipment helps identify and locate leaks in HVAC and refrigeration systems.

kids.d_tr: İklimlendirme temizlik kimyasalları ve ekipmanları kir ile kirliliği gidererek sistemin doğru çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: HVAC cleaning chemicals, equipment, and kits help keep HVAC equipment operating correctly by removing dirt, debris, and other contaminants.

kids.d_tr: Serpantin temizleme kimyasalları ve püskürtücüleri, kanatçıkları tıkayan ve verimi düşüren toz ile kirliliği giderir.
kids.d_en: Coil cleaning chemicals and sprayers remove dust, debris, and other contaminants that clog the fins of an HVAC coil and reduce its effectiveness.

kids.d_tr: Kireç çözme sistemleri, serpantin performansını düşüren kireç, kalsiyum ve pas birikintilerini kimyasal olarak çözen solüsyonları dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Descaling systems spread solutions that chemically break down scale, calcium, rust, and other deposits that reduce the performance of HVAC coils. These deposits reduce heat transfer rates and restrict or block working fluid flow in an HVAC system.

kids.d_tr: Ultraviyole dezenfeksiyon sistemleri küf ve bakteri gibi mikroorganizmaları UV ışığıyla yok eder.
kids.d_en: Ultraviolet disinfection cleaning systems eradicate microorganisms such as mold and bacteria using ultraviolet (UV) light. They allow for continuous disinfection of HVAC systems without chemicals or labor.

kids.d_tr: Serpantin fırçaları ve tarakları iklimlendirme sistemlerini temizleyerek en iyi performansı sağlar.
kids.d_en: HVAC brushes and combs clean and maintain HVAC systems to ensure optimal performance.

kids.d_tr: Isı değiştirici temizleme ekipmanları boru ve kanal içine girerek kir ile döküntüyü alır ve sistemi verimli tutar.
kids.d_en: Heat exchanger cleaning equipment fits into the tubes, piping, and other parts of a heat exchanger system to remove dirt and debris and keep systems running efficiently.

kids.d_tr: Dezenfektanlar ve koku gidericiler rahatsız edici kokuya yol açan mikroorganizma ve organik bileşikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: Disinfectants and odor neutralizers remove microorganisms and organic compounds that cause unpleasant odors.

kids.d_tr: Hat yıkama ekipmanları tesisat tıkanıklıklarını açar, sistemi soğutucu akışkana hazırlar ve birikintileri temizler.
kids.d_en: Flushing equipment and accessories clears HVAC plumbing blockages, prepares HVAC systems for refrigerants, and helps remove clogs or buildups.

kids.d_tr: Isıtma yakıtı katkıları, motorin ve kalorifer yakıtına eklenerek performans ile verimi artırır.
kids.d_en: Heating fuel treatments are added to heating fuels such as diesel and heating oil to enhance performance and efficiency. These treatments help prevent fuel jelling, reduce sludge, and improve combustion.

kids.d_tr: Montaj, onarım ve bağlantı ekipmanları teknisyenlerin sistemleri daha kısa sürede kurmasına ve bakımını yapmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: HVAC installation, repair, and mounting equipment help technicians install, maintain, and connect HVAC systems more efficiently by reducing installation time.

kids.d_tr: Soğutma vanaları sistemdeki akışkan akışını denetler; arıza tespiti ve onarıma yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Refrigeration valves control refrigerant flow in HVAC systems to provide control and assist with diagnostics and repairs.

kids.d_tr: Yoğuşma suyu yönetimi ürünleri iklimlendirme sistemlerindeki yoğuşmayı denetlemeye ve arıtmaya yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Condensate management products help users treat and control condensation in HVAC systems.

kids.d_tr: İklimlendirme bantları, mastikleri ve yapıştırıcıları sistemdeki ek yerlerini ve kaçakları yalıtır.
kids.d_en: HVAC tapes, sealants, and cements seal joints and leaks in HVAC systems.

kids.d_tr: Klima montaj ekipmanları sistemlerin verimli ve güvenli biçimde kurulup çalıştırılmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Air conditioning installation and mounting equipment help users set up and operate their air conditioning systems efficiently and safely.

kids.d_tr: Klima hırsızlık koruması ürünleri, klima parçalarına izinsiz erişimi ve hırsızlığı önlemeye yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Air conditioning theft protection products help prevent unauthorized access or theft of air conditioning system parts and components.

kids.tr: Kurutucu Filtreler, Gözetleme Camları ve Akümülatörler
kids.en: Filter Driers, Sight Glasses & Suction Line Accumulators
kids.d_tr: Kurutucu filtreler, gözetleme camları ve akümülatörler sistemdeki soğutucu akışkan akışını işler ve izler.
kids.d_en: Filter driers, sight glasses, and suction line accumulators help process and monitor refrigerant flow in an HVAC system.

kids.d_tr: Fan kanatları ve pervaneleri, performansı düşüren ve gürültü yapan eğrilmiş veya yıpranmış kanatların yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: Fan blades and propellers replace bent or pitted blades and propellers that can reduce performance and cause unwanted noise in HVAC systems.

kids.d_tr: Kondenser pervane göbekleri, kondenser ünitesinde fan kanadını motor miline bağlar.
kids.d_en: Condenser propeller hubs connect the fan blade to the motor drive shaft in an HVAC condenser unit.

kids.d_tr: Plastik fan kanatları saat yönü ve tersi yönde çalışan geniş bir model yelpazesi sunar.
kids.d_en: Grainger carries an extensive plastic fan blade inventory with more than 50 styles in clockwise and counterclockwise configurations. For larger fans, choose from an extensive stock of aluminum fan blade replacements, or a replacement propeller for an air circulator. Stockpile parts such as a propeller hub for your condenser, so your customers won't have to wait in the heat later for the part to arrive. Whatever your HVAC system, Grainger has the parts including plastic fan blades.

kids.d_tr: Kanal tipi fan kanatları dört, beş ve altı kanatlı pervanelerle belirli fan modellerine uyumlu göbek deliklerinde sunulur.
kids.d_en: For durable and reliable tubeaxial fan blades, shop Grainger! Find four-, five- and six-blade propellers with hub bores that make them compatible with specific Dayton tubeaxial fans. Find tubeaxial propellers that measure from 12” to 60” in diameter. Check out the Grainger selection of tubeaxial fan blades today!

kids.d_tr: Yedek parçalar buzdolabı, dondurucu ve iklimlendirme sistemlerindeki yıpranmış parçaların yerine geçerek sistemi çalışır tutar.
kids.d_en: Replacement HVAC parts are used to replace worn, lost, or damaged parts in refrigerators, freezers, and HVAC systems to keep systems functioning.

kids.en: Replacement Motor Accessories for HVACR Equipment
kids.d_tr: Yedek motorlar ve aksesuarları, tüm üniteyi değiştirmeden fan ve kondenser gibi bileşenlerin ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Replacement motors and accessories extend the life of HVACR components such as blowers, fans, and condensers without replacing the entire HVACR unit.

kids.en: Bearings, Bushings & Sheaves for HVACR Equipment
kids.d_tr: Bu parçalar kondenser, ısı pompası ve çatı fanlarındaki tahrik gruplarında yıpranmış rulman, burç ve kasnakların yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These parts replace worn or lost bearings, bushings, and sheaves (pulleys) in HVACR motor drive assemblies found in condensers, heat pumps, heat exchangers, unit heaters, and power roof ventilators. Parts should be matched to equipment of a compatible brand and manufacturer model number.

kids.d_tr: Yedek kontrol, anahtar ve termostatlar; sıcaklığı düzenleyen ve verimli çalışma için sinyal gönderen arızalı parçaların yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: Replacement controls, switches, and thermostats replace nonfunctioning parts in HVACR equipment that help regulate temperatures and send signals to control components for efficient operation.

kids.tr: Yedek Fan, Filtre ve Havalandırma Parçaları
kids.en: Replacement HVACR Fans, Filters & Ventilation Parts
kids.d_tr: Yedek fan, filtre ve havalandırma parçaları, iç ortam hava kalitesi ile sıcaklığını korumak üzere ekipmanın bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Replacement fans, filters, and ventilation parts support the maintenance of HVACR equipment to ensure indoor air quality and temperature.

kids.d_tr: Bu parçalar ekipmandaki yıpranmış veya arızalı pompa, vana ve boruların yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These parts replace worn or nonfunctioning pumps, valves, and tubing in HVACR equipment.

kids.d_tr: Bu kaideler, gövdeler ve montaj setleri iklimlendirme sistemlerinin kurulum, bakım ve onarımını destekler.
kids.d_en: These bases, housings, and mounting kits support the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVACR systems. Parts should be matched to equipment of a compatible brand.

kids.en: Seals, Fittings & Fasteners for HVACR Equipment
kids.d_tr: Yedek keçe, rakor ve bağlantı elemanları, sızdırmaz bağlantılar için yıpranmış parçaların yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: Replacement seals, fittings, and fasteners replace worn, lost, or nonfunctioning parts in HVACR equipment to ensure leak-tight connections.

kids.tr: Isıtıcı ve Isı Değiştirici Yedek Parçaları
kids.en: Replacement Parts for HVACR Heaters & Heat Exchangers
kids.d_tr: Bu parçalar iklimlendirme sistemlerindeki ısıtıcı, ısı değiştirici ve bileşenlerinin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These parts replace heaters, heat exchangers, and their components in HVACR systems.

kids.en: Power Sources & Cables for HVACR Equipment
kids.d_tr: Bu parçalar ekipmandaki yıpranmış kablo, fiş ve diğer elektrik tesisat bileşenlerinin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These parts replace worn or nonfunctioning power source components such as cords, cables, plugs, and other electrical wiring parts in HVACR equipment.

kids.en: Knobs, Handles & Wheels for HVACR Equipment
kids.d_tr: Bu parçalar sistemlerdeki yıpranmış termostat düğmelerinin, kolların ve tekerleklerin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These parts replace worn or lost thermostat knobs, equipment handles and wheels, and other components on HVACR systems. Parts should be matched to equipment of a compatible brand.

d_tr: Hırdavat ürünleri endüstriyel ve ticari tesislerde montaj, onarım ve bakım işlerinde kullanılır.
d_en: Hardware is used for installations, repairs, or maintenance tasks in industrial and commercial facilities.

kids.d_tr: Tel askılar ve askı setleri; mekanik, elektrik ve tesisat bileşenlerini tavandan veya üst yapıdan asmak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Wire hangers and suspension kits are used to suspend mechanical, electrical, and plumbing components of building services from ceilings or overhead structures. They include various items such as wire ropes, cables, brackets, and clamps to securely support suspended loads.

kids.d_tr: Kapı donanımları kapıların açılıp kapanmasını ve geçiş sağlamasını mümkün kılar.
kids.d_en: Door hardware allows doors to open and close so people can pass through an entryway.

kids.d_tr: Kilit takımları ve panik barlar; kapıları açıp kapatan mandal, kilit mekanizması ve farklı kollara sahiptir.
kids.d_en: Locksets and exit devices have latches, locking mechanisms, and different handles that open and close doors.

kids.d_tr: Kapı kilitleri ve karşılıkları kapıları güvene alır ve içeridekilerin güvenliğini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Door locks and strike plates secure doors and locks and keep occupants safe.

kids.d_tr: Kapı kapatıcılar ve otomatlar, uyumlu kapı ve geçiş sistemleriyle birlikte çalışarak açılan kapıyı otomatik kapatır.
kids.d_en: Door closers and operators work in tandem with compatible doors and access control systems to automatically close doors when they’ve been opened and released.

kids.d_tr: Kapı koruyucuları, fırçaları ve fitilleri kapıya takılarak zorla girişe karşı korur ve istenmeyen etkenlerin içeri girmesini engeller.
kids.d_en: Door guards, sweeps, and weatherstripping install onto doors to protect them from break-ins and vandalism and to block out unwanted elements from entering a room or building.

kids.d_tr: Kapı stoperleri duvarları kapı kolu ve benzeri parçaların çarpmasından, iz ve delik oluşmasından korur.
kids.d_en: Door stops protect walls from contact with doorknobs, levers, and other parts which may produce scuff marks or holes in the walls. They typically mount onto floors, walls, and doors. Door holders keep doors propped open to allow hands-free entry and exit, maintain airflow, and prevent doors from slamming shut.

kids.d_tr: Kapı eşikleri kapının altına takılarak kapı ile zemin arasındaki boşluğu kapatır.
kids.d_en: Door thresholds install underneath doors to cover gaps where the door meets the floor. They prevent water, air, insects, and other unwanted elements from entering rooms and help align rooms with different flooring.

kids.d_tr: Kapı rampaları, eşik veya kapı kasası zeminle aynı hizada olmadığında yumuşak bir geçiş oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Door ramps create a smooth transition through a doorway when the threshold or door frame is uneven with the walking surface. They minimize tripping hazards and enable carts, hand trucks, wheelchairs, or other wheeled equipment to roll easily through the doorway.

kids.d_tr: Kapı dürbünleri, güvenlik için kapıyı açmadan önce dışarıdakinin görülmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Door viewers allow occupants to see who’s at the door before opening for increased security. Door knockers install onto doors and let occupants hear when someone is waiting at the door.

kids.d_tr: Sürgülü kapı donanımları kilit, kol, ray seti ve makara gibi parçalarla kapıları güvenli ve çalışır tutar.
kids.d_en: Sliding door hardware includes items such as locks, handles, track kits, and rollers to keep doors secure and operational.

kids.d_tr: Cam kapı donanımları cam kapıların bağlanması, sabitlenmesi ve çalıştırılması için gereken parçaları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Glass door hardware includes parts and components that are used to attach, secure, and operate glass doors.

kids.d_tr: Sineklik kapı donanımları sineklik montajı ve işlevinin artırılması için gereken parçaları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Screen door hardware includes parts and components required to install screens and enhance their functionality.

kids.d_tr: Pencere donanımları binaları davetsiz misafir, haşere ve hava koşullarından korur.
kids.d_en: Window hardware helps protect buildings from intruders, pests, and weather.

kids.d_tr: Yedek sineklik teli, yıpranmış veya hasarlı mevcut siparişleri onarır ve yeniler.
kids.d_en: Door and window replacement screen repairs, refreshes, and renovates worn or damaged existing screens. They provide enhanced aesthetics while minimizing the ingress of pests in commercial, residential, manufacturing, food service, and educational applications.

kids.d_tr: Kauçuk kilitli fitiller sabit cam ve ön camları panel ile çerçevelere monte eder ve yalıtır.
kids.d_en: Rubber locking gaskets mount and seal stationary panes of glass and windshields into panels and frames. They work in commercial and automotive glass applications.

kids.d_tr: Kapı ve pencere fitilleri iç mekanları haşere, hava koşulları, toz, su sızıntısı ve gürültüye karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Window and door seals help protect indoor spaces against pests, weather elements, dirt, dust, water leaking, and noise. They can also be used to seal gaps for energy efficiency, preventing heat loss in cold weather months in commercial, manufacturing, hospitality, healthcare, educational, and correctional applications.

kids.d_tr: Pencere yalıtım setleri soğuk aylarda ısı kaybını önler.
kids.d_en: Window insulation kits prevent loss of heat during colder months. They install around windows with double-sided tape or nails and stretch tight when exposed to heat, forming a tight seal to increase R-values and add a layer of protection against cold outside temperatures. Window insulation kits are used on exterior windows in commercial, industrial, and residential applications.

kids.d_tr: Pencere kilitleri ve donanımları pencerelerin açılıp kapanmasını denetler ve sınırlar.
kids.d_en: Window locks and hardware control and limit access to the opening and closing actions of windows. They repair and provide enhanced function of existing and new window installations in commercial businesses, rental properties, and permanent residence applications.

kids.d_tr: Pencere güvenlik parmaklıkları pencere ve diğer açıklıklardan istenmeyen geçişi engeller.
kids.d_en: Window security bars prevent unwanted passage through windows and other openings. They can be a fixed size or adjustable to fit different openings and are commonly used in high-security areas.

kids.d_tr: Pencere açılım sınırlayıcıları, kaza ve yaralanmayı önlemek için pencerenin ne kadar açılacağını sınırlar.
kids.d_en: Window opening control devices limit how far a window will open to prevent accidents and injuries.

kids.d_tr: Kollar, tutamaklar ve düğmeler gereken yerde sağlam bir kavrama noktası sunar.
kids.d_en: Handles, pulls, and knobs provide a firm gripping location where needed.

kids.d_tr: Kollar ve tutamaklar kapı, dolap veya çekmeceye takılarak kolay açılıp kapanmayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Handles and pulls attach to doors, cabinets, or drawers to enable easy opening and closing. They are suitable for use in office breakrooms, workshops, kitchens, and cabinetry.

kids.d_tr: Yük taşıyıcı tutamaklar, endüstriyel ve ticari ortamlarda ağır ve tekrarlı kullanım içindir.
kids.d_en: Load-rated pull handles are for heavy-duty, repetitive use in industrial and commercial settings. They have a stated load capacity and are used on drawers and doors that support heavy loads and require force to operate.

kids.d_tr: Gömme kollar ve tutamaklar, yüzeyden neredeyse hiç taşmadan çekmece, dolap ve kapıları açıp kapatır.
kids.d_en: Recessed handles and pulls open and close drawers, cabinets, and doors with minimal protrusion from the surface. They prevent snags and create a smooth streamlined appearance in commercial, healthcare, educational, correctional, and residential applications.

kids.d_tr: Dolap düğmeleri dolap kapak ve çekmecelerinin açılıp kapanmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Cabinet knobs help open and close cabinet doors and drawers. They provide a positive grip and a decorative look to match or complement new and existing cabinet components. They are used in commercial, healthcare, hospitality, and residential cabinet repair and installation applications.

kids.d_tr: Dolap kapı düğmeleri uyumlu gömme dolap kapaklarını açar ve çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: Closet door knobs open and operate compatible closet doors.

kids.d_tr: El düğmeleri makineleri çalıştıran temel kumanda elemanı olarak ve parçaları sabitleyen basit sıkma aparatı olarak kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hand knobs serve as basic controls to operate machinery and function as simple clamps to secure parts and materials.

kids.d_tr: El volanları bir mile takılarak döner; mili çevirerek makine ve bileşenleri çalıştırır ve ayarlar.
kids.d_en: Hand wheels mount onto a shaft and turn in a circle, rotating the shaft to operate and adjust machinery, equipment, and components. They mount to equipment to perform a variety of tasks, including opening and closing valves, positioning work tables and tooling, and engaging rollers and tensioners.

kids.d_tr: Makine kolları takım tezgahlarına monte edilir ve tezgahta elle ayar yapmak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Machine handles mount to machine tools and are used to make manual adjustments to the machines.

kids.d_tr: Çekmece rayları uyumlu çekmecelerin sorunsuz açılıp kapanmasını sağlar; genel ve ağır hizmet uygulamalarında dayanıklılık sunar.
kids.d_en: Drawer slides open and close compatible drawers smoothly, providing convenience and durability in general purpose and heavy-duty drawer applications found in commercial and residential kitchens, tool cribs, maintenance shops, and storage cabinets.

kids.d_tr: Menteşeler, bir mafsalla birleştirilmiş iki kanattan oluşur.
kids.d_en: Hinges include two leaves joined by a knuckle that holds them together.

kids.d_tr: Düz menteşeler ortadaki mafsalda pimle birleşen iki dikdörtgen kanattan oluşur; bir kanat kapıya, diğeri kasaya monte edilir.
kids.d_en: Butt hinges have two rectangular mounting plates, called leaves, connected at a center knuckle joined by a hinge pin. One leaf mounts on the door, while the other mounts to the frame, allowing up to 180° swinging motion. Butt hinges are the most used type of door hinge.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli menteşeler, kilit veya panik bar ile geçiş kontrol sistemi arasında sürekli elektrik akımı iletir.
kids.d_en: Electrified hinges conduct a continuous flow of electric current between locks or exit devices and an access control system. They allow users to control or monitor opening and closing of doors.

kids.d_tr: Piano menteşeler ağırlığı menteşe boyunca eşit dağıtarak ek destek ve denge sağlar.
kids.d_en: Piano hinges distribute weight evenly across the length of the hinge, providing added support and stability. Also called continuous hinges, metal hinges have a central pin with leaves on both sides that run down the entire length of a door or lid. Plastic hinges are one-piece units that do not require a pin.

kids.d_tr: Sökülebilir menteşeler, menteşeyi çıkarmadan kapının kaldırılıp kasadan ayrılmasına imkan verir.
kids.d_en: Lift-off hinges allow doors to be lifted and removed from the frame without removing the hinges. These hinges make it convenient to use the full width of the doorway in high-traffic areas and facilities that receive large or frequent deliveries.

kids.d_tr: Pivot menteşeler kapının üst ve alt kısmına dikey eksende bağlanır.
kids.d_en: Pivot hinges attach to the top and bottom of doors on a vertical axis. These hinges support larger, heavier doors than standard hinges, as the door’s weight is distributed down to the floor instead of on the frame. They are also less visible than standard hinges for a cleaner, more aesthetic appearance.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı menteşeler mafsalda pimle birleşen iki kanattan oluşur; içindeki yay mekanizması kapıyı açık konumdan otomatik kapatır.
kids.d_en: Spring hinges have two rectangular mounting plates, called leaves, connected at a center knuckle and joined by a hinge pin. They have a built-in spring mechanism that automatically closes the door from an open position. The tension of the spring is adjustable to determine the closing power of the door.

kids.d_tr: Gizli menteşeler hem kapı hem kasa yüzeyiyle aynı hizada takılır.
kids.d_en: Concealed hinges install flush with both the door and frame surfaces. Also called hidden hinges, they remain concealed from view when the door is closed for a more aesthetically pleasing appearance.

kids.d_tr: Özel menteşeler endüstriyel, ticari ve konut ortamlarındaki belirli uygulama ihtiyaçlarını karşılar.
kids.d_en: Specialty hinges meet specific application needs for industrial, commercial, and residential settings.

kids.d_tr: Kilit kancaları, mandallar ve tutucular kapı, dolap ve kapakları kapalı tutan mekanizmalardır.
kids.d_en: Hasps, latches, and catches are mechanisms that fasten doors, cabinets, or lids shut.

kids.d_tr: Kilit kancaları kapı, bahçe kapısı ve dolaplara takılarak kapalıyken kilitlenmelerini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Hasps install on doors, gates, and cabinets to lock and secure them when closed. They are used for indoor and outdoor applications to restrict access, deter theft, and increase security.

kids.d_tr: Bastırmalı mandallar kapı ve dolapları kapalı ve güvenli tutar.
kids.d_en: Push-to-close latches and catches keep doors or cabinets closed and secure. Latches open when a button is pushed, use a mechanism that catches or hooks the door, or use a magnetic power source to pull doors shut and prevent them from opening.

kids.d_tr: Sıkıştırmalı mandallar, bir eksende dönerek mandalı serbest bırakan veya sabitleyen kam ya da cıvatadan oluşur.
kids.d_en: Compression latches consist of a cam or bolt that rotates on an axis to release or secure a pawl or lever, which then seals the panel or door shut. They have compression gaskets to form a tighter seal than standard cam latches and are often used for applications that require protection against dust, water, or vibration.

kids.d_tr: Çekme mandalları iki farklı yüzeye takılan kanca ve karşılıktan oluşur; kapı, sandık ve alet kutularını kapalı tutar.
kids.d_en: Draw latches have a clasp and hatch that attach to two different surfaces and connect to hold doors, chests, toolboxes, and other storage compartments together. Also called tension latches, they form a tight seal that prevents lids and doors from opening, even when moved or exposed to vibration.

kids.d_tr: Kapı sürgüleri, mandalları ve zincirleri konut, apartman ve otellerde ek güvenlik sağlamak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Door bolts, latches, and chain guards are often used with doors in residential homes, apartments, and hotels to provide increased security.

kids.d_tr: Asma kapı mandal ve kilitleri, kolay tek elle çıkışı korurken kapının kazara açılmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Hanging door latches, locks, and hardware prevent accidental opening of hanging doors while maintaining easy one-handed egress. They provide firm closures for hanging doors without requiring a key to open. They work in commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and residential applications.

kids.tr: Köşe Koruyucular, Duvar Koruma ve Küpeşteler
kids.d_tr: Köşe koruyucular, duvar koruma ürünleri ve küpeşteler yoğun geçişli koridorlarda duvarlarda iz ve darbe hasarını önler.
kids.d_en: Corner guards, wall protection, and handrails help prevent scuff and impact damage to walls in high traffic corridors.

kids.d_tr: Köşe ve kenar koruyucular ile tamponlar darbe kuvvetini emip dağıtarak hassas köşelerin zarar görmesini engeller.
kids.d_en: Corner guards, edge guards, and bumpers absorb and distribute forces from impacts to prevent damage to vulnerable corners in walkways and corridors.

kids.d_tr: Darbe bariyerleri ve tamponlar duvar yüzeylerini araba ve sedyelerin bıraktığı çizik, iz ve eziklerden korur.
kids.d_en: Crash rails and bumper guards protect wall surfaces from scrapes, scuffs, and dents left by carts and gurneys. They protrude from wall surfaces to absorb impacts and extend scheduled maintenance intervals for finished walls in commercial offices, healthcare, hospitality, and institutional facilities.

kids.d_tr: Kombine küpeşte ve duvar koruyucular ergonomik bir tutunma yüzeyi sunarken duvarları çizik ve eziklerden korur.
kids.d_en: Combined handrail and wall guards provide an integrated ergonomic grip surface while protecting wall surfaces from scrapes, scuffs, and dents left by carts and gurneys. They protrude from wall surfaces to assist pedestrians, absorb impacts, and extend scheduled maintenance intervals for finished walls in commercial offices, healthcare, hospitality, and institutional facilities.

kids.d_tr: Küpeşteler koridor ve merdivenlerde hareket ederken güvenlik ve destek sağlar.
kids.d_en: Handrails provide safety and support while navigating walkways, corridors, and stairwells. They help prevent injuries from falls while providing ergonomic support in offices, hospitals, residences, and hospitality applications.

kids.d_tr: Kapı kolu duvar koruyucuları, kapı kilit takımı ile bitişik duvar arasında darbe bariyeri oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Door handle wall guards provide an impact barrier between door locksets and adjacent walls within a door's path of travel.

kids.d_tr: Koruyucu duvar panelleri ve kaplamaları, araba ve sedyelerin bıraktığı çizik ile ezikleri önleyen geniş formatlı esnek levhalardır.
kids.d_en: Protective wall panels and coverings are large-format resilient sheets that prevent scrapes, scuffs, and dents left by carts and gurneys. They install flat on wall surfaces to absorb impacts and extend scheduled maintenance intervals for finished walls in commercial offices, healthcare, hospitality, and institutional facilities.

kids.d_tr: Duvar koruma şeritleri, sandalye ve ekipman temasından kaynaklanan darbe ve izlere karşı ince profilli hedefli koruma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Wall rub rails and strips provide strategic low-profile protection for walls against impacts and scuffs caused by contact with chairs, carts, and equipment. They work in conference rooms, high-traffic areas, and corridors found in healthcare environments, commercial office spaces, and hospitality applications. Wall rub rails and strips can be installed with adhesive or compatible screws.

kids.d_tr: Duvar ve küpeşte yapıştırıcıları, duvar koruma bileşenlerini dikey yüzeylere sabitler.
kids.d_en: Wall and handrail adhesives and sealers attach wall protection components to vertical surfaces. They are color-matched to seamlessly blend with compatible wall protection bars, rails, strips, and panels in healthcare, hospitality, education, and office applications.

kids.d_tr: Sızdırmazlık malzemeleri kenar, delik ve panellerin yanına monte edilen bileşenler için koruyucu bariyer oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Sealing supplies form protective barriers for components mounted adjacent to edges, holes, and panels.

kids.d_tr: O-ringler iki nesne arasında sıkı bir yalıtım oluşturan halka biçimli contalardır; sıvı ve gaz kaçağını önler.
kids.d_en: O-rings are circular-shaped gaskets that form tight seals between two objects to prevent liquids or gases from leaking.

kids.d_tr: Kauçuk kenar profilleri iç ve dış mekan uygulamalarında koruyucu bir bariyer sağlar.
kids.d_en: Rubber edging provides a protective barrier for indoor and outdoor installations. It helps protect exposed edges from wear caused by wind, water, and dust. Rubber edging resists rot and decay making it a popular choice for long-term landscaping projects. It can also be applied to lighting fixtures and storage containers.

kids.d_tr: Kauçuk kenar fitilleri yüzey kenarlarına takılarak yastıklama, hava sızdırmazlığı, yangın direnci veya dekoratif görünüm sağlar.
kids.d_en: Rubber edge trim seals mount on the edge of surfaces to provide cushioning, weatherproofing, fire resistance, or decoration. They are used in construction, automotive, industrial, and commercial applications.

kids.d_tr: Delik tapaları kasa deliklerini, kablo çıkışlarını ve üretim erişim deliklerini alet gerekmeden kapatır.
kids.d_en: Hole plugs fill chassis holes, wiring outlets, and production access holes without tools. They create finished appearances and protect against dirt, debris, and unwanted damage.

kids.d_tr: Naylon burçlar kablo, boru ve hortumu sacdaki keskin ve düzensiz deliklerden korur.
kids.d_en: Nylon bushings protect wire, cable, tubing, and hose from sharp and uneven holes in sheet metal. They protect and insulate materials from contact with panel holes in HVAC, electrical, automotive, and construction applications.

kids.d_tr: Fitil uygulama aparatları kauçuk kenar profili ve sızdırmazlık ürünlerinin takılıp değiştirilmesine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Rubber edging and seal application tools aid in the installation and replacement of rubber edging and sealing products.

kids.d_tr: Yaylar uzayıp kısalarak darbeleri emer, basınç uygular ve bu basıncı korur.
kids.d_en: Springs expand and elongate to absorb impacts and apply and maintain pressure.

kids.d_tr: Baskı ve kalıp yayları, üzerlerine baskı kuvveti uygulandığında kısalan açık sarımlı helisel yaylardır.
kids.d_en: Compression and die springs are open-coiled helical springs that shorten when compressive forces are applied to them. Heavy duty compression springs absorb impacts, protect against shocks, and use stored energy to apply pressure to surfaces. Die springs have greater tensile strength than compression springs and are often used for applications that require higher compressive force, such as heavy machinery and equipment used in tool and die production.

kids.d_tr: Çekme yayları, dış kuvvet uygulanmadığında sarımları birbirine değecek şekilde sarılır.
kids.d_en: Extension springs are typically wound with their coils touching when no external force is applied. When pulled, they stretch apart to elongate and they have different end types based on desired applications.

kids.d_tr: Burulma yaylarının bir ucu sabit bir noktaya bağlıdır; diğer uç merkez ekseni etrafında dönerek gereken dönme kuvvetini üretir.
kids.d_en: Torsion springs have one end attached to a fixed point while the other end moves around the center axis to generate the necessary rotational force to hold or release objects. These springs are wound in either a clockwise (right wound) or counterclockwise (left wound) direction and offer precise control for applications that require a turning motion.

kids.d_tr: Tabak yaylar, darbe ve titreşimi emmek için esneyen yuvarlak konik yay pullarıdır.
kids.d_en: Disc and Belleville springs are round, conical-shaped spring washers that flex to absorb shocks and vibrations. They are small, compact, and used for applications where space is limited or where standard springs would not fit. Often used in combination, these springs can be stacked in different configurations to improve load-bearing and deflection capabilities. Belleville springs are a specific type of disc spring built for more heavy-duty applications. These springs come in different cut types and materials for various commercial and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Sabit kuvvetli sarmal yaylar, kenarları birbirine değene kadar sıkıca kendi üzerine sarılan bir çekme yayı türüdür.
kids.d_en: Constant-force coil springs are a type of extension spring that is tightly wound up around itself until its sides touch. When they release and are fully uncoiled and extended, they resemble a long strip of flattened metal. Small and compact, these springs typically slide onto either side of a rod or pole and provide a consistent and constant output force.

kids.d_tr: Halka yayların uçları birleşerek bir daire oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Garter springs have connected ends that come together to form a circle. They generate powerful radial forces, which help create a tight seal around electrical connectors and motor belts.

kids.d_tr: Gaz yayları ve amortisörler kapak, kaporta ve erişim panellerini sabit ve kontrollü hızda açıp kapatır.
kids.d_en: Gas springs and shock absorbers open and close doors, hatches, access panels, and other objects at steady and controlled speeds. They contain pressurized gas or liquids that provide smoother movement and make them less prone to wear than coiled metal springs. Gas springs, also known as gas struts or shocks, supply pushing or pulling force for lifting, lowering, and supporting objects such as vehicle tailgates, trunks, and machinery hatches. Shock absorbers, also called dampers, slow the motion of doors or lids, so they close gently and quietly to avoid damage.

kids.d_tr: Döner damperler, bir nesnenin dönüşünü yavaşlatan viskoz sıvı dolu mekanik elemanlardır.
kids.d_en: Rotary dampers are mechanical devices filled with viscous fluids that slow or decelerate the rotation of an object. These motion dampers ensure objects move with a controlled and measured motion to reduce noise and vibration and help improve safe operating conditions by eliminating abrupt movement. Rotary dampers control the rate at which doors, drawers, and lids close and prevent damage to industrial equipment and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Brandalar ve aksesuarları eşya, yüzey ve alanları dış etkenlerden örterek korur.
kids.d_en: Tarps and tarp accessories cover and protect items, surfaces, and areas from exposure.

kids.d_tr: Brandalar, depolama ve taşıma sırasında malzemeyi korumak için kullanılan büyük ve esnek hazır kesim örtülerdir.
kids.d_en: Tarps are large, flexible pre-cut sheets of material used to protect supplies during storage and transportation. They are used in agricultural, shipping, and temporary shelter applications.

kids.d_tr: Branda aksesuarları brandaların kullanım alanını ve kabiliyetini genişletir.
kids.d_en: Tarp accessories expand the uses and capabilities of tarps.

kids.d_tr: Kancalar, halkalı makaralar ve karabinalar genel amaçlı uygulamalarda yük ve ekipmanı asar, taşır ve hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Hooks, eye pulleys, and snap hooks hang, support, and move loads and equipment in general purpose applications, which do not include fall protection or overhead lifting.

kids.d_tr: Genel amaçlı kancalar duvar ve tavanda alet, kablo ve giysiler için geçici asma ve düzenleme imkanı sunar.
kids.d_en: Utility hooks provide temporary hanging storage and organization for tools, cables, hats, and garments on walls and ceilings.

kids.d_tr: Karabinalar ve bağlantı elemanları yaylı dil veya klipsleriyle doğrudan bağlantı noktalarına takılır.
kids.d_en: Snap hooks and connectors clip directly to attachment points with spring-loaded bolts or clips. They are for light-to-moderate loads and are not intended for overhead lifting or fall protection.

kids.d_tr: S kancalar uyumlu nesneleri sabit halka ve bağlantı noktalarından asar.
kids.d_en: S-hooks hang compatible items from static-mounted eyelets and attachment points.

kids.d_tr: Halkalı makaralar, yük taşırken gereken kuvveti azaltan kuvvet çoğaltıcılardır.
kids.d_en: Eye pulleys are force multipliers used to reduce efforts while moving loads. They connect to compatible attachment points and work to route and guide cables and ropes in rigging applications.

kids.d_tr: Halat kılavuzları halatın sıkışmasını, dönmesini, burulmasını ve dolaşmasını azaltır.
kids.d_en: Rope guides reduce rope binding, spinning, twisting, and tangles. They help keep rope and paracord organized while reducing equipment wear and trip hazards in rigging applications.

kids.d_tr: Titreşim kontrolü ve ayaklar, ekipman ve makinelerin yol açtığı gürültü ile titreşim seviyesini düşürür.
kids.d_en: Vibration control and leveling mounts reduce the level of noise and vibration caused by equipment and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Yüzeye montaj titreşim takozları titreşim ve darbeyi emer; makineleri hasardan korur ve daha sessiz çalışma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Surface-mount vibration damping bumpers absorb and reduce vibration and impact to help protect machines and equipment from damage and provide quieter operation. They are commonly used in machine shops, manufacturing, transportation, electronics enclosures, and testing and measuring equipment.

kids.d_tr: Askı tipi titreşim izolatörleri asılı nesneleri taşır ve titreşim ile gürültünün yapıya geçmesini söndürür.
kids.d_en: Hanger-mount vibration isolators support suspended objects or structural elements to dampen vibration and noise transmission to a structure. These hanger-spring isolators are typically mounted in ceilings to hold suspended piping, ductwork, fans, and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Zemin tipi titreşim izolatörleri makinelerden binaya titreşim geçişini önler ve gürültüyü söndürür.
kids.d_en: Floor-mount vibration isolators help prevent vibration transmission and dampen noise from machines and equipment to buildings and structures. They are commonly used with compressors, HVAC equipment, pumps, and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Titreşim yalıtım takozlarının gövdesi dolu kauçuktur; bir ucunda montaj için dişli saplama veya dişli delik bulunur.
kids.d_en: Vibration-isolating mounts have solid rubber bodies with threaded studs or tapped holes on one end for mounting. Also called bumpers, these vibration isolator mounts absorb impact energy, dampen shock, sound, and rebound, and serve as end-stop bumpers or set-up elements for conveyors, machines, and assembly systems.

kids.d_tr: Ayarlı makine ayakları dolap, raf ve makinelerin altına takılarak dengeyi sağlar; titreşim, gürültü ve zorlanmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Leveling mounts install onto the bases or bottoms of the legs of cabinetry, shelving, and machinery to help stabilize it and reduce vibration, noise, and stress on machinery parts.

kids.d_tr: Tutamak sargıları el ve elektrikli aletlerin saplarını sararak kaymaz ve yastıklı bir kavrama sunar; darbe ve titreşimi söndürür.
kids.d_en: Grip wraps surround the handles of power and hand tools to provide a cushioned, anti-slip grip that dissipates shock and vibration transferred to the user.

kids.d_tr: Mıknatıslar ve manyetik şeritler manyetik alan üreterek demir içeren nesneleri çeker, tutar ve konumlandırır.
kids.d_en: Magnets and magnetic strips generate a magnetic field to attract, hold, move, and locate ferrous objects.

kids.d_tr: Seramik mıknatıslar demir oksit ve stronsiyum karbonat içerir; yüksek sıcaklığa ve korozyona dayanır.
kids.d_en: Ceramic magnets contain iron oxide and strontium carbonate and resist high temperatures and corrosion. Also called ferrite magnets, they are the most commonly used type of magnet and do not break as often as rare earth magnets, but are not as powerful. They come in different shapes and sizes for many commercial and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Neodyum mıknatıslar standart seramik ve alnico mıknatıslardan daha güçlü manyetik alan üretir; daha küçük ve kompakttır.
kids.d_en: Rare earth magnets generate a stronger magnetic field than standard ceramic and Alnico magnets and are smaller and more compact. They are made from rare earth elements and available in two main types: Neodymium magnets are used when a powerful magnet is required in a confined space, and Samarium cobalt magnets are used in areas with temperature fluctuations. Rare earth permanent magnets come in different styles, shapes, and sizes and are often used for various applications, including use in electric vehicles (EVs), medical devices, and linear actuators.

kids.d_tr: Destekler ve braketler çeşitli uygulamalarda yapısal destek sağlar.
kids.d_en: Braces and brackets provide structural support in various applications.

kids.d_tr: Raf ve dolap donanımları, gömme dolap raflarını ve borularını taşıyan ve güçlendiren parçaları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Shelf and closet hardware include parts and components that support and reinforce closet shelves and rods.

kids.d_tr: Destek ve takviye donanımları duvar, kiriş ve döşemelere sabitlenerek ek taşıma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Braces and reinforcement hardware fasten to walls, beams, and joists to provide added support. These brackets and plates come in various shapes, sizes, and materials to provide structural support and enhance appearance.

kids.d_tr: Sismik takviye donanımları deprem sırasında boru, kanal ve asılı ekipmanı binada sabit tutan parçaları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Seismic braces include parts and components that secure pipes, conduit, ductwork, and other hanging equipment in buildings during earthquakes. Hardware such as rigid and cable braces, retaining straps, concrete inserts, and structural bracing stabilize equipment and prevent it from moving during seismic events to minimize damage.

kids.d_tr: Yapısal destekler inşaat ve onarımda döşeme, kiriş ve diğer yapı elemanlarına geçici destek verir ve onları dengeler.
kids.d_en: Structural support braces provide temporary support and stabilize floors, beams, joists, and other architectural structures in construction and repair applications.

kids.d_tr: Askılar bağlı malzemeleri dikey yüzeylere gömülü elemanlardan asar.
kids.d_en: Hangers suspend attached materials from fasteners embedded in vertical surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Cırt bantlar iki yüzeyi tekrar tekrar birleştirerek alet gerekmeden takıp çıkarma imkanı verir.
kids.d_en: Hook and loop fasteners repeatably mate two surfaces together for easy, tool-free mounting and dismounting.

kids.d_tr: Metrajlı cırt bant ruloları küçük ve büyük ölçekli uygulamalarda kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hook and loop cut-to-length bulk rolls, also called hook and loop tape, work in large and small applications. They are customized by the end user to best suit repeated mounting requirements in production, manufacturing, and hobbyist applications.

kids.d_tr: Kesilmiş cırt bant parçaları kullanıma hazırdır; montaj için ek işlem gerektirmez.
kids.d_en: Hook and loop pre-cut pieces, also called hook and loop shapes and strips, are ready-to-use and require no modification for installation. They work in tight areas where space is a concern or when a mounted component is lightweight in automotive, electronics, and communications applications.

kids.d_tr: Cırt bantlı kayışlar, birbirine tutunan iki yüzeyi tek bir kayışta birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Hook and loop straps integrate both interacting surfaces into a single self-mating strap. They wrap and bundle items for storage and organization, preventing damage and extending the service life of items. They are used in storage, cable management, and shipping applications.

kids.d_tr: Zemin donanımları kaplama ürünlerini alt zemine sabitler; odalar ve farklı kaplamalar arasında bitmiş kenar ve geçiş oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Flooring hardware attaches flooring products to subflooring surfaces while providing finished edges and transitions between rooms and varying flooring materials.

kids.d_tr: Koruyucu kapaklar, tapalar ve ağlar ürünleri kirlilikten korur.
kids.d_en: Protective caps, plugs, and netting shield and protect products from contamination.

kids.d_tr: Sızdırmaz ve kapatma tapaları; boyama, toz boya ve galvaniz gibi yüzey işlemleri sırasında delikleri örter ve yalıtır.
kids.d_en: Sealing and finishing caps and plugs cover and seal holes during finishing or surface treatment processes such as painting, powder coating, galvanizing, and plating. They also help protect fabricated parts during shipping or storage.

kids.d_tr: Diş koruma kapakları, sevkiyat ve depolama sırasında dişli bileşenleri örterek korur.
kids.d_en: Thread-protection caps and plugs cover and protect compatible threaded components during shipping or storage. They also protect threaded components from contamination.

kids.d_tr: Sac kör tapaları; kaporta, tank ve soğutma üniteleri gibi sac ürünlerdeki delikleri kapatır.
kids.d_en: Sheet metal button plugs insert into and cover holes in parts and equipment such as auto bodies, tanks, refrigeration units, and other sheet metal products.

kids.d_tr: Genleşen koruma ağı bileşenleri sararak yastıklama sağlar ve yüzeylerini çizilme ile darbeden korur.
kids.d_en: Expandable sleeve netting surrounds components and parts to provide cushioning and protect their surfaces from marring and impact. This flexible netting is reusable and retains its elasticity and fit.

kids.d_tr: Tutamak kavramaları yuvarlak uçlu nesne ve boruların ucuna geçerek kaldırma ve taşımayı kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Handle grips fit over the ends of round-end items and tubes to help facilitate lifting and handling. They also help minimize potential damage from sharp edges or corners. Feature molded finger nubs to provide a firm grip and make handling and lifting items easier.

kids.d_tr: Köşe kapama kapakları esnektir; cam ve çerçeve köşelerine geçerek sevkiyat ve depolamada onları çatlama ve hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Corner cover caps are flexible and stretch to fit over the corners of glass, frames, and other edges to protect them from chips and damage during shipping or storage.

d_tr: Hidrolik sistemler basınçlı yağı mekanik enerjiye dönüştürür.
d_en: Hydraulics systems convert pressurized oil into mechanical energy.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik akümülatörler basınçlı akışkanı depolayıp gerektiğinde bırakır; debiyi dengede tutar, titreşimi söndürür ve kaçakları telafi eder.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic accumulators store pressurized hydraulic fluid and release it as needed to maintain steady pump flow and pressure, dampen vibrations and shocks, and compensate for leaks or thermal expansion in the system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik silindirler ve keçeler damper ve vinçleri kaldırır, presleri çalıştırır ve ağır yükleri iter, taşır ve bastırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cylinders and seals are used to lift beds and winches, operate presses, and to push, support, and press heavy loads.

kids.d_tr: Kompakt hidrolik silindirler alçak gövdeli ve metrik tasarımlıdır; yer darlığı olan noktalara monte edilebilir.
kids.d_en: Compact hydraulic cylinders have a low profile and a metric design that allows these cylinders to be installed where space is limited. They have a corrosion-resistant aluminum body with grooves on three sides to allow sensors to be mounted. A magnetic piston allows a position-indicating switch to be installed that verifies the position of the cylinder at the end of the stroke. Compact hydraulic cylinders are often used in production applications and factory automation for tasks such as clamping, pushing, lifting, and workpiece support.

kids.d_tr: Silindir bağlantı elemanları NFPA standardındaki hidrolik silindirleri ekipman, fikstür ve diğer mekanizmalara sabitler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic industrial cylinder mounts secure National Fluid Power Association (NFPA) hydraulic cylinders to equipment, fixtures, and other mechanisms. Cylinder mounts help maintain alignment and protect the cylinder from side load to increase the lifespan of the cylinder. Mounts attach to threaded stud ends, pivot holes, or bolt holes on the cylinder.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik silindir keçeleri akışkan kaçağını önler ve kir ile kirliliğin silindire girmesini engeller.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cylinder seals are used on hydraulic cylinders to prevent hydraulic fluid from leaking and help keep dirt and other contaminants from entering the cylinders.

kids.d_tr: Kaynaklı hidrolik silindirler atık tesisi, pres ve çelikhane gibi zorlu ortamlarda büyük sıcaklık değişimlerine dayanır.
kids.d_en: Welded hydraulic cylinders withstand large temperature swings in harsh industrial environments, including waste and recycling facilities, metal-fabricating presses, and steel mills. Also called round-body cylinders, welded-cross cylinders, or ag cylinders, they are lighter and more compact than tie-rod cylinders, making them a good choice for mobile applications. The barrel of the heavy-duty housing is welded directly to the end caps, strengthening the cylinder body and eliminating the need for tie rods.

kids.d_tr: Bağlama silindirleri; presleme, talaşlı imalat, test istasyonu ve montaj hatlarında parçaları konumlandırır ve sıkar.
kids.d_en: Workholding hydraulic cylinders position and clamp parts in stamping, machining, testing stations, factory automation, and assembly lines.

kids.d_tr: Kar bıçağı silindirleri, kar küreme donanımındaki yıpranmış veya hasarlı silindirlerin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: Snowplow hydraulic cylinders replace worn or damaged cylinders on snowplows.

kids.d_tr: Silindir strok kontrolleri silindir milinin dışına kelepçelenerek geri çekilme miktarını sınırlar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cylinder stroke controls clamp around the exterior of cylinder rods to limit the amount of retraction. They control the stroke length, based on the size of the stroke control segment used.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik sistem yedek parçaları sistemleri çalışır tutar, arızayı önler ve duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic system replacement parts help keep hydraulic systems working, prevent failure, and reduce downtime.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik filtrasyon ürünleri yağı temiz tutar; normal aşınmadan gelen kirliliği ve sisteme giren yeni kirlilikleri süzer.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic filtration products help keep hydraulic oil clean, which reduces contamination from normal wear and filters contaminants from new air, fluid, or components introduced into the system.

kids.d_tr: Filtrasyon arabaları, endüstriyel hidrolik sistemlerdeki yağı temizlemek için kullanılan tekerlekli taşınabilir filtrasyon üniteleridir.
kids.d_en: Filtration carts are portable wheeled filtration systems used to clean hydraulic fluid in industrial hydraulic systems, such as those found in process and automobile manufacturing. Unlike in-line filters that continuously filter fluid as it passes through the system, these portable systems are not intended to be permanently attached to the system. Clean hydraulic fluid reduces contaminant buildup and maintenance costs and extends the working life of the system.

kids.d_tr: El tipi filtrasyon üniteleri yeni yağı temizler, sistemi yıkar ve depoları tamamlar.
kids.d_en: Handheld filtration units clean new fluid, flush and drain systems, and top off reservoirs in hydraulic systems, such as those found in gear boxes, turbines, and construction and agricultural equipment. They are highly portable with a handle for carrying the unit to the service area and are not intended to be permanently attached to the hydraulic system. Clean hydraulic fluid reduces contaminant buildup, extending the working life of the system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tank filtreleri tanka takılarak akışkanı temiz ve döküntü, su ile havadan arınmış tutar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tank filters attach to tanks to keep fluid clean and free from debris, water, and air.

kids.d_tr: Hat üstü hidrolik filtreler sisteme entegre edilir ve yağdaki partikül ile kirlilikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: In-line hydraulic filters are integrated into a hydraulic system and are used to remove particulates and contaminants from hydraulic oil.

kids.d_tr: Muadil hidrolik filtre elemanları, dolmuş veya kirlenmiş orijinal filtrelerin yerine kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic interchangeable filter elements are used to replace existing OEM filters in hydraulic systems when they become full or dirty. Hydraulic filter elements get dirty as a normal part of the filtering process and need to be changed to ensure the system is functioning as intended. Filters can also be changed to meet cleaning needs, such as when higher or lower filter ratings are desired.

kids.en: Replacement Parts for Hydraulic Filtration Systems
kids.d_tr: Bu yedek parçalar hidrolik filtrasyon sistemlerinin bakım ve onarımını destekler; akışkanın temiz kalmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: These replacement parts support the maintenance and repair of hydraulic filtration systems to keep them functioning properly and ensure clean hydraulic fluid.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik rakorlar akışkan sistemlerinde bağlantıları kurar ve açıklıkları yalıtır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic fittings provide connections and seal openings in hydraulic fluid systems.

kids.d_tr: Gözetleme tapaları tek camlı göstergelerdir; varil, tank ve kaplardaki sıvı seviyesinin gözle izlenmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Sight plugs are single-pane indicators that allow visual observation and monitoring of liquid levels in barrels, tanks, or other liquid storage containers. Typically, two sight plugs mount to the exterior of a container, toward the top or bottom. The top plug indicates the container is full, while the bottom plug shows when the container is nearly empty. These plugs permit a quick inspection to show the presence of oil in gear cases and bearing housings, or show liquid levels in reservoirs and tanks.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tank tapaları kap, tank ve dişli kutularındaki açıklıkları yalıtarak kaçağı önler ve dolum ile boşaltmayı kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tank plugs seal openings in containers, tanks, and gearboxes to prevent leaks and improve control during filling and draining.

kids.d_tr: Hortum sıkma makineleri, özel hortum grupları üretmek için rakorları hidrolik hortumun ucuna preslar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic hose crimping machines press hydraulic fittings onto a length of bulk hydraulic hose to create custom assemblies.

kids.d_tr: Sıkma makineleri hidrolik sistemler için özel hortum grupları oluşturmak üzere rakorları hortuma preslar.
kids.d_en: Crimping machines press hydraulic fittings onto a length of bulk hydraulic hose to create custom assemblies for hydraulic systems. The assemblies make connections between valves, cylinders, pumps, or other components in a system. Hydraulic hose crimp machines operate on a compatible pump, and they accept compatible dies to crimp specific types and sizes of hose and fittings. They are commonly used in maintenance and hose assembly shops.

kids.en: Dies & Die Sets for Hydraulic Hose Crimping Machines
kids.d_tr: Sıkma makinesi çeneleri ve setleri, rakorları hortuma preslerken temas yüzeyini oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Dies and die sets provide the point of contact for hydraulic hose crimping machines to press fittings onto hose to create assemblies. They replace worn dies or change dies to match specific types and sizes of hydraulic fittings and hose.

kids.d_tr: Sıkma çenesi rafları çeneleri düzenler ve saklar; makineyle kullanım için hazır tutar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic hose crimper die racks organize and store dies to keep them readily available for use with crimping machines.

kids.en: Accessories for Hydraulic Hose Crimping Machines
kids.d_tr: Aksesuarlar hortum sıkma makinelerinin kabiliyetini genişletir ve kullanımını iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Accessories expand and enhance the operation of hydraulic hose crimping machines.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik motorlar ve yedek parçaları; vinç, konveyör, balyalayıcı ve karıştırıcı tahriklerini çalıştırmak için mekanik enerji üretir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic motors and replacement parts use a hydraulic power source to create mechanical energy to run winches, conveyors, balers, process equipment, mixer and agitator drives, and other industrial, agricultural, and process equipment.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik motorlar hidrolik güç kaynağını kullanarak vinç, konveyör, balyalayıcı ve proses ekipmanını çalıştıracak mekanik enerji üretir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic motors use a hydraulic power source to create mechanical energy to run winches, conveyors, balers, process equipment, mixer and agitator drives, and other industrial, agricultural, and process equipment. Gear motors, sometimes called low-speed, high-torque (LSHT) motors, have fixed displacement to provide constant torque and output motion.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik yağ soğutucuları hava veya su kullanarak sistemdeki akışkanı soğutur.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic oil coolers, also called heat exchangers, use air or water to cool fluid in hydraulic systems.

kids.d_tr: Hava soğutmalı yağ soğutucuları, tarım ve şantiye gibi elektrik erişiminin kısıtlı olduğu yerler için tasarlanmıştır.
kids.d_en: Air-cooled oil coolers are designed to be used where access to a power source is limited, such as agricultural and construction sites. Sometimes called heat exchangers, air-cooled oil coolers pass oil through a coil or core to cool the oil before it can enter the system. Keeping hydraulic oil cool helps extend system life by reducing wear and damage caused by excess heat. Heated oil causes excess wear on seals, surfaces, and other components, which can cause particulate buildup and damage components.

kids.d_tr: Fanlı yağ soğutucuları, motorla çalışan fanla ısı değiştiriciden geçen hidrolik yağı soğutur.
kids.d_en: In-line forced-air oil coolers use a motor-driven fan to cool hydraulic oil as it passes through the heat exchanger's core or coil. They are installed in a variety of systems, including truck lifts, log splitters, and auto hoists. Sometimes called heat exchangers, they are installed in-line with the hydraulic power unit and pass oil through a coil or core to cool the oil before it can enter the system. Keeping hydraulic oil cool helps extend system life by reducing wear and damage caused by excess heat. Heated oil causes excess wear on seals, surfaces, and other components, which can cause particulate buildup and damage components.

kids.d_tr: Hat dışı fanlı yağ soğutucularında entegre motor ve filtre bulunur; hidrolik yağı hem soğutur hem süzer.
kids.d_en: Off-line forced-air oil coolers have an integrated motor and filter that cool and filter hydraulic oil in hydraulic systems. Sometimes called heat exchangers, hydraulic oil coolers pass oil through a coil or core to cool the oil before it can enter the system. Keeping hydraulic oil cool helps extend system life by reducing wear and damage caused by excess heat. Heated oil causes excess wear on seals, surfaces, and other components, which can cause particulate buildup and damage components.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik aletler akışkan basıncı kullanarak havalı ve elektrikli aletlere göre daha yumuşak çalışma ve daha yüksek kuvvet sunar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tools use fluid pressure for smoother performance and higher force than air- or electric-powered tools.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tork anahtarları belirli bir kuvvet uygulayarak cıvataları hedef torka sıkar; gevşemeyi ve aşırı sıkmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic torque wrenches apply a set force to tighten nuts and bolts to a target torque so they won't loosen over time or get damaged from overtorquing.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kablo makasları keskin çeneleriyle kabloyu ezmeden, uçlarını dağıtmadan keser.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cable cutters squeeze their sharp-edged jaws through cable to shear it without flattening, splaying, or fraying the ends. This makes it easier to strip cable and slide on lugs, connectors, and other fittings. Also known as hydraulic cable shears, they make more uniform cuts with less effort than manual cable cutters.

kids.tr: Kablo Makası Yedek Bıçak ve Kafaları
kids.en: Replacement Blades & Heads for Hydraulic Cable Cutters
kids.d_tr: Kablo makası yedek bıçak ve kafaları uyumlu makasın kesme yüzeyini oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cable cutter blades and heads provide the cutting edge for a compatible cutter.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kablo sıkma kafaları pabuç ve ek konnektörlerini kabloya sıkarak lehimsiz, mekanik olarak sağlam bağlantılar kurar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cable crimping heads compress lug and splice connectors onto cable, making solderless connections that are mechanically stable and electrically sound to prevent signal loss. They apply steady force for a uniform crimp, and they operate faster and with less effort than manual crimpers.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik boru kesiciler zincirini sıkarak pis su ve drenaj borularını keser.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic pipe cutters squeeze their chain to pop through soil pipe that carries drain and wastewater. Their hydraulic operation delivers smooth performance and high force to cut pipe with less effort than manual pipe cutters. They are self-lubricating to provide a long lifespan and minimize maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik boru bükme makineleri basınç uygulayarak boru ve kanalı istenen açıda büker.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic pipe benders apply pressure to curve conduit and pipe to the desired angle. They are commonly used when setting up and repairing electrical, hydraulic, and gas lines. These hydraulic benders deliver smooth performance and high force to bend pipe with less effort than manual benders. They are self-lubricating to provide a long lifespan and minimize maintenance.

kids.tr: Hidrolik Darbeli Anahtarlar ve Somun Sıkıcılar
kids.d_tr: Hidrolik darbeli anahtarlar dönme ve darbe hareketiyle bağlantı elemanlarını sıkar ve delik açar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic impact wrenches produce a rotating and thrusting action to turn fasteners and drill holes. They use compatible impact sockets, nut runners, and bits. These hydraulic tools deliver smoother performance and higher force than their air- or electric-powered counterparts. They are self-lubricating to provide a long lifespan and minimize maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik motorlu testereler ve budayıcılar aşırı büyümüş dalları keser; ağaç ve çalılardaki kuru veya hastalıklı dalları alır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic chain saws and pruners cut back overgrowth and remove dead or diseased branches from trees and shrubs. They typically weigh less than gas-powered cutters, improving maneuverability and reducing fatigue during long-term use.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kompaktörler tabanını gevşek malzemeye vurarak onu sıkıştırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tampers pummel their foot against loosely packed material to compact it. Also known as pole tampers, they are commonly used to set asphalt patch and pack soil around newly installed utility or fence poles. These hydraulic tampers deliver smoother performance and higher force than air-powered tampers, are lighter than gas-powered tampers, and require less effort than manual tampers. They are self-lubricating to provide a long lifespan and minimize maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik vana çalıştırıcıları vanaları tekrar tekrar açıp kapatarak sertleşmelerini veya sıkışmalarını önler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic valve exercisers repeatedly open and close valves to prevent them from stiffening or seizing. They are used as part of regular maintenance on supply, sewage, and drainage lines to ensure that valve stems will operate properly in emergency situations. These hydraulic tools deliver smoother performance and higher force than their air- or electric-powered counterparts. They are self-lubricating to provide a long lifespan and minimize maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tezgah mengeneleri hidrolik mekanizmayla güçlü bir sıkma kuvveti üreterek iş parçasını güvenle tutar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic bench vises use a hydraulic mechanism to generate a strong clamping force to securely hold workpieces in place. They provide a consistent and reliable grip for automotive, fleet maintenance, agriculture, manufacturing, and general industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik cıvata gericiler cıvataya gerginlik uygulayarak yüksek yüklü uygulamalarda kopma riskini azaltır ve güvenliği artırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic bolt tensioners apply tension to bolts to help reduce the risk of bolt failure and improve safety in high-load applications. They are commonly used in oil and gas flanges, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and manufacturing machinery.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik karot makineleri beton ve duvarda tesisat, kanal ve kablo geçişi için derin, büyük çaplı delikler açar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic core drills create deep, large-diameter holes in concrete and masonry to run plumbing lines, HVAC ducts, electrical wires, telecom cables, and more. They grind out material around the edge of a hole, leaving the core intact for removal. They are powered by hydraulic pumps, so they deliver smoother performance and higher force than air or electric mag drills and can operate in wet environments.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kırıcı deliciler beton ve duvarı deler ve keskiler; yüksek darbeli, düşük frekanslı vuruş uygular.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic rotary hammers drill and chisel concrete and masonry, creating holes and delivering high-impact, low-frequency blows. Also known as hydraulic SDS drills and combination hammers, they are commonly used to drill through-holes, place anchors, and remove bricks.
