They are powered by hydraulic pumps, so they deliver smoother performance and higher force than air or electric rotary hammers and can operate in wet environments.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik taşınabilir şerit testereler esnek bir bıçağı iki tekerlek üzerinde döndürerek boru ve profilleri temiz kenarlarla keser.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic portable band saws (also called hydraulic portabands) turn a flexible blade around two wheels to cut through and leave clean edges on pipe, conduit, threaded rod, and other structural elements. They are powered by hydraulic pumps, so they deliver smoother performance and higher force than air or electric portabands and can operate in wet environments.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik boru kesme setleri montaj için boruyu ölçüsüne keser veya onarımda hasarlı bölümü çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic pipe cutting kits slice through pipe to cut a length for installation or remove damaged sections when making repairs. Also known as hydraulic belly saws, they make clean cuts and leave smooth edges that require minimal deburring. They are powered by hydraulic pumps, so they deliver smoother performance and higher force than air or electric pipe cutters and can operate in wet environments.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik güç üniteleri yağı basınçlandırarak hidrolik lift, alet ve ekipmana güç verir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic power units (HPUs) pressurize oil to power hydraulic lifts, tools, and equipment.

kids.d_tr: DC hidrolik güç üniteleri akülü çalışır; damperli römork, tarım ve deniz ekipmanları ile taşınabilir aletlere güç verir.
kids.d_en: DC hydraulic power units (HPUs) are battery-operated and used to power tail-gate lifts, agricultural and marine equipment, dump trailers, and other portable hydraulic tools. They are smaller and more compact than AC power units and can be installed in hard-to-reach areas. DC hydraulic power units can be operated where access to a reliable electrical power source is limited or unavailable. They provide higher amounts of force than traditional electrical and mechanical systems, allowing hydraulic power units to lift and move heavier loads in a smaller footprint. DC hydraulic power units also provide precise movement and speed control over a wide range of speeds and load weights.

kids.d_tr: Benzinli hidrolik güç üniteleri, elektriğin bulunmadığı yerlerde motorlu testere ve odun yarıcı gibi aletlere güç sağlar.
kids.d_en: Gasoline-powered hydraulic power units deliver power to hydraulic chain saws, log splitters, and other mobile tools where access to electrical power is unavailable. Sometimes called engine-driven power packs, gas-power hydraulic power units provide higher flow rates than DC hydraulic power units. They provide higher amounts of force than traditional electrical and mechanical systems, allowing hydraulic power units to lift and move heavier loads in a smaller footprint. They also provide precise movement and speed control over a wide range of speeds and load weights.

kids.tr: Güç Ünitesi Yedek Parça ve Aksesuarları
kids.en: Hydraulic Power Unit Replacement Parts & Accessories
kids.d_tr: Güç ünitesi yedek parça ve aksesuarları mevcut sistemlerin kabiliyetini artırır veya yıpranmış parçaları değiştirir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic power unit (HPU) replacement parts and accessories extend the capabilities of existing systems or replace worn or damaged parts. HPUs power hydraulic tools such as auto hoists, hydraulic chain saws, and truck bed lifts.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik pompalar akışkanı alet ve makinelere taşır; lift, pres, kesici ve konveyörleri çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic pumps circulate or transfer hydraulic fluids to tools and machinery, operating lifts, presses, cutters, pavers, and conveyors.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli hidrolik pompa üniteleri lift, yarıcı ve delici gibi uyumlu hidrolik ekipmanı bağlar ve çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: Electric hydraulic pump units connect to and operate compatible hydraulic equipment, such as lifts, splitters, and punchers.  Electric pump units use compatible DC batteries or plug into a nearby outlet to operate the pump and generate hydraulic power. They are faster and create more pressure than air and manual-operated units.

kids.d_tr: Havalı pompa üniteleri kompresöre bağlanarak hidrolik güç üretir.
kids.d_en: Air-operated pump units connect to air compressors to create hydraulic power. They connect to and operate compatible hydraulic equipment, such as lifts, cutters, spreaders, and test instruments. Air-operated units can be relocated wherever the pump is needed and are suited for locations with limited access to gas motors.

kids.d_tr: Manuel pompa üniteleri el veya ayak gücüyle debi üretir ve enerjiyi hidrolik güce çevirir.
kids.d_en: Manual-operated pump units use hand or foot power to generate flow and convert energy into hydraulic power. They connect to and operate compatible hydraulic lifts, cutters, spreaders, test instruments, and other hydraulic equipment. Manual hydraulic pump units are lighter than air-operated and electric units and can be easily relocated to wherever the pump is needed. They're suited for hazardous locations and environments that don't have access to a gas motor, electricity, or an air compressor.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik dişli pompalar; tarım, imalat, inşaat ve malzeme taşıma uygulamalarında akışkanı sistem boyunca hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic gear pumps move hydraulic fluid through a hydraulic system to power tools and equipment in agricultural, industrial machining, construction, and material-handling applications. Their meshing gears rotate within the pump housing to produce a consistent flow and feature a simple pump design, making them easier to maintain than other hydraulic pumps. Gear pumps are self-priming, drawing liquids from sources below the pump's inlet, but require an initial prime to create a proper seal.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik paletli pompalar kayar paletlerle akışkanı hareket ettirerek yumuşak ve düzenli bir debi üretir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic vane pumps use sliding vanes to move fluid through a hydraulic system, producing smooth, consistent flows. These pumps produce minimal noise and reduced flow ripple or pulsation compared to most other hydraulic pumps. They circulate hydraulic fluid through hydraulic systems and power tools such as injection molding machines, die-casting tool systems, and construction equipment in material-handling and construction applications.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik pistonlu pompalar ileri geri hareket eden pistonlarla akışkanı diğer pompalara göre daha yüksek basınçta ve verimli sirküle eder.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic piston pumps use reciprocating pistons that move back and forth to circulate hydraulic fluid at higher pressures and more efficiently than other hydraulic pumps. They circulate hydraulic fluid in hydraulic systems and power construction machinery for heavy-duty hydraulic applications.

kids.d_tr: Bu yedek parçalar hidrolik pompaların bakım ve onarımını destekleyerek akışkan sirkülasyonunun sürmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: These replacement parts support the maintenance and repair of hydraulic pumps to keep them functioning to circulate hydraulic fluids to tools and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Motor tahrikli hidrolik pompa üniteleri iki hızda çalışarak yüksek performans ve güvenilirlik sunar.
kids.d_en: Engine-driven hydraulic pump units operate at two speeds, ensuring high performance and reliability. They are commonly used in structure moving, construction, and rigging applications, and are ideal for jobsites where electricity or compressed air are not available.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik krikolar ve aparatlar bir güç kaynağına bağlanarak ağır yük taşıma ve sıkı geçme parçaları ayırma gibi işlerde yüksek kuvvet uygular.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic rams and tools attach to a hydraulic power source to apply large amounts of force required when supporting heavy loads, spreading and pulling apart press-fit parts, and tightening and loosening fasteners.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik bakım setleri, parça bükme ve doğrultma ile makine kaldırma gibi işler için gereken ekipman ve ataşmanları içerir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic maintenance sets include the items and attachments needed to perform a variety of maintenance tasks, such as bending and straightening parts and lifting machinery. Sets include a hydraulic cylinder, hand pump, and compatible accessories.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik somun kırıcılar hidrolik pompaya bağlanarak paslanmış veya sıkışmış somunları kırıp cıvatayı kurtarır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic nut splitters attach to a hydraulic pump to break apart corroded or frozen nuts to free the bolt. The nut splitter is placed around the nut and a blade is pushed through the nut to cut it free from the bolt. Industrial nut splitter tools are used to break nuts in a variety of applications, including off pipe flanges, machinery, and structures.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kriko aksesuarları uyumlu krikolarla kullanılarak montajı kolaylaştırır, güvenliği artırır veya yıpranmış parçaları değiştirir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic ram accessories pair with compatible hydraulic rams to aid installation, increase safety and functionality, or replace worn and damaged parts.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik makine kaldırıcıları bir pompaya bağlanarak ağır ekipman imalatında ve endüstriyel montajda makineleri kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic ram machine lifts (sometimes called toe jacks) connect to a hydraulic pump to lift machinery in heavy equipment manufacturing and to install and place machinery in industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik çektirmeler rulman, dişli ve kasnak gibi sıkı geçme parçaları çekerek ayırır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic ram pullers perform pulling tasks and pull apart press-fit parts, such as bearings, gears, and pulleys. They apply less force to move parts than mechanical pullers that use rotational torque in addition to linear force, reducing wear and the risk of damaging parts. Hydraulic pullers attach to a hydraulic pump and can be set up and operated remotely, which allows operators to stand a safe distance away from the parts being moved.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik krikolar ağır yükleri kaldırmak ve taşımak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic rams (sometimes called hydraulic cylinder rams, porta powers, and hydraulic jacks) are used to lift and support heavy loads.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik ayırıcılar bir pompaya veya güç kaynağına bağlanarak parçaları kaldırır, ayırır veya açar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic ram spreaders attach to a hydraulic pump or power source to lift, separate, or spread parts. Ram and wedge-style spreaders have jaws or wedges that fit into tight spaces to pry pieces apart or to lift items in stages. Collet-style spreaders separate flanges by inserting collets into bolt holes on the flanges. These tools are often used in general material handling, pipe flange maintenance, and rigging.

kids.d_tr: Öngerme krikoları; yüksek sıcaklık, kirli ve gürültülü ortamlarda zemin üstü beton döşemeler ve yüksek yapı işlerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic post-tension and stressing jacks are used for high temperature, dirty, or loud applications with concrete slabs that are directly on the ground as well as high rise and elevated work. They feature internal fuel controls for safe, efficient operation and a fast return time.

kids.d_tr: Senkronize hidrolik kaldırma sistemleri ağır nesnelerin eşzamanlı kaldırılması ve indirilmesinde hassas kontrol sağlar.
kids.d_en: Synchronized hydraulic lifting systems provide precise control for synchronous lifting and lowering or pushing and pulling of heavy objects. These systems are used with large structures, machinery, and heavy components in construction, infrastructure, and manufacturing applications.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tanklar, sistemin kullandığı yağ hacmi değiştikçe fazla akışkanı depolar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tanks and reservoirs hold excess hydraulic fluid as the volume of oil used by the system changes.

kids.d_tr: Alüminyum hidrolik tanklar sistemdeki fazla akışkanı depolar.
kids.d_en: Aluminum hydraulic tanks store excess hydraulic fluid in a hydraulic system. They are lighter than steel tanks and also provide better heat dissipation to cool hydraulic fluid as it passes through the tank and before it re-enters the hydraulic system. Tanks also allow air to escape from the fluid. Hydraulic tanks are used in applications where fluid level fluctuates, such as material handling, agricultural, and industrial applications. Cooling and cleaning hydraulic fluid reduces contaminant buildup, which reduces maintenance costs and extends the working life of the system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tank flanşları boru ve hortumları depo tankına bağlar ve yalıtır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tank flanges connect and seal pipes and tubing to a reservoir tank in a hydraulic system. They form a secure seal that helps eliminate leaks that can cause pressure to fluctuate inside the tank. Hydraulic flanges also keep out contaminants that can damage system components. Hydraulic tanks and reservoirs hold excess hydraulic fluid as the amount of oil being used by the system changes. Tanks are used in applications where fluid level fluctuates, such as material handling, agricultural, and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik tank takozları havadaki kirliliğin tanka girmesini engelleyerek akışkanı temiz tutar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tank isolators, sometimes called hydraulic reservoir isolators, keep hydraulic fluid clean by preventing airborne contaminants from entering hydraulic tanks. This prevents buildup inside the hydraulic system, which can shorten the life of the system and increase maintenance requirements.

kids.d_tr: Pompa ve motor bağlantı elemanları hidrolik pompa ile motorları tank kapağına veya diğer montaj yüzeylerine sabitler.
kids.d_en: Pump and motor mounts secure hydraulic pumps and motors to hydraulic tank lids or other mounting surfaces. Hydraulic motors and pumps are used to power hydraulic systems and move hydraulic fluid through the system. Motors and pumps can cause vibration that results in excess noise or can strain tanks or mounting surfaces. Hydraulic motor mounts have a stiff surface to provide additional support. Dampening bars help reduce noise and vibration, and adapters ensure pumps and mounts are correctly aligned.

kids.d_tr: Çelik hidrolik tanklar kaynaklı dikişlidir; malzeme taşıma ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda yedek akışkanı depolar.
kids.d_en: Steel hydraulic reservoir tanks have welded seams and are used for storing reserve fluid in hydraulic systems, such as those found in material handling and industrial applications. Heavy-duty steel hydraulic tanks have a top plate that can support peripherals, such as motors and pumps. Hydraulic tanks and reservoirs hold excess hydraulic fluid as the needs in a hydraulic system change. They also cool and filter fluid as it passes through the system and allow air escape from the fluid. Cooling and cleaning hydraulic fluid reduces contaminant buildup, which reduces maintenance costs and extends the working life of the system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik valfler ve akış kontrol ürünleri akışkanı sistemde yönlendirerek hareketin hızını, kuvvetini ve yönünü düzenler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic valves and flow control products direct and distribute hydraulic fluid through a system to regulate the speed, force, and direction of generated motion.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik kartuş valfler kompakt, geçmeli valflerdir; sistemdeki akışkan iletimini devre içinde denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic cartridge valves are compact, slip-in valves used to control a hydraulic system's transmission of fluids through a circuit. Also known as logic valves, they insert into bases or manifolds to function as part of a hydraulic circuit or system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik akış bölücüler sistemdeki sıvının akış yönünü ve basıncını denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic flow dividers control the flow direction and pressure of liquids in a hydraulic system. They are used to balance actuators and provide predictable flow to outlets where pressure requirements may vary.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik küresel vanalar yüksek basınçlı sistemlerde akışkan akışını denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic ball valves control fluid flow in high-pressure hydraulic systems. They provide unrestricted flow in the open position and full flow stop in the closed position.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik çek valfler sistemdeki akışkanın akış yönünü denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic check valves control the flow direction of hydraulic fluids in a hydraulic system. They provide free flow in one direction and dependable shutoff in the opposite direction. Hydraulic check valves prevent backflow and support loads and are used in manifolds, tanks, and hydraulic lines.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik blok valfler birden fazla hidrolik kontrolü merkezi bir modülde toplar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic stack valves consolidate multiple hydraulic controls into a centralized module. Each working section bolts together with an inlet and outlet section to minimize leaks and heat buildup. Hydraulic stack valves are used in presses, automotive hydraulics systems, and forklifts.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik manifold valfler sistemlerde akışkan debisini denetler ve düzenler.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic manifold valves control and regulate fluid flow in hydraulic systems.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik seçici valfler akışkanı iki devreden birine yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic selector valves divert fluid flow to one of two circuits.

kids.d_tr: Manuel kumandalı monoblok valfler, iç makarayı elle konumlandırarak giriş ile çıkış arasındaki geçitleri açıp kapatır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic manual spool monoblock valves control the flow of fluid by manually positioning an internal spool to obstruct or open passages between inlet and outlet ports.

kids.d_tr: Bu emniyet valfleri fazla basıncı tanka yönlendirerek basıncı sınırlar ve sistem bileşenlerini korur.
kids.d_en: These pressure relief valves protect hydraulic system components by limiting pressure by directing excess pressure to the tank.

kids.d_tr: Bu kontrol valfleri sistemdeki basıncı düzenler ve sınırlar içinde tutar.
kids.d_en: These control valves regulate pressure in a hydraulic system, keeping pressure limited. They can be set at a desired value to maintain pressure in part of a circuit.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik akış kontrol valfleri gereken debiyi koruyarak sistemin en iyi performansta çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic flow control valves ensure optimum hydraulic system performance by maintaining required specified fluid flow rates. They install in-line on specified hydraulic circuits.

kids.d_tr: Tank tahliye vanaları ve rakorları hidrolik tank ile diğer kaplardaki akışkanın kolayca boşaltılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic tank drain valves and fittings enable easy draining of fluid from hydraulic tanks and other vessels. When open, valves allow liquid to flow through a hose into another container. Fittings connect to drain valves for faster, efficient drainage.

d_tr: Aydınlatma ürünleri iş yerlerini, acil durumları ve belirli görev alanlarını aydınlatır.
d_en: Lighting products illuminate workplaces, emergency situations, and specific tasks or locations.

kids.d_tr: Ampuller ve lambalar uyumlu armatürlere takılarak ışık kaynağı ekler veya yeniler.
kids.d_en: Light bulbs and lamps install into compatible fixtures to add or replace a light source.

kids.d_tr: Lineer ampuller iki ucunda duy bulunan düz boru biçimli lambalardır; bant ve sarkıt armatürlere takılır.
kids.d_en: Linear light bulbs are straight, tubular lamps with a base on each end for installation in wraparound, strip, suspension-mount, and other compatible light fixtures. They provide illumination for area or accent lighting in office buildings, warehouses, and manufacturing facilities. These tube lights are typically used in ceiling- and wall-mount fixtures that remain on for extended periods of time.

kids.d_tr: Standart ve dekoratif ampuller ofis, konaklama ve konut binalarındaki çeşitli armatürlere ışık kaynağı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Standard and decorative light bulbs supply the light source for a variety of fixtures in offices, hospitality settings, residential buildings, and more.

kids.en: Spot, Reflector & Flood Light Bulbs & Lamps
kids.d_tr: Spot ve reflektörlü ampuller ışığı yanlardan yansıtıp üstten yönlendirerek ışık çıkışını yoğunlaştırır.
kids.d_en: Spot, reflector, and flood light bulbs intensify their light output by reflecting light away from the bulb sides and directing it through the top. They cast light in one direction for general and accent lighting applications. These spot, reflector, and flood lamps are commonly found in can, track, and security lighting fixtures.

kids.tr: Yüksek Güçlü HID ve LED Ampuller
kids.en: High-Output HID & LED Light Bulbs & Lamps

kids.d_tr: Minyatür ampuller genellikle dar alanlarda özel aydınlatma uygulamaları için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Miniature light bulbs typically fit into tight spaces for specialized lighting applications.

kids.en: Plug-In CFL & LED Light Bulbs & Lamps
kids.d_tr: Soketli CFL ve LED ampullerin pimli duyu, uyumlu armatürdeki eşleşen sokete oturur.
kids.d_en: Plug-in CFL and LED light bulbs have a pin base that fits a matching socket on a compatible light fixture. Also known as PL lamps, they are commonly used in commercial and multifamily residential settings for general, task, and security lighting.

kids.d_tr: U tipi ampuller kavisli borusuyla dar armatürlere sığar ve lineer lambalara benzer aydınlatma sunar.
kids.d_en: U-bend lights bulbs fit their arched tube into troffers and other fixtures with limited bulb space while providing illumination similar to linear lamps. Their leg spacing (distance between the bases) should match the distance between the sockets on the light fixture. These U-bend lamps are commonly used in offices, commercial locations, and healthcare facilities.

kids.d_tr: Halka tipi ampuller tam daire biçiminde ışık yayarak genel aydınlatmada eşit dağılım sağlar.
kids.d_en: Circular light bulbs emit a full circle of light for uniform distribution in general lighting applications. Also known as circline lamps, they supply the light source in fixtures such as drum-style ceiling lights, magnifier lights, and ceiling fan lights.

kids.d_tr: Ampul aksesuarları lambaları yerinde tutar, sökme ve takmaya yardımcı olur ve işlevlerini iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Light bulb and lamp accessories hold lamps in place, assist with lamp removal and installation, and enhance or restore lamp function.

kids.d_tr: Balastlar ve sürücüler armatüre takılarak lambaya veya LED dizisine giden akım ile gerilimi düzenler.
kids.d_en: Ballasts and drivers install into lighting fixtures to regulate current and voltage flowing to the fixtures' lamps or LED arrays.

kids.d_tr: Floresan balastları uyumlu armatürlere takılarak lambaları ışık kalitesini bozan gerilim dalgalanmalarından korur.
kids.d_en: Fluorescent ballasts install into compatible lighting fixtures to protect linear fluorescent and CFL lamps from damaging power fluctuations that affect the lamp's output quality.

kids.d_tr: HID balastları metal halide veya yüksek basınçlı sodyum lamba kullanan armatürlerle birlikte çalışır.
kids.d_en: HID (High-Intensity Discharge) ballasts pair with lighting fixtures that use metal-halide or high pressure sodium HID lamps.

kids.d_tr: LED sürücüleri lambaları, ışık kalitesini düşüren besleme dalgalanmalarından korur.
kids.d_en: LED drivers protect lamps from damaging fluctuations in the power supply that can reduce the quality of lamps' or arrays' light output.

kids.d_tr: Acil aydınlatma balastları ve sürücüleri elektrik kesintisinde armatürleri yanık tutar.
kids.d_en: Emergency lighting ballasts and drivers keep light fixtures on during a power outage.

kids.d_tr: Armatürler ve dönüşüm setleri elektrik tesisatına bağlanarak veya prize takılarak iç mekan aydınlatması sağlar.
kids.d_en: Lighting fixtures and retrofit kits hard-wire into an electrical system or plug into outlets to supply indoor illumination.

kids.d_tr: Sıva üstü armatürler doğrudan tavan veya duvara takılarak iş yeri, sağlık tesisi ve mağazalarda genel aydınlatma sunar.
kids.d_en: Surface mount lights attach directly to ceilings or walls to supply general lighting in workplaces, healthcare settings, and retail spaces.

kids.d_tr: Panel ve kaset armatürler asma tavan taşıyıcılarına oturarak geniş açık alan ve koridorlarda genel aydınlatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Panel and troffer light fixtures mount in drop ceiling grids to provide general lighting for large open areas and hallways.

kids.d_tr: Yüksek tavan armatürleri yüksek tavan ve makaslardan zemine parlak ve eşit aydınlatma verir.
kids.d_en: Bay lights deliver bright, uniform illumination from high ceilings or open trusses to floors and work surfaces below.

kids.d_tr: Gömme spot armatürler genel veya vurgu aydınlatması için dar bir ışık huzmesini aşağı doğru yansıtır.
kids.d_en: Can lights and downlights cast a narrow light beam downward for general lighting or accent lighting.

kids.d_tr: Etanj armatürler toz ve nemin içeri girip tesisat ile bileşenlere zarar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Vapor-tight lights prevent dust and moisture from entering the fixture and damaging internal wiring and components.

kids.d_tr: Darbeye dayanıklı armatürler darbe ve müdahaleye direnç göstererek okul, terminal ve ortak tuvalet gibi riskli alanları aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Vandal-resistant and confinement light fixtures resist impacts and tampering to illuminate behavior health facilities, schools, transit centers, public restrooms, and other indoor spaces with a higher risk of damage.

kids.d_tr: Exproof armatürler yanıcı, parlayıcı veya patlayıcı madde bulunan alanları aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Hazardous location light fixtures illuminate areas with flammable, combustible, or ignitable materials.

kids.d_tr: Sağlık tesisi armatürleri hastane, klinik, bakımevi ve veteriner tesislerini aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Healthcare light fixtures illuminate hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, animal care facilities, and other medical and personal care settings.

kids.d_tr: UV dezenfeksiyon armatürleri yüzeyleri veya havayı arındırmak için UV-A ya da UV-C ışını üretir.
kids.d_en: Disinfecting and sanitizing UV light fixtures produce UV-A or UV-C rays to decontaminate surfaces or air.

kids.d_tr: Ray spot armatürler vurgu veya spot aydınlatma olarak küçük alanları, ürün teşhirini ve köşeleri aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Track light fixtures serve as accent lights or spotlights to illuminate small spaces, highlight product displays or decorative features, and brighten corners and alcoves.

kids.d_tr: Tezgah altı ve vurgu aydınlatmaları genel aydınlatmayı tamamlar, görev aydınlatması sunar veya belirli alanları öne çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Under-cabinet and accent lights supplement general lighting, provide task lighting, or highlight specific areas or features.

kids.d_tr: Dekoratif armatürler mağaza, otel, ofis ve sağlık ortamlarında hem aydınlatma sağlar hem görsel zenginlik katar.
kids.d_en: Decorative light fixtures supply illumination and add visual interest for general and accent lighting in retail, hospitality, office, healthcare, and multifamily housing settings.

kids.d_tr: LED hortum ve şerit aydınlatmalar, vurgu aydınlatmasında uzun hatlar ve dekoratif bordürler için şerit halinde ışık verir.
kids.d_en: LED rope and tape lights supply a strip of light for long runs and decorative trims in accent lighting applications.

kids.d_tr: Bitki yetiştirme lambaları, fide gelişimini ve çiçeklenmeyi destekleyen renk spektrumlarında ışık yayar.
kids.d_en: Grow lights emit light in color spectrums that optimize seedling growth, stem and leaf growth, or budding and flowering to grow plants indoors.

kids.d_tr: Gece lambaları karanlık oda, koridor ve geçitlerde güvenlik ve yön bulma için düşük seviyeli aydınlatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Night lights provide low-level illumination to help light darkened rooms, hallways, and pathways for safety and orientation. These devices offer hands-free lighting that activates automatically or remains on continuously, reducing the need for separate lamps or overhead fixtures in residential and light commercial spaces.

kids.d_tr: Dış mekan armatürleri hava koşullarına dayanır; açık alanları ve kısmen açık noktaları aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Outdoor lighting fixtures withstand weather exposure, illuminating outdoor areas or partially exposed locations.

kids.d_tr: Duvar armatürleri dış cepheye monte edilerek binayı eşit aydınlatır, yaya görüşünü artırır ve suçu caydırmaya yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Wall packs and decorative wall lights mount flush on exterior walls to uniformly illuminate building features, increase pedestrian visibility, and help deter crime.

kids.d_tr: Projektörler yüksek çıkışlı bir huzme yayar; anıt gibi sabit nesneleri aydınlatır ya da park, otopark ve rampa gibi geniş alanlarda görüşü artırır.
kids.d_en: Floodlights project a high-output beam to spotlight fixed objects like a monument or flagpole or increase visibility and security in larger dim or dark areas such as parks, building exteriors, loading docks, driveways, and parking lots.

kids.d_tr: Yol ve otopark aydınlatmaları gün batımından doğuma kadar yüksek ve parlak ışık vererek görüş ve güvenliği artırır.
kids.d_en: Street and parking lot lights, also known as area and site lights, emit elevated bright light from sunset to sunrise to enhance visibility and safety in roadways and parking lots.

kids.d_tr: Peyzaj aydınlatmaları dış mekanları aydınlatarak görüşü artırır, kazaları önler ve bahçe ile çim alanlara dikkat çeker.
kids.d_en: Landscape lights illuminate outdoor spaces to increase visibility, prevent accidents, and draw attention to landscaped areas such as lawns, gardens, and planting beds.

kids.d_tr: Güvenlik aydınlatmaları bina çevresi, giriş ve garaj gibi alanları aydınlatarak gece hırsızlık ve vandalizmi caydırır.
kids.d_en: Security lights illuminate perimeters, doorways, and other outdoor areas around buildings, residences, and garages to help deter theft and vandalism at night.

kids.d_tr: Güneş enerjili aydınlatmalar güneş ışığını elektriğe çevirerek dış mekanları aydınlatır; enerji maliyetini ve besleme ihtiyacını ortadan kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Solar lights convert sunlight to electricity to illuminate outdoor areas, reduce energy costs, and eliminate the need for a power supply. These lights have solar panels or cells that absorb sunlight during the day to charge the lights' batteries, operate the lamp at night, and eliminate the need for wiring and trenching. Solar lights operate even when local power is out.

kids.d_tr: Dış mekan duyları görüşü artırır ve yayaların güvenle hareket etmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Outdoor lampholders increase visibility and provide safe navigation for pedestrians. Their simplistic construction is cost-efficient and makes them suitable as a primary or secondary lighting source for entryways and doorways, garage and workshop exteriors, outdoor patios, yard spaces, and office buildings.

kids.d_tr: Park ve rekreasyon aydınlatmaları park, saha, kort ve açık hava mekanları gibi geniş alanları aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Parks and recreation lights illuminate large areas such as outdoor parks and recreational facilities, municipal fields, courts, and open-air venues. These fixtures provide a high lumen output to direct light down on the field or court without blinding spectators.

kids.d_tr: Acil ve çıkış aydınlatması, kesinti ya da acil durumda insanları binadan çıkaracak aydınlatma ve yönlendirmeyi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Emergency and exit lighting provides illumination and direction to guide people out of buildings during a power loss or other emergency.

kids.d_tr: Acil aydınlatma armatürleri enerji kesildiğinde otomatik devreye girer ve çıkışa giden yolları aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Emergency light fixtures automatically switch on when power goes out and illuminate pathways toward exits.

kids.d_tr: Ayrık başlıklı acil aydınlatmalar, kesinti durumunda ana acil aydınlatmayı tamamlar.
kids.d_en: Remote head emergency lights supplement illumination from primary emergency lighting in the event of a power loss. They connect to a compatible, remote-capable emergency or exit light and draw power from it during an electrical outage. Remote heads provide coverage around corners, outside exits, and in other areas where primary emergency lights can't reach or may be unsuitable for use.

kids.d_tr: Kombine çıkış ve acil armatürler tek üründe çıkışı işaretler ve tahliye yolunu aydınlatır.
kids.d_en: Combination exit signs with emergency lights are all-in-one fixtures that mark exits and illuminate pathways to guide evacuations from buildings.

kids.d_tr: Işıklı çıkış levhaları elektrik tesisatına bağlanır ve sürekli yanarak görünürlüğünü korur.
kids.d_en: Lighted exit signs hardwire into an electrical system that keeps them lit for visibility.

kids.d_tr: Bu dönüşüm setleri ışıklı çıkış levhalarını akkor veya halojenden LED'e çevirir.
kids.d_en: These retrofit kits convert lighted exit signs from incandescent or halogen to LED. LED exit signs use less energy, require less maintenance, and provide better visibility than other light technologies. Also known as exit light retrofit kits, they include components that fit into the housing of an existing exit sign so that it doesn't have to be completely removed, replaced, and rewired.

kids.d_tr: Acil aydınlatma aksesuar ve bataryaları armatür ile çıkış levhalarının performansını korur ve artırır.
kids.d_en: Emergency lighting accessories and batteries maintain or enhance the performance of emergency lights and exit signs.

kids.d_tr: Çalışma ve şantiye aydınlatması; inşaat, montaj ve bakım işlerinde aydınlatılmamış alanlar için geçici ışık sağlar.
kids.d_en: Task and jobsite lighting offers temporary illumination to brighten unlit spaces and supplement general lighting for construction, assembly, maintenance, and other work.

kids.d_tr: Seyyar lambalar kancası veya mıknatısıyla asıldığında geniş alanı aydınlatır; elde tutulduğunda fener gibi yönlendirilir.
kids.d_en: Hand lamps spread light over a wide area when hung by their hook or magnet, or they direct light like a flashlight when held by hand. Also known as trouble lights or drop lights, their guard protects the light source from bumps and scrapes to withstand rough handling. These work lights supply illumination to perform inspections and make repairs in crawlspaces, tunnels, engine compartments, and other dark or dimly lit spaces.

kids.d_tr: Şantiye lambaları genel aydınlatmanın yetersiz kaldığı alanlarda çalışma yüzeylerine odaklı ışık verir.
kids.d_en: Jobsite lights cast light into workspaces and onto work surfaces, providing more focused illumination than 360-degree jobsite lights in areas where general lighting is inadequate or unavailable. Also known as directional work lights, they sit on or mount to a surface, keeping both hands free to work. They are commonly used to supply temporary area and task lighting for construction, assembly, maintenance, and other jobs that require extra illumination.

kids.d_tr: 360 derece şantiye lambaları tam daire ışık yayarak birden fazla kişinin çalıştığı geniş alanlara aydınlatma dağıtır.
kids.d_en: 360-degree jobsite lights emit a full circle of light to distribute illumination across a room or large space where multiple people are working. Also known as multidirectional or omnidirectional work lights, they sit on a floor or other flat surface, keeping both hands free to work. They are commonly used to supply temporary area lighting for construction, assembly, maintenance, and other jobs where general lighting is inadequate or unavailable.

kids.d_tr: Sahra aydınlatmaları; olay yeri, şantiye ve spor etkinliği gibi bol ışık gereken uzak noktalara taşınabilir geçici projektör sağlar.
kids.d_en: Remote area lights supply portable, temporary floodlighting at emergency scenes, construction sites, sporting events, and other outlying or isolated locations that require lots of bright light. They operate on built-in, rechargeable batteries for a quieter, exhaust-free alternative to generator-powered scene lights. Their adjustable-height light heads can be raised to increase the area of light coverage.

kids.d_tr: Askılı ve dizi lambalar yukarıdan ışık vererek inşaat, montaj ve bakım işlerinde geçici alan aydınlatması sunar.
kids.d_en: Hanging and string lights deliver light from above to supply temporary or semi-permanent area and task lighting for construction, assembly, maintenance, and other jobs. They attach to framing and other structural components, keeping both hands free to work.

kids.d_tr: Rampa lambaları duvara veya direğe monte edilir; hareketli koluyla ışığı römork içine ve yükleme alanına yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Dock lights mount to a wall or post and extend their light head on a movable arm to shine light into trailers and onto loading docks or staging areas. They improve visibility to provide a safer environment for loading and unloading cargo. Their housing resists impacts from dock doors, trailer doors, forklifts, and other dock equipment.

kids.d_tr: Tezgah aydınlatmaları ışığı tezgah, masa ve diğer çalışma yüzeylerine odaklar.
kids.d_en: Workstation lights focus light onto benchtops, desktops, and other work surfaces. They supply task lighting to perform detailed work, such as assembling parts, making repairs, and reviewing documents. Using workstation lights to supplement general lighting creates uniform illumination without shadows to reduce eyestrain and improve accuracy when completing tasks.

kids.d_tr: Tezgah lambaları imalat ekipmanının içine veya yakınına monte edilerek gölgeli alanları aydınlatır ve işi incelemeye odaklı ışık verir.
kids.d_en: Machine tool lights mount in, on, or near machining, manufacturing, and fabrication equipment to brighten obscured areas and supply targeted illumination for placing and examining work. They resist damage from vibration and flying chips, filings, and debris. These machine lights are commonly used with CNC machines, drill presses, and printing presses.

kids.d_tr: El fenerleri, armatürleri geçici olarak tamamlayan veya başka aydınlatmanın bulunmadığı alanları aydınlatan taşınabilir ışık kaynaklarıdır.
kids.d_en: Flashlights are portable light sources that temporarily supplement fixtures or illuminate areas where other lighting is unavailable or impractical.

kids.d_tr: El fenerleri karanlık veya loş alanlarda hareket için kişisel ve taşınabilir aydınlatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Handheld flashlights supply personal, portable lighting to navigate dark or dimly lit areas.

kids.d_tr: Kafa lambaları ve baret ışıkları başa takılır; karanlıkta görünürlük sağlarken iki eli de çalışmak için serbest bırakır.
kids.d_en: Headlamps and helmet lights are worn on a worker's head, making them visible to others in dark spaces, illuminating their area of focus, and keeping both hands free to work.

kids.d_tr: Kalem fenerler ve muayene lambaları, el fenerinin büyük kalacağı dar alanlara küçük ve odaklı bir ışık huzmesi verir.
kids.d_en: Penlights and inspection lights shine a small, focused light beam onto specific areas or into tight spaces where flashlights would be too large or overpowering.

kids.d_tr: Dik açılı fenerlerin başı gövdeye 90 derece açılıdır; klipsli veya dik tutulduğunda ışığı doğrudan öne yöneltir.
kids.d_en: Right-angle flashlights angle their head at 90° from their body, aiming light beams straight ahead when clipped in place or held upright.

kids.d_tr: Kamp lambaları ve spotlar el fenerinden daha fazla aydınlatma sunar; ışığı daha geniş alana veya daha uzağa yayar.
kids.d_en: Lanterns and spotlights provide more illumination than flashlights, shining light over a wider area or at greater distances. Their handle provides a secure grip, and they are lightweight enough to carry for on-the-go lighting. Lanterns and spotlights are used by search and rescue teams, first responders, and outdoor workers and enthusiasts.

kids.d_tr: Silah üstü fenerler ateşli silahlara takılarak isabetli hedefleme için aydınlatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Weapon-mounted flashlights attach to firearms and provide illumination for accurate targeting. Also known as weapon-mounted lights (WML), they eliminate the need for a separate flashlight to identify targets and keep both hands free to position the weapon. They are lightweight and compact to maintain the balance of the firearm. These rail-mounted tactical lights mount to specific rail systems, which provide a platform for lights, sights, and other accessories. They are commonly used by law enforcement and military personnel.

kids.d_tr: Bu fenerler kolla kurulur, prizde şarjlı bekler veya suyla çalışır; kesintide pil derdi olmadan hazır olur.
kids.d_en: These flashlights crank by hand, plug in to stay charged, or draw power from water, making them ready for use during power outages without the worry of depleted batteries. They provide a reliable alternative to standard battery-powered or rechargeable flashlights.

kids.d_tr: Klipsli ve anahtarlık fenerler hafif ve kompakttır; gerektiğinde hemen elinizin altında olur.
kids.d_en: Clip and keychain flashlights are lightweight, compact, and remain close at hand for when illumination is needed.

kids.d_tr: Fener parça ve aksesuarları fenerleri özel uygulamalara uyarlar, şarjlı tutar veya işlevini geri kazandırır.
kids.d_en: Flashlight parts and accessories adapt flashlights for specific applications, keep them powered up, or restore their function.

kids.d_tr: Aydınlatma kontrolleri ışığı kısar, açar ve kapatır; kullanımı yönetip enerji maliyetini düşürür.
kids.d_en: Lighting controls dim, turn on, and turn off lighting to manage usage and reduce energy costs.

kids.d_tr: Dimmerler ışık çıkışını azami ayardan düşürerek parlaklığı ayarlar.
kids.d_en: Lighting dimmers decrease light output from its maximum setting to adjust brightness.

kids.d_tr: Hareket sensörleri odayı izler ve kimse kalmadığında ışıkları otomatik kapatır.
kids.d_en: Occupancy sensors monitor a room and automatically switch off lights after occupants leave the room.

kids.d_tr: Bu aksesuarlar aydınlatma kontrol sistemlerinin çalışmasını özelleştirir ve montaja yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: These accessories customize operation and assist with installation of lighting control systems.

kids.d_tr: Ampul kırma makineleri ömrünü tamamlamış floresan ampulleri ezerek depolama hacmini düşürür; açığa çıkan kirliliği filtreyle tutar.
kids.d_en: Light bulb crushers pulverize dead or broken fluorescent bulbs to minimize the space required for storing them, and they have filters that capture contaminants released during the crushing process. Sometimes called bulb eaters, these units reduce safety hazards by eliminating the risk of accidentally breaking bulbs that are being stored for recycling and disposal. They also reduce the cost of shipping the bulbs to a facility that can recycle and dispose of the bulbs' components in accordance with regulations. Light bulb crusher accessories maintain or improve the functionality of the crushers.

kids.d_tr: Aydınlatma yedek parçaları armatürleri onarır veya kullanışlılığını artırır.
kids.d_en: Lighting replacement parts are used to repair or enhance the utility of light fixtures.

kids.d_tr: Armatür yedek parçaları yıpranmış bileşenleri onarır veya lambaların kullanışlılığını artırır.
kids.d_en: Lamp replacement parts repair worn or damaged components or enhance the utility of lamps.

d_tr: Yağlama; sürtünmeyi azaltarak, ısıyı sınırlayarak ve korozyonu önleyerek motor, alet ve makinelerin sorunsuz çalışmasını ve uzun ömürlü olmasını sağlar.
d_en: Lubrication keeps motors, tools, and mechanical equipment running smoothly by reducing friction, inhibiting heat, and preventing corrosion which increases operation efficiency and prolongs equipment life.

kids.d_tr: Gres hareketli parçaları yağlar, ısıyı sınırlar ve ekipmana kirlilik girişini engeller.
kids.d_en: Grease lubricates moving parts, inhibits heat, and seals out contaminants in equipment and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Çok amaçlı gres, özel bir gres gerekmeden çeşitli endüstriyel işlerde farklı ekipman tiplerini yağlar.
kids.d_en: Multipurpose grease lubricates many different types of equipment in a variety of industrial operations without the need for a specialized grease. This versatile grease combines additives to enhance specific resistance properties depending on the needs of the application.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu çok amaçlı gres; gıda, içecek ve ilaç üretim tesislerindeki makine parçalarını yağlar.
kids.d_en: Food-grade multipurpose grease lubricates machine parts and equipment in food, beverage, and pharmaceutical production facilities. This grease is used in and around processing areas where there is the potential for exposure to food. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies this grease for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: Rulman gresi, dönen parçaları taşıyan ve hizalayan bilya, makara ve silindirik elemanları yağlar.
kids.d_en: Bearing grease lubricates the balls, rollers, and cylindrical-shaped elements that move together to support and align rotating parts. It creates a barrier between these fast-moving elements to protect against wear, overheating, and corrosion. Bearing grease is used in motors, conveyors, pumps, and a variety of industrial machinery.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu rulman gresi; gıda, içecek ve ilaç ekipmanlarındaki bilya ve makaraları yağlar.
kids.d_en: Food-grade bearing grease lubricates balls, rollers, and cylindrical-shaped elements that move together to support and align rotating parts in food, beverage, and pharmaceutical processing equipment and machinery. This grease is used in and around processing areas where there is the potential for contact with food. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies this grease for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: O-ring gresi vana bileşenlerindeki O-ringleri yağlar ve besler; sızdırmazlığı sağlayıp sistemi nem, ısı ve oksitlenmeden korur.
kids.d_en: O-ring grease lubricates, seals, and conditions O-rings in valve system components to ensure a seal and protect the system against moisture, heat, and oxidation. This grease helps seat O-rings during installation, preventing damage from abrasion and pinching.

kids.d_tr: Açık dişli gresi, açıkta çalışan yavaş hareketli dişli ve rulmanlarda yerinde kalacak şekilde tasarlanmış koyu kıvamlı bir yağlayıcıdır.
kids.d_en: Open gear grease is a thick paste-type lubricant designed to stay in place on exposed, slow-moving gears and bearings. It is often used on winches and hoists, elevator tracks, and construction machinery.

kids.d_tr: Tesisat gresi suya dayanıklı bir yağlayıcıdır; batarya gibi armatürlerde sertliği ve gıcırtıyı azaltır, parça ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Plumbing grease is a water-resistant lubricant designed for plumbing fixtures such as faucets to reduce stiffness, squeaking, and to extend the life of moving parts.

kids.d_tr: Yağlar ısıyı sınırlar, sürtünmeyi azaltır ve hareketli parçalarda aşınmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Oils inhibit heat, reduce friction, and prevent wear on moving parts.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik yağlar basınçlı sistemlerde dolaşarak yağlama yapar ve gücü aktarır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic oils, also called hydraulic fluids, circulate through pressurized systems to lubricate and transmit power. They use their inherent volume and viscosity to create a pushing force to move parts of a system.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu hidrolik yağlar; gıda, içecek ve ilaç üretim ekipmanlarında basınçlı sistemlerde yağlar ve gücü aktarır.
kids.d_en: Food-grade hydraulic oils, also called hydraulic fluids, circulate through pressurized systems to lubricate and transmit power in food, beverage, and pharmaceutical production equipment and machinery. These oils are used in and around processing areas where there is the potential for exposure to food. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies these oils for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: Sirkülasyon yağları endüstriyel makinelerdeki dişli, rulman ve bileşenlere sürekli ve yeniden kullanılabilir bir yağlama sağlar.
kids.d_en: Circulating oils provide a continuous, reusable supply of lubrication to gears, bearings, and other components in industrial machinery. They help cool systems and flush out contaminants. Circulating oils have emulsifying properties that allow water and contaminants to separate from oils in system reservoirs.

kids.d_tr: Dişli yağları yüksek basınç ve hızda birbirine kayan dişli dişlerini yağlar, soğutur ve korur.
kids.d_en: Gear oils lubricate, cool, and protect gear teeth that slide and roll together under high pressures and speeds. Gears are typically enclosed in a gearbox where the lubricant must also protect bearings within the box. Gearboxes are installed in conveyors, pulpers, and pumps in heavy duty applications and harsh environments.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu dişli yağları; gıda, içecek ve ilaç üretim tesislerindeki ekipmanlarda dişli dişlerini yağlar ve korur.
kids.d_en: Food-grade gear oils lubricate, cool, and protect gear teeth in processing equipment for food, beverage, and pharmaceutical production facilities. These oils are used in and around production areas where there is the potential for exposure to food. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies these oils for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: Makine yağları çeşitli makinelerdeki hareketli ve dişli parçaları yağlar; sürtünmeyi azaltır, korozyonu önler ve parça ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Machine oils lubricate moving or threaded parts in a variety of machines and equipment to reduce friction, prevent corrosion, and extend the working life of components. These oils are used on equipment ranging from hinges and fasteners to conveyors and industrial machinery.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu makine yağları; gıda, içecek ve ilaç üretim tesislerindeki makine parçalarını yağlar.
kids.d_en: Food-grade machine oils lubricate machine parts and equipment in food, beverage, and pharmaceutical production facilities. These oils are used in and around processing areas where there is the potential for exposure to food. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies these oils for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: Gıda uyumlu ayırıcı yağlar gıda işleme ekipmanını yağlar ve artık gıdanın ekipmana yapışmasını önleyen bir ayırıcı görevi görür.
kids.d_en: Food-grade divider oils lubricate food processing equipment and provide a releasing agent to prevent residual food from sticking to equipment. These oils are intended for light use on pans, grills, and slicer blades and include rust and mold inhibiters to protect and maintain clean surfaces. The National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) certifies these oils for the level of contact that is appropriate for use to eliminate the risk of food contamination.

kids.d_tr: Kızak yağları kayan parçalar arasındaki sürtünmeyi azaltarak aşınmayı önler ve yumuşak hareket sağlar.
kids.d_en: Way oils reduce friction between sliding parts to help prevent wear on the parts and allow them to move smoothly. Also called slide oils or way lubricants, they contain additives that allow them to adhere to surfaces without dripping. Way oils are commonly used on sliding surfaces on machine tools, such as lathe carriages and milling machine tables.

kids.d_tr: Fener mili yağları makine millerini yağlar ve yüksek hızlı uygulamalarda bozulmaya direnç gösterir.
kids.d_en: Spindle oils lubricate machine spindles and withstand degradation when used in high-speed applications. They are low viscosity, resist foaming, and protect machinery from rust and corrosion to protect bearings and maintain high precision.

kids.d_tr: Yağlayıcılar ve pas sökücüler makine, alet ve parçalara kaygan bir film bırakarak aşınma ile sürtünmeyi azaltır.
kids.d_en: Lubricants and penetrating lubricants add a slippery film or coating on machinery, tools, and parts to reduce wear and friction between surfaces and keep equipment running smoothly.

kids.d_tr: Yağlayıcılar yüzeyleri kaygan bir sıvıyla kaplayarak sürtünmeyi, aşınmayı ve aşırı ısınmayı azaltır; makine ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Lubricants reduce friction, wear, and overheating in mechanical equipment by coating surfaces with a slippery fluid that smooths the movement of parts and extends machine life.

kids.d_tr: Kuru yağlayıcılar hareketli parçalar arasındaki sürtünmeyi azaltırken kir çeken ıslak kalıntı bırakmaz.
kids.d_en: Dry lubricants reduce friction between moving parts without leaving a messy wet residue that attracts dirt and debris.

kids.d_tr: Pas sökücü yağlayıcılar sıkışmış veya paslanmış bağlantı elemanlarını gevşeterek sökülmelerini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Penetrating lubricants loosen stuck or frozen fasteners and bolts to remove them from equipment or machinery. These liquids seep into crevices or small spaces between threaded parts to release them and displace moisture to prevent corrosion. Penetrating lubricants evaporate faster than standard lubricants.

kids.d_tr: Sıkışma önleyici macunlar parçaların birbirine kaynamasını ve korozyonu önler; bakımda kesmeye gerek kalmadan sökülmelerini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Anti-seize compounds prevent assembled parts and fasteners from sticking together or corroding to ensure they can be dismantled for maintenance and repairs without shearing or needing to be cut off. These compounds are applied before assembly in applications where heat, chemicals, and harsh environments cause corrosion.

kids.d_tr: Kalıp ayırıcılar doğrudan kalıba uygulanarak malzemenin kalıba yapışmasını önleyen bir bariyer oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Mold release agents are applied directly to molds to create a barrier that prevents materials from sticking to them. This allows the casted product to be released without damage to the mold or the product. They increase the life of the mold, improve the final product's finish, and reduce production times.

kids.d_tr: Gres tabancaları; otomobil, tarım makinesi ve rüzgar türbini gibi kalıcı yağlama sisteminin pratik olmadığı noktalara doğrudan gres uygular.
kids.d_en: Grease guns apply grease directly in locations where a permanent lubrication system is not practical such as on automobiles, farm equipment, aircraft, and wind turbines.

kids.d_tr: Manuel gres tabancaları basit bir el hareketiyle gres uygular.
kids.d_en: Manual grease guns dispense grease with a simple, hand-powered operation. They are lightweight and portable to move from one lubrication site to another without the need for additional equipment. Manual grease guns are used for low-volume lubrication in a wide variety of applications from automotive components to industrial or agricultural equipment.

kids.d_tr: Akülü gres tabancaları kablo gerekmeden dar, yüksek veya uzak alanlarda serbestçe kullanılabilir.
kids.d_en: Battery-powered grease guns can be maneuvered freely around confined, elevated, or remote areas without the need for a wired power source. Also called cordless grease guns, they eliminate the need to manage and shift cords, hoses, and air compressors while navigating around equipment. They are useful in workshops, on farms, and around construction sites to reduce fatigue on repetitive and frequent lubrication tasks.

kids.d_tr: Havalı gres tabancaları basınçlı havayla düzenli bir yağlayıcı akışı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air-operated grease guns use compressed air to deliver a consistent flow of lubricant. Also called pneumatic grease guns, they attach to an air compressor and are often paired with bulk tanks and loading methods to provide a steady supply of lubricant for high-volume applications. These grease guns lubricate machinery and equipment in industrial, aerospace, and agricultural settings with high-lubricant needs and where an air compressor with a power source are within close proximity.

kids.tr: Gres Tabancası Hortum, Boru ve Hazneleri
kids.en: Hoses, Pipes & Barrels for Grease Guns
kids.d_tr: Bu ürünler gres tabancalarındaki yıpranmış hortum, boru ve haznelerin yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These items replace worn or damaged hoses, pipes, and barrels on grease guns.

kids.en: Couplers & Dispensing Tips for Grease Guns
kids.d_tr: Başlıklar gres tabancasının nozul, hortum veya borusunun ucuna takılarak yağın çıktığı noktayı oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Couplers, also called dispensing tips, attach to the end of a grease gun's nozzle, hose, or pipe where lubrication is discharged. They provide the connection point for the grease gun to a grease fitting (zerk fitting) on equipment. These replaceable components provide a leak-tight fit while dispensing grease.

kids.d_tr: Bu aksesuarlar gres tabancalarının kullanımını ve taşınmasını destekler.
kids.d_en: These accessories support the operation and handling of grease guns.

kids.d_tr: Gresörlükler ekipmana kalıcı olarak takılır ve rulman ile dişli gibi bileşenlere gres iletmek için giriş noktası sağlar.
kids.d_en: Grease fittings (zerk fittings) install permanently in equipment to provide entry points for delivering grease to components such as bearings and gears.

kids.d_tr: Gresörlükler ekipmandaki kalıcı giriş noktalarıdır; rulman ve dişli gibi bileşenlere taşma ve kaçak olmadan gres iletir.
kids.d_en: Grease fittings (zerk fittings) are permanently installed entry points on equipment for delivering grease to components such as bearings and gears without overflow or leaks. Also referred to as grease nipples, they remain closed to keep out contaminants until the pressure from a grease gun forces them open and allows grease to flow into the system.

kids.d_tr: Adaptörler ve manifoldlar gresörlükleri uyarlar ve birden fazla yağlama noktasını toplayarak işi hızlandırır.
kids.d_en: Adapters and manifolds alter grease fittings and consolidate multiple lubrication points to expedite and support lubrication on heavy equipment and industrial machinery.

kids.en: Washers, Caps & Tools for Grease Fittings
kids.d_tr: Pullar, kapaklar ve aparatlar gresörlüklerin kullanımını ve bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Washers, caps, and tools support the use and maintenance of grease fittings (zerk fittings). Color-coded washers assist with identifying lubricant types to avoid cross-contamination. Dust caps protect grease fittings from the ingress of dust and debris, and cleaning tools extract dried grease from fittings, joints, and other components.

kids.d_tr: El yağdanlıkları ve ölçekli kaplar, yağın ölçülmesine ve uygulanmasına yardımcı olan basit ve ekonomik ürünlerdir.
kids.d_en: Handheld oilers and oil measuring containers are simple, economical devices that help with the measurement and dispensing of oil.

kids.d_tr: El yağdanlıkları tek elle küçük miktarda yağın kontrollü biçimde verilmesini sağlayan basit ve ekonomik ürünlerdir.
kids.d_en: Handheld oil dispensers are simple, economical oilers that provide controlled delivery of small amounts of oil with a one-handed operation. These steel oil cans are lightweight and portable to move from one lubrication site to another in low-volume, low-pressure applications.

kids.d_tr: Ölçekli yağ kapları yağlayıcıların elle ölçülmesine ve aktarılmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Oil measuring containers assist with handheld measuring and transferring of lubricants.

kids.d_tr: Makine üstü yağlayıcılar rulman, kızak, dişli ve zincir gibi kritik bileşenlere otomatik gres veya yağ vererek arızayı önler.
kids.d_en: Machine-mount lubricators automatically dispense grease or oil to critical components such as bearings, slides, gears, and chains to avoid equipment breakdown or malfunction.

kids.d_tr: Tek noktalı gres yağlayıcılar makineye monte edilir ve rulman ile hareketli parçalara elle kontrol gerekmeden otomatik gres verir.
kids.d_en: Single-point grease lubricators mount to machines to automatically dispense grease onto bearings and other moving machine parts to keep them lubricated without the need for manual inspections. They hold a specific amount of grease to prevent machine failure due to over- or under-greasing, which can waste grease and cause system downtimes. They are commonly used to lubricate bearings on conveyors, fans, and motors.

kids.en: Service Kits for Single-Point Grease Lubricators
kids.d_tr: Tek noktalı yağlayıcı servis setleri, gres dolumu ve yağlayıcının bakımı için gereken bileşenleri içerir.
kids.d_en: Service kits for single-point grease lubricators include grease refill and components to maintain lubricators when the grease supply is replenished. The service kit must match the lubricator's brand and manufacturer model number.

kids.d_tr: Sabit seviyeli ve damlalı yağlayıcılar, yağ zamanla azaldıkça hareketli parçalara düzenli bir yağ beslemesi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Constant-level and drip-feed oilers ensure moving parts have a steady feed of lubrication as oil levels deplete over time due to displacement, misting, and evaporation. They mount permanently onto industrial machinery to lubricate gears, bearings, chains, and maintain oil levels in reservoirs such as gearboxes and bearing housings. Constant-level and drip feed oilers reduce maintenance needs by limiting frequent lubricant level checks and refilling of oil in equipment.

kids.d_tr: Bu aksesuarlar sabit seviyeli ve damlalı yağlayıcıların çalışmasını ve bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: These accessories support the operation and maintenance of constant-level and drip-feed oilers.

kids.d_tr: Merkezi yağlama sistemleri çalışan makinelere yağ ve gres uygular; parçaların verimli hareketini sağlar ve duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Lubrication systems apply oil and grease to working machinery to keep parts moving efficiently and reduce maintenance and system downtime.

kids.d_tr: Yağ depolama ve dağıtım sistemleri yağlayıcıları yalıtır, düzenler, etiketler ve kontrollü biçimde dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Oil storage and dispensing systems seal, organize, identify, and provide controlled dispensing of lubricants.

kids.tr: Yağ Depolama Kapları ve Transfer Kapakları
kids.d_tr: Yağ depolama kapları ve transfer kapakları yağlayıcıları kapalı, ayrı ve kirlilikten korunmuş halde tutar; elle taşınabilir boyuttadır.
kids.d_en: Oil storage containers and transfer lids keep lubricants sealed, separated, organized, and protected from contaminants in containers that are sized for hand-carrying around a shop floor. They eliminate the need to move large storage tanks to lubricate different pieces of equipment. Transfer lids offer color-coding to quickly identify types of lubricants to avoid mixing. These containers and their brand-compatible transfer lids provide controlled dispensing of lubricants to eliminate the need for additional accessories such as funnels.

kids.tr: Yağ Kabı Hortumları ve El Pompaları
kids.en: Extension Hoses & Hand Pumps for Oil Containers
kids.d_tr: Uzatma hortumları ve el pompaları depolama kaplarından yağın alınmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Extension hoses and hand pumps help dispense oil from storage containers.

kids.tr: Toplu Yağ Tankları ve Dağıtım Sistemleri
kids.en: Bulk Oil Storage Tanks & Dispensing Systems
kids.d_tr: Toplu yağ tankları ve dağıtım sistemleri, yağ tüketimi yüksek tesislerde depolama ve dağıtım çözümü sunar.
kids.d_en: Bulk oil storage tanks and dispensing systems offer solutions for the delivery and storage of oil in facilities with heavy oil usage.

kids.d_tr: Nem alıcı havalandırma filtreleri kapalı yağlama sistemlerinde temiz hava akışını sağlayarak basınç ve vakum oluşmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Desiccant breathers and breather vents ensure the flow of clean air in closed lubrication systems to prevent pressure or vacuum.

kids.d_tr: Nem alıcı filtreler yağ deposuna takılarak temiz ve kuru havanın girmesini sağlar; nem ve kirlilik girişini engeller.
kids.d_en: Desiccant breathers mount to lubrication containers or reservoirs in industrial equipment to allow clean, dry air to flow into the system, keeping pressure neutral while preventing the ingress of moisture or contaminants. These breathers use silica gel to absorb moisture and a filter to remove airborne particulate, prolonging oil life. Silica gel changes color to indicate the breather is depleted and requires replacement.

kids.d_tr: Havalandırma tapaları atmosferle hava alışverişine izin vererek kapalı sistemlerde ani basınç ve vakum değişimlerini önler.
kids.d_en: Breather vents prevent unexpected pressure or vacuum changes in closed systems by allowing the exchange of air with the atmosphere. They thread into the vent ports of reservoirs, housings, or storage tanks in closed systems such as gear boxes.

kids.tr: Seviye Göstergeleri ve Akış Gözetleme Camları
kids.en: Level Gauges & Flow Sights for Lubrication Equipment
kids.d_tr: Seviye göstergeleri ve gözetleme camları ekipmanın dışına monte edilerek yağ seviyesinin, akışının ve durumunun görsel takibini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Level gauges, flow sights, and viewports mount externally onto equipment and allow visual checks and monitoring of lubricant levels, flow, and condition in closed systems where direct contact and testing of lubricants is not practical.

kids.d_tr: Yağ seviye göstergeleri ekipmanın dışına monte edilerek yağ seviyesinin gözle kontrolünü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Oil level gauges mount externally to equipment for visual checks and monitoring of lubricant levels. They are used in industrial applications with closed systems where direct measurement of lubricant levels is difficult or unsafe.

kids.d_tr: Yağ akış gözetleme camları kapalı sistemlerde yağın akışını, durumunu ve berraklığını izleme imkanı verir.
kids.d_en: Lubricant flow sights and viewports allow monitoring of lubricant flow, condition, and clarity in closed systems where direct contact and testing of lubricant is not practical.

d_tr: Talaşlı imalat, iş parçasından malzeme kaldırarak onu istenen biçime getiren bir üretim yöntemidir.
d_en: Machining is a process in which material is removed from a workpiece to shape or finish it into a desired form.

kids.d_tr: Delme takımları iş parçasında delik açar ve deliğin son işlemini yapar.
kids.d_en: Drilling and holemaking tools create and finish holes in a workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Matkap uçlarının kesici kenarları, uç iş parçasına döndürülerek ilerletildikçe malzeme kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Drill bits have cutting edges that remove material as they are rotated and fed into a workpiece by handheld drills, drill presses, or CNC machines.

kids.d_tr: Raybalar mevcut bir deliği hassas ölçüye getirir ve pürüzsüz bir yüzey bırakır.
kids.d_en: Reamers enlarge or finish an existing hole to a precise size with a smooth surface.

kids.d_tr: Havşa, punta ve nokta matkapları iş parçasında sığ delikler açar; her biri delme sürecinde farklı bir amaca hizmet eder.
kids.d_en: Countersinks, center drills, and spotting drills create shallow holes in workpieces, each with specific purposes in the holemaking process.

kids.tr: Havşa Freze ve Port Açma Takımları
kids.d_tr: Havşa freze ve port açma takımları, bağlantı elemanı ya da port montajında hassas geçme için mevcut deliği genişletir.
kids.d_en: Counterbores and port tools expand existing holes for a precise fit when installing fasteners or ports.

kids.d_tr: Broşlar metal işlemede delik içine kama kanalı, kanal ve diğer biçimleri işlemek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Broaches are used to machine keyways, splines, and other shapes into a hole in metalworking tasks.

kids.d_tr: Zımbalar ve kalıplar sacda delik açar.
kids.d_en: Punches and dies make holes in sheet metal. Each punch installs into a manual or hydraulic punch press that forces it through the sheet metal and into a matching die.

kids.d_tr: Matkap burçları delme aparatına takılarak matkap ve rayba uçlarını yönlendirir; deliklerin hassas ve tekrarlanabilir olmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drill bushings (also known as jig bushings) install in a drilling jig to guide, position, and support drill bits, reamers, countersinks, and counterbores to ensure accurate and repeatable hole placement in metalworking tasks.

kids.d_tr: Matkap uzatmaları uçlara takılarak erişimlerini artırır ve derin delik açılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drill bit extensions attach to drill bits to extend the bits' reach and allow them to drill deep holes. The extensions connect to compatible drills and are commonly used in woodworking and construction projects.

kids.d_tr: Delme takım taslakları, özel matkap ucu ve rayba üretmek için işlenebilen metal çubuklardır.
kids.d_en: Holemaking blanks are metal rods that can be machined to create custom drill bits, reamers, or other round cutting tools with precise dimensions or features to suit a particular metalworking application.

kids.d_tr: Frezeleme, dönen bir kesici takımın iş parçası yüzeyinden malzeme kaldırdığı bir talaşlı imalat yöntemidir.
kids.d_en: Milling is a machining process in which a rotating cutting tool removes material from the surface of a workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Parmak frezelerin uç ve yan yüzeylerindeki kesici kenarlar malzeme yüzeyinden talaş kaldırır.
kids.d_en: End mills have cutting edges on their nose and sides that remove material from the surface of a piece of stock.

kids.d_tr: CNC router uçları freze tezgahı ve CNC routerlara takılarak yüzeylerde dalma ve profil kesimleri yapar.
kids.d_en: CNC router bits install in milling machines and CNC routers to make plunge and profile cuts in solid surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Gravür takımlarının sivri ucu çeşitli metal ve kompozitlere harf, rakam ve desen işler.
kids.d_en: Engraving tools have a pointed tip that cuts letters, numbers, and designs into a variety of metals and composites.

kids.d_tr: Freze çakılarının dişleri malzemeden talaş kaldırarak karmaşık biçimli parçalar oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Milling cutters have teeth that remove material from a piece of stock to create parts with complex features and shapes.

kids.d_tr: Kalıpçı freze takımlarının konik yan yüzeyleri, kalıp içindeki kanallara girebilmelerini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Mold and die milling tools have tapered sides that allow them to fit into the channels in a mold or die. They are used to remove material from dies or molds in plastic mold-making applications and in manufacturing facilities.

kids.d_tr: Diş açma, bir takımla parça yüzeyinde iç veya dış diş oluşturulan bir talaşlı imalat yöntemidir.
kids.d_en: Threading is a machining process in which a tool is used to create threads on the external or internal surface of a fastener, part, or workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Kılavuzlar, uyumlu bağlantı elemanlarıyla birleşmek üzere iç diş açan silindirik takımlardır.
kids.d_en: Taps are cylindrical tools that create internal threads for connection with compatible fasteners.

kids.d_tr: Paftalar çubuk, boru ve bağlantı elemanı gibi silindirik parçalarda dış diş açar veya onarır.
kids.d_en: Dies create or repair external threads on cylindrical parts like rods, pipe, or fasteners that insert into holes with corresponding internal threads.

kids.d_tr: Kılavuz ve pafta setleri farklı ölçülerde kılavuz, pafta ve matkap ucunu bir arada sunar.
kids.d_en: Threading sets include multiple taps, dies, and drill bits in a range of sizes, eliminating the need to buy threading tools separately.

kids.d_tr: Kılavuz ve pafta aksesuarları bu takımların kullanımını ve bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Tap and die accessories support the operation and maintenance of taps and dies.

kids.d_tr: Diş tamir aparatları hasarlı dişleri onarır ve eski haline getirir.
kids.d_en: Thread repair tools fix damaged threads and restore them to their original condition.

kids.d_tr: Diş frezeleri delik içine veya parça yüzeyine iç ve dış diş işler.
kids.d_en: Thread mills cut internal and external threads into a hole or the surface of a part.

kids.tr: Tornalama, Delik Büyütme ve Kanal Açma
kids.d_tr: Tornalama, delik büyütme ve kanal açma; iş parçasından malzeme kaldıran talaşlı imalat işlemleridir.
kids.d_en: Turning, boring, and grooving are machining operations that remove material from workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Delik işleme barları torna ve işleme merkezlerinde delik iç çapını ölçüsüne getiren tek ağızlı kesici takımlardır.
kids.d_en: Boring bars are single-point cutting tools used with lathes, CNC lathes, turning machines, and machining centers to size, straighten, and finish the inside diameter of drilled or cast holes.

kids.tr: İç Diş Açma Takımları ve Setleri
kids.d_tr: İç diş açma takımları, torna ve CNC tezgahlarında delik içine diş açan tek ağızlı kesici takımlardır.
kids.d_en: Internal threading tools are single-point cutting tools used with lathes, CNC lathes, or turning machines to add internal threads to drilled or cast holes in workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Tırtıl açma takımları, tornada iş parçası yüzeyinde tırtıllı doku oluşturan makaralı kesici takımlardır.
kids.d_en: Knurling tools are wheeled cutting tools used with lathes to create textured surfaces on workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Torna kalemleri ve taslakları tornalama, delik işleme, kanal açma ve diş açma işlemlerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Lathe tool bits, blanks, and sets are used on lathes to perform turning, boring, grooving, and threading operations.

kids.tr: Tornalama ve Kanal Açma Takım Setleri
kids.d_tr: Tornalama ve kanal açma takımları tornada malzeme kaldırmak veya iş parçasına kanal açmak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Turning and grooving tools are used with lathes to remove sections of material or add grooves to workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu takımlar geleneksel takımlar gibi çalışır ancak kesici kenarı değiştirilebilir uç veya kafalarla oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Indexable cutting tools perform like traditional cutting tools but have a tool body or toolholder that accepts replaceable indexable inserts or exchangeable heads to form a cutting edge.

kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu delik işleme takımları torna ve CNC tezgahlarında delik içinden malzeme kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Indexable boring tools are used with lathes or CNC turning machines to remove material from inside holes.

kids.tr: Kesici Uçlu ve Değişken Kafalı Frezeleme
kids.d_tr: Bu freze takımlarının gövdesi, kesici kenarı oluşturmak üzere değiştirilebilir kafa veya uç kabul eder.
kids.d_en: These milling tools have a tool body or toolholder that accepts replaceable cutting heads or indexable inserts to form a cutting edge.

kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu ve modüler delme takımlarının gövdesi, kesici kenarı oluşturan değiştirilebilir uç veya kafa kabul eder.
kids.d_en: Indexable and modular drilling and holemaking tools have a tool body or toolholder that accepts replaceable indexable inserts or exchangeable heads to form a cutting edge.

kids.tr: Kesici Uçlu Kesme ve Kanal Açma
kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu kesme ve kanal açma takımları tornada parçayı ayırır veya kanal açar.
kids.d_en: Indexable parting and grooving tools are used with lathes or CNC turning machines to remove sections of a workpiece in parting or cut-off operations or add grooves to a workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu diş açma, değiştirilebilir uçlarla iş parçasına iç veya dış diş işleyen bir yöntemdir.
kids.d_en: Indexable threading is a machining process that uses replaceable cutting inserts to add internal or external threads to a workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Kesici uçlu tornalama takımları torna ve CNC tezgahlarında malzeme kaldırarak parçayı ölçüsüne ve biçimine getirir.
kids.d_en: Indexable turning tools are used with lathes or CNC turning machines to remove material from workpieces in order to size, shape, and add features to them.

kids.tr: Kesici Uçlu Takım Yedek ve Aksesuarları
kids.en: Replacement Parts & Accessories for Indexable Cutting Tools
kids.d_tr: Bu yedek parça ve aksesuarlar, tüm takım tutucuyu değiştirmeden kesici uçlu takımların işlevini geri kazandırır.
kids.d_en: These replacement parts and accessories restore or improve the function of indexable cutting tools to avoid the expense of replacing the entire toolholder.

kids.d_tr: Tezgahlar, metal atölyeleri ve üretim tesislerinde parçaları şekillendirmek ve son işlemini yapmak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Machinery is used in metal shops and production facilities to shape and finish parts in machining operations.

kids.d_tr: Polisaj ve taşlama tezgahları iş parçalarından malzeme kaldırır, şekillendirir ve son işlemini yapar.
kids.d_en: Buffing and grinding machines finish, shape, and remove material from workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Sütunlu ve manyetik matkaplarda dikey matkap kafası bir kaideye monteldir; el matkabına göre daha düzgün delikler açar.
kids.d_en: Drill presses and magnetic drills have a vertical drill head mounted to a base that provides stability and maintains consistent alignment to make more uniform holes than handheld drills.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik presler ve aksesuarları iş parçalarını büker, doğrultur, düzleştirir veya baskılar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic presses and accessories bend, straighten, flatten, or stamp workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Torna tezgahları silindirik iş parçalarını keser, şekillendirir, ölçüsüne getirir ve son işlemini yapar.
kids.d_en: Lathe machines cut, shape, size, or finish cylindrical workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Metal işleme makineleri metal iş parçalarını şekillendirir veya keser.
kids.d_en: Metal fabrication machines shape or cut metal workpieces.

kids.d_tr: Freze tezgahları dönen kesici takımlarla iş parçalarını şekillendirir, kanal açar ve karmaşık biçimli parçalar üretir.
kids.d_en: Milling machines use rotary cutting tools to shape workpieces, add grooves and contoured shoulders, and create parts with complex shapes and features in manufacturing plants and machine shops.

kids.d_tr: Markalama makineleri lazer veya değiştirilebilir vuruş uçlarıyla yüzeylere kalıcı ve hassas yazı ve görsel işler.
kids.d_en: Marking machines use lasers or replaceable percussive tips to etch text or images permanently and precisely onto surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Su jeti kesim makineleri yüksek basınçlı su huzmesiyle metal, cam, granit, seramik ve plastiği keser.
kids.d_en: Waterjet cutting machines use high-pressure streams of water to shape or cut metal, glass, granite, ceramic, plastic, or other materials. They're often used to create machine parts and will not damage heat-sensitive materials.

kids.tr: Metal Toz Toplama ve Hava Filtrasyonu
kids.d_tr: Metal toz toplama ve hava filtrasyonu, metal atölyelerinde çalışma alanını ve ortam havasını temiz tutar.
kids.d_en: Metal dust collection and air filtration keep workspaces and ambient air clean in metal shops and metal fabrication applications.

kids.d_tr: Makine kaideleri tezgah ve ekipmanı zeminden yükselterek çalışma için doğru yüksekliğe getirir.
kids.d_en: Machine bases raise tools or equipment (such as bench lathes, milling machines, or drills) off the floor to position them at proper heights for operation or to reposition them in the workspace.

kids.d_tr: Makine terazileme elemanları makine parçalarını, tezgahları ve kaideleri kademeli olarak yükseltip alçaltarak hizalar.
kids.d_en: Machine leveling components incrementally raise and lower machine parts, benches, or bases to level, align, and position them.

kids.d_tr: Saklama sepetleri işleme parçalarını ve sarf malzemesini düzenli ve yolun dışında tutar.
kids.d_en: Storage baskets keep machining parts and supplies organized and out of the way.

kids.d_tr: Takım tutucular ve takım sistemleri kesici takımları CNC ve torna gibi tezgahlara bağlar.
kids.d_en: Toolholders and tooling systems attach cutting tools to machine tools, such as CNCs and lathes.

kids.d_tr: Mandrenler ve aksesuarları matkap, freze ve torna tezgahlarında matkap ucu, kılavuz ve diğer kesici takımları kavrar.
