kids.d_tr: Manuel direk çakıcılar direklerin üstüne vurarak onları kazıcıyla açılmış deliklere oturtur.
kids.d_en: Manual post drivers pound the top of poles and posts to set them into holes made by diggers.

kids.tr: Testereler, Bıçaklar, Makaslar ve Dal Kesiciler
kids.d_tr: Testereler, bıçaklar, makaslar ve dal kesiciler aşırı büyümüş dalları budar ve ağaçlardaki kuru dalları alır.
kids.d_en: Saws, knives, shears, and loppers trim back overgrowth and prune dead branches on trees and shrubs.

kids.tr: Bahçe Aleti ve Kürek Yedek Sapları
Bahçe Örtüleri, Erozyon Kontrol ve Ağaç Bakımı
kids.en: Garden Fabrics, Erosion Control Blankets & Tree Care
kids.d_tr: Bahçe örtüleri, erozyon kontrol örtüleri ve ağaç bakım ürünleri tarhları düzenli tutar ve toprak ile bitkileri korur.
kids.d_en: Garden fabrics, erosion control blankets, and tree care products keep garden beds tidy and protect soil, trees, and plants from damage.

kids.d_tr: Erozyon kontrol örtüleri yeni işlenmiş ve tohumlanmış toprağın üzerine serilerek zemini sabitler ve yağmurla savrulmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Erosion control blankets lay over freshly turned and newly seeded earth to stabilize soil and protect against washout, runoff, and scatter due to rain and heavy winds.

kids.d_tr: Ot bariyeri ve peyzaj örtüsü toprağı kaplayarak yabani otları bastırır ve istenen bitkilerin gelişmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Weed barrier and landscape fabric covers soil to suppress weeds and allow desired plants to thrive. Also known as weed block, it retains moisture and heat in soil to promote plant growth while keeping weeds from sprouting.

kids.tr: Ağaç Sulama Torbaları ve Kök Besleyiciler
kids.d_tr: Ağaç sulama torbaları ve kök besleyiciler ağaçlara su ve besin vererek gelişimini destekler.
kids.d_en: Tree watering bags and root feeders supply hydration and nutrients to trees to promote growth. They deliver water or fertilizer directly to the roots of the tree.

kids.d_tr: Ağaç ızgaraları ağacın dibini çevreleyerek yaya trafiğinden kaynaklı hasarı ve köklere takılmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Tree grates encircle the foot of trees to protect against damage from foot traffic and prevent tripping over roots.

kids.d_tr: Peyzaj kenar bordürleri tarh, ağaç ve yolların çevresinde temiz ve belirgin sınırlar oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Landscape edging forms clean, defined borders along garden beds, trees, and paths.

kids.d_tr: Bitki koruma örtüsü sıcaklık donma noktasının altına düştüğünde bitkileri don hasarından korur.
kids.d_en: Plant protection fabric shields plants to prevent frost damage when temperatures drop below freezing.

kids.d_tr: Sargılar ve koruyucular ağaçların zarar görmesini önler veya hasar sonrası iyileşme sürecinde onları korur.
kids.d_en: Wraps and protectors prevent damage to trees or safeguard trees while they recover from damage. They form barriers to shield tree trunks from animals and lawn equipment such as string trimmers.

kids.d_tr: Bahçe kazıkları ve bitki destekleri fidan ve bitkileri dik tutarak düzgün büyümelerini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Garden stakes and plant supports hold saplings and plants upright so they'll grow straight.

kids.d_tr: Çit sistemleri tarım arazisi, bina çevresi ve rekreasyon alanlarında sınır çizer ve kapalı alan oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Fencing sets boundaries and creates enclosures on agricultural fields, building grounds, recreational areas, and other outdoor spaces.

kids.d_tr: Kümes teli; kümes ağından geçici çite ve yapısal desteğe kadar geniş kullanımı olan esnek bir örgüdür.
kids.d_en: Chicken wire is a flexible mesh for applications ranging from poultry netting to temporary fencing to structural support. It's commonly used in agricultural, gardening, and construction settings.

kids.d_tr: Şev koruma bariyeri şantiye ve açık toprak alanlarının çevresinde suyun geçmesine izin verirken tortuyu tutan bir bariyer oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Silt fence forms a barrier around construction sites and plots of exposed soil to retain sediment while allowing water to filter through. It minimizes erosion and keeps silt from clogging waterways or building up on roads.

kids.d_tr: Dikenli tel ve malzemeleri; yüksek güvenlikli tesis, mera ve özel alanlarda izinsiz geçişi caydıran dikenli bir çevre oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Barbed wire and supplies set up a spiky perimeter that deters trespassing and unauthorized exit from high-security facilities, pastures and fields, and other private or restricted areas.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli çit malzemeleri, elektrikli çit hatlarının kurulması ve onarılması için tel, alet ve donanım sunar.
kids.d_en: Electric fence supplies provide wire, tools, and hardware for setting up and repairing runs of electrified fence. This type of fencing is energized with electric current that shocks upon contact to keep animals from exiting fenced areas and to deter predators from entering.

kids.d_tr: Hayvan koruma çiti, geyik ve benzeri hayvanların bitkileri yemesini engelleyen bir ağ oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Deer fence forms a net that blocks deer from feeding on plants and vegetation. It's commonly installed around farm fields, orchards, and gardens.

kids.d_tr: Kar bariyeri, savrulan karı kontrol altında tutan bir rüzgar kesici oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Snow fence creates a windbreak that controls blowing and drifting to keep snow contained. It's commonly used to set up drift-free zones around buildings and along roads.

kids.d_tr: Gizlilik ve rüzgar perdeleri dış mekanlarda görüşü ve hava akışını denetleyen bariyerler sunar.
kids.d_en: Privacy and wind screens provide barriers to control visibility into and airflow through outdoor environments.

kids.d_tr: Tel germe aparatları çit telini gererek direkler arasına sabitlenmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Fence stretching tools pull fencing wire taut so it can be fastened between posts. Also known as wire fence stretchers, they remove slack and add tension to keep fencing from sagging. They are used when installing new fencing or replacing snapped fence wires.

kids.d_tr: T ve U profil çit direkleri; tel, kar, ahşap ve kompozit çit türlerini taşır.
kids.d_en: T-posts and U-posts support wire, snow, wood, composite, and other types of fencing. T-posts are easy to install, remove, and reuse.  U-posts are perforated along their length to easily attach fencing.

kids.tr: Örgü Tel Çit, Direk ve Donanımları
kids.d_tr: Örgü tel çit, direk ve donanımları bir araya gelerek mülk sınırlarında kalıcı bir çevre veya kapalı alan oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Chain link fencing, posts, and hardware fit together to form a permanent boundary around property perimeters or to create pens and enclosures.

kids.d_tr: Kapı donanımları bahçe kapılarının mandallanması, açılması ve kapanması için gereken parçaları sunar.
kids.d_en: Gate hardware provides parts to latch, open, and close fence gates.

kids.d_tr: Panel çitler ve kapılar; havuz, jakuzi ve bahçe gibi dış alanların çevresinde estetik bir bariyer oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Privacy fences, gates, and supplies create an aesthetic barrier around outdoor areas such as pools, hot tubs, and yards in commercial, public, or residential settings. They are resistant to rust and UV damage and have modular components that can be configured to meet space requirements.

kids.d_tr: Küçük motorlar yakıt yakarak çim biçme, üfleyici, kar makinesi ve yıkama makinesi gibi bahçe ekipmanlarını çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: Small engines burn fuel to run outdoor power equipment such as lawn mowers, leaf blowers, snowblowers, trimmers, chainsaws, and pressure washers.

kids.tr: Küçük Motor Servis Setleri, Susturucular ve Parçalar
kids.en: Small Engine Service Kits, Mufflers & Parts

kids.d_tr: Sulama ekipmanları ve sistemleri çim, ağaç ve bahçelerin sulanması için su iletir.
kids.d_en: Watering equipment and irrigation systems deliver water to hydrate lawns, trees, and gardens.

kids.d_tr: Bahçe hortumu başlıkları su basıncı ve püskürtme biçiminin elle denetlenmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Garden nozzles give handheld control of water pressure and spray from garden hoses. They create specific spray patterns and move with the hose to aim water onto the desired area. Their threaded connector mates with a fitting on the hose.

kids.d_tr: Çim fıskiyeleri bahçe hortumuna takılarak suyu bahçe ve tarhlara dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Lawn sprinklers attach to garden hoses and distribute water across yards, flower beds, and gardens.

kids.d_tr: Fıskiye başlıkları ve nozulları sulama hatlarına bağlanarak sistemden su püskürtür.
kids.d_en: Sprinkler heads and nozzles connect to irrigation lines and spray water from sprinkler systems. They replace broken heads and nozzles, change to a different type, or add outlets for increased coverage.

kids.d_tr: Sulama vanaları sistemlerde suyu açar ve keser.
kids.d_en: Sprinkler valves shut water on and off in irrigation systems.

kids.tr: Sulama Kontrol Üniteleri, Zamanlayıcılar ve Sensörler
kids.d_tr: Sulama kontrol üniteleri, zamanlayıcılar ve sensörler sistemdeki su akışının zamanını ve süresini yönetir.
kids.d_en: Watering controllers, timers, and sensors manage the timing and duration of water flow in sprinkler and irrigation systems.

kids.d_tr: Damla sulama sistemleri toprağı iyice ıslatırken püskürtmeli fıskiyelere göre daha az su kullanır.
kids.d_en: Drip sprinkler systems soak soil thoroughly while using less water than spray-type sprinklers.

kids.d_tr: Sulama bakım ve tamir setleri fıskiye ile sulama sistemlerinin düzgün çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Irrigation maintenance and repair kits keep sprinklers and irrigation systems operating properly.

kids.d_tr: Jeneratörler ve güç istasyonları şebeke enerjisi kesildiğinde veya yetersiz olduğunda yedek ya da birincil güç sağlar.
kids.d_en: Electrical generators and power stations supply backup or primary power when electricity from the power grid is offline, inadequate, or unavailable.

kids.d_tr: Taşınabilir jeneratörler yakıt yakarak kesinti anında, uzak noktalarda ve şantiyelerde ekipmanı çalıştıracak elektrik üretir.
kids.d_en: Portable generators burn fuel to produce electrical energy for running equipment during power outages, in remote settings, and on jobsites. They are carried or rolled for transport to supply power when electricity from the power grid is offline, out-of-reach, or inadequate. These standalone, engine-driven power sources are placed outdoors and away from windows, doors, and vents to prevent buildup of carbon monoxide emissions.

kids.d_tr: Taşınabilir güç istasyonları doğru akımı alternatif akıma çevirerek kesinti ve uzak noktalarda kablolu alet ve cihazları çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: Portable power stations convert DC power to AC power for running corded power tools, appliances, and other electrical-powered devices during power outages, in remote locations, and in other applications where a wired power source is unavailable. Also known as battery generators, they draw power from onboard, rechargeable batteries. They allow indoor use since they run without fuel and produce no gas emissions. These battery-powered inverters are light enough to carry between locations.

kids.d_tr: Jeneratörlü ışık kuleleri inşaat, yol çalışması, gece etkinlikleri ve arama kurtarma için dış mekanda yüksek çıkışlı aydınlatma üretir.
kids.d_en: Generator light towers produce high-output illumination at outdoor locations for construction and roadwork, nighttime events, search-and-rescue operations, and more. They are fuel-powered to provide long run times for supplying area and task lighting in remote locations.

kids.d_tr: Jeneratör transfer şalterleri kesinti anında besleme kaynağını şebekeden jeneratöre aktarır.
kids.d_en: Generator transfer switches shift the source of electrical power from the grid to a generator for running equipment during outages.

kids.d_tr: Jeneratör aksesuarları kurulum, işletme, taşıma ve onarım işlerine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Generator accessories assist with installing, operating, transporting, and repairing generators.

kids.d_tr: Zemin koruma paspasları yumuşak zeminde ağır yük ve ekipmanın taşınması için sabit bir taban sunar; yüzeye zarar vermez.
kids.d_en: Ground protection mats provide a stable base to move heavy loads and equipment over soft ground without damaging the surface or getting equipment stuck. Mats can be joined at the ends to create temporary roadways to access construction areas.

kids.d_tr: Haşere ve zararlı kontrol ürünleri bina, saçak, tabela ve yolları zararlı hayvan ile böceklerin yol açtığı hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Insect and wildlife control products protect buildings, ledges, signs, and walkways from damage and nuisance caused by pest animals and bugs.

kids.d_tr: Böcek kontrol ürünleri sinek, karınca ve hamamböceği gibi zararlı böcek popülasyonlarını azaltır veya yok eder.
kids.d_en: Bug and insect control products reduce or eliminate populations of pest insects such as flies, ants, and cockroaches.

kids.d_tr: Kemirgen kontrol ürünleri fare ve sıçan gibi kemirgenleri kaçırır, yakalar veya yok eder.
kids.d_en: Rodent control products repel, capture, or eliminate rodents such as mice and rats. They are suitable for use indoors and outdoors in commercial, residential, and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Kuş kontrol ürünleri iç ve dış mekanlarda zararlı kuş popülasyonlarını azaltır veya alandan uzak tutar.
kids.d_en: Insect and wildlife control products reduce, remove, or exclude populations of pest animals, birds, and insects from indoor and outdoor spaces.

kids.d_tr: Yaban hayvanı kontrol ürünleri zararlı hayvanları uzaklaştırır veya tuzaklar; korunan alanlara erişimlerini sınırlar.
kids.d_en: Wildlife control products eliminate, repel, or trap pest animals to prevent and limit access to protected areas.

kids.d_tr: Basınçlı yıkama makineleri su jetiyle kaplama, bina ve ekipmandaki kir, pas ve birikintileri söker.
kids.d_en: Pressure washers spray jets of water to loosen and remove dirt, grime, rust, and other deposits from pavement, buildings, and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli yıkama makineleri prize takılarak çalışır ve su jetiyle yüzeylerdeki kir, pas ve birikintileri söker.
kids.d_en: Electric pressure washers plug into and operate within range of an electrical outlet that provides power for spraying jets of water to loosen and remove dirt, grime, rust, and other deposits from pavement, buildings, and equipment. Also known as electric power washers, they enhance the cleaning power of detergents while reducing or eliminating the need to scrub surfaces. These corded pressure washers run more quietly than gas-powered units, operate without fumes, and require no refueling or recharging. They allow long run times and maintain full power during operation.

kids.d_tr: Benzinli yıkama makinelerinin motoru gün boyu düzenli güç üretir ve su jetiyle yüzeylerdeki kir ile birikintileri söker.
kids.d_en: Gas-powered pressure washers have a gasoline-fueled engine that produces consistent, all-day running power for spraying jets of water to loosen and remove dirt, grime, rust, and other deposits from pavement, buildings, and equipment. Also known as gas-powered power washers, they enhance the cleaning power of detergents while reducing or eliminating the need to scrub surfaces. They operate in areas without access to wired power and have no batteries to recharge or cords to manage. Their engine requires refueling, regular maintenance, and winterizing for storage.

kids.d_tr: Akülü yıkama makineleri kablosuz ve egzozsuz çalışarak su jetiyle yüzeylerdeki kir ve birikintileri söker.
kids.d_en: Battery-powered pressure washers provide cord-free, fume-free operation for spraying jets of water to loosen and remove dirt, grime, rust, and other deposits from pavement, buildings, and equipment. Also known as cordless power washers, they enhance the cleaning power of detergents while reducing or eliminating the need to scrub surfaces. They require no fuel supply, operate in areas without access to wired power, and eliminate the tripping hazard of a cord. These pressure washers are powered by batteries of a compatible platform and matching voltage. The batteries require recharging or replacement when depleted.

kids.d_tr: Nozullar yıkama makinesinden çıkan suyun kuvvetini ve püskürtme biçimini denetler.
kids.d_en: Nozzles control the spraying force and pattern from a pressure washer. They connect to a compatible fitting on a spray gun or wand.

kids.tr: Yıkama Tabancaları, Lansları ve Köpük Aparatları
kids.en: Spray Guns, Wands & Foamers for Pressure Washers
kids.d_tr: Yıkama tabancaları, lansları ve köpük aparatları makinenin su çıkışını denetler, yönlendirir ve biçimlendirir.
kids.d_en: Spray guns, wands, and foamers control, direct, and modify the water output from pressure washers. They have fittings to connect to compatible pressure washer components.

kids.d_tr: Yıkama makinesi deterjanları temizleme gücünü artırarak yerleşmiş kir ve yapışmış kalıntıları çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Pressure washer detergents boost cleaning power to remove ingrained dirt, heavy soils, and stuck-on residues. Each detergent type creates a pressure washing cleaning solution for specific applications, such as cleaning, degreasing, and steaming.

kids.tr: Döner Yüzey Temizleyiciler ve Su Süpürgeleri
kids.d_tr: Döner yüzey temizleyiciler ve su süpürgeleri standart makinelerden daha geniş alanı kapsayarak büyük yüzeyleri kısa sürede temizler.
kids.d_en: Rotary surface cleaners and water brooms provide more spraying coverage than standard pressure washers to clean large surface areas in less time.

kids.tr: Kanal, Tank ve Rögar Temizleme Aparatları
kids.en: Duct, Tank & Manhole Cleaners for Pressure Washers

kids.d_tr: Yıkama makinesi yedek parça ve aksesuarları yıpranmış bileşenleri değiştirir veya makineyi özel uygulamalara uyarlar.
kids.d_en: Pressure washer replacement parts and accessories change out worn components or adapt pressure washers for specific applications. They perform functions such as sealing against leaks, supporting and connecting components, delivering soaps and cleaners, and regulating flow.

kids.d_tr: Kar ve buz temizlik ürünleri kaldırım, yol ve otoparkları temizleyerek tehlikeyi azaltır ve geçiş yolu açar.
kids.d_en: Snow and ice removal products clear off sidewalks, driveways, parking lots, and other surfaces to reduce hazards and leave a path for travel.

kids.d_tr: Buz çözücüler ve kaymaz malzemeler kaplı yüzeyleri işleyerek soğuk ve ıslak koşullarda kayma riskini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Ice melt and traction control products treat paved surfaces to reduce the risk of slipping in cold, wet conditions. Also known as de-icers, they coat walkways, driveways, and roads to dissolve ice and enhance grip for improved footing and traction.

kids.d_tr: Kar atma makineleri motorlu helezonuyla karı yüzeyden alıp yığınlara atarak kaldırım, yol ve otoparkları temizler.
kids.d_en: Snow blowers use their powered paddle or auger to pick up snow from surfaces and discharge it into piles to clear sidewalks, driveways, and parking lots. They remove snow more quickly and with less effort than shoveling.

kids.tr: Kar Makinesi Bakım Setleri ve Yedek Parçaları
kids.en: Maintenance Kits, Accessories & Repair Parts for Snow Blowers
kids.d_tr: Kar makinesi bakım setleri ve yedek parçaları makineleri düzgün çalışır tutar veya işlevini özel uygulamalara uyarlar.
kids.d_en: Snow blower maintenance kits, accessories, and repair parts keep blowers operating properly or modify their function for specific applications. They are typically compatible with specific snow blower models.

kids.d_tr: Kar küreklerinin geniş ağzı ve uzun sapı, kaldırım ve yollardan karı almak için kaldıraç etkisi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Snow shovels have a large blade and a long handle that provides leverage for removing snow from sidewalks, driveways, patios, and other paved areas. They are typically used to clear smaller areas where snow blowers would be too large or overpowered.

kids.d_tr: Çatı kar sıyırıcıları, çatıya yapısal hasar vermeden önce ağır kar yükünü aşağı çeker.
kids.d_en: Snow roof rakes pull down heavy snow loads before they cause structural damage to roofs. They are commonly used on single-story buildings, trailer tops, and other elevated surfaces that are within reach while standing on the ground.

kids.d_tr: Buz kazıyıcılar ve kırıcılar beton merdiven, yol ve geçitlerdeki sıkışmış kar ile kalın buzu kazır veya kırar.
kids.d_en: Ice scrapers and choppers shave off or break up packed snow and thick ice from concrete steps, walkways, and driveways. They also double as roofing shovels to remove shingles and as spades to slice through roots, cut turf, and dig trenches.

kids.d_tr: Kar süpürgeleri ve yedek fırçaları kaplamadan kar ve sulu karı kaldırıp iter.
kids.d_en: Snow sweepers and replacement brushes lift off and plow away snow and slush from pavement. Also known as rotary snow brooms, they clear sidewalks, driveways, parking lots, and more.

kids.d_tr: Dış mekan püskürtücüleri ve sisleyiciler sıvı gübre, ot ilacı, pestisit ve kaplamaları çim, bahçe ve bina çevresine dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Outdoor sprayers and foggers disperse liquid fertilizers, weed killers, pesticides, cleaning solutions, sealants, and more onto lawns, gardens, and building grounds.

kids.d_tr: El tipi ve arabalı püskürtücüler sıvıyı taşıdıkları tankta tutar ve lansa pompalayarak uygular.
kids.d_en: Handheld and cart sprayers hold liquids in their carry-along or roll-along tank and pump them to their spray wand for dispensing. Also known as handheld pump sprayers, they have a lever control and a nozzle to regulate the spray. These portable, compressed air sprayers disperse liquid lawn treatments, surface-cleaning solutions, sealants, and more. They require draining and rinsing out before storage to prevent chemicals from damaging sprayer seals and valves.

kids.d_tr: Sırt pülverizatörleri tank ağırlığını omuzlara dağıtarak hareketi kolaylaştırır, iki eli serbest bırakır ve yorgunluğu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Backpack sprayers strap on and distribute the weight of their tank across the shoulders to ease maneuvering, keep both hands free for spraying, and reduce fatigue during extended use. Also known as backpack pump sprayers, they pump liquids from the tank to their spray wand and regulate the spray via their lever control and nozzle. They disperse liquid fertilizers, weed killers, pesticides, cleaning solutions, sealants, and more onto lawns, gardens, and building grounds as well as onto equipment and surfaces in and around warehouses and other facilities. Sprayers require draining and rinsing out before storage to prevent chemicals from damaging sprayer seals and valves.

kids.d_tr: Çekilir püskürtücüler araca bağlanarak peyzaj ve tarım uygulamalarında sıvı gübre, ot ilacı ve pestisit püskürtür.
kids.d_en: Tow-behind sprayers hitch to vehicles to spray liquid fertilizers, weed killers, pesticides, cleaning solutions, sealants, and more in landscaping, groundskeeping, and agricultural applications. Also known as trailer sprayers, these towable sprayers cover more ground in less time than walk-behind sprayers. They require draining and rinsing out before storage to prevent chemicals from damaging sprayer seals and valves.

kids.d_tr: Araç üstü püskürtücüler uzak noktalara taşınabilir ve yüksek kapasiteli tanklarıyla daha geniş alanı kapsar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle-mounted sprayers allow transport to remote locations and feature high-capacity tanks to cover more ground than other types of sprayers. Also known as truck bed sprayers, they sit on the back of a truck, UTV, or ATV and disperse water, liquid fertilizers, weed killers, pesticides, cleaning solutions, and more in landscaping, groundskeeping, and agricultural applications. They require draining and rinsing out before storage to prevent chemicals from damaging sprayer seals and valves.

kids.tr: Püskürtücü Hortum, Lans, Tabanca ve Nozulları
kids.en: Hoses, Wands, Guns & Nozzles for Sprayers
kids.d_tr: Püskürtücü hortum, lans, tabanca ve nozulları sıvıyı hedef alana iletir ve yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Sprayer hoses, wands, guns, and nozzles deliver and direct the liquid spray onto the target area. They pair with compatible sprayer models to replace worn components or switch out components to modify the spray.

kids.d_tr: Püskürtücü parça ve aksesuarları yıpranmış bileşenleri değiştirir veya cihazı özel uygulamalara uyarlar.
kids.d_en: Sprayer parts and accessories change out worn components or adapt sprayers for specific applications.

kids.d_tr: Sisleyiciler ince bir sis püskürterek geniş alanları insektisit, ot ilacı, gübre, dezenfektan ve kaplamayla işler.
kids.d_en: Foggers spray a fine mist to treat large areas with insecticides, weed killers, fertilizers, parasite controls, disinfectants, cleaners, stains, and sealers. Also known as misters, they hold chemicals in their tank, pump them to their misting nozzle, and emit them in an aerosolized form. A fogger's seal material, tank construction, and other design features determine its chemical compatibility and the applications it can perform. Foggers require draining and rinsing out before storage to prevent chemicals from damaging seals and valves.

kids.d_tr: Serpme makineleri tuz, kum, buz çözücü, çim tohumu ve gübre gibi granül maddeleri dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Spreaders distribute salt, sand, ice melt, grass seed, fertilizers, and other granular substances.

kids.d_tr: İtmeli serpme makineleri düz veya hafif eğimli arazide yürütülerek buz çözücü, tohum ve gübreyi eşit dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Walk-behind spreaders roll along flat or gently sloped terrain to evenly distribute ice melt, grass seed, fertilizers, and other granular substances. They have a hopper to hold bulk material for spreading across areas that don't require the larger-scale coverage of vehicle-mounted or tow-behind spreaders. Also known as push spreaders, they set their handle at a comfortable height for pushing while walking behind the spreader.

kids.d_tr: Omuz ve el tipi serpiciler, büyük makinelerin ulaşamadığı küçük alanlara buz çözücü, tohum ve gübre dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Shoulder and handheld spreaders distribute ice melt, grass seed, fertilizers, and other granular substances across small areas and locations that can't be reached with larger spreaders. They have a bag, hopper, or scoop that holds bulk materials for spreading.

kids.d_tr: Araç üstü serpme makineleri uzak noktalara taşınabilir ve yüksek kapasiteli hazneleriyle daha geniş alanı kapsar.
kids.d_en: Vehicle-mounted spreaders allow transport to remote locations and feature high-capacity hoppers to cover more ground than other types of spreaders. They are typically used as a salt spreader for trucks and UTVs. Their hopper holds compatible materials (such as salt, sand, feed, and other granular substances) and releases them as the vehicle moves forward.

kids.d_tr: Çekilir serpme makineleri traktör veya ATV'ye bağlanarak düz ve hafif eğimli arazide tuz, kum ve yem dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Tow-behind spreaders hitch to a lawn tractor, ATV, or UTV for pulling along flat or gently sloped terrain to distribute salt, sand, feed, and other granular substances. These towable spreaders cover more ground in less time than walk-behind spreaders.

kids.d_tr: Serpme makinesi parça ve aksesuarları yıpranmış bileşenleri değiştirir veya makineyi özel uygulamalara uyarlar.
kids.d_en: Spreader parts and accessories change out worn components or adapt spreaders for specific applications. They perform functions such as illuminating the area around the spreader, regulating material flow, directing material onto target areas, and securing spreaders to vehicles.

kids.tr: Geçici Dış Mekan Yapıları ve Mobilyaları
kids.d_tr: Geçici dış mekan yapıları ve mobilyaları kamp, festival ve acil durum gibi geçici kullanımlarda barınak ve oturma alanı sunar.
kids.d_en: Temporary outdoor structures and furniture provide shelter and seating outdoors for camping, festivals, emergencies, and other temporary applications.

kids.d_tr: Tente çadırlar ve barınaklar, insanları dış hava koşullarından koruyan geçici yapılardır.
kids.d_en: Canopy tents and shelters are temporary structures that shield people from the outdoor elements. They consist of a frame that supports the weather-shielding fabric and can be erected or taken down as needed.

kids.tr: Çadır Yan Perdeleri ve Taşıma Çantaları
kids.en: Sidewalls & Bags for Canopy Tents & Temporary Shelters
Anchors & Weights for Canopies & Temporary Shelters
kids.d_tr: Çadır ankraj ve ağırlıkları, çadırları zemine sabitleyerek veya ağırlaştırarak yerinde kalmalarını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Anchors and weights for canopies and temporary shelters, also called tent weights or tent anchors, help keep canopies and temporary shelters in place by securing them to the ground or making them too heavy to blow away.

kids.tr: Katlanır Dış Mekan Masa ve Sandalyeleri
kids.d_tr: Katlanır dış mekan masa ve sandalyeleri taşınabilirdir; depolama için katlanır ve gerektiğinde hızla kurulur.
kids.d_en: Collapsible outdoor tables and chairs are portable seating and working surfaces that fold into compact footprints for storage and can be quickly deployed as needed.

kids.en: Replacement Parts for Canopy Tents & Temporary Structures
kids.d_tr: Çadır yedek parçaları hasarlı, yıpranmış veya eksik bileşenleri değiştirerek çadırı yeniden kullanılır hale getirir.
kids.d_en: Replacement parts for canopy tents and temporary structures return tents to working order by replacing damaged, worn, or missing components.

d_tr: Ambalaj ve sevkiyat malzemeleri ürünleri depolama, taşıma ve gönderi için paketlemek, korumak ve etiketlemek için gereken her şeyi sunar.
d_en: Packaging and shipping supplies provide the materials needed to pack, bundle, protect, seal, and label items for storage, transit, or shipment.

kids.d_tr: Koliler, dolgu levhaları ve tüpler ürünleri sevkiyat için paketleyerek taşıma sırasında hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Shipping boxes, pads, and tubes are containers that package products for transit and delivery, protecting them from damage during shipping.

kids.d_tr: Koliler birçok biçim, ölçü ve dayanımda sunulur; ürünleri depolama ve taşıma için içine alır ve korur.
kids.d_en: Shipping boxes come in many shapes, sizes, and strengths to contain and protect products for storage or transport.

kids.d_tr: Posta tüpleri bükülmeyen sert malzemeden üretilir; rulo belge, poster ve boru gibi ürünleri sevkiyatta korur.
kids.d_en: Mailing tubes are made of rigid material that won't bend to protect a variety of items during shipment such as rolled documents, posters, and artwork, as well as heavier items such as pipes and baseball bats.

kids.d_tr: Oluklu mukavva levhalar, ürünler arasına veya paletli istifte katman oluşturan düz karton ya da plastik parçalardır.
kids.d_en: Corrugated pads and sheets are flat pieces of cardboard or plastic that layer between products or separate items in a palletized stack. They are also used to protect the floor beneath a pallet.

kids.d_tr: Perakende ve hediye kutuları, satın alınan ürünleri paketlemek için kullanılan hafif kartonlardır.
kids.d_en: Retail and gift boxes are lightweight cartons for packing up individual merchandise pieces after purchase.

kids.d_tr: Koli bantları depolama, taşıma ve sevkiyat için paketleri kapatır ve ürünleri bir arada tutar.
kids.d_en: Packing tape seals packages and bundles items for storage, transit, and shipping.

kids.d_tr: Bu koli bandı ruloları standart paketleme ve sevkiyat işlerinde koli ve kartonları kapatır.
kids.d_en: These rolls of packing tape seal boxes, mailers, and cartons in standard packing and shipping operations.

kids.d_tr: Islak kraft bant oluklu mukavvada güçlü bir bağ kurarak güvenli bir kapatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Water-activated Kraft tape forms a strong bond on corrugated packaging to provide a secure seal. This tape must be run through a water-activated tape machine that applies water to activate the glue on the tape. Also referred to as WAT and gummed tape, it is used in commercial shipping operations to secure packages and provide a professional appearance that can be recycled along with recyclable packaging.

kids.d_tr: Takviyeli çemberleme bandı, cam elyaf takviyeli, yüksek çekme dayanımlı ve yırtılmaya dirençli bir banttır.
kids.d_en: Strapping tape is a high-tensile strength, fiberglass-reinforced tape with good tear resistance. Also known as filament tape, it is moisture- and solvent-resistant and will not delaminate, split, or crack. Strapping tape is commonly used for bundling and reinforcing shipments.

kids.d_tr: Basınca duyarlı kağıt bant, solvent veya ısı gerekmeden elle bastırılarak yüzeye yapışır.
kids.d_en: Pressure-sensitive tape is paper-backed and adheres to surfaces by applying pressure by hand without the need for a solvent or heat for activation.

kids.d_tr: Sessiz koli bandı ruloda açılırken tiz bir ses çıkarmadan düzgün biçimde çözülür.
kids.d_en: Quiet packing tape unwinds smoothly without emitting loud screeching sounds when the adhesive pulls from the roll. They help reduce noise levels in busy packing and shipping facilities, and in shared workspaces.

kids.d_tr: Kristal şeffaf koli bandı UV ışığı ve hava koşullarına bağlı sararmaya ve yaşlanmaya direnir.
kids.d_en: Crystal clear packing tape resists yellowing and aging from UV light and weathering. Clear tape is often preferred on white and colored boxes or packaging with designs and logos.

kids.d_tr: Renk kodlu koli bandı paketleri kapatırken elleçleme ve stok amacıyla görsel olarak sınıflandırma imkanı verir.
kids.d_en: Color-coding packing tape provides a means to seal packages and visibly classify them for handling and inventory purposes.

kids.d_tr: Soğuk ortam koli bandı, donma noktasının altındaki sıcaklıklarda kolideki yapışkanlığını korur.
kids.d_en: Cold-temperature packing tape maintains its bond on cartons in subfreezing temperatures. They are useful in food processing applications for storing and transporting food as well as cold weather climates for moving and storing packaged inventory in unheated warehouses.

kids.d_tr: Baskılı koli bandı taşınmakta olan paketler hakkında bilgi aktarır.
kids.d_en: Preprinted packing tape conveys information for packages in transit.

kids.d_tr: Kesilmiş bant levha ve şeritleri kullanıma hazır uzunluklar sunar; aparat veya kesiciye gerek bırakmaz.
kids.d_en: Pre-cut packing tape sheets and strips provide convenient, ready-to-apply lengths of tape that eliminate the need for a dispenser or cutting tool. They are useful for uniform box sizes to reduce waste, make quick repairs to damaged seals on packaging, and protect labels.

kids.d_tr: Poşet kapatma bandı, uygun aparatla kullanıldığında açık uçlu naylon poşetleri kapatır.
kids.d_en: Bag sealing tape seals open-ended poly bags when used with bag sealing tape dispensers. This tape is thin, durable, and constructed of unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) with a vinyl film backing. Bag sealing tape provides a stronger seal than twist ties.

kids.d_tr: Etiket koruma bandı nem, yağ ve solvente dayanarak sevkiyat etiketlerinin yerinde ve okunur kalmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Label protection tape withstands moisture, oils, solvents, and other liquids to keep shipping labels on packages fixed in place and legible.

kids.d_tr: Koli bandı aparatları ve makineleri yüksek hacimli paketleme ve sevkiyatta bant uygulamasını kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Packing tape dispensers and machines ease tape dispensing in high-volume packing and shipping settings.

kids.d_tr: İrsaliye zarfları paketin dışına yapıştırılarak fatura, irsaliye ve güvenlik bilgi formu gibi belgeleri taşır.
kids.d_en: Packing list envelopes adhere to the outside of packages or shipping containers to hold invoices, packing lists, safety data sheets, and other important documents.

kids.d_tr: Baskılı irsaliye zarflarının ön yüzünde, içeriğini alıcıya bildiren bir mesaj bulunur.
kids.d_en: Printed packing list envelopes have a message on the front of the envelope that identifies the contents of the envelope for the recipient. These adhesive-backed plastic document pouches adhere to the outside of a package or shipping container to ensure invoices, packing lists, safety data sheets, and other important documents are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: İki dilli irsaliye zarfları birden fazla dilde basılı mesaj taşır ve içeriği alıcıya bildirir.
kids.d_en: Bilingual packing list envelopes display printed messages in more than one language and identify the envelope's contents for the recipient. These adhesive-backed plastic document pouches can be stuck to the outside of a package or shipping container to ensure invoices, packing lists, safety data sheets, and other important documents are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: Bu irsaliye zarfları sürdürülebilirlik için geri dönüştürülmüş plastikten üretilir ve ön yüzünde içeriği bildiren bir mesaj taşır.
kids.d_en: These packing list envelopes are made from recycled plastic to support sustainability and have a message on the front that identifies the envelope's contents. These adhesive-backed document pouches adhere to the outside of a package or shipping container to ensure invoices, packing lists, safety data sheets, and other important documents are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: Güvenlik bilgi formu zarfları, içinde güvenlik bilgi formu bulunduğunu alıcıya bildiren bir uyarı taşır.
kids.d_en: SDS packing list envelopes have messaging to alert recipients that Safety Data Sheets are included in the envelope. These adhesive-backed document pouches adhere to the outside of a package or shipping container to ensure these SDS papers and other documents such as invoices and packing lists are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: Bu irsaliye zarfları ihracat belgesi ve sertifika gibi nakliye için gereken evrakı tanımlayan mesajlar taşır.
kids.d_en: These packing list envelopes have messaging to identify documents required for transportation such as export documents and certifications. They adhere to the outside of packages or shipping containers to ensure documents are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: Askeri standart irsaliye zarfları, askeri paketleme ve sevkiyat için belirlenen resmi şartnameleri karşılar.
kids.d_en: Military spec packing list envelopes meet U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) requirements and government specifications for military packaging and shipping applications. These pouches adhere to the outside of packages or shipping containers to ensure documents are visible and accessible to recipients. They provide an alternative to placing the documents inside the package or shipping container and reduce the risk of the documents getting damaged, lost, or thrown out.

kids.d_tr: Barkod etiketleme ve okuma malzemeleri, sevkiyat ve stok süreçlerinde ürünlerin tanımlanmasına ve izlenmesine yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Barcode labeling and scanning supplies and equipment help identify, track, and manage items in shipping and inventory processes.

kids.d_tr: Barkod etiketleri ve ribbonları uyumlu yazıcılara beslenerek sevkiyat ve stok yönetimi için özel etiketler üretir.
kids.d_en: Barcode labels and ribbons feed into compatible barcode printers to create custom labels for shipping and inventory management applications.

kids.d_tr: Barkod yazıcıları sevkiyat, varlık takibi ve stok yönetimi için barkod, adres ve logo içeren özel etiketler üretir.
kids.d_en: Barcode label printers create custom labels with barcodes, addresses, company logos, and other information for shipping, asset tracking, product identification, pricing, and inventory management applications.

kids.d_tr: Barkod okuyucular etiketlerdeki barkodları okuyan kompakt cihazlardır.
kids.d_en: Barcode label scanners are compact devices that read barcodes on labels.

kids.d_tr: Gönderi zarfları küçük veya yassı ürünleri taşır ve içeriği güvenle kapatan bir kapama sistemine sahiptir.
kids.d_en: Shipping mailers hold small or flat items and have a closure to seal the contents securely inside.

kids.d_tr: Balonlu zarfların içinde, ürünlerin çevresinde yastıklama sağlayan plastik balonlu bir astar bulunur.
kids.d_en: Bubble mailers have a plastic bubble liner to provide some cushioning and padding around items. These mailing envelopes protect the contents of the package and help prevent breakage during shipment. A closure with self-sealing tape secures the contents inside the envelope. Bubble mailers are common for shipping small parts, sample products, and small gift items.

kids.d_tr: Geri dönüşümlü zarflar küçük veya yassı ürünleri taşır ve içeriği güvenle kapatan bir kapama sistemine sahiptir.
kids.d_en: Recyclable mailers hold small or flat items and have a closure to seal the contents securely inside. They are made from recycled paper material and are recyclable once used.

kids.d_tr: Yırtılmaz plastik zarflar esnektir ve içeriği nemden korur.
kids.d_en: Tear-resistant poly mailers are flexible envelopes that protect the contents from moisture. They seal closed and are suitable for shipping non-fragile items such as clothing.

kids.d_tr: Karton ve fiberboard düz zarflar sert ve kalın kağıttan üretilir; içeriğin taşıma sırasında katlanmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Chipboard and fiberboard flat mailers are made of stiff, thick paper, and they prevent the envelope contents from folding or bending during transit. A top flap folds over the opening to close the mailer. They are ideal for shipping flat items that must not bend, such as photos.

kids.d_tr: Dekoratif gönderi zarfları küçük ürünleri parlak ve canlı renkli malzemede taşıyarak pakete dikkat çeker.
kids.d_en: Glamour mailers hold small or flat items in brightly colored, shiny material that draws attention to the package in retail, marketing, and gifting applications. They have a closure to seal the contents securely inside.

kids.d_tr: Koruyucu ambalaj kutu içindeki ürünün çevresinde tampon oluşturur; kayma, darbe, korozyon ve neme karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Protective packaging creates a buffer around items in a box or container and protects against shifting, impact, corrosion, moisture, or temperature fluctuations during shipment or storage.

kids.d_tr: Balonlu naylon torba ve ruloları hava kabarcıklı esnek plastiktir; ürünleri sararak taşıma ve depolamada hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Bubble bags and rolls are flexible plastic material with air-pocket bubbles that wrap and cushion items inside a package to protect them from damage during transit or storage.

kids.d_tr: Sünger rulo, poşet ve levhaları depolama ve sevkiyat sırasında ürünleri koruyan ambalaj malzemeleridir.
kids.d_en: Foam rolls, pouches, and sheets are packaging material that protect items during storage and shipping.

kids.d_tr: Ambalaj kağıdı ürünleri sarmak veya kutudaki boşluğu doldurarak taşıma sırasında kaymayı önlemek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Packaging paper is used to wrap items for shipment or to fill empty space in containers, preventing products from shifting during transit.

kids.d_tr: Hava yastıkları kolideki boşluğu doldurarak ürünleri yastıklar ve taşıma sırasında kaymalarını önler.
kids.d_en: Air pillows fill empty space in shipping boxes to cushion products and prevent them from shifting during transit.

kids.d_tr: Hava yastıklı sabitleme torbaları kamyon ve konteynerde ağır ürünlerin arasına yerleştirilerek kaymalarını önleyen büyük şişme torbalardır.
kids.d_en: Dunnage bags are large, durable, inflated bags that are placed between and around heavy items in trucks and shipping containers to prevent them from shifting during transit.

kids.d_tr: Dolgu köpükleri ürünün çevresindeki fazla boşluğu dolduran, tekrar kullanılabilir dökme ambalaj malzemesidir.
kids.d_en: Packaging peanuts are reusable, loose packing material that fill excess space around a product and provide some protection against damage during transit.

kids.d_tr: Anında şişen köpük, kap içindeki ürünün çevresinde şekil alarak koruyan bir ambalaj malzemesidir.
kids.d_en: Instant foam is a protective packaging material that forms into a shape to surround an item in a container. It consists of two separate compounds that harden into foam when mixed. The foam fills all void space in the container and secures the items with a snug fit, preventing them from shifting or sustaining damage during transit. It's a good choice for protecting valuable, fragile, or odd-shaped items such as heavy accessories, motors, or camera and video equipment.

kids.d_tr: Antistatik ambalaj malzemeleri statik elektrik birikimini önleyerek elektronik bileşenlere zarar verebilecek deşarj riskini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Anti-static packaging materials prevent static electricity from building up around items, reducing the risk of electrostatic discharge (ESD) that could damage electronic components and computers.

kids.d_tr: Korozyon önleyici ambalaj malzemeleri yastıklar, nem emer ve sevkiyat sırasında metal parçalarda pas oluşumunu engeller.
kids.d_en: Corrosion-inhibiting packaging materials cushion, absorb moisture, and prevent rust build-up on metal items and electronic components during shipment.

kids.d_tr: Sıcaklık kontrollü ambalaj malzemeleri kapları yalıtarak sıcak veya soğuğun içeriğe zarar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Temperature-controlled packaging materials insulate shipping containers, preventing heat or cold from damaging or spoiling the contents.

kids.tr: Balonlu Naylon ve Sünger Kesme Aparatları
kids.d_tr: Balonlu naylon ve sünger kesme aparatları paketleme istasyonunda ambalaj malzemesini saklar, düzenler ve keser.
kids.d_en: Bubble and foam dispensers and cutters store, organize, and cut packing material at a packaging station. These metal stands hold rolls at their core with a support bar that rotates as lengths of material are pulled from the roll. Bubble rolls and foam can be cut or torn to length and wrapped around fragile items to protect them from damage during shipment.

kids.d_tr: Nem emici ambalaj; depolama ve sevkiyatta kuru kalması gereken ürünlerin zarar görmesini önleyen malzeme ve göstergeleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Moisture absorbent packaging includes packing materials and indicators to prevent damage to products that must stay dry during storage and shipment.

kids.d_tr: Streç film ürünleri toz ve nemden korur, müdahaleyi belli eder ve sevkiyat ile depolamada ürünleri bir arada tutar.
kids.d_en: Stretch wrap protects products from dust and moisture, prevents and indicates tampering, and keeps items together for shipping and storage in fulfillment centers, loading docks, and storage facilities.

kids.d_tr: Streç film ruloları bir göbek üzerine sarılmış sürekli plastik şeritlerdir; elle veya makineyle uygulanabilir.
kids.d_en: Stretch wrap rolls are continuous lengths of plastic wrapped around a core that can be applied by hand or with a wrapping machine.

kids.d_tr: Streç film aparatları paletlere elle sarımı hızlandırır, elleri keskin göbekten korur ve el yorgunluğunu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Stretch wrap dispensers make it easier and quicker to manually apply stretch wrap to loaded pallets and bundles, protecting hands from sharp core material and reducing hand fatigue and strain. Stretch wrap dispensers are more portable than machines, and can be easily transported around a facility.

kids.tr: Streç Sarma Makineleri ve Döner Tablaları
kids.d_tr: Streç sarma makineleri ve döner tablaları orta ve yüksek hacimli paketlemede sarımı elle yapmaktan daha hızlı ve güvenli kılar.
kids.d_en: Stretch wrap machines and turntables are used in medium- to high-volume packing and shipping applications to make applying stretch wrap to bundles and pallets quicker, easier, and more secure than hand wrapping. These machines turn pallets or apply stretch wrap to the sides of bundles to protect them and keep items secured.

kids.d_tr: Üst örtü filmleri, yanlar streçlenmeden önce paletin üstüne yerleştirilerek içeriği toz ve nemden korur.
kids.d_en: Top sheeting is placed on top of the pallet prior to wrapping the sides with stretch wrap to help protect pallet contents from dust and moisture. The rolls are composed of perforated sheets that are torn from the roll as needed.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme ürünleri sevkiyatta ürünleri koruyacak veya depolamada düzenli ve güvenli tutacak şekilde bir arada bağlar.
kids.d_en: Strapping products secure items together to protect them during shipment or to keep them organized and secure during storage.

kids.d_tr: Çember bantları sevkiyat, depolama ve paketleme işlerinde palet, demet ve kolileri sabitler.
kids.d_en: Strapping bands secure pallets, bundles, and boxes in shipping, storage, and packing operations.

kids.d_tr: Çember klipsleri ve tokaları plastik ile çelik çemberin uçlarını sevkiyat veya depolama için sabitler.
kids.d_en: Strapping seals and buckles secure the ends of plastic and steel strapping for shipping or storage.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme aparatları demet ve paketleri sabitleyen çemberi gerer, kapatır ve keser.
kids.d_en: Strapping tools tension, seal, and cut strapping that is used to secure bundles and packages for shipping and storage.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme arabaları çember bobinlerini taşıyarak malzemeyi düzenli ve kullanıma hazır tutar.
kids.d_en: Strapping carts, also called strapping dispensers, hold strapping coils to keep materials organized and accessible for use. Carts secure coils through the core, so operators can pull strapping off the coil as needed. A brake stops the roll from turning or unwinding when not in use.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme setleri metal ve plastik çemberi taşımak, germek ve kapatmak için birlikte çalışan ürünleri içerir.
kids.d_en: Strapping kits include a selection of items that work together to hold, store, transport, tension, and seal metal and plastic strapping.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme makineleri sarımı hızlandırır ve elle çemberleme için gereken fiziksel eforu azaltarak yorgunluğu düşürür.
kids.d_en: Strapping machines speed wrapping and reduce operator fatigue by reducing the amount of physical labor required to manually strap and seal bundles. They are used in medium-to-high volume shipping applications, such as loading docks and fulfillment centers.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme aksesuarları palet, demet ve paketleri sabitleyen çemberleme ve kapatma işlemlerini destekler.
kids.d_en: Strapping accessories support strapping and sealing operations used to secure pallets, bundles, and packages for shipping and storage.

kids.d_tr: Balya teli ve bağları çit onarımında veya karton, inşaat demiri ve hafif boru gibi dökme ürünleri demetlemede kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Baling wire and ties are used to repair fences or secure packages and bundles of loose items such as cardboard, rebar, and lightweight pipe. Also called bundling wire, this flexible wire wraps around the bundle, and wire ties secure the ends together to hold the bundle in place. Baling wire and ties are used in warehouses, on construction sites or farms, or wherever loose items need bundling.

kids.d_tr: Çemberleme aparatı yedek parçaları bu ürünlerin onarım ve bakımını destekler.
kids.d_en: Replacement parts for strapping tools help support the repair and maintenance of these products.

kids.d_tr: Kenar ve köşe koruyucular taşıma sırasında büyük paketli sevkiyatları dengeler ve korur.
kids.d_en: Edge and corner protectors help stabilize and safeguard large packaged shipments during transit.

kids.d_tr: Kenar koruyucular istiflenmiş paketlerin üzerine yerleştirilerek sevkiyat ve depolamada yükü dengeler ve korur.
kids.d_en: Edge protectors are placed on stacked packages to help stabilize and protect loads during shipping and storage. They help prevent shifting of loads during transport and provide additional support for double-stacked pallets. Edge protectors are secured in place using stretch wrap or strapping.

kids.d_tr: Köşe koruyucular kutu ve kapların çevresine yerleştirilerek elleçleme ve sevkiyatta ezik ve hasarı önler.
kids.d_en: Corner protectors are placed on or around boxes and containers to help prevent dents or damage during handling, shipping, and storage. They can also be used to provide a shock barrier between inner and outer cartons.

kids.d_tr: Çember koruyucuları çember ile yük yüzeyi arasında bariyer oluşturarak sıkı çemberin yol açacağı ezikleri önler.
kids.d_en: Strapping guards, also called strap edge protectors, provide a barrier between the strapping and the load surface to avoid dents and damage from tight strapping on shipping boxes, containers, and cargo. They also assist with keeping strapping in place during transit.

kids.d_tr: Ambalaj ve sevkiyat poşetleri perakende, imalat ve gıda işleme sektörlerinde ürünleri taşır ve korur.
kids.d_en: Packing and shipping bags hold and protect items for a variety of applications in the retail, manufacturing, and food processing industries.

kids.d_tr: Açık uçlu naylon poşetler bir ucundan açılır; ısıyla, zımbayla veya bantla kapatılabilir.
kids.d_en: Open-ended poly bags open on one end to ease filling and can be closed with a heat seal, staple, twist tie, or tape for a variety of applications in the retail, manufacturing, and food processing industries.

kids.d_tr: Kilitli poşetlerin kapama mekanizması defalarca açılıp kapanır; ürünleri nem, hava ve kirden korur.
kids.d_en: Reclosable poly bags have a closing mechanism that can be opened and closed multiple times to keep items protected from moisture, air, and dirt in retail, manufacturing, and food processing industries.

kids.d_tr: Naylon boru rulolar kesilerek farklı boy ve biçimdeki ürünlere özel ambalaj oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Poly tubing can be cut to make custom-sized packaging for items of various lengths and shapes.

kids.d_tr: Büzgülü poşetlerin ipli kapaması, klips, zımba ve bant ihtiyacını ortadan kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Drawstring bags have pull-string closures to eliminate the need for twist ties, staples, and tape. They can be closed and reopened multiple times and their strings can be used to tie or hang parts to equipment, door handles, or other items.

kids.d_tr: Kasa içlikleri ve palet örtüleri sevkiyat ve depolama sırasında ürünleri kir ve döküntüden korur.
kids.d_en: Bin liners and pallet covers protect goods from dirt and debris during shipping and storage.

kids.d_tr: Big bag çuvallar ağır yükleri yırtılmadan taşımak için sağlam dokuma polipropilenden üretilir.
kids.d_en: Bulk bags are made of strong, woven polypropylene for holding heavy loads without breaking or ripping. They have straps for lifting by forklift and are collapsible for easy storage.

kids.d_tr: Perakende poşetleri market ürünlerini, paket yemekleri taşır ve yeni ya da kuru temizlenmiş giysileri korur.
kids.d_en: Retail bags hold groceries, merchandise, take-out food, and protect new or dry-cleaned clothing.

kids.d_tr: Sevkiyat etiketleri, kartelaları ve şablonları paket içeriği hakkında önemli bilgileri aktarmaya yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Shipping and handling labels, tags, and stencils help companies convey important information about the contents of containers and packages.

kids.d_tr: Sevkiyat etiketleri, taşıma sırasında paket içeriği hakkında personele önemli mesajlar iletir.
kids.d_en: Shipping and handling labels provide a variety of shipping and receiving messages to convey important information about the contents of containers and packages to personnel during transit.

kids.d_tr: Tehlikeli madde etiketleri ve levhaları, tehlikeli madde içeren sevkiyatları açıkça tanımlar ve mevzuata uyumu sağlar.
kids.d_en: Department of Transportation (DOT) and United Nations (UN) handling labels and placards clearly identify shipments containing hazardous materials and help companies comply with government and UN regulations.

kids.d_tr: Darbe ve hasar göstergeleri, gönderi içeriğinin hasar açısından incelenmesi gerektiğini alıcıya bildirir.
kids.d_en: Damage indicators alert recipients that the contents of a shipment need to be inspected for damage.

kids.d_tr: Sevkiyat kartelaları, standart yapışkanlı etiketin sığmadığı veya uygun olmadığı durumlarda ürüne bağlanır.
kids.d_en: Shipping tags tie onto products or equipment when a standard adhesive label will not fit, or is not practical.

kids.d_tr: Sevkiyat şablonları yazıcı ve etikete gerek kalmadan kap ve paketleri işaretlemek için tekrarlanabilir bir yöntem sunar.
kids.d_en: Shipping stencils provide a repeatable, manual method for creating signage or labeling shipping containers, packages, and equipment without the need for printers, labels, or placards. Stencil ink and sprays are rolled or sprayed onto stencils to create signage and messages on products, containers, or packages.

kids.d_tr: Isı ile daralan ambalaj, ürünleri demetleyen ve koruyan şeffaf kalıplı bir plastik kaplama oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Heat shrink wrap provides a clear, molded plastic seal that bundles, protects, and improves the presentation of products.

kids.d_tr: Shrink film ruloları ürünleri sarmak, demetlemek ve korumak için deliksiz film uzunlukları sunar.
kids.d_en: Shrink film rolls provide nonperforated lengths of film for wrapping, bundling, protecting, and improving the presentation of products.

kids.d_tr: Shrink poşetler ürünle doldurulmaya hazırdır; ısıya maruz kaldığında koruyucu bir kalıp oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Shrink film bags are ready to be filled with products to create a protective molded seal when exposed to heat. They are made of clear, strong, puncture-resistant film.

kids.d_tr: Shrink boru filmler şeffaf, güçlü ve delinmeye dirençli plastikten üretilir; ürüne göre kesilebilir.
kids.d_en: Shrink film tubing is made of clear, strong, puncture-resistant plastic that can be cut to fit around an item. When exposed to heat, they create a protective seal for shipping and storage.

kids.d_tr: Shrink bantlar kapaklı gıda ve ilaç kaplarında müdahalenin belli olmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Shrink film bands help provide evidence of tampering on food and medication containers with lids. They mold to the cap or lid when exposed to heat.

kids.d_tr: Koli zımbaları ve telleri birlikte kullanılarak paketleri sevkiyat için sabitler.
kids.d_en: Box staplers and staples are used together to secure packages for shipping.

kids.d_tr: Koli zımbaları ambalaja zımba teli uygulayarak taşıma sırasında hava koşullarına dayanan sağlam bir kapatma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Box staplers apply staples to packaging for a durable closure that withstands weather, temperature, and humidity during transit. They secure the sides, base, and top by inserting the staple through the box flaps, curling back underneath the flap to pinch closed.

kids.d_tr: Koli zımba telleri, zımbalarla birlikte paketleri sevkiyat veya depolama için kapatır.
kids.d_en: Box staples are used with staplers to seal packages for shipping or storage. The correct type of staple to select depends on the stapler used, the staple brand, and the thickness of the material being stapled.

kids.d_tr: Sevkiyat aksesuar ve ekipmanları yüksek hacimli paketleme işlemlerini destekler.
kids.d_en: Shipping accessories and equipment support high-volume packing operations.

kids.d_tr: Poşet dispenserleri poşetleri bir arada tutar ve dağıtımı kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Bag dispensers keep bags together and ease dispensing.

kids.d_tr: Koli sehpaları yüksek hacimli sevkiyatta katlanmış oluklu mukavva kutuları paketleme öncesi tutar ve düzenler.
kids.d_en: Carton stands hold and organize collapsed corrugate and paperboard boxes in preparation for packing in high-volume shipping applications.

kids.d_tr: Taşıma battaniyeleri cihaz, kapı pervazı ve mobilyayı sararak taşıma sırasında ezik ve çiziklerden korur.
kids.d_en: Moving blankets wrap around appliances, doorjambs, and furniture to protect against dents, scratches, and other damage while items are in transit. Their quilted zigzag stitching keeps the cotton batting in place to ensure uniform padding and prevents the fabric from unraveling.

kids.d_tr: Palet aksesuarları paletleri korur ve taşımaya hazırlanmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Pallet accessories protect and help prepare pallets for transport.

kids.en: Poly Bag & Shrink Film Heat Sealers
kids.d_tr: Poşet ve shrink ısı yapıştırıcıları basınç ve ısı uygulayarak film kenarlarını kaynaştırır ve hava geçirmez bir kapatma oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Poly bag and shrink film heat sealers apply pressure and heat to fuse bag and film edges together to create an airtight seal.

d_tr: Boya, ekipman ve sarf malzemeleri birlikte çalışarak yüzeylere renk ve koruyucu kaplama uygular.
d_en: Paints, equipment, and supplies work together to apply color and protective coatings to surfaces and objects.

kids.d_tr: Sprey boyalar ve astarlar dekoratif ve koruyucu amaçla iç ile dış mekan yüzeylerine kolayca renk ve kaplama ekler.
kids.d_en: Spray paints and primers easily add color and coatings to indoor and outdoor surfaces for decorative and protective purposes.

kids.d_tr: Sprey astarlar, son kat boya uygulanmadan önce yüzeyi kaplayan aerosol ürünlerdir.
kids.d_en: Spray primers are aerosols that cover surfaces prior to topcoat paint application. They dry faster than brush-on primers because they have thinner coats. Primers protect substrates from rust, repair rusted materials, or cover dark shades of prior paint coats.

kids.d_tr: Çizgi boyaları ve ekipmanları beton, asfalt, çim ve çakıl gibi dış yüzeylere işaretleme yapar.
kids.d_en: Striping paints, marking paints, and striping equipment add markings to outdoor surfaces such as concrete, pavement, grass, or gravel.

kids.d_tr: Çizgi boyaları beton, asfalt, çim ve çakıl gibi dış yüzeylere işaretleme eklemek için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Striping and marking paints are used to add markings to outdoor surfaces such as concrete, pavement, grass, or gravel. Striping and marking paints range from temporary (lasting three to four weeks) to permanent. They are commonly used by utility workers, municipalities, and paint contractors to create bold, crisp lines and markings on parking lots, factory and warehouse floors, sporting facilities, athletic fields, and construction and excavation sites.

kids.d_tr: Termoplastik yol markalamaları yol, otopark ve kaplı yüzeylerde şerit, sembol ve sınırları belirgin biçimde işaretler.
kids.d_en: Thermoplastic pavement marking paints are used to clearly mark traffic lanes, legends, symbols, and road boundaries on roads, parking lots, and other paved surfaces. They are thicker and more wear resistant than other types of marking paints. These paints are heated and applied to paved surfaces to increase visibility and provide long-term wear.

kids.d_tr: Çizgi çekme makineleri asfalt, fabrika zemini ve spor sahalarına boya ile çizgi uygular.
kids.d_en: Line stripers apply lines of paint on pavement, factory floors, and athletic fields.

kids.d_tr: Boyalar ve kaplamalar yüzeyleri korur, renklendirir ve görünümünü tazeler.
kids.d_en: Paints and coatings protect, color, and refresh the look of surfaces or objects.

kids.d_tr: Çatı ve su yalıtım kaplamaları binaya ısı geçişini azaltarak, ısıl şoku düşürerek ve sızıntıyı azaltarak çatı ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Roof and leak coatings extend the life of a roof, by reducing heat transfer into the building, decreasing thermal shock (thermal expansion and contraction of the roof membrane), and helping to mitigate leaks.

kids.d_tr: Zemin kaplamaları yüzeyleri korur, estetik bir görünüm sağlar ve günlük trafiğe maruz zeminlerin ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Floor coatings protect surfaces, provide aesthetic treatments, and extend the life of surfaces that must withstand daily traffic.

kids.d_tr: Özel amaçlı boya ve kaplamalar; iklimlendirme, deniz ve tesisat gibi uygulamalarda ya da korozyon ve aşırı sıcaklık gibi özel koşullarda yüzeyleri korur.
kids.d_en: Specialized paints and coatings protect surfaces in specific applications such as HVAC, marine, and plumbing, or for unique conditions such as to inhibit corrosion, withstand extreme temperatures, cover lead paint, or repel liquids to prevent ice formation.

kids.d_tr: Çok amaçlı kaplamalar neme, küfe, pasa ve korozyona karşı koruma sağlar.
kids.d_en: Multipurpose coatings protect against moisture, mold, rust, and corrosion. They are durable and often thicker than standard paint. Most coatings are formulated to work on both interior and exterior surfaces while others are specifically rated for one or the other. These non-aerosol products come in standard, premixed colors for commercial and industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: İç ve dış cephe boyaları duvar, tavan, mobilya ve ahşap işleri kaplayarak renk katar ve yüzeye temiz bir görünüm verir.
kids.d_en: Interior and exterior paints cover walls, ceilings, furniture, and woodwork to add color and provide a clean, refreshed look to surfaces. Most paints are formulated to work on both interior and exterior surfaces while others are specifically rated for one or the other. These non-aerosol products come in standard, premixed colors for commercial, industrial, and residential applications.

kids.d_tr: Ahşap vernikleri ve emprenyeler şeffaf ya da yarı şeffaftır; yüzeye koruyucu bir katman ekleyerek ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Stains and sealers are transparent or semitransparent products that add a protective layer on surfaces to extend their life and reduce frequent maintenance or premature replacement of materials. Stains shield materials against extended exposure to sunlight which can cause materials to crack and fade. They also repel water and offer differing levels of transparency with or without pigment to provide tinted color to the material. Sealers prevent moisture from absorbing into materials which can cause rotting, cracking, and shrinking. Stains and sealers are used on outdoor decks, foundations, walkways, and structures.

kids.d_tr: Otomotiv boya ve kaplamaları; otomobil, kamyon, tarım ekipmanı ve endüstriyel parçaların yüzeyini koruyan bir katman ekler.
kids.d_en: Automotive paints and coatings add a layer that protects and enhances the surfaces of automobiles, trucks, farming equipment, and industrial parts.

kids.d_tr: Tinerler boyanın akışkanlığını ayarlar, tabancayla kullanıma hazırlar ve boyama sonrası fırça ile yüzeyleri temizler.
kids.d_en: Paint thinners reduce the viscosity of paint to prepare it for use with sprayers, to clean brushes and surfaces after painting, or to thin out paint that has become too thick.

kids.d_tr: Boya sökücüler boya, vernik ve kaplamaları çıkarırken alttaki yüzeyi de temizleyen kimyasal ürünlerdir.
kids.d_en: Paint strippers, or paint removers, are chemical products designed to remove paint, finishes, and coatings while also cleaning the underlying surface. Paint removers are used to get rid of unwanted paint markings from walls, floors, and other surfaces. Paint thinning and paint removal products are commonly used by maintenance and janitorial crews and professional painters.

kids.d_tr: Tinerler boyanın akışkanlığını düşürerek tabancayla kullanıma hazırlar ve boyama sonrası fırça ile yüzeyleri temizler.
kids.d_en: Paint thinners reduce the viscosity of paint to prepare it for use with a sprayer, to clean brushes and surfaces after a paint job, or to thin out paint that has become too thick.

kids.d_tr: Fırça ve rulo temizleyicileri, aplikatörlerden boyayı çıkaran solvent gibi kimyasalları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Paint applicator cleaners include chemicals like solvents to remove paint from applicators and accessories. Manual brush spinners help remove excess water or solvent to ensure brushes are ready for re-use. Squeegees press out excess paint to reduce waste.

kids.d_tr: Mastik ve yapıştırıcı sökücüler su bazlı ve biyolojik olarak parçalanabilir formüllerdir; beton, seramik ve ahşaptan yapıştırıcıyı hızla çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Mastic and adhesive removers are water-based biodegradable formulas designed for quickly removing latex, acrylic, and pressure sensitive adhesives from concrete, terrazzo, ceramic and vinyl tile, or wood substrate.

kids.d_tr: Sıvı duvar kağıdı sökücüler, eski yapıştırıcıyı çözmek üzere tasarlanmış ıslatıcı maddeler içerir.
kids.d_en: Liquid wallpaper removers contain wetting agents designed to dissolve the old adhesive. Before using liquid remover, water-resistant wallpaper should be scored or perforated so the remover will be able to contact the adhesive between the paper and the wall.

kids.d_tr: Boya öncesi hazırlık ve restorasyon ürünleri; vernik, emprenye ve boya uygulanmadan önce yüzeyleri işler ve temizler.
kids.d_en: Paint preparation and restoration products treat and clean surfaces prior to staining, sealing, and painting.

kids.d_tr: Yüzey hazırlık temizleyicileri kir, yağ ve gresi çıkararak boyanın yüzeye düzgün tutunmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Preparation cleaning products remove dirt, oil, grease, and other debris from surfaces to ensure paints and coatings bond properly to the surface with a smooth finish.

kids.d_tr: Restorasyon kaplamaları yüzeyleri yeniler; yangın, su baskını, nem ve duman kaynaklı koku, leke ve küfü kapatır.
kids.d_en: Restoration coatings revive surfaces and block the resulting odors, stains, and mold from damaging events such as fire and flood or from long exposure to conditions such as moisture and smoke.

kids.d_tr: Boya ekipmanları hazırlıktan temizliğe kadar endüstriyel, ticari ve konut boyama projelerini destekler.
kids.d_en: Painting equipment supports a wide range of industrial, commercial, and residential painting projects from preparation activities to cleanup.

kids.d_tr: Fırçalar, rulolar ve aplikatörler çeşitli yüzeyleri kaplar veya boyar.
kids.d_en: Paint and coating applicators cover or coat a variety of surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Boya tavaları ve kovaları uygulama için büyük miktarda boyayı taşır.
kids.d_en: Paint trays and buckets hold large quantities of paint for application.

kids.d_tr: Yüzey koruma ve toz bariyeri ürünleri; inşaat, boyama ve tadilat sırasında halı ile sert zeminleri hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Surface protection and dust barrier products help safeguard carpets and hard surfaces from damage during construction, painting, and renovation.

kids.d_tr: Boya tabancaları ve sistemleri, fırça ile ruloya göre daha hızlı ve verimli biçimde düzgün ve eşit kat uygular.
kids.d_en: Paint spray guns and systems apply smooth, even coats of paint and coating to surfaces faster and more efficiently than using brushes and rollers.

kids.d_tr: Boya kabinleri; otomobil parçası, endüstriyel ekipman ve mobilyanın basınçlı boyayla kaplanması için kontrollü bir ortam sunar.
kids.d_en: Paint spray booths provide a controlled environment for spraying pressurized paint on automobile and boat parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and other products that require a smooth finish.

kids.d_tr: Boya karıştırıcıları ve çubukları boya ile kaplamaları karıştırarak özel renk elde eder veya uygulama öncesi homojen hale getirir.
kids.d_en: Paint shakers and stir sticks mix paints, coatings, and similar liquids to create custom colors or to ensure material is properly blended prior to applying.

kids.d_tr: Bu aparatlar boya kutusu kapaklarını açıp kapatır, hazırlık sürecini kolaylaştırır ve uygulamayı hızlandırır.
kids.d_en: These tools open and close paint can or pail lids, ease the paint setup process, and speed application. Lid tools help open paint can lids neatly and efficiently without spilling or splattering paint. Can hooks attach to ladders to speed painting at high elevations. Pour-and-store paint lids allow paint to flow through a notched spout in the top but then press closed to reseal the paint cans or pails for future use.  Magnetic clips attach to any size metal paint can for easier holding.

kids.d_tr: Duvar kağıdı aparatları kağıdın yapışmasına ve yerinde durmasına yardımcı olur, sökme işlemini hızlandırır.
kids.d_en: Wallpaper applicators and tools help paper adhere, hold paper in place, and speed removal.

d_tr: Boru, hortum ve tesisat elemanları; hava, su, yakıt ve kimyasal gibi maddeleri bir yerden diğerine taşır.
d_en: Pipe, hose, and tubing move materials such as air, water, gasoline, and chemicals from one place to another. Pipe is rigid, hose is flexible, and tubing can be either rigid or flexible.

kids.d_tr: Borular ve bağlantıları; onarım, yeni yapı ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda hava, su ve kimyasal gibi akışkanları aktarır.
kids.d_en: Pipe and pipe fittings help transfer media such as air, water, gasoline, and chemicals from one place to another in repairs, new construction, and in residential, commercial, or industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Standart borular ve fittingsler; onarım, yeni yapı ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda akışkanları bir yerden diğerine aktarır.
kids.d_en: Standard pipe and pipe fittings help transfer media such as air, water, gasoline, and chemicals from one place to another in repairs, new construction, and in residential, commercial, or industrial applications.

kids.d_tr: Boru bağlantı contaları birleştirilen iki boru arasında durarak boşluğu doldurur, kaçağı önler ve sürtünmeyi azaltır.
kids.d_en: Pipe fitting gaskets sit between two joined sections of pipe to fill gaps, prevent leaks, and reduce friction.

kids.d_tr: Tank geçiş rakorları boru, vana ve muslukları tanka bağlayarak dolum ve boşaltma için giriş ile çıkış oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Bulkhead fittings connect pipes, valves, and spigots to tanks to form an inlet or outlet for fluids to flow freely for draining and filling. These fittings are also used to distribute fluids through piping systems in industrial and agricultural applications.

kids.d_tr: Döner mafsallar ve rakorlar sabit bir boruyu dönen bir bileşene bağlayarak akışkan, hava veya buharın kesintisiz akmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Rotating joints and unions, also referred to as swivel unions, connect a stationary pipe to a rotating component to allow uninterrupted flow of fluid, air, or steam. They are used in applications with rotating equipment such as a leader hose attached to a hose reel.

kids.d_tr: Boru kompansatörleri boru bölümlerini bağlayan esnek elemanlardır; genleşme ve büzülmeyi emerek hizasızlığı önler.
kids.d_en: Pipe expansion joints are flexible unions that connect sections of pipe in a system to absorb expansion and contraction and prevent misalignment caused by temperature changes, movement, vibration, start-ups, or surges from attached pumps and machinery.

kids.d_tr: Cıvatalı boru kaplinleri kaynak veya özel fitting gerekmeden dişsiz boru uçlarını birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Bolted pipe couplings join plain, unthreaded pipe ends without the need for welding or for special pipe fittings, in general plumbing applications and industrial systems.

kids.d_tr: Boru flanş kapakları kullanılmayan flanşları toz, nem ve hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: Pipe flange covers protect flange fittings from dust, moisture, and damage when the flange is not in use.

kids.d_tr: Boru bağlantı sıçrama siperleri flanşlı bağlantıları örterek conta arızasında zararlı akışkanın personele sıçramasını önler.
kids.d_en: Pipe fitting spray shields cover flanged joints in a system to protect personnel from the spray of harmful fluids if the seal on a joint fails. Sometimes referred to as a flange guard, they are used in applications such as petrochemical and wastwater treament plants.

kids.d_tr: Nipel düzenleyicileri nipelleri açık bir tepsideki ölçülü yuvalara yerleştirerek hızlı erişim sağlar.
kids.d_en: Pipe nipple caddies organize and secure nipples into sized slots in an open tray for quick access. They feature a handle for easy storage and transport.

kids.d_tr: Püskürtme nozullu boru bağlantıları endüstriyel boru sistemlerine takılarak farklı desen ve debilerde sıvı püskürtür.
kids.d_en: Spray nozzle pipe fittings attach to industrial piping systems to produce liquid spray in a variety of spray patterns and flow rates.

kids.d_tr: Hortumlar; hava, su, yakıt ve kimyasal gibi maddeleri bir yerden diğerine taşır.
kids.d_en: Hoses move materials such as air, water, gasoline, and chemicals from one place to another.

kids.d_tr: Hortumlar sulama, pnömatik ekipman besleme, duman tahliyesi ve sıvı aktarımı gibi işlerde maddeleri bir yerden diğerine taşır.
kids.d_en: Hoses are used to move materials such as air, water, gasoline, and chemicals from one place to another for tasks such as watering plants, powering pneumatic equipment, venting fumes, vacuuming dust, transferring liquids and bulk materials to storage containers, and pumping water.

kids.d_tr: Hortum rakorları ve kaplinleri hava, su ve kimyasal taşımak için özel hortum grupları oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Hose fittings and couplings create custom hose assemblies for carrying air, water, and chemicals through a pipe system.

kids.d_tr: Hortum makaraları, askıları ve rafları hortuma sürekli erişim sağlayan, kaçağı ve takılma kazalarını azaltan yönetim sistemleridir.
kids.d_en: Hose reels, hangers, and racks are hose management systems that provide continuous access to hose, minimize leakages, and reduce tripping accidents.

kids.d_tr: Hortum koruma ürünleri hidrolik ve pnömatik hortumların hasar görmesini önlemeye yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Hose protection products help prevent damage to hydraulic and pneumatic hoses.

kids.d_tr: Hortum emniyet bağları, yüksek basınçlı bağlantı arızasında hortumun savrulmasından doğan yaralanma ve hasarı önler.
kids.d_en: Hose safety restraints prevent injury to personnel, damage to equipment, and excess spillage from hose whipping and thrashing caused by failures in high-pressure hose couplings.

kids.d_tr: Esnek hortum sistemleri hava ve soğutucuyu kesici takım ile iş parçasına taşır; takımı serin tutar ve talaşı uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Flexible hose systems move air and coolant to cutting tools and workpieces to keep tools cool and move swarf away from the cutting edge and workpiece.

kids.d_tr: Tüp ve bağlantı elemanları, akışkan ve hava iletim sistemlerinde sızdırmaz bağlantılar sağlar.
kids.d_en: Tube and tube fittings ensure leaktight connections in fluid and air delivery systems.

kids.d_tr: Tüp ve borular hava, su, gaz ve kimyasalı taşırken belirli bir basınca göre sınıflandırılır.
kids.d_en: Tubing is rated for pressure when transferring air, water, gas, and chemicals from one place to another.

kids.d_tr: Tüp rakorları çeşitli plastik ve metal boruları birbirine bağlar.
kids.d_en: Tube fittings connect a variety of plastic and metal tubing and piping.

kids.d_tr: Hortum ve tüp kelepçeleri akışkan ile hava iletim sistemlerindeki bağlantıları sıkarak kaçağı önler.
kids.d_en: Tube and hose fitting clamps secure tube and hose connections in fluid and air transport systems to ensure a tight fit and prevent leaks.

kids.d_tr: Sonsuz vidalı kelepçeler hortum ve tüp bağlantılarını sıkarak akışkan ile hava kaçağını önler.
kids.d_en: Worm gear clamps, also called worm drive clamps, secure tube and hose connections to ensure a tight fit and prevent fluid and air from leaking. They’re called worm gear clamps because of the housed, helical-threaded screw that engages with the slots in the band and tightens the band as the screw turns.
