Worm gear clamps are non-permanent and remove in the same way they are installed, easing maintenance. They are used in a variety of automotive and industrial applications to secure hose and tube connections.

kids.d_tr: Cıvatalı kelepçeler iç çap boyunca eşit basınç uygulayarak titreşime dayanır.
kids.d_en: Bolt-close clamps provide uniform pressure around the inside diameter of the clamp to withstand vibration. These non-permanent clamps are installed and tightened with a threaded bolt. They are often used on fuel injection hoses in automotive applications.

kids.en: Crimp-On Ear Clamps for Tube & Hose
kids.d_tr: Kulaklı sıkma kelepçeleri hortum ve tüp bağlantılarını kalıcı olarak sabitleyerek kaçağı önler.
kids.d_en: Crimp-on ear clamps permanently secure tube and hose connections to prevent fluid and air from leaking. Their name comes from the ear-shaped protrusions on the clamp that must be crimped with a tool, such as pincer pliers, to install the clamp. The crimped ear provides visible confirmation that the clamp is closed and reduces the risk of tampering.

kids.en: Buckle-On Band Clamps for Tube & Hose
kids.d_tr: Tokalı bant kelepçeler yüksek sıkma kuvveti ve düzgün bir iç yüzeyle kalıcı bir sızdırmazlık sağlar.
kids.d_en: Buckle-on clamps provide a permanent seal with a high clamping force and a smooth inside diameter. A clamping tool is needed to lock the clamp and trim off the excess band material. These clamps withstand high vibration environments and are often used on tubes and hoses in fluid discharge and suction applications.

kids.d_tr: Geçmeli kelepçelerde, kelepçe kapanırken birbirine kenetlenen dişler bulunur.
kids.d_en: Snap-on clamps have interlocking teeth that engage as the clamp is closed. These nylon clamps are reusable and install easily with pliers. They are suitable for clamping tubes and hoses in automotive assemblies, medical equipment, and kitchen appliances.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı kelepçeler hortum ve tüpteki sıcaklık değişimlerine göre genleşip büzülür.
kids.d_en: Spring-tension clamps expand and contract in response to temperature changes in tube and hose. The use of spring pressure ensures that the clamp is not under or overtightened on the hose. These clamps require pliers to install or remove.

kids.d_tr: Isıyla daralan kelepçeler sıcak hava tabancasıyla uygulanır; hortumun biçimini alarak sıkı ve sızdırmaz bir bağ kurar.
kids.d_en: Heat-shrink clamps install with a heat gun to conform to the shape of the tube or hose assembly to maintain a secure fit and prevent leaks. They are maintenance-free because they do not require retightening.

kids.tr: Boru Güzergah Kelepçeleri, Destekleri ve Askıları
kids.en: Tube & Pipe Routing Clamps, Supports & Hangers
kids.d_tr: Boru güzergah kelepçeleri, destekleri ve askıları tesisat, yangın ve iklimlendirme uygulamalarında boru hatlarını taşır ve yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Tube and pipe routing clamps, supports, and hangers hold, route, and suspend lines of tube or pipe in general plumbing, fire-sprinkler, and HVAC applications.

kids.d_tr: Bu kelepçeler düz bir yüzeye monte edilerek tesisat, soğutma ve iklimlendirme uygulamalarında boru hatlarını taşır.
kids.d_en: These tube and pipe clamps mount to a flat surface to hold and route runs of tube or pipe in general plumbing, refrigeration, irrigation, and HVAC applications.

kids.d_tr: Yüzeye montaj boru destekleri boru hatlarına ek denge ve terazileme sağlar; yüzeyle teması engeller.
kids.d_en: Surface-mount tube and pipe supports provide additional stability and leveling for tube and pipe runs and prevent surface contact.

kids.d_tr: Askılı boru taşıyıcıları tesisat, soğutma ve mekanik uygulamalarda boru hatlarını yönlendirir ve asar.
kids.d_en: Tube and pipe hangers route and suspend runs of tube or pipe in plumbing, refrigeration, and mechanical applications.

kids.d_tr: Yalıtım, ceketleme ve kaplamalar boruyu ısı kaybına karşı yalıtır; darbe ve zorlu koşullardan korur.
kids.d_en: Insulation, jacketing, and coatings insulate tubing and pipe against thermal loss and protect from impact and exposure to harsh conditions.

kids.d_tr: Ekipman ve boru yalıtımı ısı kaybını veya kazancını azaltır, donmayı önler ve yoğuşmayı denetler.
kids.d_en: Equipment, tube, and pipe insulation reduces heat loss or gain, prevents freezing, and controls condensation.

kids.d_tr: Yalıtım koruma ceketleri boru ve bağlantı yalıtımının çevresine geçerek koruyucu bir bariyer oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Insulation shielding jackets fit around pipe and pipe fitting insulation to create a protective barrier. Jacketing is needed in outdoor or harsh environments to help protect the insulation and the underlying pipe in industries such as chemical processing plants, refineries, power plants, and paper mills.

kids.d_tr: Yalıtım bandı yalıtımı boru çevresinde sabitler, düzensiz biçimleri kapatır ve dikişleri birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Insulation tape secures insulation around pipe or tubing, seals irregular shapes, closes insulation seams, and attaches jacketing to the insulation.

kids.d_tr: Boru tıkama tapaları boru sisteminin içinde veya ucunda akışı keserek basınç testi ve bakıma imkan verir.
kids.d_en: Tube and pipe blocking plugs provide a seal inside or at the end of pipe systems to block flow and allow for pressure testing, maintenance, or prevent unwanted material from entering the pipe.

kids.d_tr: Mekanik tıkama tapaları borunun içinde veya ucunda akışı keserek basınç testi ve bakıma imkan verir.
kids.d_en: Mechanical blocking plugs provide a seal inside or at the end of a pipe to block flow and allow for pressure testing, maintenance, or to prevent unwanted material from entering the pipeline. A manual closure mechanism squeezes two plates together to compress and expand a rubber seal that presses against the internal walls of the pipe. They are primarily used in drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems.

kids.d_tr: By-pass'lı mekanik tıkama tapaları akışı keserken basınç testi ve bakım için bir geçiş hattı sunar.
kids.d_en: Mechanical blocking plugs with a bypass provide a seal inside or at the end of a pipe to block flow and allow for pressure testing, maintenance, or to prevent unwanted material from entering the pipeline. The bypass is a removable cap that allows flow around the plug and helps release and clean out material that may have accumulated inside the pipe. These blocking plugs have a manual closure mechanism that squeezes two plates together to compress and expand a seal that presses against the internal walls of the pipe. They are primarily used in drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems.

kids.d_tr: Şişirilebilir tıkama balonları, boru hattına yerleştirilip akışkanla doldurularak geçici bir tıkaç oluşturan kauçuk balonlardır.
kids.d_en: Inflatable blocking plugs have a rubber bladder that inserts into a pipeline and fills with fluid to provide a temporary plug. They fit into out-of-round pipes that have lost their shape due to wear or damage. Blocking plugs are primarily used in drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems for maintenance and pressure testing of water systems.

kids.d_tr: By-pass'lı tıkama balonları boru hattına yerleştirilip doldurularak akışı kesen geçici bir tıkaç oluşturur.
kids.d_en: These inflatable blocking plugs with a bypass have a rubber bladder that inserts into a pipeline and fills with fluid to provide a temporary plug to block flow. The bypass is a removable cap that allows flow around the plug and helps release and clean out material that may have accumulated inside the pipe. They fit out-of-round pipes that have lost their shape due to wear or damage. They are primarily used in drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems, and underground sewer lines for maintenance and testing of water systems.

kids.d_tr: Bu ürünler yıpranmış parçaları değiştirir veya tıkama tapalarının montaj ve kullanımını destekleyen aksesuarlar ekler.
kids.d_en: These items replace worn parts or add accessories to support the installation and operation of blocking plugs.

kids.d_tr: Boru test ekipmanları boru eklerinin sağlamlığını doğrular ve yeraltı hatlarındaki kaçakları tespit eder.
kids.d_en: Pipe testing equipment is used to ensure the effectiveness of pipe joints and identify leaks and inflow in underground pipe systems. They are used with blocking plugs to stop flow in the pipe while testing.

kids.d_tr: Tamir kelepçeleri ve setleri hasarlı boru bölümlerindeki çatlak ve delikleri kapatarak kaçağı önler.
kids.d_en: Repair clamps and kits seal cracks, holes, and punctures in damaged sections of tube or pipe to prevent leaks. They are commonly used in the water and wastewater industry to fix stationary, low pressure systems.

kids.d_tr: Boru ve hortum temizleyicileri, pnömatik bir fırlatıcıyla mermi göndererek içerideki kir ve yağı temizler.
kids.d_en: Pipe, hose, and tube cleaners and accessories utilize a pneumatic launcher to shoot projectiles through hose or tubing which removes internal dirt, oil, and contaminants. These systems provide a quick, efficient way to clean contaminated lines and tubing for applications in hydraulics, pneumatics, HVAC, automotive, and chemical processing.

kids.d_tr: Boru manifoldları ana akışkan, hava veya gaz hattını birden fazla kola dağıtır.
kids.d_en: Tube and pipe manifolds redistribute a main line of fluid, air, or gas into multiple branch lines. They are often used in plumbing systems to distribute the main water line to other fixtures.

d_tr: Tesisat malzemeleri; banyo armatürü, batarya, gider, boru ve bağlantı elemanlarıyla tesisat sistemlerini kurar ve bakımını yapar.
d_en: Plumbing supplies such as bathroom fixtures, faucets, drains, pipe, fittings, and plumbing hardware are used to build and maintain plumbing systems.

kids.d_tr: Bataryalar lavaboya giden su akışını denetler; musluk gövdesi ve montaj donanımını içerir.
kids.d_en: Faucets control water flow to sinks and include spouts and hardware for installation.

kids.d_tr: Banyo bataryaları farklı tasarım ve montaj biçimlerinde sunulur; el yıkama ve kişisel bakım için akan su sağlar.
kids.d_en: Bathroom faucets come in different styles and mounting configurations and provide running water for handwashing and grooming tasks.

kids.d_tr: Mutfak bataryaları evler, restoranlar, barlar ve dinlenme alanları gibi gıdanın hazırlandığı yerlere takılır.
kids.d_en: Kitchen faucets install in areas where food is handled or prepared, including home kitchens, restaurants, bars, and break rooms.

kids.d_tr: Genel amaçlı musluklar alet, büyük parça ve ekipmanın temizlenmesi için su sağlar.
kids.d_en: Utility sink faucets provide water for cleaning tools, large parts, and equipment. These faucets are suitable for new utility sink installations or replacing existing faucets in utility areas like mop and laundry rooms and commercial and industrial facilities.

kids.d_tr: Batarya yedek parçaları mevcut bataryalardaki bileşenlerin değiştirilmesi için gereken ürünleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Faucet replacement parts include components to replace parts on existing faucets.

kids.d_tr: Dış mekan muslukları ve hidrantları açık alanda akan suya erişim sağlar.
kids.d_en: Outdoor hose bibbs and hydrants provide access to running water outdoors.

kids.d_tr: Lavabolar, yıkama üniteleri ve yedek parçaları suya erişim olan her yerde temizlik ve hijyeni destekler.
kids.d_en: Sinks, wash fountains, and repair parts promote cleanliness and hygiene wherever there is access to water. Bathroom sinks are used for handwashing and grooming tasks in restrooms.

kids.d_tr: Banyo lavaboları ticari ve konut uygulamalarında mevcut alanı en iyi kullanacak farklı montaj biçimlerinde sunulur.
kids.d_en: Bathroom sinks for commercial or residential applications come in different mounting styles to best use the available space and provide an aesthetic look.

kids.d_tr: Mutfak ve bar evyeleri ticari gıda servisi ve hazırlığı, yemekhane, restoran ve barlarda kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Kitchen and bar sinks are used for commercial food service and preparation, hospital and school cafeterias, and restaurants and bars.

kids.d_tr: Çamaşır ve genel amaçlı evyelerin derin haznesi ovma, temizleme ve durulama için ekstra alan sunar.
kids.d_en: Utility and laundry sinks, also known as service sinks, have deep basins that allow extra space for scrubbing, cleaning, and rinsing.

kids.d_tr: Temizlik evyeleri temizlik odalarında zemine yakın monte edilir; mop durulama ve kova boşaltmayı zorlanmadan yapmayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Mop sinks mount on or near the floor in janitorial closets or maintenance rooms for personnel to rinse mops and dump bucket contents with minimal lifting or strain. These sinks accommodate a variety of cleaning supplies and janitorial tools. Mop sink bowls have higher sides to contain water splashes inside the sink; mop sinks with drop fronts have a shorter or notched side for easy pouring. Corner mop sinks install in corners to maximize space.

kids.d_tr: Hastane, laboratuvar ve sınıf lavaboları; hastane, klinik, diş kliniği ve okul gibi eğitim ile sağlık tesislerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Hospital, lab, and classroom sinks are used in education, healthcare, and lab facilities such as hospitals, clinics, dental facilities, and schools.

kids.d_tr: El yıkama üniteleri ve istasyonları, elleri ve ürünleri yıkamak için kullanılan sabit ve seyyar üniteleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Hand wash fountains, sinks, and stations include mobile and stationary units used to rinse and clean hands and wash food or other items.

kids.en: Sink, Wash Fountain & Wash Station Parts
kids.d_tr: Lavabo ve yıkama ünitesi parçaları, mevcut ünitelerin onarımı ve işlevinin iyileştirilmesi için gereken bileşenleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Sink, wash fountain, and wash station parts include components needed to repair, replace, or enhance the functionality of existing sinks and wash stations.

kids.d_tr: Küvetler, duşlar ve yedek parçaları farklı yapılandırmalarda sunulur; mevcut tesisat ve gider konumlarına göre tasarlanır.
kids.d_en: Bathtubs, showers, and repair parts come in different configurations and are designed based on the existing locations of plumbing connections and drains.

kids.d_tr: Küvetler ticari, konut ve kurumsal banyolarda yıkanma amacıyla kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Bathtubs are used for bathing and soaking in commercial, residential, and institutional restrooms.

kids.d_tr: Duşlar ticari, konut ve kurumsal banyolarda su püskürtmek üzere farklı yapılandırma ve tasarımlarda sunulur.
kids.d_en: Showers come in different configurations and designs to spray water in commercial, residential, and institutional bathrooms and shower rooms.

kids.d_tr: Küvet ve duş yedek parçaları yıpranmış, kaybolmuş veya hasarlı parçaların onarımı ile değişimi için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Bathtub and shower repair parts are used to repair or replace worn, lost, or damaged parts.

kids.d_tr: Klozetler, pisuarlar ve yedek parçaları atığı uzaklaştırarak binada hijyenik koşulların korunmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Toilets, urinals, and repair parts remove waste to help maintain sanitary conditions within a building. Toilet fixtures (such as tankless toilets, gravity-tank toilets, and pressure-assist toilets) are units that connect to water lines for flushing and filling the bowl.

kids.d_tr: Rezervuar vanaları ve dönüşüm setleri, rezervuarsız klozet ve pisuarların sifonunun çalışmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Flush valves and retrofit kits enable the flushing of tankless toilets and urinals.

kids.d_tr: Klozetlerin geniş haznesi atığı toplar; sifonla kanalizasyona veya septik tanka gönderilir.
kids.d_en: Toilets feature a large bowl for collecting waste, which can then be flushed or deposited into a sewer or septic tank.

kids.d_tr: Pisuarların geniş haznesi idrarı toplayarak atık hattına yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Urinals have a large basin for collecting urine and directing it into a waste line. These industrial and commercial urinals are used in public and institutional restrooms.

kids.d_tr: Klozet kapakları hazneye cıvatalanır; menteşeleri sayesinde temizlik ve tam erişim için kaldırılıp indirilir.
kids.d_en: Toilet seats bolt onto toilet bowls and raise and lower on their hinges for cleaning and full access to the bowl. These oval or circular seats should match the bowl shape to keep the seat stable, direct waste into the bowl, and help ensure user comfort.

kids.d_tr: Klozet yedek parça ve aksesuarları kırık parçaları değiştiren bileşenleri, montaj donanımını ve tamir aparatlarını kapsar.
kids.d_en: Toilet repair parts and accessories include components for replacing broken parts, mounting hardware, add-ons for specialized uses, and repair tools.

kids.d_tr: Pisuar yedek parça ve aksesuarları; kırık parça değişimi, montaj ve susuz pisuar bakımı için gereken ürünleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Urinal repair parts and accessories include components for replacing broken parts, hardware and fittings for installation, and products for cleaning and maintaining standard and waterless urinals.

kids.tr: Su Sebilleri, Şişe Dolum ve Dağıtım Üniteleri
kids.en: Drinking Fountains, Bottle Fillers & Water Dispensers
kids.d_tr: Su sebilleri ve şişe dolum üniteleri, çalışma alanları ile kamusal tesislerde içme suyu sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drinking fountains, bottle fillers, and water dispensers provide drinking water in work areas and public facilities.

kids.d_tr: Çeşmeler içilebilir su sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drinking fountains provide potable drinking water.

kids.d_tr: Ayaklı su sebilleri soğuk, sıcak veya oda sıcaklığında taze içme suyu verir.
kids.d_en: Freestanding water dispensers deliver fresh cold, hot, or room temperature drinking water.

kids.d_tr: Harici su soğutucuları, soğutmasız çeşme ve sebilleri soğuk su verecek hale getirir.
kids.d_en: Remote water chillers convert non-refrigerated drinking fountains, bottle fillers, and water dispensers into chilled drinking water. These fully enclosed units are indoor rated, available in multiple sizes, and installed remotely under sinks, counters, or inside walls.

kids.d_tr: Su filtrasyon ve arıtma sistemleri suyu temizleyerek içme, cihaz kullanımı ve gıda üretimi için güvenli hale getirir.
kids.d_en: Water filtration and purification systems clean and purify water to make it safe for drinking, appliances, food and beverage processing, and manufacturing.

kids.tr: Genel Amaçlı Su Filtre Kartuşları ve Gövdeleri
kids.en: General Purpose Water Filter Cartridges & Housings
kids.d_tr: Genel amaçlı su filtre kartuşları ve gövdeleri konut, ticari ve hafif endüstriyel ortamlarda yaygın olarak kullanılır.
kids.d_en: General purpose water filter cartridges and housings are commonly used in residential, commercial, and light industrial settings.

kids.d_tr: Cihaz tipi su filtre sistemleri kirlilikleri giderir, su kalitesini artırır ve cihazların ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Appliance water filter systems remove contaminants, improve water quality, and help extend the life of appliances.

kids.d_tr: Merkezi su filtre sistemleri binanın su beslemesinin ana giriş noktasına takılır.
kids.d_en: Whole-house water filtration systems install at the main entry point of a building's water supply.

kids.d_tr: Ters ozmoz sistemleri ön filtre ve yarı geçirgen membranlarla çok kademeli bir süreçte suyu arıtır.
kids.d_en: Reverse osmosis (RO) water filtration systems use a multistage process including prefilters and semi-permeable membranes to filter water for drinking and appliances. They are often used in various applications, from filtering household drinking water to large-scale industrial water treatment applications.

kids.en: Water Filter Bags & Water Filter Bag Housings
kids.d_tr: Torba filtreler ve gövdeleri sudaki kirlilikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: Water filter bags and water filter bag housings remove contaminants from water.

kids.d_tr: Ultraviyole su dezenfeksiyon sistemleri, suyu kimyasal kullanmadan arıtan basit, etkili ve çevre dostu bir yöntemdir.
kids.d_en: Ultraviolet water disinfection systems are a simple, effective, and environmentally safe method for treating water without chemicals. UV light destroys harmful bacteria and viruses by attacking their genetic core, eliminating their ability to reproduce. Ultraviolet disinfecting requires reverse osmosis or other filtration systems to remove contaminants for drinking water purposes. These energy-efficient systems are commonly used for both point of use and point of entry. Ultraviolet water disinfecting systems are used in commercial and industrial water filtration and purification.

kids.d_tr: Su pislik tutucuları su hatlarına takılarak partikül, kir ve döküntünün hatta girmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Water strainers install onto water lines and prevent particles, dirt, and debris from entering and contaminating them. Y-strainers are shaped like the letter "Y" and install directly onto lines to prevent solids, pipe scale, rust, and debris from mixing into liquid, gas, or steam in a flowline. Inline strainers install onto lines before valves, pumps, and nozzles to catch debris and protect sensitive equipment.

kids.tr: Su Filtresi Montaj Donanımı ve Yedek Parçaları
kids.en: Mounting Hardware, Repair Parts & Tools for Water Filter Systems
kids.d_tr: Montaj donanımı, yedek parça ve aparatlar su filtre sistemlerinin kurulumu, sökümü ve bakımı için gereken bileşenlerdir.
kids.d_en: Mounting hardware, repair parts, and tools are components needed to install, remove, and maintain water filter systems.

kids.d_tr: Su yumuşatıcılar sert suyun mineral içeriğini azaltarak cihaz ve armatürlerin zarar görmesini önler, kötü tat ve kokuyu giderir.
kids.d_en: Water softeners, sometimes called ion exchange units, reduce the mineral content of hard water to prevent damage to appliances and fixtures and eliminate bad tastes or odors.

kids.d_tr: Su yumuşatma sistemleri iyon değişimiyle mineral içeriğini azaltarak sert suyu yumuşak suya dönüştürür.
kids.d_en: Water softeners use an ion exchange process to convert hard water into soft water by reducing mineral content. Hard water inhibits the effectiveness of laundry detergents, soaps, and shampoos and can cause bathtub rings and spots on glassware. Water softeners come in commercial and residential grades.

kids.d_tr: Su ısıtıcılar konut, ticari ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda soğuk suyu elektrikle veya doğalgaz ile ısıtır.
kids.d_en: Water heaters heat cold water from the water source or water supplied through a building's water system for domestic, commercial, and industrial applications with electricity or fuel gases such as propane or natural gas.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli ani su ısıtıcılar gerektiğinde sıcak su üreterek bekleme kaynaklı enerji kaybını azaltır.
kids.d_en: Electric tankless water heaters produce a supply of hot water as needed, reducing standby energy loss. These electric-powered heaters, also called instantaneous or on-demand, don't require venting. Tankless water heaters have a compact footprint that’s ideal for areas with limited space.

kids.d_tr: Gazlı termosifonlar yakıt gazı yakarak suyu ısıtır ve iç tankta depolar.
kids.d_en: Gas tank water heaters burn fuel gases to heat and store water in an internal tank. The gas burner heats and recovers stored water for a responsive system. These heaters are well-suited for periods of high hot water demand, with periods of low demand for the stored water to recover.

kids.d_tr: Gazlı şofbenler su depolamadan anında sıcak su üretir ve bekleme kaynaklı enerji kaybını azaltır.
kids.d_en: Gas tankless water heaters provide hot water on demand without storing water in a tank, helping reduce standby energy loss. These gas-powered heaters, also called instantaneous or on-demand, use natural gas or propane to heat the water. Tankless water heaters have a smaller footprint, are well-suited for areas with limited space, and can be installed indoors or outdoors.

kids.d_tr: Isı pompalı su ısıtıcılar ortam havasından ısı çekerek yalıtımlı tanktaki suya aktarır.
kids.d_en: Heat pump water heaters use heat pump technology to extract heat from the surrounding air and transfer it to water stored in an insulated tank. These electric water heaters help reduce energy use compared to standard electric water heaters.

kids.d_tr: Sıcak su depolama tankları su ısıtıcılarla birlikte çalışarak yüksek talepli uygulamalarda büyük miktarda sıcak suyu hazır tutar.
kids.d_en: Water heater storage tanks work in tandem with water heaters to store large amounts of hot water ready for use in high-demand and commercial applications. Storage tanks retain heat through insulation and can also help reduce standby heat loss.

kids.tr: Su Isıtıcı Yedek Parça ve Aksesuarları
kids.en: Replacement Parts & Accessories for Water Heaters
kids.d_tr: Su ısıtıcı yedek parça ve aksesuarları kurulum, bakım ve onarıma yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Replacement parts and accessories for water heaters aid in their installation, maintenance, and repair.

kids.d_tr: Tuvalet kabinleri ve donanımları, ortak tuvaletlerde klozet ve pisuarları mahremiyet için tam ya da kısmi kapatır.
kids.d_en: Bathroom partition and partition hardware install in public or commercial restrooms with appropriate hardware to fully or partially enclose toilets and urinals for privacy.

kids.d_tr: Tuvalet kabinleri klozetleri kapatır ve pisuarları mahremiyet için birbirinden ayırır.
kids.d_en: Bathroom partitions enclose toilets and separate urinals for privacy. Stalls are constructed from individual components, including panels that form the sides, pilasters that support the paneling, and doors that allow entry and exit. Bathroom partitions are commonly used in commercial, industrial, and office building bathrooms.

kids.en: Hardware & Replacement Parts for Bathroom Partitions
kids.d_tr: Kabin donanımı ve yedek parçaları genellikle kol, menteşe, askı, stoper, kilit ve ayak gibi bileşenleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Hardware and replacement parts for bathroom partitions typically include handles, pulls, door hinges, hooks, stops, headrails, latches, partition shoes, and other components used to install and equip bathroom partitions. This hardware is often used for connecting partition components, providing pulls for opening and closing doors, and adding door latches to lock stalls.

kids.d_tr: Banyo aksesuarları kullanılabilirliği artıran ve tuvaletin görünümünü iyileştiren işlevsel parçaları kapsar.
kids.d_en: Bathroom fixtures include functional parts and components that enhance usability and improve restroom appearance.

kids.d_tr: Tutunma barları yaşlı ve hareket kısıtlılığı olan kişilerin dengeyi korumak için tutunabileceği sabit bir nokta sunar.
kids.d_en: Bathroom grab bars provide a fixed point for older adults  or individuals with mobility issues to hold onto for balance while lowering and lifting themselves or entering and exiting showers. These bars can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or diagonally on walls near or in showers, bathrooms, and other locations where slips and falls are likely to occur. They come in various lengths and styles and give individuals the confidence to bathe or shower independently in accessible bathrooms or showers.

kids.d_tr: Banyo aynaları kişisel bakım işleri için yansıtıcı bir yüzey sağlar.
kids.d_en: Bathroom mirrors provide a reflective surface for grooming and other personal-care tasks. They are typically mounted to walls above sinks in hotels, public bathrooms, or other facilities.

kids.d_tr: Bebek bakım üniteleri ve örtüleri; bebek ve engelli bireylerin bakımı için güvenli ve erişilebilir bir alan sunar.
kids.d_en: Changing stations and liners provide a safe and accessible space for parents and caregivers to change, clean, and assist infants, toddlers, and individuals with disabilities. These stations can be recessed-mounted, flush-mounted, or mounted to bathroom walls with elevated, antimicrobial surfaces that fold out easily. Plastic or paper baby changing liners cover the station for a hygienic and sterile surface.

kids.d_tr: Banyo askıları havlu, giysi ve kişisel eşyaları asmak için duvar, kapı veya dolaba monte edilir.
kids.d_en: Bathroom hooks mount to walls, doors, or cabinets for hanging towels, clothing, or other personal items. They're available with single, dual, or multiple hooks and come in distinctive decorative shapes and styles.

kids.d_tr: Banyo rafları ve havluluklar kişisel eşyaları taşır, saklar ve düzenler.
kids.d_en: Bathroom shelves and towel bars hold, store, and organize personal belongings. They are often mounted in bathrooms, keeping items close at hand and out of the way on the wall or above the floor. Towel bars are often mounted by sinks or in showers, allowing towels to dry between uses

kids.d_tr: Duş perdeleri, barları ve halkaları duşun çevresine asılarak mahremiyet sağlar ve suyu içeride tutar.
kids.d_en: Shower curtains, rods, and rings attach to rods with rings or hooks that suspend them alongside or around showers for privacy and to keep water contained within the shower. Rods are commonly fastened to walls with mounting screws and brackets.

kids.d_tr: Duş sandalyeleri ve oturakları, denge ve hareket kısıtlılığı olan kişilere yıkanırken sabit bir oturma imkanı sunar.
kids.d_en: Shower chairs and seats offer a stable seating option for older adults or individuals with balance, mobility, or other physical limitations, allowing them to rest comfortably while bathing or showering. These devices help individuals lower and lift themselves out of the shower safely and independently, reducing the risk of slips and falls. Shower chairs and seats are often used in residential areas, hospitals, nursing homes, or other care facilities.

kids.tr: Duş Sepetleri, Sabunluklar ve Çamaşır İpleri
kids.en: Shower Baskets, Soap Dishes & Retractable Clotheslines
kids.d_tr: Duş sepetleri ve sabunluklar kişisel eşyaları ve sabunu taşır.
kids.d_en: Shower baskets and soap dishes hold personal belongings and soap. Retractable clotheslines extend to hang clothes on for indoor or outdoor drying. They withdraw and wind up easily to save storage space.

kids.d_tr: Giderler binadaki su ve sıvıları tesisat sistemine yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Drains channel water and liquids from buildings into plumbing systems.

kids.d_tr: Oluk ve iniş borusu aksesuarları suyu toplayıp binadan uzaklaştırarak nem hasarını önler.
kids.d_en: Gutter and downspout accessories aid in collecting and redirecting water away from houses and buildings to prevent moisture damage.

kids.d_tr: Lavabo süzgeçleri banyo ve mutfaklarda suyu gidere yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Sink drains channel water down drains in lavatories and kitchens.

kids.d_tr: Küvet ve duş teknesi giderleri, konut ile ticari küvet ve duşlardan akan suyu tahliye eder.
kids.d_en: Bathtub and shower pan drains install in residential or commercial tubs and showers to remove flowing water from basins. They're used for new installations or to replace worn or damaged drains.

kids.d_tr: Yer süzgeçleri atık suyun drenaj sistemine akmasını sağlayarak tıkanma ve su baskınını önler.
kids.d_en: Floor drains help prevent clogs and flooding by allowing wastewater to flow into drainage systems.

kids.d_tr: Zemin yıkama haznelerinin geniş çanağı ticari mutfaklarda bulaşık makinesi ve fritöz gibi ekipmandan gelen atığı toplar.
kids.d_en: Floor sinks have a large basin that collects waste from dishwashers, fryers, and other equipment in commercial kitchens, restaurants, and food preparation areas.

kids.d_tr: Kanal süzgeçleri uzun ve dar drenaj sistemleridir; sıvıları toplayıp gidere yönlendirerek su birikmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Trench drains are long, narrow drainage systems that collect liquids and channel them to a drain, effectively eliminating standing water or chemical spills.

kids.d_tr: Çatı süzgeçleri yağmur suyunu hızla tahliye ederek bağlı boru ve toplama haznelerini döküntüden korur.
kids.d_en: Roof drains remove rainwater quickly to protect connected piping and drain sumps from debris.

kids.d_tr: Temizleme kapakları tesisatta belirli noktalara takılır; tıkalı boruların açılması ve genel temizlik için erişim sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drain cleanouts and cleanout covers are installed at specific points in a plumbing system for access to drain lines to clear clogged pipes and for general cleaning and inspection. They have covers for easy access and maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Gider havalandırma vanaları sisteme hava girmesini sağlayarak basıncı dengeler ve sifon suyunun boşalmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Drain air vents and valves allow air to enter drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems to regulate and equalize pressure, preventing water used to seal out sewer gases and odors from draining out of traps.

kids.d_tr: Yağ tutucular ve seyreltme tankları tüy, gres ve katı tortunun gider hatlarına girip hasar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Drain interceptors and dilution tanks prevent lint, grease, and other solid sediments from entering drain lines and damaging them. Also called drain separators, they prevent clogs, standing water, and overflows. Dilution tanks neutralize corrosive liquids so they can be safely discharged into sewers without contaminating downstream systems or the environment.

kids.d_tr: Tesisat vanaları sistemlerde su, gaz ve diğer akışkanların akışını denetler.
kids.d_en: Plumbing valves control the flow of water, gas, and other fluids in plumbing systems.

kids.d_tr: Kesme vanaları bakım, cihaz montajı veya basınç tahliyesi için sistemdeki akışı başlatır ve durdurur.
kids.d_en: Shut-off valves start and stop the flow of compatible media within a system for maintenance, instrument installation, or to relieve system pressure.

kids.d_tr: Geri akış önleyiciler akışkanın sistemde tek yönde hareket etmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Backflow prevention valves ensure fluids move in one direction through a system.

kids.d_tr: Kısma vanaları sistemdeki akış debisini başlatır, durdurur ve düzenler.
kids.d_en: Throttling valves start, stop, and regulate media flow rate within a system.

kids.d_tr: Basınç ve sıcaklık kontrol vanaları endüstriyel ve ticari ekipmanda sıcaklık ile basınç seviyelerini düzenler.
kids.d_en: Pressure and temperature control valves regulate the temperature and pressure levels of industrial and commercial equipment.

kids.d_tr: Selenoid vanalar manyetik alanla açılıp kapanan elektrikle çalışan elemanlardır; sıvı ve hava akışını başlatır ya da durdurur.
kids.d_en: Solenoid valves are electrically operated devices that use a magnetic field to open and close the valve, which starts or stops the flow of liquids or air.

kids.d_tr: Havalı pistonlu vanalar; su, yağ, inert gaz ve buhar akışını havalı bir pistonla başlatır veya durdurur.
kids.d_en: Air-operated piston valves use an air-operated piston to start or stop the flow of water, oil, inert gas, light slurries, and steam.

kids.tr: Vana Tamir Setleri ve Yedek Parçaları

kids.d_tr: Vana ve sayaç kutuları pompa, vana ve geri akış ekipmanını aşırı hava koşulları ile zorlu zemin şartlarından korur.
kids.d_en: Valve and meter boxes protect pumps, valves, and other backflow protection equipment from extreme weather and harsh soil conditions.

kids.d_tr: Vana aktüatörleri ve aksesuarları uyumlu vanalarla çalışarak onları otomatik olarak açar, kapatır veya belirli konumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Valve actuators and accessories pair with compatible valves to automatically open, close, or position valves at specific points.

kids.d_tr: Hortum istasyonları, hortumlar ve başlıklar tesislerde temizlik ve dezenfeksiyon için karıştırmalı istasyonlar oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Hose stations, hoses, and nozzles create mixing unit stations used to clean and sanitize in facilities.

kids.d_tr: Kurumsal tesisat armatürleri ruh sağlığı tesisleri ile ceza ve tutukevlerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Institutional plumbing fixtures are used in behavioral and mental health facilities and correctional and detention centers.

kids.en: Flush Valves & Valve Covers for Institutional Toilets & Urinals
Water Management System for Institutional Combination Units

kids.d_tr: Kurumsal banyo aksesuarları genellikle tutunma barı, askı, raf, sabunluk ve benzeri özel ürünleri kapsar.
kids.d_en: Institutional bathroom fixtures typically include grab bars, hooks, shelves, soap dishes, and other specialized accessories used in bathrooms. They are designed for behavioral and mental health facilities, correctional institutions, hospitals, and other patient-care areas where users may be at risk of self-harm.

kids.d_tr: Kurumsal giderler atık suyu tesisata yönlendirir, tıkanmayı önler ve zeminleri temiz tutar.
kids.d_en: Institutional drains channel wastewater into plumbing systems, help prevent clogs, and keep floors clean and free from dirt, debris, and other waste. They are for behavioral and mental health facilities, correctional institutions, hospitals, and other patient-care areas where inmates or patients may be at risk of harming themselves.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Institutional Plumbing Fixtures

kids.d_tr: Tesisat uzaktan izleme modülleri armatür ve tesisat sistemlerinin uzaktan takip edilmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Plumbing supplies such as bathroom fixtures, faucets, drains, pipe, fittings, and plumbing hardware are used to build and maintain plumbing systems.

kids.d_tr: Besleme vanası çıkış kutuları, gömme duvar montajı gereken yerlerde cihazlara su ve gaz bağlantısı sunar.
kids.d_en: Supply valve outlet boxes provide water and gas connections to appliances and machines where a recessed wall installation is required.

kids.d_tr: Tesisat yedek parçaları klozet, lavabo ve diğer armatürlerin onarım ve bakımında kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Plumbing replacement parts are used to repair and maintain toilets, sinks, and other plumbing fixtures.

d_tr: Pnömatik ekipmanlar basınçlı havayla çalışır.
d_en: Pneumatic equipment is powered by compressed air.

kids.d_tr: Havalı aletler basınçlı havayla çalışır; keskileme, delme, çakma, perçinleme ve zımparalama gibi işlerde hafif gövdede yüksek güç sunar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic tools (also known as air tools) run on compressed air, providing high power in a lightweight, balanced form for chiseling, cutting, drilling, hammering, punching, nailing, riveting, sanding, sawing, and other tasks.

kids.tr: Hava Tabancaları ve Vakumlu Kazı Aparatları
kids.en: Air Guns, Vacuum Guns & Air Excavation Tools
kids.d_tr: Hava tabancaları ve vakumlu kazı aparatları; üfleme, temizleme, soğutma ve emiş uygulamaları için basınçlı hava akımı üretir.
kids.d_en: Air guns, vacuum guns, and air excavation tools produce a pressurized airstream for blow-off, cleaning, cooling, conveying, and suctioning applications.

kids.d_tr: Hortum ve alet dengeleyiciler aletleri tezgahın üstünde askıda tutar; ağırlığını taşıyarak yorgunluğu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Air hose tool balancers suspend tools above work surfaces, keeping the tools within reach to maintain productivity and supporting their weight to decrease user fatigue. Also known as hose reel balancers, they tether tools to prevent damage from drops, lessen workspace clutter, and avoid loss. They ease positioning of tools, producing more accurate work and reducing the risk of repetitive-motion injuries. Using tools that weigh close to the upper limit of the balancer's capacity provides optimal support and puts the least strain on the operator. Air hose tool balancers are commonly used to hold pneumatic tools for assembly, fabrication, manufacturing, and packaging and shipping operations.

kids.tr: Havalı Zımpara ve Yüzey İşleme Aletleri
kids.d_tr: Havalı zımpara ve yüzey işleme aletleri aşındırıcılarla malzeme kaldırır, kaplama öncesi yüzeyi hazırlar veya son yüzeyi oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Air-powered sanding and finishing tools (also known as pneumatic sanders) use abrasives to remove material, refine surfaces before coating, or create a final finish.

kids.d_tr: Havalı gravür aletleri; alet ve ekipmanı sahiplik ile stok takibi için işaretlemek üzere yüzeylere harf, rakam ve desen kazır.
kids.d_en: Air-powered engravers carve letters, numbers, and designs into surfaces to mark tools, equipment, and materials for ownership and inventory control. Also known as pneumatic gravers and pencil engravers, these engraving pens move their bit like a small chisel to inscribe tool surfaces without damaging the tool. They operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and require minimal maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Havalı eğeler küçük bir eğeyi ileri geri titreştirerek dar alanlardaki fazla malzemeyi kaldırır.
kids.d_en: Air-powered files vibrate a small file back and forth to remove excess material from small areas and in tight spaces. Also known as pneumatic reciprocating filers, they work more quickly and produce more uniform results than hand sanding. They operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and require minimal maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Havalı beton vibratörleri yeni dökülmüş betondaki hava boşluklarını gidererek betonun tam dayanımına ulaşmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered concrete vibrators remove air pockets from newly poured concrete to ensure that it consolidates and reaches its maximum finished strength. They prevent honeycombing (bug holes) and properly pack the aggregate to increase density and reduce rework and surface patching. Also known as immersion vibrators, their rod-shaped head inserts into wet concrete and pulsates to force air bubbles up and out at the surface. They emit a radius of vibration that is four times the head width to vibrate concrete in sections.

kids.d_tr: Havalı taşlama ve kesme makineleri aşındırıcı diskleri döndürerek malzeme kaldırır ve yüzeyi kaplamaya hazırlar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered grinders and cut-off tools (also known as pneumatic grinders and cut-off tools) rotate abrasive wheels or other attachments to remove material and prepare surfaces for coating.

kids.d_tr: Havalı frezeler kesici uçları döndürerek ahşap iş parçasında kenar profili, kanal ve geçme açar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered routers spin cutting bits that remove material from wood workpieces to profile edges, create grooves and slots, cut joints, and trace shapes. Typical applications include forming decorative edges, mortising hinges and locksets, trimming laminate, and cutting openings for windows and doors. These pneumatic routers operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and require minimal maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Havalı matkaplar ve vidalama makineleri delme ve sıkma işlerinde değiştirilebilir uçları döndürür.
kids.d_en: Air-powered drills and drivers (also known as pneumatic drills and drivers) rotate interchangeable bits in holemaking and fastening applications.

kids.tr: Havalı Yüzey Kazıyıcılar ve Kesici Takımları
kids.d_tr: Havalı yüzey kazıyıcılar kesici takımlarıyla beton ve metalden kalın epoksi, pas ve boyayı sökerek yeniden kaplamaya hazırlar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered scarifiers use cutter bundles to remove thick epoxies, cement overlays, rust, paint, and other coatings from concrete and metal, leaving rough, grooved surfaces for recoating. Multi-tooth cutting wheels (flails) on the cutter bundles rotate at high speeds, chipping away material more aggressively than grinders and with greater control than abrasive blasting. These pneumatic scarifiers operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight and balanced to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and are easier to repair than corded units.

kids.d_tr: Havalı çekiçler keski ve zımbaları yüzeye vurarak sert malzeme kaldırma ve yıkım işlerini yapar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered hammers strike chisels and punches against surfaces for aggressive material removal and demolition work.

kids.d_tr: Havalı makaslar ve nibbler'lar sacda düz veya kavisli kesimler yapar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered shears and nibblers make straight or curved cuts in sheet metal.

kids.tr: Havalı Çivi, Zımba ve Perçin Tabancaları
kids.en: Air-Powered Nail Guns, Staple Guns & Riveting Tools
kids.d_tr: Havalı çivi, zımba ve perçin tabancaları hava basıncıyla bağlantı elemanı çakarak malzemeleri kesintisiz biçimde birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Air-powered nail guns, staple guns, and riveting tools use air pressure to fire fasteners for joining two or more pieces of material, without requiring a reset or rewind between shots.

kids.d_tr: Havalı somun sıkma ve cırcırlar değiştirilebilir lokmalarla somun ve cıvataları döndürür.
kids.d_en: Air-powered wrenches and ratchets use interchangeable sockets to turn nuts and bolts.

kids.d_tr: Havalı kazıcılar, kırıcılar ve kompaktörler inşaat ile yıkım işlerinde darbe kuvveti sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered diggers, breakers, and sand rammers provide impact force for construction and demolition tasks.

kids.d_tr: Havalı testereler testere bıçaklarıyla ahşap, metal ve plastik keser.
kids.d_en: Air-powered saws use power saw blades to cut wood, metal, plastic, and other materials.

kids.d_tr: Tork kolları kılavuz çekme, kalıpçı taşlama ve montaj aletlerinin konumlandırılmasına yardımcı olarak hassas ve tekrarlanabilir sonuç verir.
kids.d_en: Torque arms assist with positioning tapping tools, die grinders, and assembly tools to improve control and produce precise, repeatable results.

kids.d_tr: Havalı alet aksesuarları pnömatik aletleri korur ve bakımını destekleyerek ömürlerini uzatır.
kids.d_en: Air tool accessories include items that enhance, protect, and maintain pneumatic tools, helping keep them in good condition and extend their life.

kids.d_tr: Havalı alet yağları pnömatik aletleri yağlayarak sorunsuz çalışmalarını sağlar ve korozyona karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Air tool oils lubricate air-powered tools to keep them operating smoothly and protect against corrosion. They are applied through a tool's intake valve before use as recommended by the tool manufacturer.

kids.d_tr: İğneli pas sökücüler hafif darbeli hareketle yüzeye vurarak kaplama, pas ve kalıntıyı havalı çekiçten daha az kuvvetle giderir.
kids.d_en: Needle and chisel scalers create light percussive action, striking surfaces with less force than air hammers to remove coatings, rust, dirt, and residues.

kids.d_tr: Havalı alet yedek parçaları ekipmanın hizmet ömrünü uzatır ve üretimde duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Air tool replacement parts extend the service life of equipment and minimize downtime in production environments.

kids.d_tr: Havalı boru kesme setleri montaj için boruyu ölçüsüne keser veya onarımda hasarlı bölümü çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Air-powered pipe cutting kits slice through pipe to cut a length for installation or remove damaged sections when making repairs. Also known as air belly saws, they make clean cuts and leave smooth edges that require minimal deburring. These pneumatic pipe cutters operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are balanced to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and can be repaired.

kids.d_tr: Havalı daire testereler inşaat, imalat ve bakım işlerinde farklı malzemelerde düz, boy ve gönyeli kesim yapar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered circular saws make cross, rip, and beveled cuts through various materials in construction, fabrication, and maintenance applications. These pneumatic circular saws operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight and balanced to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and are easier to repair than corded and cordless circular saws.

kids.d_tr: Havalı manyetik matkaplar, sabit ya da tezgaha taşınamayacak kadar büyük metal parçalarda delik açar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered magnetic drills (mag drills) make holes in metal materials that are fixed in place or too large to bring to a stationary drill press. Their magnetic base adheres to ferrous metal surfaces, keeping the drill stable during drilling. These pneumatic magnetic drills operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight and balanced to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and are easier to repair than corded and cordless drill presses.

kids.d_tr: Havalı beton yüzey kazıyıcılar pistonlarını beton yüzeye vurarak yüzeyi pürüzlendirir ve kaplamanın tutunmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Air-powered scabblers strike their pistons against concrete surfaces to roughen and level them, so they bond securely with and support overlays and coatings. Their rapid, high-impact hammering action is more aggressive for heavier material removal than scarifiers. These pneumatic scabblers operate on compressed air and contain few moving parts, so they are lightweight and balanced to ease handling, run cool for a long lifespan, and can be repaired.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik toz emiciler beton ve taş kesme, delme ve taşlama sırasında oluşan silis tozunu çeker.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic dust extractors draw in silica dust generated during cutting, drilling, grinding, and surfacing concrete, masonry, and rock. They reduce airborne dust to minimize respiratory hazards and prevent accumulation on floors, surfaces, and tools.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik hortum ve kablo makaraları hortumu düzenli saklar ve kolay erişilebilir tutar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic hose and cable reels keep hose neatly stored yet readily available.

kids.en: Hose and Hose Reel Replacement Parts
kids.d_tr: Hortum ve makara yedek parçaları ekipmanın hizmet ömrünü uzatır ve üretimde duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Hose and hose reel replacement parts extend the service life of equipment and minimize downtime in production environments.

kids.d_tr: Kompresörler, vakum pompaları ve blowerlar havayı hareket ettirmek için basınç ve vakum üretir.
kids.d_en: Air compressors, vacuum pumps, and blowers generate pressure and vacuum to move air.

kids.d_tr: Kompresörler basınçlı hava üreterek havalı alet ve ekipmanı çalıştıracak hazır bir güç kaynağı sunar.
kids.d_en: Air compressors generate pressurized air that provides a readily available power source to connect to and operate air-powered tools and equipment.

kids.d_tr: Vakum pompaları filtrasyon ve paketleme gibi hava veya malzeme çekme işlemleri için sisteme bağlanır.
kids.d_en: Vacuum pumps connect to systems for air or material removal such as filtration or packaging.

kids.d_tr: Kombine kompresör ve vakum pompaları aynı ünitede hem hava basıncı hem vakum üretir.
kids.d_en: Combination air compressor and vacuum pumps generate air pressure or vacuum in the same unit.

kids.d_tr: Blowerlar kompresör ve vakum pompalarına göre daha düşük basınçta yüksek hacimde hava hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Blowers move high volumes of air at lower pressure or vacuum levels than air compressors or vacuum pumps.

kids.d_tr: Basınçlı hava şartlandırma, kompresörden gelen havanın kalitesini iyileştiren süreçtir.
kids.d_en: Compressed air treatment, also referred to as air preparation, is the process of improving the quality of air that is supplied by the air compressor.

kids.d_tr: Basınçlı hava filtreleri besleme hattına takılarak havadaki su, kir, yağ ve diğer kirlilikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: Compressed air filters install into the supply lines of compressed air systems to remove water, dirt, oil, and other contaminants from the air.

kids.d_tr: Basınçlı hava regülatörleri kompresörden gelen hava beslemesindeki basıncı denetler.
kids.d_en: Compressed air regulators control the pressure in the air supply that is delivered by an air compressor.

kids.d_tr: Filtreli regülatörler filtre ve regülatör işlevini tek bir cihazda birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Compressed air filter/regulators combine the function of a filter and a regulator in a single device. Also referred to as "piggybacks," these units save space on a compressed air supply line by improving the quality of the compressed air while regulating the pressure. These air filter/regulators are typically installed on a branch line extending off the main air supply line, or at the point of use. FRL modules are interchangeable within the same brand and series and provide flexibility in customizing the system based on the needs of the application.

kids.d_tr: Hava yağlayıcıları havalı alet ve ekipmana yağ vererek performansı artırır ve aşınmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Compressed air lubricators deliver oil to air tools and equipment to improve performance and reduce wear.

kids.d_tr: Şartlandırıcı üniteler filtre, regülatör ve yağlayıcıyı içeren modüler bir sistemdir.
kids.d_en: FRLs are a modular system that includes a filter, a regulator, and a lubricator. FRLs treat the compressed air before it is delivered to downstream equipment, or the point of use. Filters remove water, dirt, oil, and other contaminants from compressed air. Regulators control the pressure in the air supply that is delivered by the air compressor. Lubricators are placed downstream from other air treatment devices and deliver oil to tools and equipment to improve performance and reduce wear.

kids.d_tr: Hava kurutucuları basınçlı havadaki su buharını gidererek hattaki bileşenleri nem hasarından korur.
kids.d_en: Dryers remove water vapor from compressed air to protect downstream components from damage caused by traces of moisture in the air supply.

kids.d_tr: Hava son soğutucuları kompresöre veya hemen çıkışına takılarak sıcak basınçlı havayı soğutur.
kids.d_en: Aftercoolers install on the air compressor, or immediately downstream, to cool the hot compressed air. As hot air enters the aftercooler, it travels through a coil system. Fan-powered aftercoolers cool the air with a motor-driven fan that blows air on the coils. Belt-guard-mounted aftercoolers attach to the compressor's v-belt guard where the air from the pulley system forces air over the aftercooler's coils.

kids.d_tr: Hava separatörleri basınçlı havadaki su ile yağı ayırır veya toplanan yoğuşmada yağı sudan ayırır.
kids.d_en: Compressed air separators remove water and oil from the compressed air, or they separate oil from water in the collected condensation.

kids.d_tr: Hava hattı kilitleme vanaları kullanılmayan veya bakımdaki kollara giden hava basıncının kesilmesini sağlar.
kids.d_en: Compressed air line lockout valves allow operators to turn off air pressure to branch lines that are not being used or that are undergoing maintenance. Lockout valves for tube fittings mount to air cylinders and stop air flow when there's a loss of pressure.

kids.d_tr: Hava debi sensörleri pnömatik sistemlerde hava kullanımını ölçüp izleyerek enerji verimini artırır ve duruşu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Compressed air flow rate sensors measure and monitor the utilization of air in pneumatic systems to optimize energy efficiency and minimize downtime. They detect leaks and help diagnose issues with flow and pressure in systems.

kids.d_tr: Bu aksesuarlar şartlandırıcı üniteleriyle çalışır; yedek hazne, braket ve kapak gibi ürünlerle montaj ve kullanımı destekler.
kids.d_en: These accessories work with filters, regulators, and lubricators and include items such as replacement bowls, mounting brackets, and covers to support their installation and operation. Accessory parts should match the manufacturer of the filter, regulator, or lubricator unit.

kids.d_tr: Yedek parçalar bakım ve onarım gerektiren hava şartlandırma ekipmanına hizmet eder.
kids.d_en: Replacement parts service compressed air treatment equipment in need of maintenance and repair.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik aktüatörler basınçlı havayı mekanik harekete çevirir.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic actuators convert compressed air into mechanical motion.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik silindirler basınçlı havayı doğrusal mekanik harekete çevirir.
kids.d_en: Air cylinders convert compressed air into linear mechanical motion.

kids.d_tr: Döner aktüatörler silindir stroğundan gelen basınçlı havayı salınımlı dönme hareketine çevirir.
kids.d_en: Rotary actuators convert compressed air from a cylinder stroke into oscillating rotary motion. Also referred to as rotaries, they provide accurate and repeatable oscillating strokes between two positions when used in automated systems for industrial and manufacturing applications.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik kızak tablaları küçük parça elleçleme ve paketleme makinelerinde bileşenleri hassas biçimde konumlandırır.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic slide tables position components for precision applications in small parts handling and packaging machines. Also called rail thruster slides, these pneumatic automation modules provide repeatable, accurate positioning for industrial systems.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik tutucular otomatik sistem ve robotlara üretim uygulamalarında parça alma, konumlandırma ve bırakma işlerinde yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic grippers assist automated systems or industrial robots in picking up, positioning, holding, and releasing components in manufacturing applications. They have pneumatically-actuated jaws or fingers that open and close to securely grip parts and products. Pneumatic grippers are commonly used in aerospace, automotive, and packaging industries.

kids.d_tr: Tutucu çeneleri ve taslakları uyumlu pnömatik tutuculara monte edilerek parçaların alınmasını ve konumlandırılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic gripper jaws and jaw blanks mount to compatible pneumatic grippers which assist automated systems or industrial robots in picking up, positioning, holding, and releasing components in manufacturing, automotive, and packaging applications.

kids.d_tr: Robot kol ucu takım sistemleri; üretim, montaj ve paketlemede parça alma, konumlandırma ve bırakma için robotlarla kullanılır.
kids.d_en: End-of-arm tooling (EOAT) systems are used with industrial robots or cobots for picking up, positioning, holding, and releasing components in manufacturing, assembly, and packaging applications. These systems consist of an interface, robot coupler, tool coupler, and input/output cable.

kids.d_tr: Aktüatör kontrolleri aktüatöre giden havanın hacmini ve basıncını düzenleyerek performansın ince ayarını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic actuator controls regulate the volume and pressure of compressed air interacting with an actuator, enabling users to fine-tune performance for a specific application or task.

kids.d_tr: Aktüatör sensörleri ve donanımları piston konumunu izler ve diğer proses ekipmanına bildirir.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic actuator sensors and hardware monitor and communicate the piston position of an actuator with other analytic and process equipment.

kids.en: Pneumatic Actuator Shock Absorbers & Floating Joints
kids.d_tr: Amortisörler ve yüzer mafsallar uyumlu aktüatörlerle çalışarak performansı artırır ve montajı kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic actuator shock absorbers and floating joints pair with compatible actuators to improve performance and ease installation in automated systems.

kids.d_tr: Havalı motorlar basınçlı havayla çalışır; elektrikli motorun kullanılamadığı yüksek sıcaklık ve tehlikeli ortamlarda dönme kuvveti üretir.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic motors and gearmotors run on circulating compressed air and provide rotational force in high temperature or hazardous environments which prohibit the use of electric motors.

kids.d_tr: Havalı motorlar aşırı sıcaklık, ıslak ve korozif ortamlarda basınçlı havayla çalışır.
kids.d_en: Air motors operate on circulated compressed air in extreme temperature, wet, and corrosive environments. Air motors are nonsparking and provide an alternative to explosionproof electric motors.

kids.d_tr: Havalı redüktörlü motorlar entegre dişli kutusuyla giriş torkunu çıkış miline aktarır; torku artırır ve hızı düşürür.
kids.d_en: Air gearmotors use an integrated gearbox to transmit input torque from air motors to an output shaft that multiplies torque and reduces speed. They are nonsparking, provide an alternative to explosionproof motors, and operate on compressed air in extreme temperatures, wet areas, and corrosive environments.

kids.d_tr: Havalı motor aksesuarları uyumlu motorların kullanımını ve uygulama alanını genişletir.
kids.d_en: Air motor accessories enhance the use and expand the application potential of compatible air motors.

kids.d_tr: Havalı motor yedek parçaları ekipmanın hizmet ömrünü uzatır ve üretimde duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Air motor and gearmotor replacement parts extend the service life of equipment and minimize downtime in production environments.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik soğutucular ve hava bıçakları basınçlı havayı hızlı ve odaklı bir akıma çevirerek malzemeyi soğutur, temizler veya kurutur.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic coolers and air knives convert compressed air into fast moving, focused air which serves to cool, clean, or dry materials. Air knives generate a linear sheet of air to sweep across conveyed items.

kids.d_tr: Hava bıçakları önlerindeki malzemenin üzerine yüksek hızda bir hava perdesi üfler.
kids.d_en: Air knives blow a high speed sheet of air across materials in their path. They reduce high temperatures, remove excess moisture from wet surfaces, and clean debris from surfaces prepped for coating.

kids.d_tr: Halkasal hava sıyırıcılar silindirik gövdelerinin merkezine doğru yüksek hızda ve eşit dağılımlı hava üfler.
kids.d_en: Air wipes blow a high speed tunnel of evenly distributed air towards the center of their cylindrical frames. Their design allows continuous extrusions of tubing, pipe, and cable to pass through the center of the air wipe to be cooled, dried, or cleaned by pressurized air.

kids.d_tr: Hava çoğaltıcılar çok az basınçlı havayla çalışan yüksek güçlü üfleyicilerdir.
kids.d_en: Air amplifiers are high-powered blowers that operate on minimal amounts of compressed air. They take in surrounding ambient air and compress it into a targeted column of high speed air. The amplified air effectively ventilates smoke and fumes, cools hot materials, or removes excess moisture from surfaces.

kids.d_tr: Soğuk hava tabancaları, beslenen basınçlı havadan yaklaşık 28 °C daha soğuk temiz havayı sürekli üfler.
kids.d_en: Cold air guns continuously blow clean air at temperatures 50 degrees cooler than the supplied compressed air. Adjustable outlet hoses precisely position for focused heat reduction during machining, sharpening, and grinding operations.

kids.d_tr: Vorteks tüpleri basınçlı havayı hızla döndürerek arkadan sıcak, ön nozuldan ise çok soğuk hava çıkarır.
kids.d_en: Vortex tubes rapidly spin compressed air to exhaust heat from the rear and extremely cold air from the front cooling nozzle. Vortex tubes reduce temperatures to quickly cool production molds, industrial electronics, and machining operations.

kids.d_tr: Pano vorteks soğutucuları basınçlı havayı döndürerek panoya temiz ve soğuk hava verir, sıcak havayı dışarı atar.
kids.d_en: Cabinet and enclosure vortex coolers rapidly spin compressed air to exhaust heat from the rear and extremely cold air into an enclosure to provide clean, cold air to electronics.

kids.d_tr: Kaldırma yastıkları ve valfleri basınçlı havayla şişirildiğinde çok ağır yükleri güvenle kaldırır ve konumlandırır.
kids.d_en: Lifting bags and valves safely elevate and position very heavy loads when inflated with compressed air. They are suitable for use in search and rescue, heavy machinery, shipbuilding, and rail car service and maintenance applications.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik sistem bileşenleri basınçlı hava sistemlerine takılarak havalı ekipman ve aletlerin çalışmasını destekler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic system components install into compressed air systems and support the operation of air-powered equipment and tools.

kids.d_tr: Havalandırma tapaları ve susturucular, kompresör ve havalı aletlerin egzoz ile havalandırma ağızlarına vidalanır.
kids.d_en: Breather vents, mufflers, and silencers thread into the vent and exhaust ports of pneumatic equipment such as air compressors and air tools. Breather vents prevent unexpected pressure or vacuum changes in closed component chambers by allowing the exchange of air inside the chamber with the atmosphere. Mufflers and silencers reduce the noise from the release of pressurized air from pneumatic equipment, and mist eliminators prevent oil mist from being exhausted into the atmosphere. These devices also prevent large particles of dust or other contaminants from entering the equipment through the port.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik çek valfler basınçlı hava akışını tek yönle sınırlayarak geri akışı ve basınç kaybını önler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic check valves limit the flow of compressed air to one direction, preventing backflow and pressure loss.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik emniyet valfleri basınçlı hava sistemlerinde hava basıncını ve kalıntı basıncı denetler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic safety valves control air pressure and residual pressure in compressed air/pneumatic systems. These pressure-relief valves allow excess pressure to escape by opening when a threshold pressure is reached, preventing damage to equipment or possible injury to workers.

kids.d_tr: Hava sigortaları hortum hasar gördüğünde veya alet beklenmedik şekilde ayrıldığında hava akışını keser.
kids.d_en: Air fuses install in compressed air systems to shut off the air flow when a hose line is damaged or a tool is unexpectedly uncoupled. The sudden surge of downstream pressure can cause flexible hose to lash around uncontrollably, also referred to as "hose whip," which can cause damage and injury.

kids.d_tr: Kayıpsız kondens tahliye vanaları basınç kaybı olmadan sistemdeki yoğuşmayı toplar ve dışarı atar.
kids.d_en: Zero-loss condensate drains collect and evacuate condensate in a compressed air system without losing pressure. They are installed downstream from the air compressor, typically after air coolers and air dryers.

kids.d_tr: Otomatik tahliye vanaları basınçlı hava sistemlerindeki yoğuşmayı uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Automatic drain valves remove condensation from compressed air systems. These timed electric drain valves have an adjustable drain cycle.

kids.d_tr: Yumuşak kalkış valfleri sistem ilk çalıştırılırken hava basıncını kademeli artıran emniyet elemanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic soft start-up valves are safety devices that gradually increase air pressure during initial system start-ups. This controlled pressurization protects system components and helps reduce the risk of injury.

kids.d_tr: Vakum sistemi bileşenleri havayla çalışan sistemlerde iş parçalarını kaldırır, aktarır ve yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Vacuum system components lift, transfer, and manipulate workpieces in air-operated systems.

kids.d_tr: Vakum pedleri ve grupları robot kolu ve kaldırma ekipmanına takılarak otomatik sistemlerde iş parçalarını taşır.
kids.d_en: Vacuum pads and pad assemblies attach to robotic arms and other lifting equipment to move and manipulate workpieces in pneumatic automated handling systems.

kids.d_tr: Vakum yaylı tutucuları pedleri robot koluna bağlayarak ekipman ile iş parçası arasında ek boy ve darbe sönümü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Vacuum buffers connect vacuum pads to robotic arms and other lifting equipment to provide extra length, space, and shock absorption between equipment and workpieces. They accommodate workpieces of different heights in automated assembly and material handling applications.

kids.d_tr: Vakum pedi montaj braketleri ped grubunu bir çerçeveye sabitler.
kids.d_en: Vacuum pad mounting brackets secure a vacuum pad assembly to a frame.

kids.d_tr: Vakum tasarruf valfleri kullanılmayan bir pedde gereksiz vakum kaybını önler.
kids.d_en: Vacuum saving valves prevent unnecessary vacuum loss on a pad that is not being used. They reduce the need to change pad configurations when workpiece size and placement changes in automated assembly and material handling applications.

kids.d_tr: Tutucu gruplu vakum jeneratörleri, vantuz rakorlu ejektör kartuşlarından oluşur; kolay montaj ve esnek konumlandırma sunar.
kids.d_en: Vacuum generators with gripper assemblies consist of vacuum ejector cartridges with suction cup fittings that provide easy installation and flexible positioning on vacuum handling systems. Also called vacuum grippers, they are part of decentralized vacuum systems where vacuum sources are placed directly at the point of suction to improve efficiency, reduce energy use, and ease service compared to centralized systems, with one vacuum source for multiple suction points. Suction cups must be ordered separately.

kids.d_tr: Yüzey vakum tutma sistemleri robot kollarının ucuna takılarak otomatik sistemlerde ürün ve bileşenleri elleçler.
kids.d_en: Vacuum area gripping systems attach at the end of arms in robotic systems to handle products and components for automated systems.

kids.d_tr: Vakum tutucu entegrasyon setleri, kol ucu tutucularını robota bağlamak için gereken jeneratör ve bileşenleri içerir.
kids.d_en: Vacuum gripper integration kits include vacuum generators and other necessary components to connect end-of-arm vacuum grippers to robots. Also called handling sets, they are used in automated processes with low cycle and evacuation times, mobile robotics, and HRC (human-robot collaboration) processes.

kids.d_tr: Manyetik tutucularda, manyetik iş parçalarını kavrayıp bırakan kalıcı mıknatıslar bulunur.
kids.d_en: Magnetic grippers for vacuum systems have permanent magnets that grip and release magnetic workpieces. They securely hold perforated metal sheets, metal workpieces with holes, and complex laser-cut workpieces in vacuum handling systems.

kids.d_tr: Masaüstü vakum sistemleri elektrikle çalışan ünitelerdir; bağlı el aparatıyla düz yüzeyli hafif nesneleri alır ve tutar.
kids.d_en: Benchtop vacuum systems are electrically-powered units with a connected handpiece that picks up and holds lightweight objects with flat surfaces. They are used for handling, inspection, and assembly of small, delicate parts in the electronics industry.

kids.d_tr: Vakum regülatörleri belirlenen vakum seviyesini korur ve sistemdeki değişken debilere göre ayar yapar.
kids.d_en: Vacuum regulators maintain a set vacuum level and adjust for variable flow rates in the system. They install in-line with the vacuum pad assembly and are often used in systems that have a vacuum pump.

kids.d_tr: Vakum emiş filtreleri kirliliğin hava besleme sistemine girip bileşenlere zarar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Vacuum suction filters prevent contaminants from entering the air supply system and damaging components. They install directly into tubing with push-in fittings. Filter elements can be replaced without the use of tools. These vacuum suction filters install in-line with vacuum pads in automated assembly and material handling applications.

kids.d_tr: Vakum su separatörleri kullanım noktasında vakum sistemine çekilen su damlacıklarını ayırır.
kids.d_en: Vacuum water separators remove water droplets that get sucked into the vacuum system at the point of use. They are often installed in-line with vacuum pads to protect vacuum generators and pumps from damage caused by moisture.

kids.d_tr: Vakum basınç anahtarları basıncı ölçüp gösterir ve ekipman için açma-kapama anahtarlarını devreye alır.
kids.d_en: Vacuum pressure switches measure and display pressure and activate on/off switches for equipment. In material handling applications they provide suction confirmation on workpieces to ensure proper operation.

kids.d_tr: Kobot kol ucu vakum uzatmaları; takım uzatma, takım dizisi ve tezgah besleme uygulamalarında robot performansını artırır.
kids.d_en: Cobotic end-of-arm vacuum tool extensions improve and supplement robotic tooling performance in tool extension, tool array, and machine tending applications.

kids.d_tr: Kobot vakum uç işlevcileri robot kolunun ucuna takılan yapılandırılabilir cihazlardır; otomatik paletleme ve paketleme için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Cobotic vacuum system end effectors are configurable devices that install on the end of robotic arms for automated palletizing, packaging, and transfer applications with small-payload boxes. They are compatible with a broad range of robot manufacturers and models.

kids.d_tr: Kobot takım değiştiriciler ve bağlantıları robotik çalışma hücrelerinin verimini ve esnekliğini artırır.
kids.d_en: Cobotic tool changers and tool mounts improve efficiency and flexibility of robotic and cobotic work cells.

kids.tr: Kobot Montaj ve Hızlı Değişim Elemanları
kids.d_tr: Kobot montaj ve hızlı değişim elemanları küçük robotların istasyonlar arasında hassas konumlandırılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Cobotic mounting and quick-change components allow precise positioning and movement of small robots between multiple workstations.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik valfler sistemlerde hava akışını denetler ve düzenler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic valves control and regulate airflow in pneumatic systems.

kids.tr: Yön Kontrol Valf Sistemleri ve Fieldbus Modülleri
kids.en: Pneumatic Directional Control Valve Systems, Fieldbus Modules & Accessories
kids.d_tr: Yön kontrol valf sistemleri ve fieldbus modülleri, pnömatik sistemde basınçlı gaz akışını düzenler ve yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic directional control valve systems, Fieldbus modules, and accessories regulate and route the flow of compressed gas in a pneumatic system.

kids.d_tr: Hat üstü hava kontrol valfleri pnömatik hatlara entegre edilir ve o hattaki akışkan ile gaz akışını doğrudan denetler.
kids.d_en: Inline air control valves integrate into pneumatic lines and directly control fluid and gas flow through that line.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik limit valfleri emniyet valfi veya kontrol valfi olarak görev yapabilir.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic limit valves may act as safety valves or control valves. They control pressure or flow, actuating based on pressure changes caused by incoming air or fluid flow.

kids.d_tr: Akış kontrol ve iğne valfleri pnömatik sistemdeki akışı denetler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic flow control and needle valves control flow through a pneumatic system. Flow may be influenced by on/off controls or throttling, which can slow flow in increments. Ball valves are usually chosen where on/off control is required, while needle valves are ideal for throttling, offering precision control in lower-flow processes.

kids.d_tr: Mekik valfler akışkanın iki girişten biri üzerinden çıkışa geçmesine izin verirken diğerini kapalı tutar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic shuttle valves allow fluid flow to an outlet port through one of two inlets, keeping the other closed. They have a tube-like construction with an opening on each end and one in the center. An internal, free-moving ball, or shuttle, is pushed into one or other inlet by incoming fluid force, blocking flow to that inlet while allowing it to escape from the central outlet. This allows pressure from two sources with no risk of backflow.

kids.d_tr: Vakum ve basınç tahliye valfleri pnömatik sistemlere bağlanarak basınç dengesizliğinin sisteme zarar vermesini önler.
kids.d_en: Vacuum and pressure relief valves connect to compatible pneumatic systems and prevent pressure imbalances from damaging the system or causing catastrophic failures such as overpressure or high vacuum conditions.

kids.d_tr: Pilot kumandalı çek valfler pnömatik pistonun giriş ve çıkışına bağlanır; enerji kesintisi ya da basınç kaybında kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Piloted non-return valves connect to the input and output of a pneumatic piston and prevent them from shifting in case of a power outage or pressure loss.

kids.d_tr: Filtreli küresel vanalar akış kontrol vanasını entegre bir elek filtreyle birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Filtered ball valves combine a flow control ball valve with an integrated mesh filter screen. This screen is removable and can be cleaned and reinstalled to extend its service life. These valves filter out foreign objects that would clog or damage sensitive system components and close off sections of the system for maintenance and repair.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik basınç regülatörleri sisteme hat üstü takılarak sabit basınç sağlar; hava israfını ve enerji tüketimini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic pressure regulators install inline in pneumatic systems or tools to maintain constant pressure and reduce air waste and energy consumption.

kids.d_tr: Manşonlu valfler bağlı hava hattı için elle açılan hat üstü bir tahliye noktası sunar.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic sleeve valves, also called slide valves, provide a manually activated inline vent point for the connected air line. They are commonly used to quickly vent the system and prevent damage or injury due to overpressure.

kids.d_tr: Titreşim yalıtım hava yaylarının elastomer körükleri basınçlı havayla doldurulup boşaltılarak süspansiyon ve yalıtım sağlar.
kids.d_en: Vibration-isolating air springs have elastomer bellows or sleeves which are filled and emptied with compressed air or gas to provide suspension, isolation, or actuation when connected to components and machinery. They are commonly used to insulate vibration in machinery and as linear or angular actuators. Air springs serve applications in automation, conveyor systems, packaging, food and beverage, and manufacturing industries.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik ekipman parçaları ekipmanın hizmet ömrünü uzatır ve üretimde duruş süresini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic equipment parts extend the service life of equipment and minimize downtime in production environments.

d_tr: Güç aktarma ürünleri enerjiyi harekete dönüştürür.
d_en: Power transmission products convert energy into motion.

kids.d_tr: Rulmanlar bileşenlerin birlikte düzgün hareket etmesini sağlayarak destek ve hizalama verir; dönen parçaların ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Bearings extend the working life of rotating parts, such as a wheel on a shaft, by enabling components to move together smoothly while providing support and alignment.

kids.d_tr: Yuvarlanma elemanlı rulmanlar destek ve hizalama sağlayarak gürültü, titreşim ve aşınmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Rolling-element bearings help rotating parts run smoothly by providing support and alignment while reducing noise, vibration, and wear.

kids.d_tr: Kaymalı yataklar, mile geçen silindirik gövdeleriyle kayma, dönme ve salınım hareketini mümkün kılar.
kids.d_en: Plain bearings, also called journal bearings, are cylindrical-shaped components with tubular inner surfaces that fit around shafts to facilitate sliding, rotating, and oscillating movement. Dry-run plastic sleeve bearings are lightweight and suitable for fast, high-load, and low-friction operations.

kids.d_tr: Kam izleyiciler ve kılavuz makaraları, bir kam veya rayı izleyerek dönme hareketini doğrusal harekete çeviren rulman türleridir.
kids.d_en: Cam followers and track rollers are types of bearings that convert rotating motion to linear motion by making contact with and following a cam or a track.

kids.tr: Rulman Adaptörleri, Manşonlar ve Kilit Somunları

kids.d_tr: Burçlar dönen mil ile gövde arasına takılarak mili yerinde tutar ve titreşimi azaltarak göbek ile milin ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Bushings install between a rotating drive shaft and a housing to help secure the shaft in place and reduce vibration to extend the working life of hubs and shafts.

kids.d_tr: Kamasız burçların kama yuvası olmayan düzgün deliği, sıkma kuvvetini mil çevresine eşit dağıtır ve dönüş yönü değişimine izin verir.
kids.d_en: Keyless bushings have a smooth, round bore without a keyway or set screw, that evenly distributes clamping force around the shaft and allows rotation direction to change. Keyless bushings can be installed, removed, or repositioned more easily than keyed bushings.

kids.d_tr: Kaynaklı burç göbekleri levha, kasnak veya zincir dişlisine kalıcı olarak bağlanır.
kids.d_en: Weld-on bushing hubs permanently attach to plate stock, drive pulleys, or chain sprockets. They accept compatible type and series bushings and provide optimal shaft engagement for power transmission components.

kids.d_tr: Redüktörlü motorlar motorun torkunu entegre dişliler üzerinden çıkış miline aktarır; hızı düşürüp torku artırır.
