kids.d_en: Gearmotors transmit input torque from a motor to an output shaft through a series of integrated gears, decreasing speed and increasing torque.

kids.d_tr: AC redüktörlü motorlar monofaze veya trifaze şebeke ile çalışır; konveyör, lift ve robot sistemlerini sürekli çalıştırır.
kids.d_en: AC gearmotors are powered by single-phase or three-phase AC power from an electrical panel and operate conveyors, lifts, and robotics continuously.

kids.d_tr: DC redüktörlü motorlar yüksek kalkış kuvveti ve hassas değişken hız kontrolü sunar; hasta yatağı ve masa liftlerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: DC gearmotors provide high starting forces and precision variable-speed control required in applications such as mobility chairs, hospital beds, table lifts, and power seats. They require DC voltage, usually supplied by a battery, or other DC power supply. They consist of a motor, gear, and bearings in a housing.

kids.d_tr: Üniversal AC/DC redüktörlü motorlar hem akü hem şebeke beslemesiyle çalışabilme esnekliği sunar.
kids.d_en: Universal AC/DC gearmotors feature the flexibility of utilizing either battery or building power supplies. They are compact, efficient, and often found in power tools, and appliances.

kids.d_tr: Redüktörlü motor aksesuarları motorları barındırır, bağlar ve korur; çalışmalarını iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Gearmotor accessories house, mount, and connect gearmotors and gearmotor parts to protect them from damage and enhance their operations.

kids.d_tr: Redüktörlü motor yedek parçaları hasarlı veya yıpranmış bileşenleri onarır.
kids.d_en: Gearmotor replacement parts repair damaged or worn gearmotor components.

kids.d_tr: Redüktörler, tahrik sistemlerinin ideal hız ve torku korumasına yardımcı olan dişli indirgeme elemanlarıdır.
kids.d_en: Speed reducers are gear reduction devices that help drive systems maintain optimal speed and torque.

kids.d_tr: Redüktörler motor devrini düşürerek çıkış miline aktarır; hızı optimize eder ve torku artırır.
kids.d_en: Speed reducers convert motor RPM (revolutions per minute) to a lower output speed transmitted to the output shaft to optimize velocity and increase torque. These reducers boost performance, extend equipment longevity, and allow users to meet specific rotational output needs.

kids.d_tr: Montaj kaideleri redüktörler için güvenli bağlantı seçenekleri sunar.
kids.d_en: Mounting bases provide secure speed reducer mounting options.

kids.d_tr: Flanş ve kaplin setleri C yüzeyli motorlar için güvenilir bağlantı çözümleri sağlar.
kids.d_en: Flange coupling kits provide reliable coupling solutions for C-face motors.

kids.d_tr: Burçlar mil montajında esneklik sağlar.
kids.d_en: Bushings provide shaft mounting versatility. Torque arm kits increase the mounting rigidity and reliable transmission of power under heavy loads.

kids.d_tr: Redüktör yedek parçaları hasarlı veya yıpranmış bileşenleri onarır.
kids.d_en: Speed reducer replacement parts repair damaged or worn speed reducer components.

kids.d_tr: Frenler ve kavramalar konveyör, kapı ve paketleme makinesi gibi döner uygulamalarda motor hareketini ve hızını denetler.
kids.d_en: Brakes and clutches stop and control the movement or speed of motors in rotary applications such as horizontal conveyors, gates, and packing machines.

kids.d_tr: Frenler ve kavramalar, bağlı yükler durup kalkarken motorların sürekli çalışmasına imkan verir.
kids.d_en: Brakes and clutches allow motors to run continuously while starting and stopping connected loads. Brakes slow and stop motion on lathes, conveyors, and other equipment. Clutches allow a motor to disengage from a load without turning the motor off.

kids.d_tr: Tork sınırlayıcılar makineleri beklenmedik aşırı yüklenmeden kaynaklı hasara karşı korur.
kids.d_en: Torque limiters protect machinery from damage due to unexpected overload conditions. Center members are machined flat and parallel and fit over sintered iron bushings to protect the torque limiter hub during slippage. They are easy to adjust and reset automatically.

kids.d_tr: Fren ve kavrama aksesuarları bu elemanları monte eder ve verilen gücü yönetir.
kids.d_en: Brake and clutch accessories mount, control, and manage the power supplied to brakes and clutches.

kids.d_tr: Fren ve kavrama yedek parçaları hasarlı veya yıpranmış bileşenleri onarır.
kids.d_en: Brake and clutch replacement parts repair damaged or worn brake and clutch components.

kids.d_tr: Mil kaplinleri, bilezikler ve kardan mafsallar iki mili birbirine bağlar.
kids.d_en: Shaft couplings, collars, and universal joints connect two shafts.

kids.d_tr: Elastik kaplinler iki mil arasında dönme kuvveti aktarırken hafif hizasızlığa tolerans gösterir.
kids.d_en: Flexible couplings allow transmission of rotational force between two shafts with a slight tolerance for misalignment.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı mil kaplinleri tek parça tasarımlıdır; iki ucundaki sıkma bileziği ve esnek gövdesiyle milleri kalıcı olarak birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Beam shaft couplings feature a one-piece design with a set screw or clamp coupling collar at each end and a flexible beam permanently joining the two ends.

kids.d_tr: Rijit kaplinler ve mil adaptörleri esneklik veya hizasızlık gerektirmeyen uygulamalarda güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Rigid couplings and shaft adapters transmit power in applications without flexibility or misalignment.

kids.d_tr: Kardan mafsallar birbirine göre çok kaçık iki mili bağlar.
kids.d_en: Universal joints connect a pair of highly misaligned shafts.

kids.d_tr: Hızlı geçmeli kaplinler tork aktarmayan uygulamalarda mil ve bileşenlerdeki eksen kaçıklığını telafi eder.
kids.d_en: Quick-fit couplings compensate for radial offset or parallel misalignment of shafts and components in non-torque power transmission applications. These couplings consist of a bolt that attaches to the rod or shaft and a body that attaches to the component.

kids.d_tr: Mil bilezikleri rulman ve dişlileri mile sabitler ve mekanik durdurucu görevi görebilir.
kids.d_en: Shaft collars hold bearings and sprockets to shafts and other components and can act as mechanical stops.

kids.d_tr: Tek parça mil bilezikleri milin ucundan geçirilerek yüzeyi çizmeden yerine kilitlenir.
kids.d_en: One-piece shaft collars slide over the end of a soft or hard shaft and lock in place without marring. They act as motion stops and positively locate pulleys, bearings, and sprockets.

kids.d_tr: İki parça mil bilezikleri tamamen ayrılır; ekipmanı sökmeden ve mili çizmeden montaj yapılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Two-piece shaft collars separate fully and install around hard or soft shafts without marring or disassembly of equipment, which would risk misaligning shafts on reassembly.

kids.d_tr: Setuskurlu bilezikler bir setuskur vidayla uyumlu mile kilitlenir.
kids.d_en: Set screw collars use a set screw to lock onto a compatible soft or predrilled shaft.

kids.d_tr: İnce mil bilezikleri dar genişliğiyle dönen kütleyi ve boyutu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Thin shaft collars feature narrow width dimensions, reducing rotational mass and size. Thin shaft collars are commonly used in medical, encoder, and food and drug applications.

kids.d_tr: Çift genişlikteki mil bilezikleri, ek sıkma alanı ve vidalarıyla standart bileziklerden çok daha yüksek tutuş gücü sunar.
kids.d_en: Double-wide shaft collars feature significantly increased holding power than standard shaft collars due to additional clamping area and clamping screws. They can also be used as compact shaft couplers.

kids.d_tr: Ağır hizmet mil bilezikleri daha kalın malzeme, geniş gövde ve büyük sıkma vidasıyla azami tutuş gücü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Heavy-duty shaft collars feature thicker material, a wider body, and a larger clamping screw for maximum shaft holding power. Heavy-duty shaft collars are for use in large bore applications.

kids.d_tr: Montaj delikli mil bileziklerinin dişli delikleri, bileziği taban plakası veya bağlantı noktalarına tutturmayı sağlar.
kids.d_en: Mountable shaft collars feature machine screw threaded holes used to join or attach collars to base plates or mounting points for precise management and load bearing applications.

kids.d_tr: Montaj delikli kollu mil bilezikleri, kollu bilezik ile montaj delikli bileziğin avantajlarını birleştirir.
kids.d_en: Mountable clamping lever shaft collars combine the benefits of clamping lever collars and mountable shaft collars. Mounting holes are drilled into flat sections on the outer diameter of the collar and tapped with machine screw threads, securely fastening hinges, sensors, or brackets. The external lever loosens and tightens the grip of the collar on the shaft. These two features allow positive positioning of brackets and sensors as well as tool-free installation, repositioning, and removal of the collar.

kids.d_tr: Kollu sıkma bileziklerinde paslanmaz bir pime bağlı cırcırlı kol bulunur; hızlı montaj ve konum değişimi sağlar.
kids.d_en: Clamping lever quick-clamping shaft collars feature a ratcheting lever mounted to a stainless steel post for quick installation, removal, or repositioning of the shaft collar.

kids.d_tr: Eksantrik kollu hızlı sıkma bileziklerinin kavisli kolu kilitlendiğinde gövdeyle bütünleşir ve takılma riskini azaltır.
kids.d_en: Cam lever quick-clamping shaft collars feature a curved cam arm which blends into the surface of the collar when locked in place, reducing risk of snags. Tools are not needed to quickly install, remove, or reposition these shaft collars.

kids.d_tr: Dişli mil bilezikleri iç dişleriyle hassas ayar, düzgün montaj ve mil boyunca yüksek tutuş gücü sağlar.
kids.d_en: Threaded shaft collars feature internal threads which allow precise adjustments, smooth installation, and increased holding power along the length of a threaded shaft, making them suitable for use as positive limit stops in repeated operations.

kids.d_tr: Kamalı miller için bilezikler işlenmiş kama yuvasıyla kaymayı önler ve mil ile bileziğin dönüşünü kilitler.
kids.d_en: Shaft collars for keyed shafts feature a machined keyway slot, which prevents slipping and locks the shaft and collar rotation together. Keyed shaft collars prevent equipment from slipping around the shaft in drive applications.

kids.d_tr: D profilli miller için bileziklerin deliğindeki düz kesit, milin düz yüzeyiyle eşleşerek kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Shaft collars for D-shafts feature a flat section in the bore which positively mates with the flat spot on the shaft. This prevents slipping and locks the shaft and collar rotation together.

kids.d_tr: Altıgen miller için bileziklerin deliğindeki altı düz yüzey, milin yüzeyleriyle eşleşerek kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Shaft collars for hexagonal shafts feature six flat sides in the bore which positively mate with the flat sections of a hexagonal shaft. This prevents slipping and locks the shaft and collar rotation together.

kids.d_tr: Rulman kilit somunları rulman, kasnak ve dişlileri dişli miller üzerinde konumlandırmak ve oturtmak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Bearing locknuts are used to position or seat bearings, pulleys, and gears onto threaded shafts.

kids.d_tr: Mil bileziği sönümleme pulları uyumlu bileziklere takılarak titreşimi emer ve temas gürültüsünü azaltır.
kids.d_en: Shaft collar damping washers install on compatible shaft collars to absorb vibration and reduce noise when collars contact other components.

kids.d_tr: Mil bileziği sensör braketleri, endüstriyel otomasyonda yakınlık ve konum ölçen sensörleri bileziklere monte eder.
kids.d_en: Sensor brackets for shaft collars mount sensors on compatible shaft collars to measure and monitor proximity, position, and other parameters for industrial automation applications.

kids.d_tr: Güç aktarma kayışları ve kasnakları birlikte çalışarak tahrik sisteminde hareket üretir.
kids.d_en: Power transmission belts and pulleys work together to generate motion in a drive system.

kids.d_tr: V kayışlar kasnaklara takılarak makine, iklimlendirme sistemi ve tarım ekipmanında dönen miller arasında güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: V-belts mount to pulleys to transmit power between rotational shafts in machinery, tools, HVAC systems, agricultural equipment, and automotive engines.

kids.tr: V Kayış Kasnakları ve Gergi Makaraları
kids.d_tr: V kayış kasnakları ve gergi makaraları, V biçimli kanallarına oturan kayışla dönme gücünü mile aktarır.
kids.d_en: V-belt pulleys and idlers, also called sheaves, fit compatible V-belts in their V-shaped grooves to transmit rotational power to a shaft.

kids.d_tr: Triger kayışları, uyumlu kasnaklarla eşleşen diş dizisiyle hassas ekipmanı tahrik eder.
kids.d_en: Timing belts, also referred to as gear belts or synchronous belts, drive precision equipment with a pattern of teeth that mate to compatible timing belt pulleys or idlers.

kids.d_tr: Triger kasnakları ve gergi makaraları uyumlu kayışın diş dizisiyle eşleşerek dönme gücünü mile aktarır.
kids.d_en: Timing belt pulleys and idlers mate with the tooth pattern of a compatible timing belt to transmit rotational power to a shaft.

kids.d_tr: Yuvarlak kayışlar dönüşlü ve kıvrımlı tahrik sistemlerinde güzergah izler.
kids.d_en: Round belts route through drive systems with twists and turns. They are soft and pliable and must stretch to maintain contact with belt pulleys to achieve the necessary tension and operate effectively. Round belts are suitable for serpentine and quarter turn drives where the belt is twisted at 90°. They can be cut and welded together or joined with a connector to fit the length needed in a drive system. Round belts are used in a variety of power transmission applications such as conveyors, packaging machines, imaging systems, and industrial sewing machines.

kids.tr: Dikey Dolum ve Kapama Makinesi Kayışları

kids.d_tr: Bu kayış aparatları ve ölçüm cihazları kayış ile kasnakların bakımını, ölçümünü ve değişimini destekler.
kids.d_en: These belt tools and gauges support the maintenance, performance, measurement, and replacement of belts and pulleys.

kids.d_tr: Güç aktarma zincirleri ve dişlileri, kaymadıkları için kayış-kasnaktan daha hassas ve kontrollü bir tahrik sistemi sunar.
kids.d_en: Power transmission chains and sprockets work together to transmit power between rotational shafts, providing a more precise and controlled drive system over belts and pulleys because they will not slip or wear.

kids.d_tr: Makaralı zincirler, uyumlu dişlinin dişleriyle kavrayan makaralı baklalardan oluşarak miller arasında güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Roller chains consist of a strand of overlapping links with intersecting rollers that engage with the teeth of a compatible sprocket to transmit power between rotational shafts.

kids.d_tr: Zincir baklaları ve bağlantı elemanları, yıpranmış bir baklayı değiştirmek veya zinciri uzatmak için mevcut zincire eklenir.
kids.d_en: Roller chain links and connectors are individual links that are added to an existing chain to replace a worn link or to extend the length of the chain.

kids.d_tr: Zincir dişlileri ve gergi makaralarının çevresindeki dişler zincirle kavrayarak miller arasında güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Roller chain sprockets and idlers have a series of teeth around a central bore, or hole, that engage with roller chains to transmit power between rotational shafts.

kids.d_tr: Zincir aparatları, onarım veya ölçü ayarı için zinciri ayıran ya da birleştiren elle kullanılan cihazlardır.
kids.d_en: Chain tools consist of manual devices that detach or join a roller chain so that it can be repaired or adjusted to a different size.

kids.tr: Kayış ve Zincir Kılavuzları ile Gergileri
kids.d_tr: Kayış ve zincir kılavuzları konveyör uygulamalarında hizayı korur, sürtünmeyi ve aşınmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Belt and chain guides are used in conveyor belt applications to guide belts and chains and keep them aligned while reducing friction and wear.

kids.d_tr: V kayış kılavuzları çalışma sırasında hizayı koruyarak sürtünme ile gürültüyü azaltır ve kayış ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: V-belt guides keep V-belts aligned during operation to reduce friction and noise, enhance traction, and extend the belt's lifespan. They have wedge-shaped channels and improve load distribution in conveyor systems that support heavy products, span long distances, or traverse inclines.

kids.d_tr: Yuvarlak kayış kılavuzları çalışma sırasında hizayı koruyarak sürtünmeyi azaltır ve kayış ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Round belt guides keep round belts aligned during operation to reduce friction and noise, enhance traction, and extend the belt's lifespan. They have semi-circle-shaped channels and improve load distribution in conveyor systems that support heavy products, span long distances, or traverse inclines.

kids.d_tr: Bu gergiler kendinden ayarlıdır; tahrik sisteminde kayış veya zincir gerginliğini sabit tutar.
kids.d_en: These tensioners are self-adjusting to maintain constant tension on the belt or chain in a drive system. They mount to equipment and engage with the belt or chain to generate tension to prevent belts and chains from slipping and breaking.

kids.d_tr: Tahrik gergileri ve milleri, zincir ya da kayış tahrik sistemi için germe düzeneğini oluşturan bileşenlerdir.
kids.d_en: Drive tighteners and shafts are components that make up a tensioning device for a chain or belt drive system. They should be matched to a compatible sprocket or pulley.

kids.d_tr: Zincir kılavuzları makaralı zincirleri hizalayarak ağır yüklerin eşit dağılmasını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Chain guides align roller chains to keep heavy loads evenly distributed. They mount to the sides of conveyor and rail systems to help facilitate roller chain movement and prevent contact between moving parts and the conveyor system to reduce operational noise and increase the chain's lifespan. Chain guides have tracks and/or channels compatible with specific ANSI chain sizes.

kids.d_tr: Dişliler; şaft, saat ve otomatik makine gibi mekanik cihazlarda bileşenler arasında dönme hareketi ve güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Gears transfer rotational motion and power between components inside mechanical devices like driveshafts, clocks, and automated machinery.

kids.d_tr: Helisel dişliler paralel miller arasında dönme hareketi ve güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Helical gears transmit rotary motion and power between parallel shafts. They have disc-shaped bodies and slanted teeth that curve to the right or left of their axis. They come in pairs with the same pitch, angle pressure, and helix angle but have opposite-facing teeth. Their inclined teeth mesh gradually and stay in contact longer than straight-cut gears, which creates less noise and vibration and enables them to handle larger loads and higher speeds. Helical gears are interchangeable with spur gears of the same module and number of teeth. Typical uses include automotive transmissions, machine tools, and industrial gearboxes.

kids.d_tr: Eşit konik dişliler kesişen döner miller arasında 1:1 oranında güç ve hareket aktarır.
kids.d_en: Miter gears transmit 1:1 power and motion between intersecting rotating shafts for continuous momentum. They have cone-shaped profiles and teeth that project radially from their bore. Miter gears operate in pairs with the same number of teeth and identical tooth length, diametrical pitch, and pressure angle. They're commonly used in mechanical applications such as door mechanisms, hand tools, and printing presses.

kids.d_tr: Konik dişliler dik açıyla kesişen miller arasında dönme hareketi aktarır.
kids.d_en: Bevel gears transfer rotary motion between intersecting shafts that meet at right angles. They have cone-shaped profiles, teeth that project radially from their bore, and operate in pairs with varying teeth counts but similar angle pressure, tooth length, and diametric pitch. They're used to alter speeds and increase torque in mechanical applications such as differential drives, plant and mill machinery, and power tools.

kids.d_tr: Sonsuz dişliler paralel olmayan veya kesişmeyen miller arasında dönme hareketi ve güç aktarır.
kids.d_en: Worm gears transfer rotary motion and power between non-parallel or non-intersecting shafts. They're used to reduce speeds or increase torque in mechanical applications that operate in confined spaces, such as power steering, machine tools, elevators, and chain blocks. Worm gears are a two-part mechanism that consists of a rod-shaped gear with spiral threading called a worm and a disc-shaped gear with projecting teeth named a wheel. The worm drives the wheel with a rolling and sliding action that creates minimal vibration and low noise output. However, their meshing motion creates friction, so they're typically paired in different materials to minimize heat and wear.

kids.d_tr: İç dişlilerin disk biçimli gövdesinde, iç çapa işlenmiş dişler bulunur; düz dişlilerle kavrayarak planet dişli grupları oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Internal gears have disc-shaped bodies with teeth cut into their inner diameter that mesh with spur gears and gear couplings to create planetary gearsets. Also known as ring gears, they transmit motion between multiple rotating parts to create varying speed and direction ratio combinations.

kids.d_tr: Vibratörler mekanik titreşim üreterek malzemenin silo, hazne, elek ve torbalardan akışını hızlandırır.
kids.d_en: Vibrators mechanically generate vibration to speed the flow of materials through bins, hoppers, screens, drums, and bags.

kids.d_tr: Pnömatik vibratörler ve hava topları basınçlı havayla çalışır; malzeme akışını düzgünleştirir ve tıkanmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Pneumatic vibrators and air cannons are powered by compressed air to facilitate the smooth flow of materials, prevent clogs, and increase productivity.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli vibratörler elektrik motoruyla çalışır ve malzemeyi oluk, hazne ve ambarlarda hareket halinde tutar.
kids.d_en: Electric vibrators are powered by an electric motor and keep materials in motion through conveying chutes, hoppers, and cargo holds.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik vibratörler basınçlı hidrolik akışkanla çalışır ve malzemeyi oluk ile haznelerde hareket halinde tutar.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic vibrators are powered by pressurized hydraulic fluid and keep materials in motion through conveying chutes, hoppers, and cargo holds. They can be operated in any position or orientation and offer high force and frequency with quiet operation.

kids.d_tr: Vibratör montaj braketleri uyumlu vibratörler ile ekipman arasında geçici veya kalıcı bağlantı noktaları oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Vibrator mounting brackets create temporary or permanent mounting points between compatible vibrators and equipment. Vibrator mounting brackets are used on forms, railcars, chutes, and hoppers.

kids.d_tr: Lineer hareket ürünleri konveyör ve montaj işlemlerinde doğrusal hareket sağlar.
kids.d_en: Linear motion products are used in conveyors and assembly operations to provide movement in a straight line, including rolling elements in a raceway or guide rail in conveyors and assembly operations.

kids.d_tr: Hassas lineer miller; CNC lazer, router ve tezgahlarda tek eksenli hareket ve konumlandırmada rulman ile kızakları yönlendirir.
kids.d_en: Precision linear shafts guide bearings and slides in single-axis motion and positioning applications such as pick-and-place systems, computerized numerical control (CNC) lasers and routers, and machine tooling.

kids.d_tr: Lineer rulmanların silindirik veya kare iç yüzeyi lineer millere geçerek hareketi kolaylaştırır.
kids.d_en: Linear bearings have cylindrical or square-shaped inner surfaces that fit around linear shafts to facilitate motion.

kids.d_tr: Lineer kılavuz sistemleri ve bileşenleri yükleri doğrusal bir eksen boyunca taşır.
kids.d_en: Linear guide systems and components transport loads along a linear axis.

kids.d_tr: Bilyalı ve trapez vidalar, uyumlu dişli somunlarla eşleşerek dönme hareketini doğrusal harekete çevirir.
kids.d_en: Ball screws and acme lead screws pair with corresponding threaded nuts to convert rotary motion into linear motion.

kids.d_tr: Lineer aktüatörler ve vidalı krikolar nesneleri doğrusal bir yol boyunca hareket ettirir; kaldırma ve eğme işlerinde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Linear actuators and screw jacks move objects along a straight path and are used in systems and applications requiring lifting, lowering, shifting, or tilting movement.

kids.d_tr: Biyel kolları, tam diş gerekmediğinde uygulamanın parçalarını birbirine bağlamak için kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Connecting rods are used to join parts of an application together when a full thread is not necessary. These rods include both internally threaded and opposing threaded options.

kids.d_tr: Döner miller, makine parçaları arasında dönme gücü ve hareketi aktaran metal çubuk biçimli elemanlardır.
kids.d_en: Rotary shafts are metal rod-shaped devices that transmit rotational power and motion within the parts of a machine.

kids.d_tr: Kamalı döner millerde boy boyunca işlenmiş bir kama yuvası bulunur; mil ile makine elemanı arasında kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Keyed rotary shafts have a keyway milled into the length of the shaft to prevent slippage between the shaft and the rotating machine element. They are used in high-load applications such as hoists or precision applications such as robotics. These keyed rotary shafts are formed and measured in either inches or metric dimensions.

kids.d_tr: Kısmi kamalı döner millerin her iki ucunda kama yuvası bulunur; mil ile makine elemanı arasında kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Partially keyed rotary shafts have a keyway milled into each end to prevent slippage between the shaft and the rotating machine element. They are used in high-load applications such as hoists or precision applications such as robotics.

kids.d_tr: D profilli döner millerde boy boyunca işlenmiş düz bir kesit bulunur; mil ile makine elemanı arasında kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: D-profile rotary shafts have a flat section milled into the full length of the shaft to prevent slippage between the shaft and the rotating machine element. They are used in high-precision applications such as robotics and drive systems.

kids.d_tr: Kısmi D profilli döner millerin her iki ucunda düz bir kesit bulunur; kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: Partially D-profile rotary shafts have a flat section milled into each end to prevent slippage between the shaft and the rotating machine element. They are used in high-precision applications such as robotics and drive systems.

kids.en: D-Profile Rotary Shafts with Tapped Hole
kids.d_tr: Dişli delikli D profilli millerde boy boyunca düz bir kesit bulunur; mil ile makine elemanı arasında kaymayı önler.
kids.d_en: D-profile rotary shafts with tapped holes have a flat section milled into the full length of the shaft to prevent slippage between the shaft and the rotating machine element. They have an internally-threaded hole at one end to accept machine screws and bolts. They are used in high-precision applications such as robotics and drive systems.

kids.d_tr: Kısmi dişli döner miller yuvarlak gövdelidir; bir veya iki ucunda somun kabul eden dişli bir uzantı bulunur.
kids.d_en: Partially threaded rotary shafts feature a continuous round, linear profile and have an externally threaded post at one or both ends to accept nuts and internally threaded components. They are used in drive systems and industrial automation applications.

kids.d_tr: Kademeli döner miller dönen gruplarda yoğun destek sağlar; farklı delik ölçülerindeki kasnak ve dişlileri hizalar.
kids.d_en: Stepped rotary shafts provide concentrated support in rotating assemblies while reinforcing, mounting, and aligning drive pulleys, sprockets, and gears with varying bore sizes commonly found in gearboxes and power transmission applications. They feature a reduced-diameter section on one or both ends and a larger-diameter main section for added strength and durability.

kids.d_tr: Kanallı döner millerin çevresinde segman kabul eden işlenmiş kanallar bulunur.
kids.d_en: Grooved rotary shafts have machined grooves around their circumference that fit retaining rings. Also called retaining ring shafts, they are commonly used to position and align gears, sprockets, and other mechanical components and as drive shafts or axles in industrial machinery applications.

kids.d_tr: Rulmanlı mandreller, tezgah üstü polisaj ve yüzey işleme aletlerindeki döner mekanizmadır.
kids.d_en: Ball bearing mandrels are the rotating mechanism found in benchtop buffing and finishing tools.

kids.d_tr: Rulman ve döner eleman bağlantıları düz yüzey, duvar veya panellere takılarak dişli, rulman ve kasnakları taşır.
kids.d_en: Mounts for bearings and rotary components attach to flat surfaces, walls, or panels to hold rotating components such as gears, bearings, and pulleys. Also called idler shafts, they have cylindrical journals (the outer part of the shaft that contacts the bearing) and enable reverse rotation of an assembly.

kids.d_tr: Mil keçeleri, mil üzerinde dönen ve sabit parçalar arasına yerleşerek yağlayıcıyı içeride tutar.
kids.d_en: Rotary shaft seals sit between rotating and stationary parts on a shaft to retain lubricants.

kids.d_tr: Mil keçeleri, dönen ve sabit parçalar arasına yerleşerek yağı içeride tutar.
kids.d_en: Rotary shaft seals sit between rotating and stationary parts on a shaft to retain oil. They consist of a metal case that fits into a bore housing and a sealing lip made of an elastomer or rubber material which presses against the surface of the shaft to create a seal. These seals include a garter spring that presses the sealing lip against the shaft for a tighter seal to retain oil. Rotary shaft oil seals are used in automotive engines, transmissions, and industrial machines that require the retention of oil in the housing of rotating parts.

kids.d_tr: Bu mil keçeleri dönen ve sabit parçalar arasına yerleşerek gresi içeride tutar.
kids.d_en: These rotary shaft seals sit between rotating and stationary parts on a shaft to retain grease. They consist of a metal case that fits into a bore housing and a sealing lip made of an elastomer or rubber which presses against the surface of the shaft to create a seal. They do not have a garter spring which allows a slightly looser fit to the shaft, reducing friction and providing a more suitable seal for grease. Rotary shaft grease seals are often used in automotive engines, transmissions, and industrial machines that require the retention of grease in the housing of rotating parts.

kids.d_tr: Yaylı sızdırmazlık elemanları mil, çubuk ve pistonlarda yağlayıcıyı tutar ve kir ile nemin girişini en aza indirir.
kids.d_en: Spring-energized seals, also known as spring-loaded seals, provide sealing for shafts, rods, and pistons to retain lubricants and minimize the entry of dirt, oil, and moisture. They are made of a chemical-resistant, high-temperature polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE). An internal spring ensures the seal maintains its shape and holds firmly in place. They can be used in place of rotary shaft seals, rod seals, and piston seals.

kids.d_tr: Aşınma manşonları, yıpranmış milin yeniden işlenmesine gerek bırakmaz; düzgün ve merkezli bir sızdırmazlık yüzeyi sunar.
kids.d_en: Wear sleeves eliminate the need to dismantle a radial drive system and re-machine a worn shaft. They provide a smooth, concentric surface so that the shaft can properly seal to the component in order to retain lubricants and keep out contaminants.

kids.d_tr: Labirent keçeler rulmanları pas, kir, kirlilik ve sıvı sıçramasından korur.
kids.d_en: Labyrinth seals protect bearings from rust, dirt, contaminants, and liquid splash. These non-contact mechanical seals are formed by layering together metal sealing plates in a complex maze-like pattern.

kids.en: Spherical Rod Ends, Fixed Rod Ends, & Yoke Ends
kids.d_tr: Güç aktarma bağlantı parçaları, enerjiyi harekete çeviren bağlantı kollarını ve bileşenleri birleştirir ve uzatır.
kids.d_en: Power transmission connecting parts attach, couple, and extend linkages and components converting energy into motion.

kids.d_tr: Küresel mafsal başları iki bileşen arasında sabit bir temas noktası oluşturarak dönme hareketine izin verir ve açısal kaçıklığı telafi eder.
kids.d_en: Spherical rod ends provide a fixed point of contact between two components to allow rotational movement and to compensate for angular misalignment.

kids.d_tr: Çatal uçlar erkek dişli çubuk ve elemanlara bağlanarak kaldırma uygulamalarında kasnakları taşır.
kids.d_en: Clevis and yoke ends connect to male-threaded rods and fasteners to support pulleys for lifting applications. Their two prongs have holes for an axle pin that the pulley sheave rotates around. Clevis fork heads and joints pair with pneumatic and hydraulic cylinders in power transmission applications.

d_tr: Pompalar belirli sistem ve uygulamalar için tasarlanır; su, yakıt, yağ ve basınçlı gaz gibi uyumlu akışkanları taşır.
d_en: Pumps are designed for specific systems or applications and handle system-compatible media, such as water, fuel, oil, or compressed gas.

kids.d_tr: Drenaj ve atık su pompaları su basmış alanlardan ve toplama haznelerinden suyu tahliye eder.
kids.d_en: Dewatering and wastewater pumps drain water from flooded areas and basin sump pits.

kids.d_tr: Foseptik pompaları ve sistemleri bodrum toplama haznelerine takılarak fazla suyu uzaklaştırır ve su baskınını önler.
kids.d_en: Sump pumps and systems install into basement or crawl space sump pits to remove excess water and prevent flooding.

kids.d_tr: Gri su pompaları, septik tanktan gelen küçük katı parçacıklı atık suyu ikincil arıtma sistemine taşır.
kids.d_en: Effluent pumps handle wastewater containing small solids from a septic tank to a secondary treatment system, such as a drain field or mound system. They can also be used for other general purpose dewatering applications.

kids.tr: Pis Su Terfi Pompaları ve Sistemleri
kids.d_tr: Pis su terfi pompaları, yerçekimiyle akışın mümkün olmadığı haznelerden katı içeren pis suyu uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Sewage ejector pumps remove sewage containing solids from basins where a gravity system won't work, such as in septic systems below the main sewer line or lift station.

kids.d_tr: Parçalayıcılı pis su pompaları, hattan geçen kağıt ve büyük katıları parçalayarak lavabo ve klozetlerde tıkanmayı azaltır.
kids.d_en: Sewage grinder pumps cut up toilet paper, sanitary wipes, and other large solids traveling through a building's water or sewer main to reduce backups in sinks, washing machines, and toilets.

kids.d_tr: Lavabo tahliye pompa sistemleri lavabo, küvet ve çamaşır makinesindeki atık suyu uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Sink drain pump systems remove wastewater from sinks, tubs, and washing machines. They are fully assembled units installed in locations below the main sewer line where gravity systems won't work, such as basements. Rising liquid levels actuate the switch, which activates the pump to drain wastewater from the basin.

kids.d_tr: Çamur pompaları; çamur, bulamaç ve katı içeren viskoz sıvıları drenaj pompalarından daha iyi aktarır.
kids.d_en: Sludge pumps transfer mud, slurry, sewage, and other liquids containing solids or viscous fluids better than dewatering and wastewater pumps. Their diaphragms handle thick, viscous or solid-laden fluids, such as mud, sludge, and slurries.

kids.tr: Kaba Atık ve Genel Amaçlı Drenaj Pompaları
kids.d_tr: Kaba atık ve genel amaçlı drenaj pompaları, geçici drenaj gereken şantiye ve noktalardaki suyu uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Trash, dewatering, and utility pumps remove water from job sites or locations where drainage is temporarily needed.

kids.tr: Toplama Hazneleri, Ayaklar ve Kılavuz Rayları
kids.d_tr: Toplama hazneleri, ayaklar ve kılavuz rayları mevcut pompanın işlevini tamamlar ve montajına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Sump basins, stands, and guide rails supplement the function of an existing sump pump and help install sump pumps and their accessories.

kids.tr: Drenaj ve Atık Su Pompası Yedek Parçaları
kids.en: Repair Parts for Dewatering & Wastewater Pumps
kids.d_tr: Drenaj ve atık su pompası yedek parçaları kırık bileşenleri değiştirerek pompaları çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Repair parts for dewatering and wastewater pumps replace broken components to ensure pumps are in working condition.

kids.d_tr: Kuyu ve yeraltı suyu pompaları emiş, basınç veya merkezkaç kuvvetiyle yeraltından su çeker.
kids.d_en: Well and groundwater pumps extract water from underground via suction, pressure, or centrifugal force.

kids.d_tr: Derin kuyu pompaları şebeke suyuna erişimi olmayan konut ve ticari tesislerde su besleme sistemlerine su aktarır.
kids.d_en: Deep-well pumps transfer water to water supply systems in residential and commercial facilities without access to a municipal water source. They're used to access and deliver water from wells deeper than 25 feet.

kids.d_tr: Sığ kuyu pompaları 7,5 metreden derin olmayan kuyulardan su sağlar; şebeke suyu bulunmayan bölgelerde kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Shallow-well pumps supply water from wells no deeper than 25 feet and are used in areas without access to a municipal water source. They are mounted above ground, which makes them easier to maintain and repair than submersible well pumps installed in the well that must be removed for inspection.

kids.d_tr: Dönüştürülebilir kuyu jet pompaları hem sığ hem derin kuyulardan ticari ve konut tesislerine su aktarır.
kids.d_en: Convertible well jet pumps transfer water from shallow wells up to 25 ft. deep or deep wells greater than 25 ft. deep to commercial and residential facilities and are used in areas without access to a municipal water source. They are mounted above ground to be easily accessible for repair, inspection, and maintenance, compared to submersible well pumps installed in the well that need to be removed for inspection.

kids.d_tr: El tulumbaları bir kol yardımıyla pompası olmayan sığ kuyulardan su çeker.
kids.d_en: Hand-operated pitcher pumps use a lever to transfer water from shallow wells that have no pump. They are for use in areas without access to a municipal water supply, require a reliable well water supply, and are only for use with water.

kids.d_tr: Jet pompa ejektörleri ve venturi grupları, konut kuyu uygulamalarında kullanılan jet pompaların bileşenleridir.
kids.d_en: Jet pump ejectors and venturi assemblies are components of jet well pumps used in residential well applications. These attachments create a vacuum that helps lift water from the well to the pump. The jet pump ejectors and venturi assemblies must match the brand, series, and manufacturer model number of the pump or pump system.

kids.d_tr: Hidrofor tankları ve aksesuarları suyu depolar, sabit basınç sağlar ve mevcut tankların işlevini tamamlar.
kids.d_en: Well water tanks and accessories store water in a tank, provide consistent water pressure, and supplement the function of existing well water tanks of the same brand and manufacturer model number.

kids.tr: Kuyu Uçları, Kaplinler ve Çakma Başlıkları
kids.d_tr: Kuyu uçları, konik delikli uçlarını toprağa çakarak yeraltı suyuna ulaşan sığ kuyular oluşturur.
kids.d_en: Well points create shallow wells by driving their cone-shaped perforated end into the soil to access groundwater. Drive caps screw onto the threaded end of a well point before it is driven into the soil to prevent damage to the threads on the well point. Couplings connect multiple sections of well point pipes.  Well points, couplings, and drive caps are for use in locations with soft soil and where the water table is close to the surface.

kids.d_tr: Kuyu kapakları ve contaları yüzey sıvıları ile döküntünün kuyuya girip suyu kirletmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Well caps and seals keep surface liquids and debris from entering the well and contaminating the water supply. They fit securely on top of the well casing, which is the above-ground section of pipe that allows water to flow from underground to the surface.

kids.d_tr: Tork tutucular ve kuyu adaptörleri pompanın kuyu içine montajına yardımcı olur ve tork kaynaklı hasarı önler.
kids.d_en: Torque arrestors and pitless adapters help install well pumps inside the well casing or below the frost line in cold weather and prevent damage to the pump caused by torque produced by the pump motor and impellers during operation.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Well & Groundwater Pumps
kids.d_tr: Kuyu pompası yedek parçaları aynı marka ve modeldeki pompaları çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Repair parts for well and groundwater pumps keep pumps of the same brand, series, and/or manufacturer model number in working condition.

kids.d_tr: Sirkülasyon ve hat tipi santrifüj pompalar, kapalı devre boru sisteminde akışkanı ısıtma, soğutma ve proses için hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Circulating and inline centrifugal pumps move fluids through a closed-loop pipe system for hydronic heating and cooling, domestic hot water recirculation, or other industrial processes.

kids.tr: Sirkülasyon ve Hat Tipi Santrifüj Pompalar
kids.d_tr: Hat tipi sirkülasyon pompaları, kapalı devre boru sisteminde akışkanı ısıtma, soğutma ve sıcak su devridaimi için hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Inline circulators and recirculation pumps move fluids through a closed-loop pipe system for hydronic heating and cooling, domestic hot water recirculation, or other industrial processes.

kids.d_tr: Hidroforlar standart santrifüj pompalara göre daha yüksek basınçlara ulaşır.
kids.d_en: Booster pumps reach higher pressures than standard centrifugal pumps.

kids.tr: Kondens Pompaları ve Kazan Besleme Sistemleri
kids.d_tr: Kondens pompaları ve kazan besleme sistemleri, yerçekimiyle tahliyenin mümkün olmadığı sistemlerde kondens suyunu tahliye eder ya da geri gönderir.
kids.d_en: Condensate pumps and boiler feed systems evacuate or return condensate water in systems where gravity-fed drainage isn't possible.

kids.d_tr: Kondens tahliye pompaları, yerçekimiyle tahliyenin mümkün olmadığı durumlarda ısıtma veya soğutma sistemindeki yoğuşma suyunu uzaklaştırır.
kids.d_en: Condensate removal pumps evacuate liquid formed by condensation from the heating or cooling system when gravity drainage is not possible. Furnaces, air conditioners, and boilers are often installed in a location lower than the drainage system, such as a basement. ​The performance of these pumps is based on the amount of liquid, in gallons per minute (gpm), that the pump can lift in vertical feet from the liquid sitting in the tank (feet of head).

kids.d_tr: Kondens dönüş pompa sistemleri büyük kazan devresinde oluşan yoğuşmayı toplayıp kazana geri gönderir.
kids.d_en: Condensate return pump systems collect condensation generated in a large boiler loop system and send it back to the boiler. They are used when gravity-fed return is not an option. These systems have a built-in collection tank fitted with a float switch. The switch triggers when condensation levels rise, activating the pump to direct condensate water back to the boiler.

kids.d_tr: Kazan besleme pompa sistemleri buhar kazanlarına su vererek ideal seviyeye doldurur.
kids.d_en: Boiler feed pump systems deliver water to steam boilers, filling them to the optimal water level. These systems include a tank and one or more pumps. They are available in vertical and horizontal configurations to accommodate various spacing requirements.

kids.tr: Kondens Dönüş ve Kazan Besleme Pompaları
kids.en: Pumps for Condensate Return & Boiler Feed Systems
kids.d_tr: Bu pompalar tek veya çift pompalı kondens dönüş sistemlerinde yıpranmış pompanın yerine geçer.
kids.d_en: These pumps replace a worn or damaged pump in either one-pump (simplex) or two-pump (duplex) condensate return systems or boiler feed units. Pumps transfer condensate in a collection tank back to the boiler and are mounted vertically at the base of the tank.

kids.en: Safety Overflow Switches for Condensate Removal Pumps
kids.d_tr: Kondens pompası taşma emniyet anahtarları tanktaki sıvı seviyesini izleyerek tıkanmadan doğan taşmayı önler.
kids.d_en: Safety overflow switches for condensate removal pumps monitor liquid levels in the tank and help prevent spillover from equipment drain blockages. When fluid levels within the condensate pump's tank rise above a certain point, the switch will trip and shut down the connected equipment generating the condensation, such as an HVAC or refrigeration unit, to prevent an overflow, which can lead to mold and mildew.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Condensate Pumps & Boiler Feed Systems
kids.d_tr: Yedek parçalar kondens pompaları ve kazan besleme sistemlerini çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Repair parts keep condensate pumps and boiler feed systems in working condition.

kids.d_tr: Pompa panoları, anahtarları ve alarmları pompaları devreye alır ve gerektiğinde uyarı göndererek su baskınını önler.
kids.d_en: Control panels, switches, and alarms for water and wastewater pumps activate pumps and send alerts when pumps need to be activated to remove liquids and prevent flooding. Pump control panels operate one or multiple pumps for emptying and filling applications, such as irrigation systems, effluent and sewage pumps, and water wells.

kids.d_tr: Pompa kontrol panoları sulama, foseptik ve kuyu gibi uygulamalarda bir veya birden fazla pompayı denetler.
kids.d_en: Pump control panels control one or multiple pumps in a system for emptying and filling applications, such as irrigation systems, sump pump basins, effluent and sewage, and water wells. These panels are wall-mounted and wire directly into a pump and one or many float switches. Simplex control panels connect to and operate one pump, duplex control pumps operate and alternate cycles between two pumps, and quadplex pumps operate and alternate cycles between four pumps.

kids.d_tr: Pompa kontrol üniteleri ve sıralayıcıları bir veya iki pompayı sırayla çalıştırarak pompa ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Pump controllers and alternators operate and cycle one (controllers) or two pumps (alternators) to extend a pump's life or for applications requiring pumps to operate for extended periods.

kids.en: Float Switches for Pumps & Pump Control Panels
kids.d_tr: Flatörler, hazne ve tanklarda pompaları devreye alan sıvı seviye sensörleridir.
kids.d_en: Float switches are liquid level sensors that activate pumps for pump-up and pump-down procedures in pits, sump basins, and tanks in water, sewage, and industrial applications. As fluid levels rise or fall, the switch's float moves above or below the "on" point, a predetermined maximum or minimum height or degree, and activates the pump. Switches must be paired with the appropriate duty type to ensure the system works efficiently.

kids.d_tr: Sıvı seviye alarmları hazne ve tanklardaki su seviyesini izler; kaçak ya da aşırı seviye durumunda uyarı gönderir.
kids.d_en: Liquid-level alarms monitor water levels in a sump pit, tank, or other container and send alerts when leaks occur or when liquid levels are too low or high.

kids.d_tr: Pompa çek valfleri konut ve ticari binaların foseptik sistemlerinde kirli suyun geri akmasını önler.
kids.d_en: Sump pump check valves prevent the backflow of contaminated water in sump pump systems of residential and commercial buildings. These valves have wide ports for suspended solids to travel through the body. Flowing media on the inlet side pushes the disc away from the seat, opening the valve. When inlet pressure drops below outlet pressure, backflow will push the disc back into the seat to prevent contamination.

kids.d_tr: Flatör aksesuar ve parçaları yıpranmış bileşenleri değiştirerek flatörleri çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Float switch accessories and parts replace worn or nonfunctioning components to keep float switches in good working condition or improve the function of existing equipment.

kids.d_tr: Pompa motor koruyucuları performansı izler ve anormal çalışma koşullarında pompayı durdurur.
kids.d_en: Pump motor protectors monitor performance and shut off pumps during abnormal operating conditions. Also called motor protection systems, they help extend motor life, reduce downtime, and decrease maintenance costs.

kids.d_tr: Diyaframlı pompalar kendinden emişli ve salmastrasızdır; normal koşullarda kuru çalışabilir ve katı içeren sıvıları esnek bir diyaframla taşır.
kids.d_en: Diaphragm pumps are self-priming, sealless pumps that can run dry under normal operating conditions without risking damage to internal parts, and use a flexible diaphragm to move chemically compatible liquids containing suspended solids and liquids of varying viscosities.

kids.d_tr: Havalı çift diyaframlı pompalar basınçlı havayla çalışır; elektrik erişimi kısıtlı sahalarda kullanılır.
kids.d_en: Air-operated double diaphragm (AODD) pumps are powered by compressed air and used on job sites with access to compressed air or with limited access to electricity.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli çift diyaframlı pompalar elektrik motoruyla çalışır ve havalı muadillerine göre daha verimlidir.
kids.d_en: Electric-operated double diaphragm (EODD) pumps are powered by an electric motor and are more energy efficient than comparable air-operated double diaphragm (AODD) pumps.

kids.d_tr: Diyaframlı pompa yedek parçaları performansı geri kazandırır, bakım kaynaklı duruşu azaltır ve hizmet ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Diaphragm pump repair parts restore performance, reduce downtime from frequent maintenance, and extend the service life of pumps with a compatible brand and manufacturer model number.

kids.d_tr: Darbe sönümleyiciler çift diyaframlı pompaların basma tarafındaki basınç ve debi dalgalanmalarını yumuşatır.
kids.d_en: Pulsation dampeners, also known as surge suppressors, smooth out pressure and flow fluctuations on the discharge side of double diaphragm pumps. They reduce vibrations, hydraulic shock, foaming, splashing, and noise, and protect the pump and downstream piping. These dampeners are available in various material options. The material must be chemically compatible with the liquid being transferred. Refer to the manufacturer's chemical compatibility guide for more information.

kids.tr: Santrifüj, Kendinden Emişli ve Dalgıç Pompalar
kids.d_tr: Santrifüj pompalar merkezkaç kuvvetiyle sıvıları çeşitli endüstriyel ve ticari uygulamalarda aktarır ve sirküle eder.
kids.d_en: Centrifugal pumps transfer and circulate liquids using centrifugal force in a variety of industrial, commercial, and specialized applications.

kids.tr: Santrifüj Pompalar, Motorlar, Çarklar ve Keçeler
kids.en: Straight Centrifugal Pumps, Motors, Impellers & Seals
kids.d_tr: Santrifüj pompaların emiş bağlantısı, çarkın merkezi ve miliyle aynı eksendedir.
kids.d_en: Straight centrifugal pumps have an intake connection in-line with the impeller's eye and shaft.

kids.en: Self-Priming Pumps, Motors, Impellers & Seal Kits
kids.d_tr: Kendinden emişli santrifüj pompalar emiş kaldırma yoluyla pompa girişinin altındaki kaynaktan sıvı çeker.
kids.d_en: Self-priming centrifugal pumps use suction lift to draw liquids from a source located below the pump's inlet.

kids.d_tr: Dalgıç santrifüj pompalar sıvıya tamamen batmış halde çalışarak sıvıyı aktarır veya sirküle eder.
kids.d_en: Submersible centrifugal pumps transfer or recirculate liquid and work fully immersed in the liquid. A screen inlet located at the bottom of the pump prevents debris from entering the volute and damaging the pump.

kids.d_tr: Türbin pompalar standart santrifüj pompalardan daha yüksek basınç üretir; yüksek basma yüksekliği gereken kazan besleme sistemlerine uygundur.
kids.d_en: Turbine pumps produce higher pressures than typical straight centrifugal pumps and are optimal for boiler feed systems that require high pressures and heads. Turbine pumps are sized by horsepower (HP) and pair with motors of the same HP to meet application pressure and flow rate requirements. As pounds per square inch (PSI) increase, so does feet of head.

kids.d_tr: Santrifüj pompa kaideleri, pompayı ve motorunu beton temele sabitleyen rijit platformlardır.
kids.d_en: Mounting bases for centrifugal pumps are rigid platforms that secure a pump and its motor or engine to a concrete foundation.

kids.d_tr: Çarklar pompa içinde dönerek merkezkaç kuvvetiyle sıvıyı sistem boyunca hareket ettirir.
kids.d_en: Impellers rotate within the pump and move liquids through a system using centrifugal force. The replacement impeller must match the turbine pump's brand, series, and manufacturer number.

kids.d_tr: Keçe ve conta setleri sıvının pompa gövdesinden çıkmasını önleyerek motor ve rulman gruplarını kuru tutar.
kids.d_en: Seal kits and gaskets prevent liquids from exiting the pump body, keeping the motor and bearing assemblies dry. Seals and gaskets must match the turbine pump's brand series, and manufacturer model number.

kids.d_tr: Dişli pompalar kendinden emişlidir; dişli rotorlarla yağ, kimyasal ve solvent gibi viskoz sıvıları yüksek basınçta düzgün akışla aktarır.
kids.d_en: Gear pumps are self-priming pumps that use gear rotors to transfer highly viscous and harsh liquids, such as oils, chemicals, and solvents, producing a constant, smooth flow at high pressure.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli dişli pompalar elektrik motoruyla çalışır; kimya, tarım ve endüstriyel uygulamalarda viskoz sıvıları aktarır.
kids.d_en: Electric-operated gear pumps are powered by an electric motor and transfer viscous and harsh liquids in chemical processing, agriculture, and other industrial applications. These pumps produce constant, smooth flows at high pressures. These pumps are self-priming, moving liquids from sources below the pump. They require an initial priming before first use.

kids.d_tr: Dişli pompa kafaları, uygun güç ve gövdedeki bir motora kaplinle bağlanan pompa gruplarıdır.
kids.d_en: Rotary gear pump heads are pump assemblies that couple to a motor of a compatible horsepower (hp) and frame. These pump heads do not include a motor. They can be integrated into an existing original equipment manufacturer (OEM) system, used to retrofit systems, or used with a custom drive configuration. Gear pumps use rotating gears to transfer viscous and harsh liquids, such as oils, chemicals, and solvents, producing a constant, smooth flow at high pressure. These pumps are self-priming, moving liquids from sources below the pump, and require an initial prime before first use.

kids.d_tr: Ayaklı dişli pompaların açıkta duran tahrik mili kayış veya kasnakla motora bağlanır; motor yerleşiminde esneklik sunar.
kids.d_en: Pedestal-mount rotary gear pumps have an exposed drive shaft that couples to a compatible motor via a belt or pulley, allowing flexibility in motor placement and drive configuration. These pumps use rotating gears to transfer viscous and harsh liquids, such as oils, chemicals, and solvents, producing a constant, smooth flow at high pressure. These pumps are self-priming, moving liquids from sources below the pump, and require an initial prime before first use.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Rotary Gear Pumps
kids.d_tr: Tamir setleri ve parçaları performansı geri kazandırır, duruşu azaltır ve dişli pompaların hizmet ömrünü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Repair kits and parts restore performance, reduce downtime, and extend the service life of rotary gear pumps with a compatible brand and manufacturer model number.

kids.d_tr: Paletli pompalar kayar paletleriyle sıvıyı aktarır; düşük darbeli düzgün akış vererek yağ gibi orta viskoziteli akışkanlara uygundur.
kids.d_en: Rotary vane pumps feature sliding vanes that transfer liquids and deliver smooth, low-pulsation flows, limiting fluid agitation, and are suitable for moving chemically compatible, low- to moderate-viscosity fluids, such as lubricants, solvents, and fuels.

kids.d_tr: Motorlu paletli pompalar, akışkan aktarımında kullanılan motor ve pompa kafasından oluşan komple gruplardır.
kids.d_en: Rotary vane pumps with motor are complete assemblies consisting of a motor and a pump head used to transfer fluid. They feature sliding vanes that slide as the rotor turns during operation to draw liquid into and through the pump housing. They deliver smooth, consistent, low-pulsation flows suitable for moving low- to moderate-viscosity fluids, such as lubricants, solvents, and fuel. These pumps must be chemically compatible with the liquid being transferred. Refer to the manufacturer's chemical compatibility guide for more information.

kids.d_tr: Paletli pompa kafaları motor içermeyen doğrudan tahrikli gruplardır; uyumlu bir motora bağlanarak mevcut sisteme entegre edilir.
kids.d_en: Rotary vane pump heads are direct-drive pump assemblies that do not include a motor; they couple to a compatible motor and can be integrated into an existing original equipment manufacturer (OEM) system, used to retrofit systems, or used with a custom drive configuration. Rotary vane pumps feature sliding vanes that transfer fluids and deliver smooth, consistent, and low-pulsation flows. These pumps are suitable for moving low- to moderate-viscosity fluids, such as lubricants, solvents, and fuels. As the rotor turns during operation, the sliding vanes slide outward to draw liquid into and through the pump housing.

kids.en: Mounting Parts & Accessories for Rotary Vane Pump Heads
kids.d_tr: Paletli pompa montaj parçaları, pompa kafalarını motorlara bağlar.
kids.d_en: Mounting parts and accessories for rotary vane pump heads connect the pump heads to motors.

kids.en: Repair Kits for Rotary Vane Pumps
kids.d_tr: Paletli pompa tamir setleri pompa ömrünü uzatır ve performansı geri kazandırır.
kids.d_en: Repair kits for rotary vane pumps extend pump service life and restore pump performance.

kids.d_tr: Helisel rotorlu pompaların sarmal rotoru elastomer bir stator içinde dönerek düşük darbeli ve düzgün akış verir; viskoz sıvılara uygundur.
kids.d_en: Progressive cavity pumps have a helix-shaped rotor that rotates within an elastomer stator to transfer or meter chemically compatible liquids, delivering consistent, low-pulsation flow, and are suitable for moving viscous, shear-sensitive liquids.

kids.d_tr: Standart emişli helisel rotorlu pompalar düzgün ve düşük darbeli akış verir; viskoz ve hassas sıvıların aktarımına uygundur.
kids.d_en: Standard suction progressive cavity pumps deliver consistent, low-pulsation flow and are suitable transferring and metering viscous and shear-sensitive liquids.

kids.d_tr: Hazneli helisel rotorlu pompalar; çamur, macun ve susuzlaştırılmış katı gibi standart emişe girmeyen yoğun maddeleri aktarır.
kids.d_en: Hopper-feed progressive cavity pumps process and transfer highly-viscous or low-flowing media, such as sludges, pastes, and dewatered solids, that cannot be drawn into a standard suction inlet. These pumps use a feed hopper and an auger to deliver material to the pump's rotor and stator assembly. Progressive cavity pumps deliver consistent, low-pulsation flow and are suitable for handling viscous liquids with gentle, low-shear fluid transfer.

kids.d_tr: Dozajlı helisel rotorlu pompalar su arıtma, imalat ve gıda işlemede hassas ve tekrarlanabilir dozaj verir.
kids.d_en: Metering progressive cavity pumps deliver a precise, accurate, and repeatable dose of chemically compatible liquids across various applications, including water treatment, industrial manufacturing, and food and beverage processing. Progressive cavity pumps deliver consistent, low-pulsation flow and are suitable for handling viscous liquids with gentle, low-shear fluid transfer.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Progressive Cavity Pumps
kids.d_tr: Helisel rotorlu pompa yedek parçaları sık yıpranan parçaları değiştirerek performansı geri kazandırır ve ömrü uzatır.
kids.d_en: Repair parts for progressive cavity pumps replace commonly-worn parts, restoring pump performance and extending service life. The repair parts and kits must match the pump's brand and manufacturer model number. These parts are available in various material options.

kids.d_tr: Varil pompaları tarım, imalat ve filo bakımı gibi sektörlerde varil, kova ve IBC tanklardan sıvıları çeker.
kids.d_en: Drum pumps suction fluids out of drums, barrels, pails, totes, and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) in various industries, including agriculture, manufacturing, sanitation, and fleet maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Manuel endüstriyel varil pompaları kol veya kranklarla elle çalıştırılarak varillerden sıvı aktarır.
kids.d_en: Manually operated industrial drum pumps are powered by hand using a crank, lever, or other mechanism to dispense or transfer liquids from drums and other containers. They are used for various applications that require moving small amounts of fluid and are ideal for job sites without access to a power source. Also known as hand drum pumps, they connect to an adapter that allows the pump tube to be mounted through a container's bung hole.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli varil pompaları prize takılır; manuel pompalardan daha düzenli akış verir ve pnömatiklere göre daha verimlidir.
kids.d_en: Electric drum pumps plug into an electrical outlet, generate a more consistent flow than manually operated pumps, and are more energy-efficient than pneumatic pumps. Also known as electric barrel pumps, these pumps dispense and transfer moderate to large amounts of fluid. These electric-powered drum pumps connect to an adapter that allows the intake shaft of the pump to be mounted through a container's bung hole.

kids.d_tr: Havalı varil pompaları basınçlı hava beslemesiyle çalışarak varil ve kaplardan sıvı çeker.
kids.d_en: Air-operated drum pumps (also called pneumatic or air-operated barrel pumps) run on a compressed air supply to draw fluids from drums and other containers. They dispense or transfer moderate to large amounts of fluid while providing more precise flow control than electric drum pumps and generating higher flow rates than manual drum pumps. They're used for pumping fluids at manufacturing plants, construction sites, automotive shops, and other facilities with shop air systems.

kids.d_tr: Akülü varil pompaları dahili şarjlı bir batarya veya elektrikli el aleti aküsüyle çalışır.
kids.d_en: Cordless battery-powered drum pumps operate on either an internal rechargeable battery or a power tool battery. They generate more consistent flows and move larger amounts of fluid than manually operated drum pumps. These portable, lightweight pumps connect to an adapter that allows the pump's intake shaft to be mounted through the bung hole of a drum or other container.

kids.d_tr: Hidrolik varil pompaları bir hidrolik sisteme bağlanır ve pistonla yağ gibi orta viskoziteli sıvıları aktarır.
kids.d_en: Hydraulic-operated industrial drum pumps connect to a hydraulic system and use a piston to transfer oils and other moderately viscous, compatible liquids stored in containers. The piston moves up to draw in fluids through the suction tube and moves down to push liquids out through the discharge port. They're used on jobsites with access to hydraulic power, such as construction sites that use hydraulic systems to power tools.

kids.d_tr: Manuel hijyenik varil pompaları; gıda, içecek ve ilaç uygulamalarında elle çalıştırılarak varillerden sıvı aktarır.
kids.d_en: Manually operated sanitary drum pumps are powered by hand using a crank, lever, or other mechanism to dispense or transfer liquids from drums and other containers in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and personal care product applications. Also known as sanitary hand drum pumps, they comply with specific hygienic and sanitation standards. These manual drum pumps operate at job sites without access to a power source and are ideal for moving small amounts of fluid. They connect to an adapter that allows the pump shaft to be mounted through a container's bung hole.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli hijyenik varil pompaları prize takılır ve manuel pompalardan daha düzenli bir akış üretir.
kids.d_en: Electric-powered sanitary drum pumps plug into an electrical outlet, providing power to generate more consistent flows than manually operated pumps. They dispense and transfer moderate to large amounts of fluid from drums and other containers in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and personal care product applications. Also known as sanitary electric barrel pumps, they comply with specific hygienic and sanitation standards. They connect to an adapter that allows the intake shaft of the pump to be mounted through a container's bung hole.

kids.d_tr: Havalı hijyenik varil pompaları; gıda, içecek ve ilaç uygulamalarında basınçlı havayla varillerden sıvı çeker.
kids.d_en: Air-operated sanitary drum pumps run on a compressed air supply to draw fluids from drums and other containers in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and personal care product applications. Also called sanitary barrel pumps, they comply with specific hygienic and sanitation standards. These pneumatic pumps dispense or transfer moderate to large amounts of fluid while providing more precise flow control than electric drum pumps and generating higher flow rates than manual drum pumps

kids.d_tr: Tank ve varil pompa sistemleri ekipman ile kaplardan sıvıları çeker ve kendi tanklarında depolar.
kids.d_en: Tank and drum pump systems use their pump to draw out fluids from equipment and containers, then store the fluids in their tank. They are commonly used to collect and transfer fluids in automotive, maintenance, manufacturing, and construction site applications.

kids.d_tr: Varil pompası aksesuar ve parçaları pompaların işlevini artırır veya çalışır durumda kalmalarını sağlar.
kids.d_en: Drum pump accessories and parts enhance the function of drum pumps or keep them in good working order.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt ve AdBlue transfer pompaları otomotiv ve makine bakım uygulamalarında akışkanları aktarır.
kids.d_en: Fuel and DEF transfer pumps move fluids in automotive and machinery maintenance applications.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt transfer pompaları filo, tarım ve inşaat sektörlerinde sabit veya mobil yakıt ikmali için uyumlu yakıtları aktarır.
kids.d_en: Fuel transfer pumps move compatible fuels (e.g., gasoline, kerosene, biodiesel) for mobile or stationary fueling applications in fleet, agriculture, and construction industries, reducing the reliance on outside service stations.

kids.d_tr: AdBlue transfer pompaları aracın AdBlue deposunu doldurur ve depolar arasında sıvı aktarabilir.
kids.d_en: DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pumps fill a vehicle's DEF reservoir and can move DEF between storage containers.

kids.en: Nozzles for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Yakıt transfer tabancaları yakıtın araca aktarılmasına veya kaplar arasında taşınmasına yardımcı olur.
kids.d_en: Nozzles for fuel and DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pumps help transfer fuel to vehicles or move liquids between containers. They control liquid flow produced by a transfer pump, and they connect to discharge hoses and can be paired with swivels to prevent hoses from kinking while fueling.

kids.en: Discharge Hoses for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Hortumlar yakıt ve AdBlue transfer pompalarının çıkış ağzına bağlanır.
kids.d_en: Hoses connect to the discharge port of fuel and DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pumps. They help deliver compatible fluids such as gasoline, diesel, and diesel exhaust fluid, to equipment, vehicles, or other storage containers. Hoses can be outfitted with inline accessories such as breakaways, nozzles, and swivels, further assisting with fuel transfer and reducing wear and damage to hoses.

kids.tr: Döner Başlıklar, Kopma Rakorları ve Adaptörler
kids.en: Swivels, Breakaways & Adaptors for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Döner başlıklar ikmal sırasında hortumun bükülmesini önler; kopma rakorları ise araç hareket ederse sistemi hasardan korur.
kids.d_en: DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pump swivels prevent kinks from occurring during fueling, and breakaways protect against damage to the fueling system in the event of a drive-off. They are inline accessories that connect to hoses, whip hoses, or nozzles.

kids.d_tr: Yakıt transfer pompası filtreleri benzin, motorin ve gazyağı gibi uyumlu yakıtlardaki kirlilikleri giderir.
kids.d_en: Filters for fuel transfer pumps remove contaminants from compatible fuels (e.g., gasoline, diesel, kerosene). Filters install between the pump and discharge hose to prevent damage to the equipment or a vehicle's engine.

kids.en: Meters for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Yakıt transfer sayaçları pompa sistemlerinden verilen yakıt veya AdBlue miktarını ölçer.
kids.d_en: Meters for fuel and DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pumps measure the amount of fuel, DEF, or other similar fluid dispensed through pump systems. These meters help ensure accurate flow measurement, prevent overfilling, and support inventory control in fueling, maintenance, and production operations.

kids.en: Suction Tubes & Hoses for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Emiş boruları ve hortumları transfer pompalarının giriş ağzına bağlanır ve kap ile tanklara daldırılır.
kids.d_en: Suction tubes and hoses connect to the inlet port of fuel and DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pumps and are lowered into containers or tanks. They aid in moving compatible fluids (e.g., diesel, kerosene, diesel exhaust fluid, gasoline) to refuel equipment, transferring fuels and DEF, and emptying containers and tanks.

kids.en: Couplings, Valves & Fittings for DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Kaplin, vana ve rakorlar AdBlue pompası ile kap arasında sızdırmaz bağlantı noktaları oluşturur ve kaba hava girmesini önler.
kids.d_en: Couplings, valves, and fittings help create leak-free connection points between a DEF (diesel exhaust fluid) transfer pump and the container, preventing air from entering the container.

kids.en: Repair Parts for Fuel & DEF Transfer Pumps
kids.d_tr: Yakıt ve AdBlue transfer pompası tamir setleri, aynı marka ve modeldeki ekipmanı çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Repair kits and parts for fuel and DEF (diesel exhaust fuel) transfer pumps keep equipment of the same brand and manufacturer model number operating and in good working order.

kids.d_tr: Kimyasal dozaj pompaları, atık su arıtma ve kimya prosesi gibi uygulamalarda sisteme hassas dozaj veren pozitif deplasmanlı pompalardır.
kids.d_en: Chemical metering pumps are positive-displacement pumps that accurately dose chemically compatible media into a system for various applications, including wastewater treatment, chemical processing, and manufacturing.

kids.en: Fittings & Valves for Chemical Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Rakor ve vanalar sıvı akışını denetler, geri akışı önler ve dozaj pompalarının bütünlüğünü korur.
kids.d_en: Fittings and valves control the flow of liquids, prevent backflow, and protect the integrity of chemical metering pumps.

kids.en: Tubing & Hoses for Chemical Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Hortumlar, kimyasal dozaj pompalarının sıvıyı sistem boyunca taşıyan ayrılmaz bir parçasıdır.
kids.d_en: Tubing is an integral part of chemical metering pumps that transfers liquids through the system. Select tubes with a compatible tubing diameter and pressure rating, and ensure the tube is chemically compatible with the media pumped through the system by consulting the manufacturer's chemical compatibility guide. The tube must also match the brand and model number of the chemical metering pump to ensure proper installation and function.

kids.tr: Hat Tipi Karıştırıcılar ve Akış Göstergeleri
kids.en: In-Line Mixers & Flow Indicators for Chemical Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Hat tipi karıştırıcılar ve akış göstergeleri dozaj pompasının basma hattı üzerine takılır.
kids.d_en: In-line mixers and flow indicators install along the discharge line of a chemical metering pump. They aid chemical metering pump operations and ensure that pumped liquids are homogeneous. Flow indicators indicate fluid is flowing through a system. Select in-line mixers or flow indicators that have a compatible connection size and pressure rating and are chemically compatible with the media pumped through the system.

kids.d_tr: Dozaj pompası kontrolleri belirli zaman aralıklarında veya çalışma sırasında debiyi devreye alır ya da ayarlar.
kids.d_en: Controls for chemical metering pumps actuate or adjust the flow rate at specific time intervals or variably during operation.

kids.en: Feed Tanks for Chemical Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Dozaj besleme tankları, dozaj pompalarıyla verilecek sıvı kimyasalları önceden depolar.
kids.d_en: Feed tanks store liquid chemicals dosed by chemical metering pumps before dosing.

kids.en: Repair Kits & Parts for Peristaltic Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Tamir setleri ve parçaları peristaltik dozaj pompalarını çalışır durumda tutar, performansı geri kazandırır ve duruşu azaltır.
kids.d_en: Repair kits and parts keep peristaltic metering pumps of a compatible brand and manufacturer model number in working condition, restore pump function, reduce downtime, and extend the operating life of equipment.

kids.en: Repair Kits & Parts for Diaphragm Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Tamir setleri ve parçaları yıpranmış bileşenleri değiştirerek diyaframlı dozaj pompalarını çalışır durumda tutar.
kids.d_en: Repair kits and parts replace worn or damaged components to  keep diaphragm metering pumps of a compatible brand and manufacturer model number in working condition.

kids.d_tr: Pompa muhafazaları motoru hava koşullarından ve ortamdaki döküntüden korur.
kids.d_en: Pump covers shield the motor from weather and ambient debris. They allow the pump to be installed outside and mounted on a wall or surface.

kids.en: Mounting Brackets & Shelves for Chemical Metering Pumps
kids.d_tr: Dozaj pompası braketleri ve rafları pompa, tank ve aksesuarların duvara veya çerçeveye montajını destekler.
kids.d_en: Mounting brackets and shelves for chemical metering pumps support the installation of pumps, tanks, and accessories on walls or frames. They keep pump systems organized and off the floor to prevent damage from spills, splashes, and vibration.

kids.d_tr: Püskürtme ve yıkama pompaları yüzeylerdeki kiri temizler veya tarımda ekinlere ilaç uygular.
kids.d_en: Sprayer and washer pumps clean surfaces of dirt or apply herbicides over crops in agricultural applications.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli püskürtme pompaları, elektrik motoruyla tahrik edilen kendinden emişli tek diyaframlı pompalardır.
kids.d_en: Electric sprayer pumps are self-priming, single-diaphragm pumps that are driven by an electric motor. Electric motors are more efficient than air-operated or gas-operated pumps. These pumps are typically used to spray herbicides in agricultural applications or general transfer applications.

kids.d_tr: Havalı püskürtme pompaları basınçlı havayla tahrik edilen kendinden emişli tek diyaframlı pompalardır.
kids.d_en: Air-operated sprayer pumps are single-diaphragm, self-priming pumps driven by compressed air. They produce constant flow and pressure rates. These pumps can be turned off when not in use, minimizing wear on the pump. Sprayer pumps are typically used to apply herbicides in agricultural or general transfer applications.

kids.d_tr: Makaralı püskürtme pompaları dönen makaralarıyla sıvıyı içeri çeker, hapseder ve çıkış ağzından dışarı iter.
kids.d_en: Roller spray pumps use a series of rotating rollers to draw in, trap, and push liquids through the pump and out through the discharge port. These pumps are self-priming pumps, requiring initial priming before first use. Roller spray pumps are commonly used to spray weed repellents in lawn care applications or can be attached to a tractor with a power take-off (PTO) coupler to spray pesticides in agricultural applications.

kids.d_tr: Yıkama makinesi pompaları püskürtme pompalarından daha yüksek basınca ulaşarak beton ve ahşap yüzeylerdeki kiri temizler.
kids.d_en: Pressure washer pumps reach higher pounds per square inch (PSI) than sprayer pumps to clean debris, build-up, and dirt from various surfaces such as concrete, wooden decks, and sidings.

kids.en: Repair Kits for Electric Sprayer Pumps
Repair Kits for Roller Spray Pumps
PTO Couplings for Roller Spray Pumps
kids.d_tr: Kuyruk mili kaplinleri ağır hizmet araç motorlarının tahrik millerini makaralı püskürtme pompalarına bağlar.
kids.d_en: Power take-off (PTO) couplings connect drive shafts from heavy-duty vehicle motors to roller spray pumps. PTO couplings are typically used in the agricultural industry, driving sprayer pumps attached to tractors treating crops with herbicides. The pump's and the PTO coupling's shafts must match in size and style.

kids.en: Chemical Injectors for Pressure Washer Pumps

kids.d_tr: Bağlantı elemanları yıkama makinesi pompalarını bir yüzeye sabitler.
kids.d_en: Mounts secure pressure washer pumps to a surface. They minimize the likelihood of knocking over or inadvertently moving the pump during operation.

kids.tr: Havuz Havalandırma, Fıskiye ve Şelale Pompaları
kids.d_tr: Havuz ve atık su havalandırıcıları hava kabarcıklarıyla suyu devirerek su kalitesini artırır.
kids.d_en: Pond and wastewater aerators turn over water with air bubbles to improve water quality.

kids.d_tr: Havuz ve atık su havalandırıcıları hava kabarcıklarıyla suyu devirerek su kalitesini artırır.
kids.d_en: Pond and wastewater aerators turn over water with air bubbles to improve water quality.

kids.d_tr: Dekoratif fıskiye pompaları suda yüzer ve farklı desenlerde su püskürtür.
kids.d_en: Decorative fountain pumps float and spray water in different patterns. These pumps function primarily for aesthetic purposes and do not effectively aerate a body of water.

kids.tr: Havuz Bakım, Temizlik ve Aydınlatma Ürünleri
kids.en: Pond, Fountain & Waterfall Treatment, Cleaning & Lights
kids.d_tr: Havuz ve fıskiye aydınlatmaları havuz ya da fıskiyenin estetik görünümünü iyileştirir.
kids.d_en: Pond and fountain lights improve the aesthetic quality of a pond or fountain.

kids.d_tr: Hidrostatik test pompaları kontrollü basınç uygulayarak boru, hortum ve silindirlerdeki kaçakları ve basınç dayanımını denetler.
kids.d_en: Hydrostatic test pumps apply controlled pressure to identify leaks and test the pressure integrity of components and systems, such as piping, hoses, and hydraulic cylinders; critical for safety, compliance, and preventative maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Elektrikli test pompaları elektrik motoruyla çalışır; egzoz tahliyesinin güç olduğu kapalı alanlara uygundur.
kids.d_en: Electric hydrostatic test pumps are powered by an electric motor, making them suitable for indoor or enclosed areas where ventilating engine emissions may be difficult or impossible, or access to compressed air is unavailable. Hydrostatic test pumps apply controlled pressure to identify leaks and test the pressure integrity of components and systems, such as piping, hoses, and hydraulic cylinders; critical for safety, compliance, and preventative maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Havalı test pompaları basınçlı havayla çalışır; doğru topraklandığında kıvılcım üretmez, patlayıcı ortamlara uygundur.
kids.d_en: Air-operated hydrostatic test pumps are powered by compressed air, generate pressure without sparking when properly grounded, and are for environments containing hazardous, explosive, or easily ignitable materials. Hydrostatic test pumps apply controlled pressure to identify leaks and test the pressure integrity of components and systems, such as piping, hoses, and hydraulic cylinders; critical for safety, compliance, and preventative maintenance.

kids.d_tr: Motorlu test pompaları benzinli motorla çalışır; elektrik ve basınçlı hava erişimi kısıtlı uzak noktalara uygundur.
kids.d_en: Engine-driven hydrostatic test pumps are powered by a gas-powered engine and suited for remote or outdoor locations where access to electricity or compressed air is limited or unavailable.
